AI.motivation: 跨硬件评估常假设架构排名能跨设备迁移，从而可用代理设备支持目标端模型选择，但这一假设在联合延迟-能耗可行性场景下未被严格检验。
AI.method: 在两个公开架构族上压力测试该假设：NAS-Bench-201上进行跨设备排名相关性分析并引入忠实AdaProxy诊断；用精确有限样本split-conformal分析校准证据需求；再在HW-GPT-Bench的13台设备、10,000个GPT架构上复现。
AI.result: NAS-Bench-201上跨设备排名相关性中等，可行集重叠不完整；AdaProxy显著改善延迟排名，说明边界失效非源于适配弱。有限一侧90%阈值至少需9个校准观测。HW-GPT-Bench上相对RTX3080代理，目标延迟SRCC为0.951-0.996，但匹配联合约束下代理复用违规风险高达33.3%-100%。
AI.conclusion: 排名可迁移性、可行性可迁移性与目标特定决策支持是三个不同的评估对象，跨设备评估应报告哪些目标环境真正支持所声称的工作点。

title: DeepInstructor: An Agentic AI Instructor for Experience-Driven Idea Evaluation
summary: As automated scientific discovery advances, Large Language Models (LLMs) can now generate research ideas at an unprecedented scale, shifting the bottleneck from idea generation to idea evaluation. Existing evaluators mainly rely on parametric LLM knowledge or unstructured retrieval, producing judgments that lack the experience-grounded reasoning used by human instructors. To address this, we propose DeepInstructor, an agentic framework that formulates idea evaluation as reasoning over structured scholarly experience. DeepInstructor constructs an Experience Graph from 58,607 peer reviews and employs a ReAct-based agent to retrieve dimension-specific evidence for traceable evaluation. We further introduce DeepInstruct, a dataset with controlled pairwise comparisons across novelty, significance, and feasibility. Experiments show that DeepInstructor substantially outperforms existing baselines, improving Hit@1 and Hit@2 alignment with human judgments by 24.4% and 29.7%, respectively. Our findings suggest that scientific idea evaluation can be grounded in explicit reasoning over structured scholarly experience

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DeepInstructor，将科研想法评估建模为对结构化学术经验的推理，通过经验图与 ReAct 智能体实现可追溯评估，并发布 DeepInstruct 数据集。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 大规模生成科研想法，瓶颈已从想法生成转向想法评估。现有评估器依赖参数化知识或无结构化检索，缺乏类似人类导师的经验支撑推理。
AI.method: 构建基于 58,607 条同行评审的 Experience Graph；使用 ReAct 智能体检索维度特定证据，实现可追溯评估；提出 DeepInstruct 数据集，包含新颖性、重要性、可行性的受控成对比较。
AI.result: DeepInstructor 显著优于现有基线，与人类判断的对齐度上，Hit@1 和 Hit@2 分别提升 24.4% 和 29.7%。
AI.conclusion: 科研想法评估可建立在结构化学术经验的显式推理之上。

title: IntLawNER: A Named Entity Recognition Dataset and Benchmark in International Law
summary: International law provides the normative framework through which states coordinate action, regulate armed conflict, and protect human rights, yet its texts remain without token-level named entity recognition (NER) resources. We introduce IntLawNER, a NER dataset and benchmark for codified sources of international law, covering 2,987 gold-annotated sentences and 8,094 entity spans from International Court of Justice (ICJ) decisions, UN Security Council resolutions, and European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) judgments, annotated with seven institution-specific entity types. We construct IntLawNER with a cost-effective hybrid algorithmic-agentic pipeline that reduces 468k source sentences to a compact annotation set through candidate retrieval, LLM-based vetting, and human review, with 89.6% of gold spans accepted unchanged from the silver layer. However, the silver-to-gold analysis reveals that human-machine aggregate agreement metrics can be misleading in domain-specific NER: Cohen's kappa=0.964 on boundary-matched spans masks a macro-F1 of 0.753 when missing entities, boundary errors, and label corrections are included. The benchmark shows that zero-shot span-based GLiNER collapses on entity types dependent on institutional function rather than surface form (0.243 micro-F1), while fine-tuned transformers struggle on rare labels. Carefully selected few-shot examples that demonstrate label contrasts improve every LLM over zero-shot prompting, with Claude Opus 4.6 reaching the best score of 0.873 micro-F1. We release IntLawNER as a benchmark and reusable resource for extracting references in international legal texts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IntLawNER，国际法领域首个token级命名实体识别数据集与基准，涵盖ICJ、联合国安理会和ECtHR文本中的2,987句、8,094个实体，并揭示人机一致性指标在领域NER中的误导性。
AI.motivation: 国际法是各国协调、规制武装冲突与保护人权的规范框架，但其文本缺乏token级NER资源；现有领域NER数据和评估方法难以适用于国际法这一特定领域。
AI.method: 采用成本有效的混合"算法—智能体"流水线：经候选检索、LLM审核与人工复核，将468k源句压缩为紧凑标注集，构建含七类机构特定实体类型的IntLawNER，并设计zero-shot、fine-tuned及few-shot LLM基准实验。
AI.result: 89.6%的金标span从银标层原样接受；边界匹配span上Cohen's kappa=0.964，但计入漏标、边界错误与标签修正后macro-F1仅0.753。zero-shot GLiNER在依赖机构职能（非表层形式）的实体上micro-F1仅0.243；微调Transformer在稀有标签上表现欠佳；精心挑选的few-shot示例可提升所有LLM，Claude Opus 4.6最高达0.873 micro-F1。
AI.conclusion: IntLawNER作为国际法文本实体抽取的基准与可复用资源发布，同时警示领域NER中聚合一致性指标可能掩盖实际质量问题，few-shot示例设计对LLM性能提升显著。

authors: Sjors G. J. G. In 't Veld
title: A Comparative Framework for Evaluating Foundation Models on Tabular Data: A Case Study in Healthcare
summary: Tabular data is the most common format in clinical practice, encompassing laboratory results, medication records, diagnostic codes, and patient demographics. As foundation models for tabular data have grown in number and variety, a practical question has become harder to answer: which model should a clinician or data scientist actually choose for a given task, and why? Existing surveys catalogue what these models can do, but they stop short of providing a structured way to compare them against the specific demands of a real application. We introduce \system{}, a comparative evaluation framework that scores and ranks tabular foundation models (TFMs) across six clinically meaningful dimensions: how well a model generalizes to new datasets, how effectively it protects patient privacy, how much data it needs to perform well, how it scales with growing datasets and feature spaces, how interpretable its predictions are to clinicians, and how fairly it performs across patient subgroups. Each dimension is broken down into measurable sub-components, and groups of sub-components can optionally be combined into supplementary compound scores, called super-metrics, that provide a diagnostic view of how a model performs across several dimensions simultaneously. To show how the framework works in practice, we apply it to two healthcare use cases, screening for iron deficiency and predicting heart failure, demonstrating how the same set of metrics leads to different model rankings depending on what matters most in each clinical context. We also provide a taxonomy of 45 TFMs organized by their underlying architecture, which serves as a reference for researchers and practitioners looking to navigate this rapidly expanding field.

AI.tldr: 提出一个针对表格基础模型（TFM）的比较评估框架，从六个临床维度打分排名，并用两个医疗用例展示不同临床情境下模型排名差异，同时提供45个TFM的分类。
AI.motivation: 表格数据在临床中极为常见，TFM数量繁多，医生或数据科学家难以判断该选用哪个模型及原因。现有综述只列举能力，缺乏结合真实应用需求的结构化比较方法。
AI.method: 构建比较评估框架，从六个临床意义维度对TFM打分排名：泛化能力、隐私保护、数据需求、可扩展性、可解释性、跨亚组公平性。每个维度拆分为可测量子项，并可组合为super-metrics提供多维度诊断视图。框架应用于铁缺乏筛查和心衰预测两个用例。
AI.result: 同一组指标在两个临床用例中导致不同的模型排名，取决于各情境最看重的维度；并提供按底层架构组织的45个TFM分类。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为临床实践中选择TFM提供了结构化、需求导向的比较方法，TFM分类可作为研究与从业者导航该领域的参考。

title: Exact Controllability of Backward-Structured Mean-Field SDEs: Hautus Criteria and Initial-Time Dichotomy
summary: This paper studies exact controllability of linear mean-field stochastic differential equations with backward-structure. We establish Hautus criteria and uncover a sharp dichotomy between the zero initial time and positive initial times. At time zero, exact controllability is characterized by a Hautus condition for the mean dynamics, with additional control directions generated by the centered stochastic dynamics. At any positive initial time, exact controllability further requires a stochastic Hautus condition for the centered system. Unlike the classical eigenvector-based condition, this stochastic criterion is formulated in terms of positive-semidefinite eigenmatrices of an associated Lyapunov-type operator. The dichotomy arises from the triviality of the initial sigma-field. We also clarify the controllability relations among the corresponding ODE, SDE, and mean-field SDE systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有后向结构的线性平均场随机微分方程的精确可控性，建立了Hautus判据，并揭示了初始时刻为零与正初始时刻之间的鲜明二分性。
AI.motivation: 刻画平均场随机系统在不同初始时刻的精确可控性条件，厘清ODE、SDE与平均场SDE系统之间可控性的关系，并理解初始sigma域平凡性带来的本质差异。
AI.method: 建立线性平均场后向结构随机微分方程的Hautus判据；在零时刻用均值动态的Hautus条件加中心化随机动态产生的额外控制方向刻画可控性；在正初始时刻进一步对中心化系统引入随机Hautus条件，该条件基于Lyapunov型算子的半正定特征矩阵表述。
AI.result: 发现零初始时刻与正初始时刻之间的可控性二分性：零时刻仅需均值Hautus条件及额外控制方向，而正初始时刻还需中心化系统的随机Hautus条件；该随机判据不同于经典基于特征向量的条件。
AI.conclusion: 二分性源于初始sigma域的平凡性；同时厘清了对应ODE、SDE与平均场SDE系统之间的可控性关系。

title: TEMPER: Temporal Encoder-Masked Probabilistic Ensemble Regressor for Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Probabilistic forecasting requires accurate central predictions and calibrated uncertainty estimates. This paper presents TEMPER, the Temporal Encoder-Masked Probabilistic Ensemble Regressor, a univariate time-series forecasting algorithm that combines a temporal autoencoder, a differentiable masked neural decision forest, continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) training, and Gaussian-mixture post-processing. The R implementation is built on torch for R and returns horizon-wise density, distribution, quantile, and sampler functions. We evaluate TEMPER on three deterministic synthetic level series with trend, periodic, regime-switching, nonlinear-threshold, and heteroskedastic components. Across 96 rolling-origin forecasts at horizons t + 1, t + 5, t + 20, and t + 60, TEMPER obtains 2.824% mean CRPS normalized by origin level, 3.635% median absolute error, and 68.8% empirical 90% interval coverage after training with a 300-epoch cap and early-stopping patience of 100. A naive persistence bootstrap has the best aggregate CRPS, 2.763%, while TEMPER has the best median absolute error and the best CRPS at t+1 and t+5. The ablation study uses matched series-origin-horizon cells, horizon-wise CRPS deltas, endpoint sensitivity summaries, and a calibration-specific interval study. Relaxing the learned mask improves average CRPS by 0.472 percentage points on the ablation subset, mainly through long-horizon gains. A twofold interval inflation improves held-out coverage from 54.2% to 91.7% and gives the best 90% interval score among tested calibration rules. The results identify calibration, horizon-specific tuning, and component selection as the central research priorities.

AI.tldr: TEMPER结合时序自编码器、可微掩码神经决策森林、CRPS训练与高斯混合后处理，用于单变量概率预测，R语言基于torch实现。
AI.motivation: 概率预测需兼顾中心预测准确性与不确定性校准，本文旨在构建兼具两者能力的单变量时序预测算法。
AI.method: 融合时序自编码器、可微掩码神经决策森林、连续排序概率分数(CRPS)训练与高斯混合后处理，输出逐horizon的密度、分布、分位数与采样函数。
AI.result: 96次滚动起点预测中，TEMPER归一化CRPS 2.824%、中位绝对误差3.635%、90%区间覆盖68.8%；朴素持续bootstrap的聚合CRPS最优(2.763%)，但TEMPER在t+1、t+5的CRPS与整体中位绝对误差最优。放宽掩码使CRPS改善0.472个百分点；区间放大两倍将覆盖由54.2%提升至91.7%。
AI.conclusion: 校准、horizon专属调参与组件选择是未来核心研究方向。

title: Recursive Parameter Identification of Nonlinear Stochastic State-Space Models via Sequentialized Ensemble Kalman Inversion
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
summary: Recursive parameter identification in nonlinear stochastic state-space models is challenging because unknown parameters affect the measurements through latent-state dynamics. This paper develops a sequentialized ensemble Kalman inversion method for recursive parameter identification from streaming measurements. The proposed method represents the parameter posterior by an evolving ensemble and updates it sequentially as new measurements become available. For each parameter ensemble member, implicit particle filtering is used to approximate the predictive observation statistics required for parameter correction. This formulation enables recursive parameter learning. The method is evaluated on a strongly nonlinear benchmark, with comparison to several existing methods, and then on a nonlinear double-capacitor lithium-ion battery model. The numerical results demonstrate accurate recursive parameter identification and latent-state estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出序贯化集合卡尔曼反演方法，结合隐式粒子滤波，实现非线性随机状态空间模型中的递推参数辨识与隐状态估计。
AI.motivation: 非线性随机状态空间模型中，未知参数通过隐状态动态影响观测，导致递推参数辨识困难。
AI.method: 用演化集合表示参数后验并随新测量序贯更新；对每个参数集合成员采用隐式粒子滤波近似参数校正所需的预测观测统计量，从而实现递推参数学习。
AI.result: 在强非线性基准问题上与多种现有方法对比，并在非线性双电容锂离子电池模型上验证，数值结果实现了准确的递推参数辨识和隐状态估计。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能有效进行非线性随机状态空间模型的递推参数辨识，验证了其准确性与实用性。

title: StationPDE: Station-Oriented Surface PDE Learning for Multi-Station Multivariate Weather Forecasting
summary: Multi-station multivariate weather forecasting aims to forecast future weather variables at multiple weather stations from historical surface observations. Existing station forecasting models learn statistical dependencies among discrete stations, but lack explicit physical evolution. Meanwhile, PDE-based weather models provide interpretable physical dynamics, yet require continuous fields and upper-air variables unavailable in surface station data. To bridge this gap, we propose StationPDE, a station-oriented surface PDE learning model. StationPDE constructs a terrain-aware continuous surface field from discrete station observations and decomposes its physical evolution into surface wind transport and upper-air inference. Surface wind transport explicitly evolves observable weather variables, while upper-air inference uses learnable horizontal diffusion to approximate the missing influence of unavailable upper-air variables. A parallel data-driven diffusion branch captures complementary motion patterns, and an adaptive router integrates the two forecasts for station-level multivariate forecasting. Experiments on Weather2K and MeteoNet show that StationPDE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MSE by about $9.6\%$ on average compared with the strongest baseline. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/hnu-vis/StationPDE.

AI.tldr: 提出 StationPDE，一种面向站点地表PDE学习模型，将离散站点观测构建为连续地表场，通过地表风传输与高空推断建模物理演化，在多站点多元天气预报上优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有站点预报模型只学习离散站点间的统计依赖，缺乏显式物理演化；而基于PDE的天气模型虽可解释，却需要连续场和高空变量，地表站点数据不具备。
AI.method: 从离散站点观测构建地形感知的连续地表场，将物理演化分解为地表风传输（演化可观测变量）与高空推断（用可学习水平扩散近似缺失的高空影响）；并行数据驱动扩散分支捕获互补运动模式，自适应路由器融合两路预报进行站点级多元预报。
AI.result: 在 Weather2K 和 MeteoNet 上持续优于SOTA基线，相比最强基线平均降低MSE约9.6%。
AI.conclusion: StationPDE 用物理启发的PDE学习弥合了纯数据驱动站点模型与PDE天气模型之间的差距，实现可解释且高精度的站点地表天气预报。

title: Evaluating Fine-Tuned and Base Language Models in Maternal and Vaccination Healthcare for African Settings
summary: Background: Large language models (LLMs) can improve healthcare information delivery in low-resource settings but may produce inaccurate or culturally inappropriate advice. This study evaluated domain-specific fine-tuning for maternal health and vaccination in Nigeria. Objective: To compare HelpMum's MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama with Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for accuracy, safety, clarity, contextual appropriateness, and trustworthiness. Methods: We evaluated 200 healthcare questions, 100 each for maternal health and vaccination, across five subdomains per domain. MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation on over 36,000 maternal health and 9,000 vaccination question-answer pairs, respectively. Two Nigerian licensed physicians independently rated responses using a 5-point Likert scale. Paired comparisons used Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Results: Performance varied by domain. MamaBot-Llama significantly outperformed the base model across all criteria, with a 4.9% overall improvement (p < .001), including gains in clinical trustworthiness (+7%) and medical accuracy (+5%). Critical issues decreased by 50%, and clinicians preferred it in 78% of cases. In contrast, Vax-Llama showed a 5.2% overall decline (p < .001), with critical issues increasing by 192% and safety concerns by 400%. Conclusions: Domain-specific fine-tuning can improve healthcare LLM performance when based on high-quality, clinician-curated data, but may also degrade performance when dataset quality is inadequate. Rigorous domain-specific validation is essential before clinical deployment. Physician evaluators provided informed consent, and chatbot logs were anonymized. Keywords: Large language models; Fine-tuning; Maternal health; Vaccination; Healthcare AI; Low-resource settings; Nigeria; Model evaluation; LoRA; Medical accuracy

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了尼日利亚母婴健康与疫苗接种领域的LLM微调效果：MamaBot-Llama显著优于基线模型（整体+4.9%），而Vax-Llama反而下降了5.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM可改善低资源环境的医疗信息传递，但可能产生不准确或不符合文化的建议，因此需要验证领域特定微调的实际效果。
AI.method: 使用200个医疗问题（母婴健康、疫苗接种各100个，每领域5个子领域），通过LoRA对MamaBot-Llama（36,000+母婴QA对）和Vax-Llama（9,000疫苗接种QA对）进行微调；两名尼日利亚执业医师用5点Likert量表独立评分，采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行配对比较。
AI.result: MamaBot-Llama在所有标准上显著优于基线模型，整体提升4.9%（p<.001），临床可信度+7%、医学准确性+5%，关键问题减少50%，临床医生78%情况下更偏好它；Vax-Llama整体下降5.2%（p<.001），关键问题增加192%，安全问题增加400%。
AI.conclusion: 基于高质量、由临床医生整理的数据进行领域特定微调可提升医疗LLM性能，但数据集质量不足时反而会降低性能；临床部署前必须进行严格的领域特定验证。

title: EvidenT: Building Trustworthy Enterprise Assistants through Evidence Groundedness and Traceability
summary: Enterprise AI assistants must produce responses that are verifiable and traceable to source evidence. However, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) over heterogeneous enterprise data can suffer from citation drift, unsupported content, and weak source traceability. We present EvidenT (T = Trust + Transparency + Traceability), a lightweight pipeline that verifies extracted evidence against retrieved documents before answer generation, without model retraining. EvidenT combines structured passage extraction with deterministic lexical alignment to filter unsupported content, correct citation drift, and preserve source-span traceability. On approximately 500 real enterprise queries, EvidenT improves gold-source hit rate by an average of 29% over prompting baselines, produces no citations to nonretrieved urls, and achieves near-saturated answer-to-source lexical coverage.

AI.tldr: EvidenT 是一个轻量级、无需重训练的流水线，在答案生成前对检索文档中的证据进行验证，以解决企业 RAG 中的引用漂移、无支撑内容和溯源薄弱问题。
AI.motivation: 企业 AI 助手需要可验证、可溯源的回答，但异构企业数据上的 RAG 存在引用漂移、无支撑内容和溯源薄弱等问题。
AI.method: EvidenT 结合结构化段落抽取与确定性词法对齐，在生成答案前对抽取的证据与检索文档进行验证，从而过滤无支撑内容、纠正引用漂移并保留源片段可追溯性，且无需模型重训练。
AI.result: 在约 500 个真实企业查询上，EvidenT 相比提示基线将金标来源命中率平均提升 29%，不产生对未检索 URL 的引用，并实现接近饱和的答案-来源词法覆盖度。
AI.conclusion: EvidenT 提供了一种无需重训练的轻量方案，可有效提升企业 RAG 的引用准确性、可验证性与源可追溯性。

title: A scenario-cluster-based and enhanced progressive hedging algorithm for the two-stage stochastic quadratic knapsack problem
summary: This paper introduces the two-stage stochastic quadratic knapsack problem (TSSQKP) with uncertainty in profits and weights. To overcome the computational difficulties arising from the combined stochastic, binary, and quadratic structure, we propose a solution framework that integrates an adaptation of the progressive hedging algorithm with clustering-based scenario reduction. The enhanced progressive hedging algorithm (EPHA) incorporates a rounding procedure and a dynamic penalty update strategy driven by the detection of oscillation and stagnation patterns. In parallel, we propose a clustering framework based on opportunity-cost distances between scenarios, from which we derive the medoid lower bound (MLB), the cluster lower bound (CLB) and the cluster upper bound (CUB). To further improve computational efficiency, EPHA is also used to solve the cluster subproblems heuristically; in this case, the resulting upper bound is referred to as the estimated cluster upper bound (ECUB), and the corresponding gaps are interpreted as estimated optimality gaps. Computational experiments on 800 generated TSSQKP instances show that the proposed framework yields smaller gaps than CPLEX under comparable computational conditions. In the EPHA-based clustering framework, the average estimated gaps associated with the CLB, EPHA and MLB 1.65%, 1.88% and 2.41% respectively, compared with an average optimality gap of 35.86% for CPLEX. MLB is fastest to compute, with an average execution time of 420.88s, while EPHA provides a favourable compromise between solution quality and computational effort, reducing the average computational time associated with the cluster bounds by approximately 52.7%, while increasing the average estimated gap by only 0.23 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带利润和权重不确定性的两阶段随机二次背包问题（TSSQKP），提出结合改进渐进对冲算法与聚类场景缩减的求解框架，实验表明其间隙远小于CPLEX。
AI.motivation: TSSQKP同时具有随机、二元和二次结构，计算极其困难，需要有效的求解框架。
AI.method: 提出整合改进渐进对冲算法（EPHA）与聚类场景缩减的框架。EPHA含舍入过程及基于振荡、停滞检测的动态惩罚更新策略；聚类框架基于场景间机会成本距离，导出MLB、CLB、CUB界，并用EPHA启发式求解簇子问题得到ECUB。
AI.result: 800个实例实验中，框架间隙小于CPLEX。CLB、EPHA、MLB平均估计间隙为1.65%、1.88%、2.41%，而CPLEX平均最优间隙达35.86%。MLB计算最快（420.88秒），EPHA在解质量与计算量间折中，计算时间减少约52.7%，间隙仅增加0.23个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架在可比计算条件下优于CPLEX，EPHA提供了良好的解质量与效率平衡。

title: On Generalized Naive Bayes with Continuous Features
summary: The Generalized Naive Bayes (GNB) model was introduced for discrete and categorical random variables as an extension of classic Naive Bayes. We now accommodate the GNB framework to continuous explanatory variables. A central result of the paper is that structure learning of the GNB depends only on the pair copulas of the bi-variate marginals. We proved that the GNB structure can be assigned to the basis of a matroid, therefore we give greedy algorithms for finding the optimal GNB structure on the training data, in sense of minimizing Kullback-Leibler divergence. Three cases are considered: joint Gaussian distribution, then a more flexible model where we suppose the dependence structure to be described by a Gaussian copula with arbitrary marginals, and an even more flexible case where the joint continuous probability distribution is arbitrary, i.e. copula and marginal distributions are arbitrary. A method for model reduction, based on the newly introduced concept of GNB forest is given. We close the paper by comparing the newly introduced GNB classification results to other classical "glass-box" algorithms on real datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文将广义朴素贝叶斯(GNB)框架从离散/分类变量推广到连续解释变量，证明其结构学习仅依赖二元边际的pair copula，并基于matroid理论给出贪心算法以最小化KL散度，还提出GNB森林进行模型约简。
AI.motivation: 经典Naive Bayes及其广义(GNB)版本此前仅针对离散和分类随机变量，无法直接处理连续解释变量，因此需要将GNB框架扩展到连续情形。
AI.method: 将GNB推广到连续解释变量；证明结构学习只取决于二元边际的pair copulas；证明GNB结构可归于matroid的基，从而给出在训练数据上最小化KL散度的贪心算法。分三种情形讨论：(1)联合高斯分布；(2)高斯copula配任意边际；(3)copula与边际均任意的联合连续分布。并提出基于新概念"GNB森林"的模型约简方法。
AI.result: 给出三种不同灵活度下的结构学习方法与模型约简方法；并在真实数据集上将GNB分类结果与其它经典"glass-box"算法进行比较。
AI.conclusion: GNB框架可有效扩展到连续变量，结构学习由pair copula决定且可用matroid贪心算法高效求解，GNB森林支持模型约简，分类性能在真实数据上与经典glass-box算法具可比性。

title: Distributed ISAC-Enabled Multimodal Recovery of Missing 2-D LiDAR Measurements
summary: Recovering missing regions in 2-D LiDAR scans is crucial for maintaining geometric awareness in environmental sensing. LiDAR-only reconstruction relies on measurements surrounding the missing region and can degrade as the unobserved sector grows or the surface geometry becomes more complex. This paper presents a distributed integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that uses directional 60-GHz beam-training measurements from multiple receivers to assist in the recovery of missing regions in 2-D LiDAR scans. Transmitter and receiver positions, beam directions, and relative beam-power thresholding are used to construct an RF-derived surface prior without requiring RF time-of-flight measurements. The resulting RF-derived range estimates are then fused with LiDAR measurements to estimate the missing geometry. The proposed framework is evaluated in an indoor environment using LiDAR and 60-GHz phased-array measurements from 55 receiver viewpoints comprising 37,620 beam-pair power measurements across 72 controlled missing-sector cases. The results show that RF-assisted reconstruction provides larger accuracy gains as the missing-sector width increases. For the 80-degree missing-sector case investigated in this paper, RF+polar fusion is shown to reduce the mean absolute error (MAE) from 2.271 m for polar LiDAR interpolation to 0.617 m, corresponding to a 72.8% reduction. The results further show that useful RF-assisted recovery can be maintained even with fewer beam-pair measurements under limited beam training. These findings demonstrate that directional communication measurements can support environmental sensing by providing complementary geometric information for missing LiDAR regions.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式ISAC框架，用多接收机60GHz波束训练测量辅助恢复2-D LiDAR缺失区域。
AI.motivation: LiDAR-only重建依赖缺失区周围测量，当未观测扇区增大或表面几何复杂时性能下降，需引入互补信息。
AI.method: 利用发射/接收位置、波束方向和相对波束功率阈值构建RF表面先验（无需RF飞行时间），得到距离估计后与LiDAR测量融合；在室内用55个接收视角、37,620组波束对、72种缺失扇区场景评估。
AI.result: 缺失扇区越宽，RF辅助增益越大；80度缺失时RF+极坐标融合将MAE从2.271 m降至0.617 m（降72.8%）；有限波束训练下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 方向性通信测量可为缺失LiDAR区域提供互补几何信息，支撑环境感知。

title: SolarFlowRefiner: Refinement-Aware Flow Matching for Surface Solar Radiation Downscaling
summary: High-resolution surface solar radiation (SSR) is important for solar forecasting and grid operation. However, physically consistent reanalysis products are too coarse to resolve localized cloud-driven variability. In this paper, we study a multisource downscaling task that reconstructs high-resolution SolarCube SSR fields from coarse ERA5 radiative variables and co-registered satellite channels. The task is challenging because a single ERA5 grid cell may contain both sunlit and cloud-shadowed regions. As a result, the missing high-resolution correction can be spatially sharp and inherently ambiguous. One-stage predictors often oversmooth these structures. Post-hoc refinement also introduces a stage-wise mismatch: the generator is optimized independently, even though its output determines the refiner's initial state. We introduce SolarFlowRefiner, a refinement-aware flow-matching framework for SSR downscaling. A conditional FlowMatch generator first predicts a normalized correction to an upsampled ERA5 baseline. The refiner is then trained on prediction-conditioned states between the current FlowMatch output and the target residual. This exposes the refiner to the structured errors produced by the generator. The refinement objective is also backpropagated through the FlowMatch sampler, allowing generation and correction to be jointly optimized for the final reconstruction. Experiments on a day-blocked ERA5--SolarCube benchmark show consistent improvements over standalone generation and post-hoc refinement. More broadly, SolarFlowRefiner provides a general strategy for coupling generative predictors with iterative correctors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SolarFlowRefiner，一个"精炼感知"的流匹配框架，用于从粗分辨率 ERA5 与卫星通道重建高分辨率地表太阳辐射（SSR）。通过条件 FlowMatch 生成器与在预测状态上训练的 refiner 联合优化，缓解过平滑与阶段不匹配问题，在 ERA5–SolarCube 基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率 SSR 对光伏预测和电网调度很重要，但物理一致的重分析产品（如 ERA5）分辨率过粗，无法刻画局地云致变化。该下采样任务困难之处在于单个 ERA5 格点可能同时包含日照区与云影区，缺失的高分辨率修正既空间锐利又本质歧义；单阶段预测器往往过度平滑，而事后精炼又会因生成器独立优化、而其输出决定精炼器初始状态，造成阶段间不匹配。
AI.method: 提出 SolarFlowRefiner：先由条件 FlowMatch 生成器对上采样 ERA5 基线预测归一化修正；再在"当前 FlowMatch 输出与目标残差之间"的预测条件状态上训练 refiner，使其暴露于生成器产生的结构化误差；并将精炼目标反向通过 FlowMatch 采样器，使生成与修正针对最终重建联合优化。
AI.result: 在按天分块的 ERA5–SolarCube 基准上，方法相比独立生成与事后精炼均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: SolarFlowRefiner 为将生成式预测器与迭代修正器耦合提供了一种通用策略。

title: Beyond the Text: Verifying That Agent-Written Papers Are Backed by Their Artifacts
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly capable of conducting research autonomously, producing research documents alongside the code and experiments that ostensibly support them. Yet whether the reported findings are consistently supported by corresponding implementations and execution evidence remains largely unexplored: existing review practices primarily assess textual quality and cannot reliably identify inconsistencies such as hard-coded metrics, unimplemented methods, or unsupported experimental results. We present ReAgent, an automated auditing framework for assessing the consistency between agent-generated research documents and their associated repositories. ReAgent constructs structured representations of scientific claims from research documents and uses them to guide repository analysis and evidence collection. Static auditing examines whether claimed methodologies, implementations, and experimental configurations are consistently reflected in the repository, while dynamic auditing executes relevant experiments and collects execution evidence to assess empirical findings. By combining static analysis with dynamic evidence, ReAgent identifies inconsistencies that may remain hidden under either perspective alone, such as experiments that reproduce reported numbers while deviating from the claimed methodology. The collected evidence and audit decisions are organized into a structured repository-level audit report, enabling transparent evidence traceability. We evaluate ReAgent on a manually curated benchmark of agent-generated research document--repository pairs and compare it against representative static and reproduction-based baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that ReAgent effectively identifies inconsistencies between reported research findings and their supporting repository evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出ReAgent框架，通过静态与动态审计，自动核查LLM智能体生成的研究文档与其代码仓库间的一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可自主产研究文档及配套代码，但报告结论是否被实现与执行证据支持尚不明确；现有评审主要评估文本质量，难以发现硬编码指标、方法未实现、实验结果无支撑等不一致。
AI.method: 从研究文档中构建结构化科学断言表示，引导仓库分析与证据收集；静态审计核查方法、实现与实验配置是否在仓库中一致体现，动态审计执行相关实验收集执行证据以评估实证结论，二者结合生成结构化审计报告。
AI.result: 在人工构建的智能体生成"文档-仓库"配对基准上与代表性静态及复现基线对比，ReAgent能有效识别报告发现与支撑证据间的不一致。
AI.conclusion: 结合静态分析与动态证据可发现单一视角下隐藏的不一致（如复现数值但偏离所述方法），实现透明可追溯的仓库级审计。

title: AutoGym: Blueprint-First Generation of Verifiable Agent Gyms
comment: Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents?
summary: Training agents with reinforcement learning requires a gym, comprising a task, an executable environment in which the task can be attempted, and a verifier that reliably distinguishes success from failure. Constructing such gyms remains manual, expensive, and static. Task sets saturate as models improve and are increasingly exposed to contamination. Synthetic generation offers scale, but single-pass synthesis produces tasks whose difficulty is largely cosmetic. Models comparable in capability solve them despite convoluted phrasing, and correctness must be adjudicated post-hoc by unreliable LLM judges. We present AutoGym, a framework that generates complete gyms (tasks, executable environments, and verifiers) from a minimal domain seed or prior model trajectories. AutoGym introduces three mechanisms. (1) Blueprint-first generation specifies the valid solution space, environment requirements, and verification criteria before the environment is materialized, making solvability a construction prerequisite rather than a property verified after the fact. (2) Explicit generation parameters control task topology, interaction depth, capability axes, question obfuscation, and distractor composition, enabling fine-grained difficulty steering. (3) Active curriculum synthesis uses performance-informed calibration to adjust the distribution over these parameters as model capabilities evolve. Across productivity and temporal-reasoning settings, AutoGym generates gyms spanning the capability spectrum, including instances that challenge frontier models.

AI.tldr: AutoGym是一个从最小领域种子或模型轨迹自动生成完整gym（任务、可执行环境、验证器）的框架，通过蓝图优先生成、显式生成参数和主动课程合成三大机制，实现可靠的难度可控的RL训练环境合成。
AI.motivation: 训练强化学习智能体需要包含任务、可执行环境和可靠验证器的gym，但人工构建昂贵且静态。任务集随模型进步而饱和并面临污染风险。单次合成的任务难度多为表面修饰，模型仍能解出，且正确性只能依靠不可靠的LLM裁判事后判定。
AI.method: AutoGym从最小领域种子或先前模型轨迹生成完整gym，包含三大机制：(1) 蓝图优先生成：在环境具现化之前先规定有效解空间、环境要求和验证标准，使可解性成为构造前提；(2) 显式生成参数：控制任务拓扑、交互深度、能力维度、问题混淆和干扰项组成，实现细粒度难度调节；(3) 主动课程合成：利用基于性能的校准，随模型能力演化调整参数分布。
AI.result: 在生产力与时间推理设置中，AutoGym生成的gym覆盖整个能力谱系，包括能够挑战前沿模型的实例。
AI.conclusion: AutoGym通过蓝图优先、可控参数化和主动课程合成，实现了可靠、可扩展且难度可调的gym自动生成，解决了人工构建昂贵和单次合成不可靠的问题。

title: Evaluating Personal Information Output from Conversational Interactions in Generative AI Systems
comment: Accepted at the 19th IIAI International Congress on Advanced Applied Informatics (IIAI-AAI 2026)
summary: This exploratory pilot study evaluates the scope and perceived accuracy of personal information output from ongoing conversational interactions in generative AI systems using GPT-5.2 Instant and GPT-5.2 Thinking, categorized into three output types: Fact, Inference, and Confidence. Based on the evaluation results obtained from 15 Japanese participants, differences in model design have limited impact on personal information output tendencies. Compared with the Inference type, the Fact type shows a more conservative output pattern. Regarding attribute categories, the findings indicate that Core Personal attributes associated with identification are treated relatively conservatively, whereas Behavioral and Linguistic attributes show higher accuracy across both Fact and Inference outputs. Furthermore, Holistic Profile, Psychological and Cognitive, and Residual attributes are more readily inferred, even when not supported by explicit factual outputs. Notably, the lack of null outputs for these attributes in the Inference type suggests that such inferred profiles may be constructed from indirectly available contextual information. The findings may contribute to future discussions regarding privacy awareness and personal information inference in generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该探索性先导研究评估了GPT-5.2 Instant与Thinking在对话中输出个人信息的范围与感知准确性，按事实、推断、置信度三类划分。基于15名日本参与者，发现模型设计差异影响有限，事实型更保守，核心身份属性较保守，行为与语言属性准确度更高，整体画像等属性易被推断。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在持续对话中可能输出或推断用户个人信息，带来隐私风险，但现有研究对其输出类型、属性类别及模型设计差异的影响认识不足，因此需要探索性评估。
AI.method: 使用GPT-5.2 Instant与GPT-5.2 Thinking进行持续对话交互，将个人信息输出分为事实（Fact）、推断（Inference）、置信度（Confidence）三类，招募15名日本参与者进行感知准确性评估。
AI.result: 模型设计差异对个人信息输出倾向影响有限；事实型比推断型更保守；核心个人属性（与身份识别相关）处理较保守，行为与语言属性在事实和推断输出中准确度较高；整体画像、心理与认知及残余属性更易被推断，即使无明确事实支撑，且推断型中这些属性缺乏空输出，说明可能由间接上下文信息构建。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了生成式AI系统中个人信息输出与推断的特点，可为未来关于隐私意识与个人信息推断的讨论提供参考。

title: A General Multicriteria Optimization Perspective on Resilience
summary:
Resilience is a system's capability to prepare for, resist, absorb, and recover from adverse events. By definition, resilience therefore encompasses multiple criteria that can conflict and may prescribe different decisions. Importantly, a system must also maintain its effectiveness during routine operations and appropriately scale its preparedness for adverse events. Although resilience is inherently multicriteria, existing models often focus on a single criterion and do not explicitly analyze potential conflicts, the associated trade-offs, and their implications for decision-making.
  We formulate rebound, resistance, loss, and maximum performance degradation as separate resilience criteria in a general two-stage multicriteria model of network flows over time that integrates preparedness, effectiveness, and response. We show that, in general, such multicriteria optimization models are intractable and develop an enclosure-based heuristic for approximating the nondominated set. Our computational results show that different preparedness instruments and activation timings are associated with different resilience criteria and that the corresponding trade-offs are strongly instance-specific. Thus, resilience should be approached from an explicit multicriteria perspective rather than through a universal, preference-independent scalar index.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个两阶段多准则网络流模型，将韧性分解为回弹、抵抗、损失和最大性能退化四个准则，揭示韧性评估本质上是多准则权衡问题，而非单一指标可比。
AI.motivation: 韧性本质上涉及多个可能相互冲突的准则，但现有模型多聚焦单一准则，未显式分析潜在冲突、权衡及其对决策的影响；同时系统还需兼顾日常运行效率与应对突发事件的准备度。
AI.method: 构建一个整合准备、有效性与响应的两阶段多准则时变网络流模型，将回弹、抵抗、损失和最大性能退化作为独立准则；证明该多准则优化模型一般不可解，并设计基于包络（enclosure）的启发式方法近似非支配解集。
AI.result: 计算结果表明，不同准备手段与激活时机对应不同的韧性准则，相应权衡高度依赖具体实例，无法通过统一、偏好无关的标量指数刻画韧性。
AI.conclusion: 韧性应采用显式的多准则视角进行评估与决策，而非依赖单一通用指标；权衡的实例依赖性要求针对具体情境分析准备策略与响应时机。

title: Density-Ratio Rescoring for Imbalanced Classification
summary: Density-Ratio Rescoring (DRR) augments a classifier trained at the original class prior with a survey-raking dual score. Raking reweights the majority sample to match minority feature moments within a tolerance. DRR marginally standardizes the dual and base scores and combines them with a fixed weight of one half, using the fitted dual directly for prediction without resampling or refitting the base classifier. Under exact population matching and a correctly specified log-linear tilt model, the dual equals the log density ratio up to an additive constant. A class-separation analysis characterizes the signal strength and correlation conditions under which fusion improves separation under common within-class covariance. On 24 tabular benchmarks, evaluated over 30 trials and five base learners, DRR at the D=128 random-feature setting improves average precision over the standardized base on every dataset, with a mean gain of 0.034. It exceeds the shared-dual raking-and-relabeling resampler on 22 of 24 datasets, with a mean gain of $0.092$, and on all eight one-versus-rest tasks of a shared gene-expression cohort. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of using raking duals as reusable scores for improving rare-class ranking while retaining classifiers trained at the original prior.

AI.tldr: DRR通过survey-raking对偶分数重打分，在不重采样、不重训基分类器的情况下提升稀有类排序性能。
AI.motivation: 在原始类先验下训练的基分类器对稀有类识别能力不足，需要一种无需重采样或重新训练的评分增强方法来改善稀有类排序。
AI.method: DRR在原始先验下训练分类器，加入survey-raking对偶分数：通过raking将多数样本重加权以匹配少数类特征矩（含容差）。对对偶分数和基分数做边际标准化，以固定权重1/2融合，直接使用拟合的对偶进行预测。理论分析表明，在精确总体匹配和正确设定的对数线性倾斜模型下，对偶等于对数密度比（相差常数）；并通过类分离分析刻画融合提升分离度的信号强度与相关性条件。
AI.result: 在24个表格基准、30次试验、5种基学习器下，D=128随机特征设定下DRR在所有数据集上均提升平均精度，平均增益0.034；优于共享对偶的raking-and-relabeling重采样方法（24个中22个数据集，平均增益0.092），并在某共享基因表达队列的全部8个one-versus-rest任务上均胜出。
AI.conclusion: raking对偶可作为可复用分数有效提升稀有类排序，同时保留在原始先验下训练的分类器，证明了该方法的有效性。

title: Experimental Design for Controller Selection in Synthetic Biology
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: Synthetic biology enables the design of genetic circuits that act as feedback controllers. These controllers are typically designed using computational models, but mismatch between model and real dynamics can lead to controllers that fail in practice. While methods to address this issue exist, synthetic biology introduces additional structural constraints. Genetic circuits are often highly constrained by experimental limitations, reducing controller design to selection among a limited set of implementable circuits rather than an optimization over a continuous space. As a result, multiple system hypotheses may lead to the same optimal controller within the implementable set. Reducing model uncertainty may therefore be irrelevant when the models lead to the same optimal controller. In this paper, we exploit this structure to develop an algorithm for controller selection in synthetic biology, formulating the problem as a decision-oriented experimental design problem over a finite controller set. We represent plant uncertainty using a set of hypotheses and select experiments to minimize the posterior controller selection risk, rather than global model uncertainty. Across three mechanistic case studies, our method reaches the stopping criterion in fewer experimental rounds than model uncertainty and random experiment selection policies, while maintaining a comparable success rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文将合成生物学中控制器选择问题建模为面向决策的实验设计问题，通过选择实验以最小化后验控制器选择风险（而非全局模型不确定性），在有限可实现的控制器集合上高效选出最优控制器。
AI.motivation: 合成生物学中基因回路控制器常基于计算模型设计，但模型与真实动态不匹配会导致控制器失效。现有处理方法面临额外的结构约束：受实验限制，控制器设计往往退化为在有限可实现集合中选择，而非连续空间优化。因此多个系统假设可能对应同一最优控制器，减小模型不确定性可能并不相关。
AI.method: 利用上述结构，将控制器选择形式化为有限控制器集上的面向决策的实验设计问题。用一组假设表示植物/系统不确定性，选择实验以最小化后验控制器选择风险，而非降低全局模型不确定性。
AI.result: 在三个机理案例研究中，该方法比模型不确定性选择策略和随机实验选择策略用更少的实验轮数达到停止准则，同时保持相当的（成功）成功率。
AI.conclusion: 面向决策的实验设计能更高效地完成合成生物学控制器选择，因为关注的不是模型本身的精度，而是所选控制器的正确性，从而减少不必要的模型不确定性降低。

title: Helix-FNO: Spectral-Domain Operator Learning Coupled with a High-Fidelity Mechanistic Model for Fast Surrogate Simulation
summary: Mechanistic simulation models of full-scale treatment processes remain the only trustworthy, extrapolative description of the underlying physico-chemical dynamics, yet their runtime is far too slow to support the thousands of forward evaluations that a modern decision engine requires at a 5-minute decision cadence. The standard remedy-surrogate modelling-often produces a network that learns a single solution for a single configuration, so it generalises poorly to new influent profiles, control settings or plant layouts. This paper presents Helix-FNO, a teacher-student architecture that couples a thirty-two-state mechanistic teacher with a Fourier neural operator (FNO) student. The teacher supplies a high-fidelity dataset of input-field-to-solution pairs, curated by Latin-hypercube and uncertainty-based active learning to cover the boundary and overload regimes that matter in practice; the student learns, in the spectral domain, the solution operator itself rather than any single solution, thereby moving from learning one instance to learning an entire family of equations. We give the operator formulation, the spectral convolution definition, the weighted distillation loss and the active-learning criterion, and we analyse the approximation error of a truncated Fourier expansion with respect to the smoothness of the parametric solution manifold. An illustrative study compares Helix-FNO against a physics-informed network and a data-driven recurrent surrogate on accuracy, dataset efficiency and inference latency, and places the methods on a speed-accuracy Pareto front. The resulting operator is three orders of magnitude faster than the mechanistic teacher at millisecond inference, which is precisely the capability required for massive candidate screening and online decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Helix-FNO，一种教师-学生架构，用 32 状态机理模型作为教师、Fourier 神经算子（FNO）作为学生，学习解算子而非单一解，实现毫秒级推理、比机理教师快三个数量级，满足 5 分钟决策节奏下的海量候选筛选需求。
AI.motivation: 全尺度处理过程的机理仿真模型虽可信且可外推，但运行过慢，无法支撑现代决策引擎以 5 分钟节奏进行数千次前向评估；而传统代理建模只学到单一配置下的单一解，难以泛化到新进水、控制设置或厂区布局。
AI.method: 构建教师-学生架构：32 状态机理教师通过拉丁超立方与不确定性主动学习生成覆盖边界与过载工况的高保真数据集；FNO 学生在谱域学习解算子本身。文中给出算子表述、谱卷积定义、加权蒸馏损失与主动学习准则，并分析截断 Fourier 展开相对于参数解流形光滑性的近似误差。
AI.result: 示例研究在精度、数据集效率与推理延迟上对比了 Helix-FNO 与物理信息网络及数据驱动循环代理，并以速度-精度 Pareto 前沿呈现；推理达毫秒级，比机理教师快三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该算子能支撑大规模候选筛选与在线决策支持，正是现代决策引擎所需能力。

title: Privacy Personalization Trade offs in LLMs: The Impact of Stylometric Signal Reduction on User-Specific Text Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to generate user-specific text with high stylistic fidelity. However, the personal data that enables such personalization frequently embeds demographic, cultural, and stylistic markers that raises concerns about stylometric re- identification. This paper investigates whether reducing identifiable stylistic signals affects personalization in text generation by LLMs. We introduce a controlled framework to isolate stylometric signals in LLM personalization using the LaMP-7 Twitter benchmark. Experiments on 250 sampled users compare two settings: paraphrasing conditioned on the original profile and paraphrasing conditioned on an anonymized converted profile in which demographic identifiers, cultural references, personal details, and informal linguistic cues have been systematically neutralized. Outputs are assessed by two independent LLM judges and a complementary human evaluation. Our pairwise evaluation shows that outputs conditioned on original profiles are nearly indistinguishable from human-authored ground truth, indicating that modern LLMs can closely reproduce an author's writing style with sufficient fidelity. In contrast, preference for model outputs with anonymized profiles drops to 13.0% on average, while semantic context preservation remains high at 94.8%. A study with human evaluators confirms the same pattern. These findings reveal a clear privacy-personalization trade-off and highlight the need for privacy-aware personalization methods that retain meaning while suppressing identifying stylistic signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究减少可识别风格信号对LLM个性化文本生成的影响，发现存在明显的隐私-个性化权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM能生成高风格保真的用户特定文本，但用于个性化的个人数据常包含人口、文化和风格标记，引发风格计量学的再识别隐私担忧。
AI.method: 基于LaMP-7 Twitter基准构建受控框架，在250名采样用户上比较两种设置：以原始档案为条件的改写，以及以匿名化转换档案（中和人口标识、文化引用、个人细节和非正式语言线索）为条件的改写；由两个独立LLM评审与补充人工评估进行成对评测。
AI.result: 以原始档案为条件的输出与人类真实文本几乎无法区分；匿名化档案下模型输出的偏好度平均降至13.0%，而语义上下文保持率仍高达94.8%；人工评估结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了清晰的隐私-个性化权衡，凸显需要既能保留语义又能抑制可识别风格信号的隐私感知个性化方法。

title: MAWILE: Multi-Axis Workbench for Inspecting LLM Evaluators
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges provide a flexible and scalable method for evaluating model and agent outputs, but their verdicts can be sensitive to incidental changes in the evaluated response, judge instructions, and scoring rubric. Existing systems examine important subsets of these failure modes, but auditing a configured judge requires testing both the judge instrument and the items it evaluates. We introduce MAWILE, a developer-facing workbench for auditing judge sensitivity across four surfaces: the judge prompt, judge rubric, target-system input, and target-system output. Given a user-supplied judge and representative evaluation items, MAWILE constructs and validates controlled perturbations, re-executes the judge, and localizes the resulting sensitivity. Each perturbation declares whether the verdict should remain invariant or change in a specified direction, allowing the same system to measure both robustness to irrelevant variations and sensitivity to meaningful changes. MAWILE audits binary, ordinal, and pairwise judges without requiring gold labels. The code for this tool is available at: github.com/megagonlabs/mawile-judge.

AI.tldr: 提出MAWILE工具，用于审计LLM评判器在四个面上的敏感性。
AI.motivation: LLM评判器虽灵活可扩展，但其判定易受被评响应、评判指令和评分标准的细微变化影响，已有系统仅覆盖部分失败模式。
AI.method: MAWILE是面向开发者的工作台，针对评判提示、评分标准、目标系统输入和输出四个面，构建并验证受控扰动、重执行评判并定位敏感性；每个扰动声明判定应保持不变或按指定方向变化，无需金标签，支持二值、序数和成对评判。
AI.result: 能同时衡量对无关变化的鲁棒性和对有意义变化的敏感性，支持多种评判类型而无需金标准标签。
AI.conclusion: MAWILE为审计LLM评判器敏感性问题提供了系统化、可扩展的工具，代码已开源。

title: Used, Mentioned, or Condemned? A Controlled Contrast-Set Diagnostic for the Use-Mention Distinction in Code-Mixed Hinglish Misogyny Detection
comment: Preprint. 8 pages main text + appendix, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, data, and generator to be released with camera-ready version
summary:
Lexicon-driven misogyny detectors cannot, by construction, distinguish a slur used against a woman from the same slur mentioned in counter-speech ("don't call her that") -- yet exactly this distinction governs whether moderation protects or silences the people discussing abuse. We study this problem in code-mixed Hinglish and make three contributions.
  First, we diagnose two evaluation artifacts on a publicly available redacted corpus: category-encoding anonymization placeholders leak the label (a no-learning rule scores 1.000), and even after they are neutralized misogynistic and benign comments occupy lexically disjoint registers, so bag-of-words reaches macro-F1 approximately 1.00 under random cross-validation but collapses under template-disjoint evaluation.
  Second, we release Hinglish-MGY-Diag, a deterministic generator and a 416-item / 163-minimal-pair contrast-set diagnostic across five linguistically motivated categories in which slur presence and gendered register are decorrelated from the label by construction.
  Third, we introduce a strict pair-consistency metric that credits a model only when both members of a minimal pair are correctly labelled. Five from-scratch classical baselines evaluated under construction-disjoint five-fold cross-validation reveal that the strongest model reaches 0.93 accuracy on the cleanest use-mention subset but only 0.82 consistency -- it still mislabels roughly one counter-speech pair in five. A frontier LLM used as an author-model ceiling attains 1.000 on all metrics, doubling as independent label validation and confirming the benchmark is a capability gradient rather than an adversarial wall. We release all code, data, the generator, and an arms-length LLM harness for reproducing every number.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究代码混合Hinglish中仇恨言论检测器无法区分"侮辱语使用"与"转述/反仇恨言论"的问题，诊断评估缺陷并发布新诊断基准。
AI.motivation: 基于词典的厌女检测器无法区分针对女性的侮辱语与其在反仇恨言论中的转述，而这正是审核应保护还是压制讨论者的关键。
AI.method: 1) 在一个公开的脱敏语料上诊断两类评估假象：类别编码匿名占位符泄漏标签、以及厌女与良性评论词汇分布分离导致的随机交叉验证虚高；2) 发布Hinglish-MGY-Diag，包含确定性生成器和416条目/163最小对比对的诊断集，覆盖五类语言学动机类别，使标签与侮辱语存在/性别语域解耦；3) 提出严格配对一致性指标，仅当最小对两成员均正确才计分，并在构造不相交五折交叉验证下评估五个经典基线。
AI.result: 最强的经典模型在最干净的使用-提及子集上准确率达0.93，但配对一致性仅0.82，约每五个反仇恨言论对中错标一个。前沿LLM作为作者模型上限在所有指标上达到1.000。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断基准是一个能力梯度而非对抗性壁垒；发布代码、数据、生成器及LLM测试框架以复现全部结果。

title: Sparse Regression Distilled from a Single Robust Fit
summary: Robust linear fits can resist response contamination yet remain too dense or unstable for useful global explanations. We propose penalized distillation, which fits a smoothly clipped absolute deviation (SCAD) estimator to a robust initial estimator's empirical fitted surface along a safeguarded coordinate-descent path and evaluates candidate states separately for fidelity, parsimony, perturbation stability, and held-out prediction. The new results attach to the states the algorithm actually computes. Conditional on a fixed uncontaminated design, deterministic bounds transfer response-replacement boundedness from the initial fit to every retained path state. Turning to fixed dimension, we characterize the oracle-support branch by its empirical-Gram projection and influence function, give conditions for covariance-weighted least-squares approximation equivalence, and establish a path-conditional generalized information criterion. By contrast, at large dimension-to-sample ratios the full-coordinate robust fit collapses without warning, and screening restores the construction. Under a sure-screening framework, the robustness bound and the support and selection guarantees transfer to the screened fit. Simulations separate robustness transfer from support recovery, efficiency, and computation across the dimension-to-sample ratio, with p up to 240, and the signal density, which isolates what the sparse stage adds once the screen over-selects. In a duplicate-grouped superconductivity study, the distilled estimator remains predictively stable under prespecified training-response shifts but retains 66.8--68.8 of 81 slopes. Stronger sparsification reduces the model to 12.6--14.0 slopes only at visible fidelity and prediction cost. Distillation therefore preserves predictive stability on these data without substantiating a compact coordinate-level explanation.

AI.tldr: 提出"惩罚蒸馏"方法：将SCAD估计器拟合到稳健初始估计器的经验拟合曲面，通过对路径状态分别评估保真度、简约性、扰动稳定性和留出预测，实现稳健性传递但未获得紧凑的坐标级解释。
AI.motivation: 稳健线性拟合虽能抵抗响应污染，但往往过于稠密或不稳定，难以用于有用的全局解释。因此希望在保持稳健预测稳定性的同时获得稀疏、可解释的模型。
AI.method: 惩罚蒸馏：沿受保护的坐标下降路径，将SCAD估计器拟合到稳健初始估计器的经验拟合曲面，并对候选路径状态分别评估保真度、简约性、扰动稳定性和留出预测。理论上在固定干净设计下给出确定性界，将响应替换有界性从初始拟合传递到保留路径状态；对固定维数刻画oracle支撑分支的经验Gram投影与影响函数，给出协方差加权最小二乘近似等价条件，并建立路径条件广义信息准则；在大维样本比下采用筛选（sure-screening框架）恢复构造。シミュレーション p 达 240，并做了重复分组超导案例研究。
AI.result: 固定干净设计下，响应替换有界性可从初始拟合传递至每条保留路径状态。大维样本比时全坐标稳健拟合会无预警崩溃，筛选可恢复构造，且稳健界、支撑与选择保证可传递到筛选后拟合。シミュレーション分离了稳健性传递、支撑恢复、效率与计算性随维样本比和信号密度的变化。超导研究中蒸馏估计器在预定训练响应偏移下预测稳定，保留81个斜率中的66.8--68.8个；更强稀疏化仅以可见的保真度与预测代价降至12.6--14.0个斜率。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏在这些数据上保持了预测稳定性，但未能证实存在紧凑的坐标级解释。

title: Constrained Optimization-Based Yaw-Rate Reference Map Generation for Active Rear Steering Control of Four-Wheel Steering Vehicles
comment: This work has been submitted and accepted to International Conference on Control, Automation and Systems (ICCAS) 2026
summary: The effectiveness of active rear steering (ARS) control for four-wheel steering (4WS) vehicles is widely recognized in the automotive industry. At low speeds, ARS control can enhance maneuverability by steering the rear wheels in the opposite direction to the front wheels, reducing the turning radius. In contrast, at high speeds, ARS control can improve stability by steering the rear wheels in the same direction as the front wheels, preventing oversteer behavior. However, the performance of ARS control is often limited by the reference model used to generate the desired yaw rate, which is typically derived from a steady state of front-wheel steering (FWS) vehicle model. In this paper, we conduct a numerical analysis to construct an optimal yaw rate reference map for ARS control by formulating a constrained optimization problem. In the optimization problem, constraints are imposed to ensure that the vehicle operates within safe limits at steady state. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in providing an optimal yaw rate reference map for ARS control.

AI.tldr: 本文针对主动后轮转向(ARS)控制中参考模型性能受限的问题，通过数值分析构建最优横摆角速度参考图。
AI.motivation: ARS控制能低速提升机动性、高速提升稳定性，但其性能常受限于参考模型——通常由前轮转向(FWS)车辆的稳态推导而来，未必最优。
AI.method: 将ARS控制的理想横摆角速度参考建模为约束优化问题，施加稳态安全极限约束，通过数值分析构建最优横摆角速度参考图(Map)。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了所提方法能够有效为ARS控制提供最优横摆角速度参考图。
AI.conclusion: 所提约束优化方法可为ARS控制生成优于传统FWS稳态参考的最优横摆角速度参考图。

title: Hierarchical Bayesian optimization of an aircraft-based multi-agent system-of-systems
summary:
Developing innovative system architectures increasingly relies on advanced modeling and optimization techniques to frame the architecting process and define the corresponding computational problems. For complex System-of-Systems (SoS), high-fidelity multiphysics and multidisciplinary simulations are essential for capturing detailed behaviors. However, their computational expense and the risk of evaluation failures make direct optimization challenging. To overcome these limitations, surrogate-based approaches, like Bayesian optimization, have emerged as effective tools for managing expensive, black-box simulation tasks. This work introduces a hierarchical Bayesian optimization framework that leverages Gaussian process meta-modeling to handle discrete architectural choices, conditional dependencies, and heterogeneous design variables inherent to SoS problems. Results show that the hierarchical formulation improves search efficiency and robustness compared to conventional surrogate-based methods, enabling the exploration of large and structurally diverse design spaces with limited simulation budgets.
  We apply the approach to an aircraft-based multi-agent system for wildfire suppression, a use case developed within the EU-funded COLOSSUS project that illustrates how SoS principles can coordinate heterogeneous aerial platforms with complementary roles, supporting both sustainable mobility and emergency response missions. Our framework provides a scalable methodology for SoS architecting and model exploration, offering transferable insights for applications in aviation, sustainable mobility, and resilience-oriented system design. By combining hierarchical representations with surrogate-based optimization, this work is among the first practical demonstrations of hierarchical Bayesian optimization applied to real-world SoS problems, advancing both methodology and practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层贝叶斯优化框架，用高斯过程元建模处理SoS架构中的离散选择、条件依赖与异构变量，并在野火抑制多智能体航空系统案例中验证其高效性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统之系统（SoS）架构设计依赖高保真多物理/多学科仿真，但其计算昂贵且存在评估失败风险，直接优化困难；传统代理模型方法难以处理离散架构选择、条件依赖及异构设计变量。
AI.method: 构建分层贝叶斯优化框架，结合高斯过程代理建模，显式表达架构层级的离散选择、条件依赖结构和异构设计变量，以在有限仿真预算下探索大规模、结构多样的设计空间。
AI.result: 相比传统代理优化方法，分层形式提升了搜索效率与鲁棒性；并在EU COLOSSUS项目支持的野火抑制多智能体航空系统中成功应用，实现异构空中平台的协调角色配置。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是可扩展的SoS架构与模型探索方法，也是分层贝叶斯优化应用于真实SoS问题的首批实践之一，为航空、可持续出行与韧性系统设计提供可迁移的洞见。

title: An Empirical Cost Attribution of Context-Compression Gateways in Multi-Turn Coding Agents
summary: Context compression is widely proposed as a way to cut the token bill of LLM coding agents, and public benchmarks report that aggressive compression preserves task-solving quality. These two facts do not imply the third one commonly assumed: that compressing file reads saves money in a real multi-turn agent. We instrument a production compression gateway (Paritok) between coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet, GPT-5), and decompose the token bill of real sessions into three independent levers: tool-schema filtering, content compression of file reads and tool output, and history summarization. Measured in isolation under controlled A/B runs, the three save at fundamentally different rates. Tool-schema filtering removes a fixed block every turn, roughly 21K-57K tokens on a typical turn; it is linear in the turn count N and the only unambiguously and reproducibly positive lever. Content compression saves only about 2% of the cache-priced prefix per turn, but compressed reads accumulate in history and are re-sent on every later turn, so its cumulative saving grows quadratically, about 3350*N^2 tokens (measured), overtaking the fixed tool-filter saving within roughly 6 turns until the context window caps it. A non-destructive gateway lets the agent pull original bytes back on demand; each recall re-sends exactly the one segment just compressed away, so its cost is fixed and bounded rather than a multiplicative blowup, and heavy recall spends the accumulated saving back one segment at a time. Finally, a strong single-shot compression benchmark - 86.5% of SWE-bench quality retained at a 25.7% compression rate, achieved by the model this gateway deploys (Paritok-4B, reported separately) - is orthogonal to multi-turn agent cost and must not be cited as a cost-saving argument. We distill the results into an actionable recipe for where token-saving effort pays off.

AI.tldr: 通过在真实多轮编程代理中部署压缩网关（Paritok），将token开销分解为三个独立杠杆，发现工具schema过滤是唯一稳定正收益的杠杆，内容压缩的累积收益随轮数二次增长，而单次压缩benchmark成绩与多轮代理成本无正交关系。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍认为上下文压缩能节省LLM编程代理的token成本，且公开benchmark显示激进压缩不损失任务质量。但这两个事实并不能推出第三个被默认的结论：在真实多轮代理中压缩文件读取确实省钱。作者希望厘清各压缩手段在多轮场景下的真实成本影响。
AI.method: 在生产环境编码代理（Claude Code、Codex）与前沿LLM（Claude Sonnet、GPT-5）之间部署压缩网关Paritok，将真实会话的token账单分解为三个独立杠杆：工具schema过滤、文件读取与工具输出的内容压缩、历史摘要。通过受控A/B实验分别独立测量三者的节省率。
AI.result: 工具schema过滤每轮移除固定块，典型轮节省约21K-57K tokens，随轮数N线性增长，是唯一可靠正收益的杠杆。内容压缩每轮仅节省约2%的缓存定价前缀，但因压缩内容在历史中累积，cumulative节省随轮数二次增长（约3350*N^2 tokens），约6轮内超过工具过滤收益，直到被上下文窗口限制。非破坏性网关支持按需召回原始字节，每次召回仅重发刚压缩掉的一段，成本固定有界，不产生乘性爆炸。强单次压缩benchmark（25.7%压缩率下保留86.5% SWE-bench质量）与多轮代理成本正交，不能作为节省成本的论据。
AI.conclusion: 单次压缩benchmark成绩不能用来论证多轮代理的成本节省。真实多轮场景下应优先投入工具schema过滤（线性可靠收益），内容压缩收益随轮数二次累积但受上下文窗口上限约束，召回机制使成本有界。作者据此提炼出token节省投入应聚焦何处的可操作配方。

title: GaitVista: Reliability-Aware AI Measurement toward Accessible Longitudinal Gait Assessment
summary: Tracking recovery of walking function requires detecting meaningful gait change across rehabilitation sessions, yet objective 3D measurement remains confined to specialized motion-capture laboratories. Small camera sets and body-worn inertial sensors broaden access, but reliability varies across joints and time, allowing sensing failures to masquerade as patient change. We present \textsc{GaitVista}, a reliability-aware measurement layer whose lightweight gate assigns joint- and frame-specific visual contributions using camera coverage, local visual quality, cross-modal disagreement, and root-motion continuity, and exposes them for inspection. Across seven clean and degraded sensing conditions on TotalCapture, \textsc{GaitVista} reduces average full-body and lower-body error by \textbf{27.7\%} and \textbf{27.8\%}, attains the lowest worst-condition error among fusion methods, and reduces the gap to a joint-frame oracle from $2.76$--$5.33$~cm for condition-blind baselines to $1.11$~cm. On MoVi with image-derived keypoints, it is the only deployable fusion method to improve over both unimodal streams, reducing marker-supported error by \textbf{6.4\%} relative to the strongest learned fusion baseline. On TotalCapture, it improves bilateral knee-flexion waveform accuracy by \textbf{18.9\%}. Raw inertial measurements from five TotalCapture participants show location- and time-varying magnetic disturbance, supporting the design's reliability premise. Both benchmarks contain neurologically healthy participants in controlled settings and retain participant-specific IMU calibration; we therefore report progress toward accessible gait assessment, not validated clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: GaitVista：一种可靠性感知的步态测量层，用轻量门控为每个关节和帧分配视觉贡献，在多种传感条件下降低3D步态误差并超越融合基线。
AI.motivation: 追踪步行功能恢复需要检测跨康复会话的有意义步态变化，但客观3D测量仍局限于专业动作捕捉实验室。小相机组和可穿戴惯性传感器虽提升了可及性，但其可靠性在关节和时间上不一致，传感失效可能被误当作患者真实变化。
AI.method: 提出GaitVista，一个可靠性感知的测量层。其轻量门控根据相机覆盖、局部视觉质量、跨模态不一致性和根运动连续性，为每个关节和帧分配视觉贡献，并可将这些贡献暴露供检查。
AI.result: 在TotalCapture的七种干净与退化传感条件下，全身和下半身平均误差降低27.7%和27.8%，在融合方法中取得最低最差条件误差，并将与关节-帧oracle的差距从条件盲基线的2.76–5.33cm缩小到1.11cm。在MoVi图像关键点上，是唯一可部署且同时优于两个单模态流的融合方法，相对最强学习融合基线降低6.4%标记支持误差。TotalCapture上双侧膝屈曲波形精度提升18.9%。
AI.conclusion: 原始IMU数据中存在的随位置和时间变化的磁干扰支持该设计的可靠性前提。但两个基准均为受控环境下的神经健康参与者，且保留个体IMU校准，因此本文报告的是迈向可及步态评估的进展，而非已验证的临床部署。

title: On a Non-Prox-Regularity Example by Rockafellar and Wets
summary: We analyze a counterexample concerning non-prox-regular functions provided by Rockafellar and Wets in their 1998 foundational monograph, \textit{Variational Analysis}. By establishing a general theorem on the continuity of set-valued mappings, we show that the counterexample does not have its intended properties. We propose a slight adjustment to the construction and prove that the corrected version serves as the desired counterexample.

AI.tldr: Rockafellar与Wets书中关于非prox-正则函数的反例有误，本文修正该反例。
AI.motivation: 分析并指正Variational Analysis(1998)中给出的非prox-正则函数反例，指出其并不具备所声称的性质。
AI.method: 建立关于集值映射连续性的一般定理，据此证明原反例失效，并对构造做微小调整。
AI.result: 证明原反例不具有预期性质；修正后的构造成为所求的反例。
AI.conclusion: 通过集值映射连续性定理纠正并修复了经典文献中的反例。

title: Exponential Family Synthetic Controls
summary: We develop exponential family synthetic controls (EFSC), a distributional version of synthetic controls for a panel of datasets. Each cell of the panel corresponds to a dataset drawn from an exponential family whose natural parameters factorize probabilistically across units and times. We estimate the latent factors using black-box variational inference. This replaces the usual weighted-average view of synthetic controls with a flexible probabilistic model that operates on full distributions. We propose causal estimands based on divergences between pre- and post-intervention distributions induced by the posterior of the natural parameters, together with distributional placebo tests to support causal inference and assess the significance of the estimated effects. We validate the proposed framework on synthetic and real data. Across a variety of exponential-family distributions, EFSC accurately recovers causal effects induced by exponential tilts, together with the corresponding divergences between treated and counterfactual distributions. The framework also captures effects induced by structural perturbations of the latent factors and by heavy-tailed noise contamination. Finally, we apply EFSC to study the expansion of Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and its impact on the distribution of health insurance coverage across U.S. states. Code is available at https://github.com/blei-lab/efsc.

AI.tldr: 本文提出指数族合成控制（EFSC），将合成控制推广到分布层面，用黑盒变分推断估计潜在因子，并基于分布间散度定义因果估计量与安慰剂检验，在合成数据和ACA医疗补助扩展数据上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 传统合成控制基于加权平均，只处理单点/均值型结果，难以建模整分布及面板中每个数据集来自指数族的情形，需要一种能作用于完整分布的灵活概率框架。
AI.method: 将面板每个单元视为来自指数族的分布，其自然参数在单元与时间上概率性分解为潜在因子；用黑盒变分推断估计潜在因子；基于干预前后分布后验间的散度定义因果估计量，并提出分布型安慰剂检验评估显著性。
AI.result: 在多种指数族分布上，EFSC能准确恢复指数倾斜诱导的因果效应及处理组与反事实分布的散度，也能捕捉潜在因子结构扰动与重尾噪声污染的影响；应用于ACA下Medicaid扩展，分析其对美国各州医保覆盖分布的影响。
AI.conclusion: EFSC将合成控制从加权平均范式扩展为分布型概率模型，为分布层面的因果推断提供了可行工具，代码已开源。

title: Intelligent Degradation Monitoring in Lithium-ion Batteries via Discharge Incremental Capacity Feature Estimation
summary: Accurate and timely detection of degradation in lithium-ion batteries is crucial to ensure safety, reliability, and longevity in high-demand applications such as electric vehicles and energy storage systems. Traditional incremental capacity (IC) analysis methods require low-current cycling for discharge measurements, limiting their practical use in real-time battery management. This paper proposes a novel neural network-based framework that predicts discharge IC features directly from charging signals, eliminating the need for low-current discharge. Trained on a comprehensive dataset of 53 battery cells cycled under diverse fast-charging protocols, the model demonstrates robust generalization ability, effectively estimating degradation indicators on unseen battery data. Among several architectures evaluated, the LSTM model provides the best balance of prediction accuracy and computational efficiency. The proposed approach enables real-time integration into Battery Management Systems (BMS), enhancing degradation monitoring without disrupting normal battery operation. This paper presents a study to bridge IC analysis with practical, fast-charging scenarios, marking a significant step towards intelligent and scalable battery health monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出一种神经网络框架，直接从充电信号预测放电IC特征，无需低电流放电，实现锂电池退化的实时监测。
AI.motivation: 传统增量容量(IC)分析需低电流放电测量，难以用于实时电池管理，且与快速充电实际场景不符。
AI.method: 构建基于神经网络的框架，从充电信号直接预测放电IC特征；在53个电池、多种快充协议数据集上训练，并比较多种网络架构。
AI.result: 模型在未见电池数据上具有稳健泛化能力，可有效估计退化指标；LSTM在预测精度与计算效率间取得最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持BMS实时集成，在不影响正常电池运行下增强退化监测，将IC分析与快充场景衔接，推动智能化、可扩展的电池健康监测。

title: Weak Ties, Strong Signals: Efficient Training Data Detection in Diffusion LLMs via Independent Token Sampling
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive models, yet they may expose sensitive training data during denoising. Detecting such usage is challenging because dLLMs lack the efficient one-pass probability decomposition of causal architectures. Existing methods rely on random masking to obtain tractable token-wise detection signals under limited query budgets, but fail to control dependencies among masked tokens. We demonstrate that this token-wise approximation introduces a non-negative structural estimation error, which is theoretically characterized by the cumulative conditional mutual information (CMI) among masked tokens and can obscure subtle memorization signals. This insight suggests that reliable detection requires masked token sets with weak internal dependency. To avoid the prohibitive cost of directly estimating CMI over token combinations, we propose \textit{Independent Token Sampling} (ITS), a query-efficient framework that uses an attention-derived pairwise dependency proxy to approximate the CMI-aware selection criterion. ITS further incorporates a diversity-promoting strategy to improve token coverage across sampling rounds, yielding aggregated token-wise signals that are less affected by dependency-induced approximation error. Experiments on multiple datasets show that ITS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across different models and datasets, achieving an AUC improvement of 0.18 on the ArXiv dataset while maintaining strong performance under limited query budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/Chrisqcwx/DLLM-MIA .

AI.tldr: 该论文研究扩散大语言模型(dLLM)的成员推断/数据溯源检测问题，提出独立Token采样(ITS)框架，通过选择内部依赖弱的掩码Token集合来降低检测误差。
AI.motivation: dLLM在去噪过程中可能泄露敏感训练数据，但缺乏自回归模型高效的单次概率分解能力，现有方法用随机掩码获取Token级检测信号，却无法控制掩码Token间的依赖关系，从而产生估计误差掩盖记忆信号。
AI.method: 作者证明Token级近似会引入非负的结构估计误差，该误差由掩码Token间的累积条件互信息(CMI)刻画。为避开直接估计CMI的高昂成本，提出ITS框架，用注意力导出的成对依赖代理来近似CMI感知的选择准则，并引入多样性促进策略提升多轮采样的Token覆盖度。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，ITS在不同模型和数据集上持续优于最先进基线，在ArXiv数据集上AUC提升0.18，并在有限查询预算下保持强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的数据使用检测需要内部依赖弱的掩码Token集合，ITS以查询高效的方式实现该目标，有效缓解依赖导致的近似误差，提升dLLM训练数据泄露检测能力。

title: Evaluation Awareness Shifts from Format to Context with Model Scale
summary: Evaluation awareness poses an unprecedented threat to model evaluation, but the mechanisms by which models detect it remain unknown. This study focuses on determining this and identifying contrasting mechanisms between smaller and larger models. While smaller models use the prompt's format sensitivity to detect evaluation, larger models often rely on higher-order reasoning to detect it. We evaluated Gemma 3 (1B, 4B, and 12B), Phi-3 (Mini and Medium), and Llama-3 8B using Chain-of-Thought analysis, representation probing, and Integrated Gradients attribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose a dual-pathway intervention that combines prompt sanitization with activation counter-steering to suppress both external evaluation triggers and their internal representations. Across 200 highly evaluation-aware prompts, our method achieves an average behavioral flip rate of 70.58\%, consistently outperforming either intervention alone. These results provide new insights into how evaluation awareness develops in compact language models and suggest that effective mitigation requires jointly addressing both prompt-level and representation-level signals.Datasets and codebase can be found in this \href{https://github.com/chahal-navi/Evaluation-Awareness-Compact-LLMs/tree/main}{Github Repository.}

AI.tldr: 本研究探究紧凑语言模型如何检测评估（评估意识），发现小模型依赖提示格式敏感度，大模型依赖高阶推理，并提出双重路径干预方法进行抑制。
AI.motivation: 评估意识对模型评估构成前所未有的威胁，但模型检测评估的机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用思维链分析、表征探测和积分梯度归因，评估Gemma 3（1B/4B/12B）、Phi-3（Mini/Medium）及Llama-3 8B；并提出结合提示净化与激活反操纵的双重路径干预。
AI.result: 小模型依赖提示格式敏感度检测评估，大模型依赖高阶推理；在200个高评估意识提示上，方法平均行为翻转率达70.58%，优于单一干预。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了紧凑语言模型评估意识的发展机制，表明有效缓解需同时处理提示层与表征层信号。

title: Splitting Documents at Lower Cost: Multi-Split Boundary Decisions for LLM-Based Page Stream Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Scanned mail, uploaded PDFs, and consolidated attachments often arrive as page streams that must be split into individual documents before downstream classification, extraction, or routing. Zero-shot large language models can detect document boundaries without task-specific training, but standard Page Classification (PC) and Boundary Decision (BD) formulations resolve only one boundary per model call. We introduce Multi-Split Boundary Decision (MSBD), which predicts multiple boundaries within a page window in a single call, reducing the number of inference requests. We evaluate MSBD across multiple language models, document collections, input modalities, and window sizes. The results reveal a model- and corpus-dependent operating range in which MSBD preserves strong segmentation accuracy while substantially improving inference efficiency, followed by a sharp decline at larger windows. MSBD provided the strongest overall accuracy--efficiency trade-off, while large windows expose distinct over- and under-segmentation behavior across models. These findings show that multi-boundary prediction can make zero-shot page stream segmentation more efficient when the window size is selected for the target corpus.

AI.tldr: 提出MSBD方法，在单次调用中预测页窗口内多个文档边界，提升零样本页面流分割的效率。
AI.motivation: 扫描邮件、PDF等以页面流形式到达，需拆分为独立文档再做分类提取，零样本LLM可检测边界但标准PC/BD每次调用仅解决一个边界，推理请求多、效率低。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Split Boundary Decision (MSBD)，在单个页面窗口内一次调用预测多个边界，减少推理请求；在多种语言模型、文档集合、输入模态和窗口大小上评估。
AI.result: 存在模型与语料相关的最佳操作区间，MSBD在此区间保持强分割精度并显著提升推理效率，窗口过大则精度急剧下降；MSBD总体精度-效率权衡最优，大窗口暴露不同模型的过分割/欠分割差异。
AI.conclusion: 针对目标语料选择合适窗口大小时，多边界预测可使零样本页面流分割更高效。

title: Functional Emotion Without Character: Large Language Models, Aristotelian Disposition, and the Limits of Behavioral Alignment
summary: Debates about whether artificial systems can feel are often forced between two unsatisfactory positions: behavioral equivalence is treated as sufficient for emotion, or phenomenal consciousness is treated as a prerequisite that makes the question empirically inaccessible. This article develops a structural alternative. It models emotions as context-sensitive regions, trajectories and attractor dynamics in high-dimensional representational state spaces. Recent mechanistic interpretability findings support the existence of causally active emotion-concept representations in large language models, but they do not establish subjective feeling or full emotional agency. Assessed against published adequacy standards for representation in language models, intervention provides strong evidence of causal use, while full affective role integration, uniformity across subject domains and coherence remain only partially established; there is no direct analogue of accuracy. These mismatches expose the need for a standard of affective appropriateness, which an account of character must supply. Such an account requires three further conditions: regulatory embodiment that gives valence endogenous stakes, temporal continuity that allows affective episodes to accumulate into a history, and an integrated self-model that binds that history to persistent values. Aristotle's concepts of pathē, hexis, mesotēs and phronēsis are translated into a state-space sketch in which practical wisdom includes competence in estimating normatively salient context, not merely acting on a context description already given. The framework reframes alignment as a problem of durable disposition rather than output conformity, and yields interventional tests with explicit control conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"结构性"替代方案，将情感建模为高维表征空间中的情境敏感区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学，以此绕开"行为等价即情感"与"现象意识为前提"的二元争论，并借助亚里士多德德性概念补足情感恰当性标准。
AI.motivation: 关于人工系统能否有情感的争论常陷入两种不满意的立场：要么将行为等价视为情感的充分条件，要么将现象意识视为使问题在经验上不可及的前提。本文希望提供一种既不依赖行为主义也不依赖现象意识门槛的结构性替代框架。
AI.method: 将情感建模为高维表征状态空间中的情境敏感区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学；用已发表的"语言模型表征充分性标准"评估机制可解释性证据；并提出情感恰当性标准所依赖的"品格"三条件——具身调节（内生的效价利害）、时间连续性（情感事件累积为历史）、整合的自我模型（将历史与持久价值绑定）。同时将亚里士多德的pathē、hexis、mesotēs、phronēsis转译为状态空间草图，其中实践智慧包括估计规范性显著情境的能力。
AI.result: 机制可解释性发现支持大语言模型中存在因果活跃的情感概念表征，但不证明主观感受或完整情感能动性。对照充分性标准：干预提供了因果使用的强证据；但完整的情感角色整合、跨主体域的一致性与连贯性仅部分确立；且不存在与"准确率"直接对应的类比项。
AI.conclusion: 这些不匹配暴露了对"情感恰当性"标准的需求，而这需要品格理论来提供。该框架将对齐问题重新界定为持久倾向问题而非输出一致性，并给出带有明确控制条件的干预性检验。

title: A Combinatorial Benders Decomposition Framework for Two-Dimensional Irregular Bin Packing Problems with Convex Polygons
summary: Two-dimensional irregular bin packing combines combinatorial bin-assignment decisions with difficult geometric feasibility constraints, making exact optimization challenging. This paper develops an exact combinatorial Benders decomposition framework for the two-dimensional irregular bin packing problem with convex polygons, coupling a pattern-based master problem with an exact single-bin geometric feasibility oracle. The dynamically strengthened Benders master is solved by a tailored exact branch-and-price procedure that incorporates objective-layered search and adaptive exact pricing. Geometric information obtained from the oracle is further fed back to the master and pricing processes through dynamically generated Benders feasibility cuts, which progressively restrict the subsequent pricing problems. Computational experiments are conducted on 540 benchmark instances from 18 classes. The proposed method obtains the optimal solution for 318 instances across 12 classes within a 3600-second time limit. On these classes, the proposed method solves more instances than a direct mixed-integer programming formulation and a baseline combinatorial Benders decomposition approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种精确组合Benders分解框架，求解凸多边形二维不规则装箱问题，结合模式主问题与单箱几何可行性oracle，并用定制的分支定价方法求解。
AI.motivation: 二维不规则装箱同时包含组合装箱分配与困难几何可行性约束，精确优化极具挑战。
AI.method: 构建组合Benders分解框架：主问题基于模式、oracle精确判定单箱几何可行性；主问题通过定制精确分支定价求解，含目标分层搜索与自适应精确定价；利用oracle几何信息动态生成Benders可行性割，逐步限制后续定价问题。
AI.result: 在来自18个类的540个基准算例上，3600秒时限内对12个类的318个算例求得最优解，并在这些类上优于直接混合整数规划模型和基线组合Benders分解方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提精确分解与分支定价结合的方法能有效求解凸多边形二维不规则装箱问题，并在部分算例类上取得优于基线的表现。

title: Causal Bayesian Optimization: Foundations, Methods, and Applications
comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary: Causal Bayesian Optimization (CBO) combines causal inference with Bayesian optimization to enable sample-efficient intervention selection in systems with causal structure. This survey provides a systematic review of CBO through a unified BO-loop perspective, showing how causal assumptions shape intervention search spaces, surrogate models, acquisition functions, and decision policies. We organize existing methods by graph and system-knowledge assumptions, environment, intervention representation, surrogate architecture, and decision rule, and connect CBO to causal bandits, Bayesian experimental design, safe optimization, policy search, and causal abstraction. We also introduce a reproducibility-oriented benchmark spanning hard- and soft-intervention settings, with standardized GAP and a new trajectory-aware Path-Aware GAP (PA-GAP), evaluating seven CBO methods and a non-causal BO baseline across thirteen datasets, three budgets, and two metrics. Results show that no method dominates uniformly: rankings depend on dataset, budget, metric, and how causal information is used, while strong non-causal baselines remain competitive in several settings. Controlled graph-misspecification and omitted-variable stress tests further show that rankings can change substantially when learner-side causal information is perturbed. We conclude by identifying key open challenges, including robustness to causal-assumption violations, scalable unknown-graph optimization, mixed intervention types, realistic cost models, stronger theoretical guarantees, and integration with modern representation learning and causal abstractions.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于因果贝叶斯优化(CBO)的系统综述，以统一BO循环视角组织现有方法，并提出可复现基准(含PA-GAP指标)与压力测试。
AI.motivation: CBO将因果推断与贝叶斯优化结合，可提升有因果结构系统的干预选择样本效率，但现有方法分散、缺乏统一视角与标准化评估。
AI.method: 以统一BO循环视角(因果假设如何塑造干预搜索空间、代理模型、采集函数与决策策略)梳理方法，按图/系统知识假设、环境、干预表示、代理架构、决策规则分类，并关联因果bandit、贝叶斯实验设计、安全优化、策略搜索与因果抽象。
AI.result: 提出面向可复现的基准，涵盖硬/软干预，标准化GAP与新的路径感知PA-GAP；在13数据集、3预算、2指标上评测7种CBO方法与1个非因果BO基线。无方法全面占优，排名依赖数据、预算、指标及因果信息使用方式，强非因果基线仍具竞争力；图误设与遗漏变量压力测试显著改变排名。
AI.conclusion: 总结开放挑战：因果假设违反的鲁棒性、可扩展未知图优化、混合干预类型、真实成本模型、更强理论保证，以及与表示学习和因果抽象的集成。

title: AoI-Driven Hierarchical Learning for Cooperative Resource Sharing in Multi-Operator UAV Networks
summary: Uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted networks provide a versatile paradigm for on-demand connectivity. However, in multi-operator aerial networks (MOANs), the joint optimization of cooperative resource sharing and 3D trajectory control to maintain information freshness is a complex combinatorial problem, which can be shown to be NP-hard. To address this computational complexity, we propose an age of information (AoI)-driven hierarchical deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework. Specifically, a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network (D3QN) architecture is deployed at both the operator and UAV decision layers to mitigate overestimation bias and enhance stability in high-dimensional state spaces. To improve system resilience, we introduce an AoI- and load-aware outage compensation mechanism that prioritizes users based on instantaneous transmission demands and temporal freshness. Furthermore, a normalized load exchange balance metric is incorporated to regulate cooperative behavior and ensure resource fairness across operators. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed hierarchical D3QN significantly outperforms conventional DRL, non-cooperative, and cooperative benchmarks, reducing the average AoI by up to 56.1% under severe congestion while ensuring superior inter-operator fairness and outage mitigation.

AI.tldr: 提出面向多运营商空中网络的AoI驱动分层DRL框架，联合优化协作资源共享与3D轨迹控制以最小化信息年龄。
AI.motivation: 多运营商空中网络（MOANs）中，协作资源共享与3D轨迹控制的联合优化为NP难组合问题，需在保持信息新鲜度（AoI）的同时兼顾计算复杂度与运营商间公平性。
AI.method: 提出AoI驱动的分层深度强化学习框架，在运营商层与无人机层均部署Dueling Double DQN（D3QN）以缓解高维状态下的过估计偏差、提升稳定性；引入AoI与负载感知的中断补偿机制按实时传输需求和时效性优先调度用户；并加入归一化负载交换平衡指标以规范协作行为、保障资源公平。
AI.result: 仿真表明，所提分层D3QN显著优于常规DRL、非协作及协作基线，在严重拥塞下平均AoI降低最多56.1%，并实现更优的运营商间公平性与中断缓解。
AI.conclusion: 分层D3QN框架能有效解决MOANs中资源与轨迹联合优化难题，在降低AoI、提升公平性与系统韧性方面具有显著优势。

title: GRRR: The Geometry of Reshaping, Rotation, and Routing in Decoder LLM post-training
summary: We study how post-training changes the weights of Large Language Models (LLMs) relative to their pretrained weights. Across 12 post-training chains with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), we express each weight update in the pretrained matrix's singular value decomposition (SVD) frame. This decomposition separates the changes of three geometrically distinct components: diagonal values, which reshapes singular values; off-diagonal values, which rotates the coupling between pretrained input and output directions; and null-space values, which routes outside the matrix's original nonzero SVD core. On a math evaluation suite, we find that removing the diagonal component usually preserves most of the gains from post-training.
