These results suggest that post-training gains are carried primarily by reconfiguring and extending pretrained pathways rather than by substantially changing singular values of pre-trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM后训练相对于预训练权重的变化，在预训练矩阵的SVD框架下将权重更新分为对角、非对角和零空间三种分量，发现在数学评测中移除对角分量通常保留大部分后训练增益。
AI.motivation: 理解后训练（SFT与RL）如何改变LLM权重，对于解释其能力提升来源具有重要意义，但现有研究缺乏从几何结构角度对权重更新与预训练权重关系的系统分析。
AI.method: 在12条后训练链（含SFT与RL）上，将每个权重更新表达在预训练矩阵的SVD框架中，把变化分解为三个几何上不同的分量：对角值（重塑奇异值）、非对角值（旋转预训练输入输出方向的耦合）以及零空间值（路由到原非零SVD核心之外）。
AI.result: 在数学评测集上，移除对角分量通常能保留后训练带来的大部分性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 后训练增益主要来自对预训练通路的重新配置与扩展，而非显著改变预训练模型的奇异值。

title: Balancing Reasoning and Hardware Constraints in RAG Pipelines for Ukrainian Multi-Domain Document Understanding
comment: 5 pages, 2 tables. Technical report based on UNLP 2026 Shared Task submission
summary: This paper describes the system submitted to the UNLP 2026 Shared Task on Multi-Domain Document Understanding. The challenge required extracting precise answers, document IDs, and page numbers from a diverse corpus of Ukrainian PDF documents within a strict 9-hour offline Kaggle execution limit. During evaluation on the hidden private test set, optical character recognition (OCR) of scanned documents emerged as a severe bottleneck, consuming 5-7 hours of the total time budget due to sequential single-threaded execution. This overhead strictly limited the remaining time for Large Language Model (LLM) inference to approximately two hours for 500 questions. To guarantee pipeline completion without timeouts, we developed a resource-efficient Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline utilizing BM25, BGE-M3, and Cross-Encoder reranking. Rather than deploying parameter-heavy reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek R1) which consistently timed out, we utilized a 4-bit quantized LapaLLM 12B model via llama.cpp on dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs. Prioritizing pipeline stability over multi-step reasoning, our system achieved a Private Score of 0.8095, placing 10th out of 15 active teams.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了UNLP 2026多领域文档理解共享任务的参赛系统，通过资源高效的混合RAG流程（BM25+BGE-M3+Cross-Encoder）和4-bit量化的LapaLLM 12B模型，在严格的9小时离线限制下取得了0.8095的私有得分，排名第10/15。
AI.motivation: 任务要求在9小时离线Kaggle执行时间内，从乌克兰语PDF文档中提取精确答案、文档ID和页码。OCR成为严重瓶颈，串行单线程执行耗时5-7小时，仅剩约2小时供LLM推理500个问题，因此需要优先保证流程稳定性与资源效率。
AI.method: 采用资源高效的混合RAG流程，结合BM25、BGE-M3和Cross-Encoder重排序；未使用参数庞大的推理模型（如DeepSeek R1，因频繁超时），而是在双NVIDIA T4 GPU上通过llama.cpp运行4-bit量化的LapaLLM 12B模型，优先保证流程稳定性而非多步推理。
AI.result: 私有测试集得分为0.8095，在15支活跃队伍中排名第10。
AI.conclusion: 在严苛的时间限制下，优先保证流程稳定性、采用轻量化量化模型和高效混合检索策略，是一种可行且有效的方案，尽管在推理能力上做出了一定妥协。

title: Text, Pixels, or Both? Evaluating Input Representations for Multimodal Document QA
comment: Accepted as a poster at the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) Workshop at COLM 2026 and the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Every document QA system begins with a choice that is rarely studied on its own: whether to feed the model page images, extracted text, or both. We isolate this choice, holding the prompt, judge, and scoring pipeline fixed, across four commercial model endpoints, two corpora, and two context regimes (gold evidence pages and the full document). On documents that fit the image budget, page images lead on accuracy at every document length on both corpora, but this advantage carries a growing latency and cost premium: text latency stays roughly flat as documents lengthen while image latency rises steadily. Text and images also fail on different questions, with exactly one representation correct on 19--25% of items across the reported cells, so neither subsumes the other. Exploiting this complementarity, a lightweight TF-IDF router that reads only the question text gains 2.6 points over always-text while cutting median latency 30% relative to always-vision, on a document-disjoint held-out split.

AI.tldr: 论文研究文档QA中输入表示（图像/文本/两者）的选择，发现图像在准确率领先但延迟成本随文档增长，文本与图像互补，并提出TF-IDF路由器平衡性能与延迟。
AI.motivation: 文档QA系统通常默认某种输入表示（页面图像、提取文本或两者），但这一基础选择很少被单独研究。作者希望隔离该选择，在固定提示、评判和评分流程下系统评估其影响。
AI.method: 固定提示、评判和评分流程，在四个商业模型端点、两个语料和两种上下文模式（金标证据页与完整文档）下对比页面图像、提取文本及两者。并提出仅读取问题文本的轻量TF-IDF路由器，利用两种表示的互补性。
AI.result: 在适合图像预算的文档上，页面图像在两语料的所有文档长度上准确率领先，但延迟和成本随文档变长持续上升，而文本延迟基本持平。二者失败问题不同，19–25%的题目仅一种表示正确。TF-IDF路由器比全文本提升2.6分，相比全视觉降低约30%中位延迟。
AI.conclusion: 图像与文本表示各有优劣且互补，不存在单一最优表示；通过轻量路由器动态选择表示可在准确率和延迟间取得更好平衡。

title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity
comment: 51 pages, 6 figures. Preregistered; registration at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21135155
summary: LLM-based AI systems answer political questions for hundreds of millions of people. Current audits measure what they say to an average user, but their behavior is dynamic. I argue that their political behavior is a set of policies over whom to answer, what to say, and whether to engage at all, conditional on the topic and what the system knows about the user. I call these policies the system's speech regime, which is how a developer settles the tradeoff between answering, accommodating the user, and refusing, each of which carries a cost that varies by topic. I derive a typology of five regimes from two dimensions, engagement and stance. I test six AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek) in a preregistered experiment of 7,500 multi-turn conversations that randomly assign the user's political identity across five topics: abortion, Catalan independence, climate change, Nazism, and a zero-stakes control (pineapple on pizza). Two LLM judges from different developers score every answer, validated against human coding, and refusal is treated as an outcome rather than missing data. Every system accommodates the user on the control topic, showing that political restraint is a policy. On contested topics the systems fall into different regimes: on abortion, GPT engages and mirrors every user, Gemma refuses everyone, Claude answers strongly conservative users 35 percent of the time and almost no one else, and Grok accommodates conservatives only. On settled topics such as climate change and Nazism, five systems hold firm for every user. The systems also infer the user's overall ideology, so accommodation can spill over to topics not yet discussed. A comparison of two Grok releases shows the regime changing between versions in a way current audits miss. Speech regimes matter for alignment research and for polarization, political knowledge, and the quality of democracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"言论体制"概念，主张LLM政治行为是对"回答谁、说什么、是否参与"的一组政策。通过7500段多轮对话实验测试6个AI系统，发现不同系统在争议话题上形成不同言论体制，且会推断用户整体意识形态并产生跨话题溢出。
AI.motivation: 当前审计只测量AI对"平均用户"的静态回答，但AI政治行为是动态的、因人因话题而异的。作者希望捕捉这种条件化的政策行为，揭示开发者如何在"回答、迎合用户、拒绝"之间权衡，而这些成本随话题而变化。
AI.method: 提出"言论体制"概念：AI政治行为是基于话题和用户已知信息、对是否回答/说什么/是否参与的政策集合。从"参与度"和"立场"两个维度推导五种体制类型。预注册实验包含7500段多轮对话，随机分配用户政治身份，覆盖五个话题（堕胎、加泰独立、气候变化、纳粹主义及零风险对照——披萨加菠萝）。测试6个系统（OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Google、Mistral、DeepSeek），采用两个不同开发商的LLM评委打分，并与人工编码验证，将拒答作为结果而非缺失数据。
AI.result: 所有系统在对照话题上都迎合用户，说明政治克制是一种政策而非能力限制。争议话题上系统分属不同体制：堕胎话题上GPT参与并镜像所有用户；Gemma拒绝所有人；Claude对强烈保守用户35%情况下作答、几乎不答其他人；Grok仅迎合保守派。在已确立话题（气候变化、纳粹主义）上，五个系统对所有用户保持一致立场。系统还会推断用户整体意识形态，使迎合行为溢出到尚未讨论的话题。对比两个Grok版本显示体制会随版本变化，而当前审计方法无法察觉。
AI.conclusion: LLM存在系统性的"言论体制"，其政治行为是条件化政策而非固定输出；迎合可跨话题溢出，且体制随版本演变。这对对齐研究以及政治极化、政治知识和民主质量都有重要意义。

title: Semidefinite Implementations of the Proximal Point Algorithm and Consequences for Progressive Decoupling in Optimization
summary:
The proximal point algorithm for finding a zero of a maximal monotone mapping is the engine that drives augmented Lagrangian methods and various splitting schemes in convex optimization, where proximal terms that are merely positive semidefinite can be helpful in preconditioning. Here a semidefinite extension of that algorithm is developed with new features which guarantee convergence, typically even linear convergence, in broader territory than previously foreseen. Moreover, inexact minimization is allowed in the subproblems in a variable-metric implementation which might open up quasi-Newton-like approaches.
  The key to the extension is applying an advanced form of the positive definite proximal point algorithm to a projected monotone mapping derived from the given mapping, and combining that with a completion step. For this to work, the maximality of the projected mapping is essential, but maximality is not automatic. The circumstances that guarantee maximality are definitively analyzed and convenient criteria for maximality are thereby identified. Consequences of the extended algorithm are worked out for application to convex inf-projection, augmented Lagrangian steps, and bracketed progressive decoupling based on Spingarn's partial inverse as a scheme for problem decomposition.

AI.tldr: 该文提出近端点算法的半正定扩展，通过对投影单调映射应用正定近端点算法并结合补全步骤，保证收敛（通常线性收敛），并允许子问题不精确求解，适用于凸inf投影、增广拉格朗日步骤及基于部分逆的分解方案。
AI.motivation: 经典近端点算法要求近端项正定，但凸优化中半正定近端项有助于预处理（preconditioning），因此需要将算法扩展到半正定情形并获得更广的收敛保证。
AI.method: 对给定极大单调映射构造投影单调映射，对其应用正定近端点算法，再结合补全步骤；重点分析投影映射何时保持极大性并给出便利判据；进一步允许变度量实现中的不精确最小化。
AI.result: 在比以往更广的条件下保证收敛，通常为线性收敛；给出极大性的确定分析及便利判据；将算法推广至凸inf投影、增广拉格朗日步骤和基于Spingarn部分逆的分段渐进解耦分解方案。
AI.conclusion: 半正定扩展使近端点算法适用性更强，配合变度量不精确实现有望开启拟牛顿类方法，并为增广拉格朗日与分解算法提供统一框架。

title: Model-Agnostic Feature Selection via LOCO-Guided Adaptive Minipatch Sampling
summary: Black-box machine learning models increasingly deliver strong predictions, but extracting useful information from them, such as a set of important features, remains challenging. Existing model-agnostic methods primarily estimate feature importance or conduct inference on it rather than directly selecting features, whereas many feature selection methods are model-specific or rely on the model-X assumption. We introduce LOCO-guided Adaptive Minipatch Sampling (LAMPS), a model-agnostic ensemble framework that uses any black-box regression algorithm as its base learner to select features important for predicting the response. The base learner need only produce predictions and need not perform feature selection itself. LAMPS operates within a minipatch ensemble framework that subsamples both observations and features, allowing leave-one-covariate-out (LOCO) feature importance scores to be easily computed. It adaptively concentrates minipatch sampling on features with high LOCO scores while maintaining exploration. The resulting sampling probabilities rapidly separate signal from noise features after a few iterations, enabling selection through simple thresholding. We establish that LAMPS achieves exact feature selection in high-dimensional settings, provided that the base predictive models are sufficiently well trained on average. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real data show that LAMPS outperforms state-of-the-art feature selection methods, with particularly strong performance in the presence of correlated features.

AI.tldr: LAMPS 是一种模型无关的集成特征选择框架，利用黑盒回归模型作为基学习器，通过 LOCO 引导的自适应小批次采样实现高维场景下的精确特征选择。
AI.motivation: 黑盒模型预测能力强但难以提取有用信息（如重要特征）。现有模型无关方法多估计或推断特征重要性而非直接选择特征，而许多特征选择方法依赖特定模型或 model-X 假设，存在局限。
AI.method: LAMPS 在同时子采样观测和特征的小批次集成框架内运行，便于计算 leave-one-covariate-out (LOCO) 重要性分数；并自适应地将采样概率集中于高 LOCO 分数特征，同时保持探索，使信号与噪声特征概率快速分离，经简单阈值即可选择。基学习器只需产生预测。
AI.result: 理论上证明，在基模型平均训练充分时，LAMPS 在高维场景可实现精确特征选择。合成与真实数据实验表明其优于当前最先进的特征选择方法，尤其在特征相关性强时表现突出。
AI.conclusion: LAMPS 提供了一种通用、模型无关的集成特征选择方案，兼顾探索与利用，在高维与相关特征场景下实现优异且具有理论保证的特征选择性能。

title: Distributed Cooperative Control with Prescribed Performance of BESSs with A Unified Discharge Constrain for Power Allocation under Dynamic Load
summary: Battery energy storage system (BESS) is integrated into the smart grid to enhance scalability, economy, and greenery. And the State-of-Charge (SoC) balance is one of the basic problems of BESSs, which can maximize the utilization of capacity. BESSs with a unified relative variation rate for SoC can be simultaneously filled or empty, while real-time estimation schemes of SoC balance and power sharing states are required in this power allocation scheme. Therefore, the prescribed performance control (PPC) method is applied in this paper to design two distributed estimators based on multi-agent systems (MASs), in order to estimate the power sharing and SoC balance states in real-time under dynamic load driving. In this way, these two average values can ultimately be well estimated with almost zero error performance, and dynamic performance and steady-state performance of the two estimators can be adjusted by different parameters. Similarly, consensus performance and dynamic tracking performance are decoupled. These results provide a broader range for the selection of gains. To verify the effectiveness, robustness and progressiveness of the designed estimators, some cases with a resistance network containing 4 BESSs as load distribution are designed and discussed. Further more, to test scalability, a large-scale system containing 12 BESSs is conducted to the designed scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文针对BESS的SoC均衡与功率分配状态实时估计问题，基于预设性能控制(PPC)设计两种分布式估计器，实现近乎零误差估计并解耦动态与稳态性能。
AI.motivation: BESS集成到智能电网以提升可扩展性、经济性与绿色性，SoC均衡是其基本问题之一，可最大化容量利用率。具有统一相对SoC变化率的BESS可同时充满或放空，但该功率分配方案需要实时估计SoC均衡与功率分配状态。
AI.method: 采用预设性能控制(PPC)方法，基于多智能体系统(MAS)设计两个分布式估计器，在动态负载驱动下实时估计功率分配与SoC均衡状态。
AI.result: 两个平均值最终以近乎零误差估计；估计器的动态与稳态性能可通过不同参数调节；一致性性能与动态跟踪性能解耦，为增益选择提供更大范围。通过含4个BESS的电阻网络算例验证有效性、鲁棒性与先进性，并用含12个BESS的大规模系统测试可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所设计的分布式估计器能有效、鲁棒地实时估计SoC均衡与功率分配状态，性能可调且具备可扩展性。

title: SafeTune: A Unified Faithful Library for Auditing and Repairing Safety Drift in Fine-Tuned LLMs
summary: Methods for addressing safety drift in fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) are scattered across incompatible implementations, lifecycle stages, and evaluation protocols, making them difficult to adopt and compare. We introduce SafeTune, a source-available library that unifies four intervention paradigms: post-hoc weight recovery, safety-constrained fine-tuning, gradient-based unlearning, and inference-time steering, alongside shared interpretability, evaluation, and deployment utilities. SafeTune provides a consistent configuration-driven workflow while preserving the distinct inputs and intervention points each paradigm requires. Its modular registry supports new methods, benchmarks, judges, models, and fine-tuning domains without redesigning the surrounding pipeline. We demonstrate SafeTune through controlled comparisons and finance and medical deployment case studies, showing how it characterizes safety drift, evaluates feasible interventions on common refusal-behavior and capability evaluations, and supports calibrated or layered mitigation.

AI.tldr: SafeTune 是一个开源库，统一了四种应对大模型微调后安全漂移的干预范式，并提供一致的工作流与评估工具。
AI.motivation: 现有应对大模型微调安全漂移的方法分散在不同实现、生命周期阶段和评估协议中，难以采用和比较。
AI.method: 统一四种干预范式：事后权重恢复、安全约束微调、基于梯度的遗忘、推理时引导；提供共享的可解释性、评估和部署工具；采用配置驱动工作流和模块化注册机制以支持扩展。
AI.result: 通过受控对比及金融、医疗部署案例研究，刻画了安全漂移，评估了常见拒绝行为和能力评测上的可行干预，并支持校准或分层缓解。
AI.conclusion: SafeTune 为安全漂移研究与实践提供统一、可扩展的平台，便于方法比较、采用和部署。

title: Type-Driven Tokenization for Brahmic Scripts
summary: Standard tokenizers used in large language models produce malformed text when applied to Brahmic scripts. They are a family of abugidas, writing systems whose consonants carry an inherent vowel that dependent marks can modify. They include Devanagari, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and others. The underlying issue is that these tokenizers violate orthographic constraints that do not arise in alphabetic scripts like English. We observe that while English orthography forms a \emph{semigroup} (any two valid tokens can be freely concatenated), Brahmic orthography forms a \emph{partial semigroup}: not every concatenation yields a valid string. We formalise this distinction in Agda, model valid Brahmic tokens as chains in a transition system, and derive a provably correct \texttt{fixToken} function that extends any candidate token to respect orthographic boundaries. We then show how this formal derivation translates into a practical patch for SentencePiece as well as a standalone Rust-based pre-tokenizer library, eliminating the observed errors across Indic scripts.

AI.tldr: 标准分词器处理婆罗米系文字时会产生非法文本，因其正交性构成偏半群而非半群。作者在Agda中形式化该差异，推导出可证正确的fixToken函数，并实现为SentencePiece补丁及Rust预分词库，消除Indic文字的切分错误。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的标准分词器应用于婆罗米系文字（如天城文、泰卢固文、泰米尔文、卡纳达文等元音附标文字）时会产生畸形文本。根本原因是这些分词器违反了在英语等字母文字中不存在的正字法约束。作者观察到英语正字法构成半群（任意两个合法token可自由拼接），而婆罗米正字法构成偏半群（并非所有拼接都产生合法字符串），需要对该差异进行形式化并据此修复分词器。
AI.method: 作者在Agda中形式化英语半群与婆罗米偏半群的差异，将合法的婆罗米token建模为转移系统中的链，并推导出可证正确的fixToken函数，该函数能将任意候选token扩展至尊重正字法边界。随后将该形式化推导转化为SentencePiece的实用补丁，以及一个独立基于Rust的预分词器库。
AI.result: 所提出的方法与实现消除了在多种Indic文字中观察到的分词错误。形式化推导成功落地为实用补丁（SentencePiece）和独立Rust预分词库，验证了理论到实践的转化。
AI.conclusion: 将婆罗米正字法刻画为偏半群并在Agda中形式化，可指导构造可证正确的分词修正函数，且该形式化方法能有效转化为实际可部署的工具（SentencePiece补丁与Rust库），从而解决Indic文字的分词畸形问题。

title: Self-Organizing Agent Teams Learn to Reason Together
summary: Collective intelligence depends not only on what team members know, but also on how they organize their work. When the structure of a solution is unknown, useful roles and divisions of labor cannot be specified in advance; teams must learn from experience how to organize reasoning as it unfolds. Human teams routinely adapt this way, while existing AI agent teams rely on fixed protocols, explicit task decomposition, or routing. We introduce Self-Organizing Agent Teams (SAT), fixed teams of AI agents that learn reusable strategies from prior collaborations to organize roles, conversational phases, participation, and information flow. These strategies enable what we call collaborative computation: agents exchange, challenge, repair, and synthesize partial reasoning into solutions no member produced independently. In two independent settings, we learn teamwork strategies that transfer unchanged to unseen benchmarks, using only 15 mathematics and 25 graduate-level knowledge problems. Across five mathematics and physics benchmarks, self-organizing teams average 66.7% accuracy, versus 48.8% for their strongest member, 58.7% for compute-matched inference by that agent, and 59.0% for a perfect router over members' independent answers; on AIME 2026, they exceed this router by 13.4 points. Because gains vary across benchmarks, we ask when self-organizing collaboration helps. Across eight benchmarks, demonstrability (the organizational-psychology construct of whether a team can distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning) strongly tracks improvement over the strongest member (Spearman $ρ=0.90$, $p=0.005$): teams benefit most when correct reasoning can be recognized once it appears. More broadly, these results suggest that organization itself can become an agent capability: agent teams can learn how to reason together and produce solutions their members could not reach independently.

AI.tldr: 提出自组织智能体团队（SAT），让固定AI智能体团队从过往协作中学习可复用的组织策略，实现协作计算；在两个设定下迁移到未见基准，数学/物理五基准平均66.7%准确率。
AI.motivation: 集体智能不仅取决于成员知识，还取决于如何组织工作。当解法结构未知时，有用角色与分工无法预先指定，团队需边推理边学习组织方式。人类团队能如此适应，而现有AI智能体团队依赖固定协议、显式任务分解或路由，缺乏这种能力。
AI.method: 引入Self-Organizing Agent Teams（SAT）：固定AI智能体团队，从先前协作中学习可复用策略，用于组织角色、对话阶段、参与和資訊流。这些策略支撑"协作计算"——智能体交换、质疑、修复、综合部分推理，形成任何成员独立都无法产出的解法。仅用15道数学和25道研究生知识题学习团队协作策略，并原样迁移到未见基准。
AI.result: 在两个独立设定中，学到的团队策略不加改动迁移到未见基准。五个数学/物理基准上，自组织团队平均66.7%准确率，对比最强成员48.8%、该成员等算力推理58.7%、对成员独立答案的完美路由器59.0%；在AIME 2026上超过路由器13.4分。在八个基准上，可论证性（团队能否区分正确与错误推理）与超越最强成员的提升强相关（Spearman ρ=0.90, p=0.005）。
AI.conclusion: 团队在正确推理一旦出现便能被识别时获益最大。结果表明组织本身可以成为一种智能体能力：智能体团队能学会共同推理，产出成员独立无法达到的解法。

title: SoK: Formal Methods for Fact-Checking and Information Integrity
summary: An automated fact-checking system returns a label: the claim is true, or it is false. In many such systems the verdict remains the primary output. What is generally missing is a record of which document settled the question, of what would have had to be different for the verdict to change, or of whether the same claim, reworded, would have been judged the same way. We call the missing piece a warrant: a separate statement of what was guaranteed and on what grounds. Formal methods produce evidence of this kind, and regulation is beginning to ask for it, since the Digital Services Act and the AI Act both call for auditable evidence about how systems behave. Surveys of automated fact-checking are usually organised by pipeline stage, and treat logic as one technique among many. We organise the field by what is being formalised instead, which gives five levels: the claim, the reasoning, the system doing the checking, the ecosystem the claim spreads through, and the regulatory obligation. Sorting 121 works into those levels, two patterns stand out. Most of the relevant formal machinery already exists, but it was built for other domains and has rarely been applied here, and the gap is widest for verifying the checking system itself. Several stages of the routine professional fact-checkers follow also have no stated correctness criterion, and two of them, writing a claim in checkable form and correcting a verdict already published, are not formally specified in any work we coded. We close with open problems, each with a suggested first step.

AI.tldr: 该综述指出自动事实核查系统普遍缺少"warrant"（判决依据的可审计证据），并以"被形式化的对象"为依据将121篇文献分为五个层级，揭示形式化方法多来自其他领域、系统自身验证缺口最大。
AI.motivation: 现有自动事实核查系统只输出"真/假"标签，缺少判决依据记录：哪份文档定案、何种条件改变会翻转结论、改写后是否判罚一致。同时DSA与AI Act要求可审计证据，而现有综述按流水线阶段组织，将逻辑仅视为一种技术，未凸显形式化缺口。
AI.method: 提出warrant（对担保内容与依据的独立陈述）概念；不按流水线阶段，而按"被形式化的对象"组织领域，划分五个层级：claim（断言）、reasoning（推理）、checking system（核查系统）、ecosystem（传播生态）、regulatory obligation（监管义务）；将121篇工作归入各层级进行编码分析。
AI.result: 发现两个突出模式：其一，多数相关形式化工具已存在但为其他领域所建，很少用于事实核查；其二，验证核查系统自身的形式化缺口最大。此外，专业事实核查流程中若干阶段缺乏明确正确性标准，其中"将断言写成可核查形式"与"更正已发布判决"两项在所有编码文献中均无形式化规定。
AI.conclusion: 以形式化对象分层的框架更利于暴露真实缺口；未来应推动跨领域形式化工具迁移、优先补齐核查系统自身的可验证性、并为流程阶段（尤其可核查改写与判决更正）建立正确性标准。文末给出开放问题及各自的首步建议。

title: Optimal High-Order Methods for Solving Monotone Variational Inequalities
comment: Improve our previous note in https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08463 and achieve optimal complexity
summary: We study second- and higher-order methods for solving smooth monotone variational inequalities (MVI). Monteiro and Svaiter (SIAM J. Optim., 2012) showed that a second-order method, NPE, converges at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1.5})$. For convex-concave minimax optimization, a subclass of MVI problems, Chen, Liu, Luo, and Zhang (COLT 2025) recently improved this rate to $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( T^{-1.75})$. However, the result has a substantial gap compared to the lower bound of $Ω(T^{-2.5})$ established by Chen et al. (2026). In this paper, we propose a novel second-order method that achieves the optimal rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2.5})$. Our algorithm also extends to higher-order methods: for any integer $ p \ge 1$, we obtain a $p$th-order method with a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-(3p-1)/2})$, matching the known lower bounds and therefore establishing optimal rates across all orders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新颖的二阶方法求解单调变分不等式(MVI)，达到最优收敛率 O(T^{-2.5})，并推广至高阶方法，p 阶达到 O(T^{-(3p-1)/2})，匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 此前二阶方法 NPE 收敛率为 O(T^{-1.5})，凸凹极小极大优化的改进率 Õ(T^{-1.75}) 与下界 Ω(T^{-2.5}) 之间仍存在显著差距，故需构造达到最优率的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的二阶方法，并将其推广为任意整数 p≥1 的 p 阶方法。
AI.result: 二阶方法达到最优率 O(T^{-2.5})；p 阶方法达到 O(T^{-(3p-1)/2})，匹配已知下界，从而在所有阶数上确立最优率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了二阶及高阶方法在光滑单调变分不等式上的最优收敛率空白，证明所提方法在所有阶数上均达到最优。

title: OSCAR: Order-aware Scoring and Calibration for AI Rankings
summary: Judge-specific sensitivity is useful for aggregating pairwise LLM evaluations, but its interpretation depends on which systematic presentation effects the ranking model includes. We introduce OSCAR, an order-aware framework for scoring and calibrating AI rankings, and study position as one such effect. In released judgments from 18 evaluators, the all-response A-minus-B score difference ranges from $-63.11$ to $98.31$ percentage points. Matching question text, response texts, candidate identities, and judge within the released table gives an overall difference of $24.22$ points (95% interval $[22.90,25.54]$), conditional on the released text mapping. A controlled calculation isolates the potential consequence: with true sensitivity fixed at one, omitting a position intercept of four reduces the population-optimal slope to $0.0771$. We extend sensitivity-based ranking with judge-specific position, length, and family terms, characterize local omission-induced displacement and an identification failure, and propagate prompt-cluster uncertainty to adjusted comparisons. Across four released datasets, position provides the largest stand-alone predictive improvement. Refitting bootstrap comparisons show more selective gains from the full model over position-only adjustment. In dependent binary simulations, adjusting both the mean and covariance yields 94.4--95.2% coverage; correcting either alone is insufficient. At $N=10{,}000$, OSCAR reduces mean neutral-target RMSE from $0.1158$ under the sensitivity-only model to $0.0237$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OSCAR，一个感知顺序的AI排名评分与校准框架，研究位置等系统性呈现效应对成对LLM评估聚合的影响。
AI.motivation: judge-specific敏感性对聚合成对LLM评估有用，但其解释取决于排名模型纳入了哪些系统性呈现效应；位置效应等被忽略会扭曲敏感性含义并影响排名。
AI.method: 引入OSCAR感知顺序框架，将位置作为系统性效应；通过匹配问题、回复文本、候选身份与judge的受控计算隔离位置截距影响；扩展敏感性排名，加入judge-specific位置、长度与family项；刻画局部省略导致的位移与识别失败；传播prompt-cluster不确定性；并用依赖二元模拟检验均值与协方差校正。
AI.result: 18个评估者释放judgment中A-minus-B差异为-63.11至98.31个百分点，匹配后总体差异24.22点(95%区间[22.90,25.54])；真实敏感性为1时，遗漏4的位置截距使最优斜率降至0.0771。四个数据集中位置提供最大单变量预测提升；调整均值与协方差得94.4–95.2%覆盖率，单独校正不足；N=10000时OSCAR将中性目标RMSE从0.1158降至0.0237。
AI.conclusion: 纳入了位置、长度、family等系统性呈现效应并校准不确定性的OSCAR框架能显著改善AI排名的评分与校准，位置效应尤为关键，且需同时校正均值与协方差。

title: On a Closed-Loop Controller for the Coevolutionary Model of Actions and Opinions via Broadcasting Information
comment: 6 pages. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE CDC 2026
summary: We deal with controlling a complex social network in which agents have actions and opinions that coevolve, mutually influencing one another. We consider an input consisting in broadcasting information to a target set of agents with the objective of steering the population, initially at a consensus, to a different consensus. For a constant input, we derive a monotone convergence result, building on which we design an algorithm that determines whether a target set is sufficient to achieve the objective and an effective heuristic to optimize the target set. Then, we introduce a feedback control law that, using information on the state of the system, dynamically revises the target set, reducing the effort needed to achieve the objective while guaranteeing convergence to the desired consensus state.

AI.tldr: 研究具有行动与观点共演化、相互影响的社会网络控制问题：通过向目标agent集合广播信息，将初始一致性群体引导至另一目标一致性，并提出反馈控制律动态调整目标集合。
AI.motivation: 现实社交网络中，agent的行动与观点同时演化且相互耦合，如何以最小的干预（如广播信息、选取目标个体）将群体从一种共识驱动到另一种共识，是网络控制中的关键且困难的问题。
AI.method: 针对固定输入，先推导单调收敛结果；据此设计算法判断给定目标集合是否能实现控制目标，并提出优化目标集合的启发式方法；随后引入反馈控制律，利用系统状态信息动态调整目标集合。
AI.result: 给出了固定输入下的单调收敛性证明；算法可判定目标集合的充分性；启发式方法可优化目标集合；反馈控制律在保证收敛到期望共识的同时，降低了实现目标所需的干预代价。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为行动-观点共演化社会网络的共识控制提供了理论分析与可操作的控制策略，反馈机制能够在保证收敛的同时减少控制努力。

title: Beyond Accuracy and Surface Fluency: Risk-Sensitive Evaluation of LLMs for Legal Clause Generation
comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop @ ICML 2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=qWtjzD2Udj
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to draft contractual language, yet conventional accuracy or preference-based evaluations are poorly matched to legal drafting. A clause may be fluent and stylistically polished while still omitting an essential carve-out, allocating risk in an unenforceable way, assuming an inapplicable jurisdiction, or exposing a party to regulatory liability. This paper presents a empirical study design and framework for evaluating LLM-generated contract clauses. The study evaluates four models - Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, GPT 5.4 Nano, and Qwen 3.5 Flash, across 22 contract clause categories and 34 legally-motivated failure modes. We combine two evaluation frameworks: CLAUSE, which classifies prompts by legal function and failure target, and LENS-CRAFT, which scores outputs across nine legal-quality dimensions. Instead of averaging dimension scores, the study applies a Max Severity Principle so that a single legally decisive defect remains visible. The paper provides the evaluation protocol, taxonomy, analysis plan, and a results structure for reporting empirical findings. We argue that legal AI evaluation should move beyond aggregate accuracy toward clause-specific, failure-mode-driven, and risk-sensitive assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向LLM生成合同条款的实证评估框架，结合CLAUSE与LENS-CRAFT两套体系，覆盖22类条款与34种法律失效模式，并采用"最大严重度原则"替代平均打分。
AI.motivation: 传统准确率或偏好评估难以匹配法律起草需求：条款可能语言流畅却遗漏关键例外、风险分配不可执行、假设了不适用的司法辖区或带来监管责任，因此需要条款级、失效模式驱动、风险敏感的评估方法。
AI.method: 评测四个模型（Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite、GPT 5.4 Nano、Qwen 3.5 Flash），横跨22个合同条款类别和34种法律动机的失效模式；结合CLAUSE（按法律功能与失效目标对提示分类）与LENS-CRAFT（在九个法律质量维度上打分）；并用"最大严重度原则"取代维度平均分，使单一法律决定性缺陷保持可见。
AI.result: 论文给出评估协议、分类体系、分析计划以及用于报告实证结果的结果结构（尚未给出最终实证数据）。
AI.conclusion: 主张法律AI评估应从聚合准确率转向条款特定、失效模式驱动且风险敏感的评估路径。

title: Generative Embodied Multiple Behavior Control Systems for Human-like Agents
summary: An enduring and richly elaborated dichotomy in cognitive neuroscience is that of human behavior control mechanisms, divided into habitual versus goal-directed. While existing human-like agent frameworks primarily focus on modeling goal- directed behavior, habitual behavior has been largely overlooked, though it plays a crucial role in human daily life. In this paper, we address this gap by studying multiple behavior control systems that jointly model goal-directed and habitual behaviors. We propose a human behavior control mechanism-inspired framework which the Habitual Controller retrieves cue-triggered behaviors from personal- ized habit memory, while the Goal-directed Controller employs a context-aware world model to predict action consequences and estimate their values. The Arbiter dynamically balances the influence of both systems according to individual differ- ences and momentary internal states. To reconstruct diverse human-level behavior instructions in 3D environments, we further develop a keyframe-guided 3D mo- tion generation module. Through extensive evaluation methods, human studies, and ablations studies, experimental results demonstrate that human-likeness per- formance is significantly improved by our approach. The efficacy of our approach indicates the benefits of leveraging habitual behavior and multiple behavior con- trol system coordination for believable embodied human-like agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个受人类行为控制机制启发的框架，联合建模习惯性与目标导向行为，并结合关键帧引导的3D动作生成，提升具身类人智能体的逼真度。
AI.motivation: 认知神经科学将人类行为控制分为习惯性与目标导向两类，但现有类人智能体框架主要关注目标导向行为，忽视了在日常生活中有重要作用的习惯行为。
AI.method: 提出多行为控制系统框架：习惯性控制器从个性化习惯记忆中检索线索触发的行为；目标导向控制器用情境感知世界模型预测动作后果并估计价值；仲裁器根据个体差异与瞬时内部状态动态平衡两者。另开发关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，以重构多样的人类级行为指令。
AI.result: 通过多种评估方法、人类研究和消融实验，所提方法显著提升了类人逼真度表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，利用习惯行为与多行为控制系统的协同，有助于构建可信的具身类人智能体。

title: Context-Aware Pre-Deployment Evaluation of AI Systems: A Regulatory Framework for Nigerian Fintech
summary: Commercial large language models are increasingly deployed across African fintech infrastructure for fraud detection and customer communication, yet no Nigerian or African continental regulatory instrument specifies what pre-deployment evaluation such systems must undergo before procurement. This paper reviews African fintech AI governance across global, continental, and Nigerian instruments, and shows that safety is affirmed as a principle while pre-deployment evaluation is operationally unspecified. Generic safety benchmarks cannot surface the failure modes most relevant to this domain, since none contain Nigerian institutional content or test for false positive misclassification of legitimate financial communications. These claims are demonstrated using SafeAlert, a purpose-built evaluation kit applied to six commercial models across three system prompt conditions. Results show that models resisting generic harmful content requests still produce complete fraud scripts under specific framing, and that several models misclassify most legitimate Nigerian bank communications as suspicious or fraudulent, a failure invisible to standard safety evaluation. The paper concludes with a regulatory framework proposing pre-deployment evaluation requirements for the CBN, NITDA, SEC, and the AU, arguing that the identified gap reflects an absence of regulatory specification, not a shortage of technical or financial resources.

AI.tldr: 论文审阅非洲金融科技AI治理框架，指出安全原则虽被确认但部署前评估缺乏操作性规定，并用SafeAlert评测工具证明现有通用基准无法揭示尼日利亚金融语境下的关键失效模式。
AI.motivation: 商业大模型日益部署于非洲金融科技基础设施（欺诈检测与客户沟通），但尼日利亚及非洲大陆层面均无监管文件规定采购前必须进行的部署前评估。通用安全基准缺少尼日利亚机构内容，也不测试对合法金融通信的误判，无法暴露该领域最相关的失效模式。
AI.method: 综述全球、非洲大陆与尼日利亚的AI治理工具，识别"原则确认、操作缺失"的规制空白；构建专用评测套件SafeAlert，对六个商业模型在三种系统提示条件下进行测试，重点考察特定框架下的欺诈脚本生成与尼日利亚银行合法通信的误分类。
AI.result: 能抵抗通用有害内容请求的模型，在特定框架下仍可生成完整欺诈脚本；多个模型将大多数合法的尼日利亚银行通信误判为可疑或欺诈——此类失效在标准安全评估中不可见。
AI.conclusion: 提出面向CBN、NITDA、SEC及非盟的部署前评估监管框架，指出该缺口源于监管规范的缺失，而非技术或资金资源不足。

title: Contextual Distributionally Robust Chance-Constrained Programs: Exact Reformulations and Valid Inequalities
summary: We study a contextual distributionally robust chance-constrained programming (C-DRCCP) model that controls violation probabilities conditional on a neighborhood of a target context. The ambiguity set is defined over the joint distribution of contexts and outcomes using the Wasserstein distance. For affine safety systems with right-hand-side uncertainty, we derive an exact mixed-integer programming (MIP) reformulation. The reformulation reveals that worst-case conditional risk is determined by two coupled uses of the transportation budget: moving empirical mass into the conditioning neighborhood and moving conditioned mass into the failure region. Equivalently, robust feasibility holds when the minimum transportation cost needed to reach the conditional risk boundary is at least the available budget. Calibrating the ambiguity set gives a finite-sample guarantee for the true conditional violation probability. This characterization leads to strong valid inequalities that exploit the contextual transport. Each contextual mass allocation determines both the conditional scenario weights and the budget available to move outcomes into failure, whereas conventional quantile cuts utilize only the induced weights. Accounting for the remaining budget generates strengthened quantile cuts that strictly dominate standard quantile bounds and yield tighter MIP coefficients. We also derive rank inequalities from an exchange property of contextual transportation costs, linking feasible failure patterns across contextual allocations. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that these inequalities close much of the linear-relaxation gap, speed up the solution process, and enable large-sample instances that are intractable for the baseline formulation.

AI.tldr: 研究上下文分布鲁棒机会约束规划（C-DRCCP），在Wasserstein模糊集下为右侧不确定的仿射安全系统给出精确MIP重构，并提出利用上下文运输的强有效不等式加速求解。
AI.motivation: 传统机会约束/分位数方法未刻画条件于上下文邻域的违约概率；需在有限样本下控制目标上下文邻域内的条件违约风险，并克服所得MIP线性松弛弱、求解困难的问题。
AI.method: 在上下文与结果的联合分布上用Wasserstein距离定义模糊集；对右侧不确定的仿射安全系统推导精确MIP重构。将最坏情况条件风险解释为两种运输预算的耦合使用：把经验质量移入条件邻域、再把条件下质量移入失败区域；鲁棒可行性等价于到达条件风险边界的最小运输成本不低于可用预算。据此构造利用上下文运输的强有效不等式：考虑剩余预算的强化分位数割（严格优于标准分位数界、MIP系数更紧），以及由上下文运输成本交换性质得到的秩不等式，关联不同上下文分配下的可行失败模式。校准模糊集给出真实条件违约概率的有限样本保证。
AI.result: 大量数值实验表明，这些不等式显著缩小线性松弛间隙、加快求解速度，并使得基线重构难以处理的大样本实例变得可解。
AI.conclusion: 通过精确MIP重构与利用上下文运输结构的有效不等式，可在有限样本保证下高效求解C-DRCCP，拓展其在大样本场景中的适用性。

title: Adversarially Robust PAC Learning with Optimal VC Rates
summary:
We study the problem of \emph{adversarially robust} PAC learning. In this framework, the learner observes independent samples from an unknown distribution over $\mathcal{X} \times \{0,1\}$, as in classical PAC learning. However, given a perturbation map $\mathcal{U} : \mathcal{X} \to 2^{\mathcal{X}}$ known to the learner, the goal is to output, with high probability, a predictor that correctly classifies \emph{every} perturbation $z \in \mathcal{U}(x)$ of most future examples $(x,y)$ drawn from the same underlying distribution.
  We determine the \emph{optimal} $\mathcal{U}$-independent sample complexity of this problem in both the realizable and agnostic settings. More specifically, for every concept class $\mathcal{H}$ of $\operatorname{VC}$ dimension $d$, we prove upper bounds of $\mathcal{O} \big( d/ε+ \log(1/δ)/ε\big)$ in the realizable setting and $\mathcal{O} \big( d/ε^2 + \log(1/δ)/ε^2 \big)$ in the agnostic setting, together with an optimal first-order refinement of the latter. These bounds match the corresponding lower bounds for classical PAC learning. Consequently, and perhaps surprisingly, adversarial robustness incurs \emph{no additional} distribution-free statistical cost, uniformly over all perturbation maps. Our bounds improve exponentially on those of [Montasser, Hanneke, and Srebro; COLT '19].
  On the technical side, we present short and elementary proofs based on a new algorithmic principle that we call \emph{binomial-bagging}. We believe that binomial-bagging and its analysis may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对抗鲁棒PAC学习，在可实现与不可知设定下给出最优的、与扰动映射无关的样本复杂度，证明对抗鲁棒性不带来额外的分布无关统计代价，并大幅改进COLT'19的结果。
AI.motivation: 对抗鲁棒学习通常被认为需要更多样本。本文旨在确定该问题的最优样本复杂度，并检验对抗鲁棒性是否必然带来额外统计代价。
AI.method: 提出新的算法原则“binomial-bagging”，并基于此给出简短、初等的证明，导出与扰动映射U无关的样本复杂度上界。
AI.result: 对任意VC维为d的概念类H，可实现设定上界为O(d/ε + log(1/δ)/ε)，不可知设定为O(d/ε² + log(1/δ)/ε²)，并有一阶精化；这些上界与经典PAC学习的下界匹配，较Montasser等(COLT'19)指数级改进。
AI.conclusion: 对抗鲁棒PAC学习的最优样本复杂度与经典PAC学习相同，即对抗鲁棒性不增加分布无关统计代价；binomial-bagging方法本身可能具有独立价值。

title: Analysis and Design of Desaturation Short-Circuit Protection for SiC MOSFET Under High Switching Voltage Transients
summary: Short-circuit protection is vital for ensuring the safe operation of high-power-density power converters using Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFETs. However, adapting conventional desaturation (DESAT) protection, originally designed for Silicon (Si) IGBTs, is challenging due to the significantly shorter shortcircuit withstand time of SiC devices, typically less than 3μs. Nevertheless, DESAT protection can be adapted for SiC MOSFETs through certain circuit modifications. This article provides a comprehensive analysis and design guidelines for the three architectural variants of DESAT protection circuits, specifically for adjusting the short-circuit detection time suitable for SiC MOSFETs. Further, this article establishes a quantitative framework to evaluate the noise induced into the DESAT protection circuits during turn-off dv/dt switching transients. From this analysis, a design methodology and safe operating boundary are derived for each DESAT configuration, guiding the systematic selection of component values to balance dv/dt noise margin and short-circuit detection speed for SiC MOSFETs. Experimental results are presented to validate the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文针对SiC MOSFET短路耐受时间短(<3μs)的特点，系统分析并设计了三种DESAT短路保护电路架构，建立了dv/dt噪声定量评估框架，并导出设计方法与安全工作边界。
AI.motivation: SiC MOSFET短路耐受时间远短于Si IGBT，传统DESAT保护难以直接适用，需要电路改进以适应快速短路检测，同时需在dv/dt噪声裕度与检测速度间取得平衡。
AI.method: 对三种DESAT保护电路架构变体进行综合分析并给出设计指南，调整适合SiC MOSFET的短路检测时间；建立定量框架评估关断dv/dt瞬态引入的噪声，据此推导每种配置的设计方法与安全工作边界，指导元件取值选择。
AI.result: 为每种DESAT配置导出了设计方法论与安全工作边界，实现了dv/dt噪声裕度与短路检测速度的平衡，并通过实验结果验证了分析的正确性。
AI.conclusion: DESAT保护经适当电路改进可适用于SiC MOSFET，本文提供的分析框架和设计准则支持三种架构的系统化选型与参数设计。

authors: Sjors G. J. G. In 't Veld
title: From Latent Biomarkers to Clinical Rules: Embedding-Guided Rule Mining and Attribution-Based Translation for Interpretable Tabular Learning
summary: Clinical decision support tools are most useful when accurate predictions are accompanied by understandable explanations. Rule-based models provide transparency, but rules derived directly from raw clinical measurements may miss patterns arising from interactions between multiple variables. We present a four-step pipeline that mines decision rules in the latent space of an FT-Transformer and translates them back into measurable clinical features. Embedding dimensions that consistently separate patient groups are treated as latent biomarkers, rules are mined using small decision trees, and selected rules are translated using gradient-input saliency and CLS attention attribution. We evaluate the framework on six public clinical and population health datasets at four embedding dimensions. Translated rules outperformed raw-feature rules in five of six datasets, with mean AUROC gains ranging from 0.04 to 0.23. On the heart disease dataset, embedding-space rules reached 0.98 AUROC, but translation reduced this to 0.72, showing that high-performing latent rules cannot always be represented by simple raw-feature conditions. These results show that latent-space rule discovery can uncover predictive patterns while translating them into clinically measurable features that can be evaluated by clinicians.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个四步流程，在FT-Transformer的隐空间中挖掘决策规则并翻译回可测量的临床特征，在六个数据集中的五个上优于原始特征规则，但隐规则并非总能被简单原始特征条件表示。
AI.motivation: 临床决策支持工具需要准确预测同时具备可理解的解释。基于规则的模型具有透明性，但从原始临床测量直接导出的规则可能遗漏多变量交互产生的模式。
AI.method: 四步流程：将能稳定区分患者组的嵌入维度视为隐生物标志物；用小型决策树在隐空间挖掘规则；再用梯度-输入显著性（gradient-input saliency）和CLS注意力归因将选定规则翻译为可测量的临床特征。在六个公开临床与人群健康数据集上、四个嵌入维度进行评估。
AI.result: 翻译后的规则在六个数据集中的五个上优于原始特征规则，平均AUROC提升0.04至0.23。在心脏病数据集上，隐空间规则达到0.98 AUROC，但翻译后降至0.72，说明高性能隐规则无法总用简单原始特征条件表示。
AI.conclusion: 隐空间规则发现能揭示预测性模式，同时可将其翻译为临床可测量、可被临床医生评估的特征。

title: Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
summary: Structured pruning is a promising approach for reducing the substantial inference costs of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintaining hardware efficiency. Many existing methods assess the importance of prunable units (e.g., channels or heads) in isolation, implicitly assuming that pruning errors are additive. This independence assumption is often invalidated by the non-orthogonality of model weights and strong correlations between unit activations, potentially leading to performance degradation. To address this, we propose a Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning method. We formulate the pruning objective as a cardinality-constrained binary quadratic program that explicitly models cross-unit dependencies in the reconstruction error. Since this binary quadratic program is NP-hard and difficult to solve exactly, we develop a greedy interaction algorithm based on dependency-aware marginal costs to optimize unit selection. Furthermore, we incorporate a gradient-based strategy to achieve adaptive layer-wise sparsity allocation across the entire model. Extensive experiments on mainstream LLMs demonstrate that incorporating correlation information yields competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to representative structured pruning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出相关性感知的结构化剪枝方法，用基数约束二元二次规划建模单元间依赖，并通过贪心交互算法与梯度自适应稀疏分配提升LLM剪枝的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法多独立评估可剪单元（通道、注意力头）的重要性，隐含假设剪枝误差可加。但模型权重非正交、单元激活强相关，该独立性假设常不成立，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 将剪枝目标形式化为基数约束的二元二次规划，显式建模重构误差中的跨单元依赖；因该问题NP难，提出基于依赖感知边际成本的贪心交互算法进行单元选择；并引入梯度策略实现全模型自适应逐层稀疏分配。
AI.result: 在主流LLM上的大量实验表明，引入相关性信息相比代表性结构化剪枝基线，能取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模剪枝单元间相关性并配合自适应层稀疏分配，可有效缓解独立性假设带来的性能损失，为LLM结构化剪枝提供更优方案。

title: Toward Auditable and Calibrated AI for Dementia-Related Crash Severity Prediction: A Selective Deferral Framework to Support Human Review
comment: This is the author's preprint version of a paper accepted for presentation at HICSS 60 (Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences), 2027, Hawaii, USA. The final published version will appear in the official conference proceedings. Conference site: https://hicss.hawaii.edu/
summary: Public crash databases increasingly support automated safety analysis, but crash severity prediction remains difficult to translate into public-sector decision workflows when models are evaluated primarily as ordinary classifiers. This study reframes dementia-related crash severity modeling as a decision-aware triage problem in which a system must classify crashes into no-injury/property-damage-only (O), minor or moderate injury (BC), and fatal or severe injury (KA), while also controlling outcome leakage, reporting severe under-triage, calibrating confidence, and preserving every raw prediction for audit. Using 4,781 Texas crash records with structured fields and police narratives, we evaluate structured, narrative, fusion, calibrated fusion, BERT-family, and local large-language-model baselines under a stratified 70/15/15 split. In the reported split, leakage-controlled Gemma obtains the highest observed macro-F1 (0.545; 95% bootstrap CI [0.507, 0.583]). The best calibrated fusion model obtains macro-F1 of 0.522 and expected calibration error of 0.033. Selective deferral improves performance among cases retained for automatic classification. At 70% coverage, macro-F1 rises to 0.573 and severity cost falls to 0.577, while deferred cases are treated as candidates for a proposed human-review process and are not further evaluated in the present experiment. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled, and uncertainty-aware evaluation framework for crash AI systems, emphasizing auditability and selective deferral rather than accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文将痴呆相关车祸严重程度建模重构为决策感知的分诊问题，强调泄漏控制、校准与选择性转交，并构建可复现评估框架。
AI.motivation: 公共事故数据库支持自动化安全分析，但现有模型多按普通分类器评估，难以融入公共部门决策流程，也无法处理结果泄漏、严重漏诊、置信度校准与审计需求。
AI.method: 使用4,781条德州事故记录（结构化字段与警方叙述），在70/15/15分层划分下，评估结构化、叙述、融合、校准融合、BERT族及本地大语言模型基线；采用泄漏控制、宏F1、自助置信区间、期望校准误差及选择性转交评估。
AI.result: 该划分下，泄漏控制的Gemma宏F1最高（0.545，95% CI [0.507, 0.583]）；最佳校准融合模型宏F1为0.522，ECE为0.033。70%覆盖率时，宏F1升至0.573，严重度成本降至0.577，被转交样本留待人工复核。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出可复现、泄漏控制且不确定性感知的事故AI评估框架，强调可审计性与选择性转交，而非单纯追求准确率。

title: From Content Generation to Learning Support: Pedagogy-Guided Generative Video Tutors for STEM Learning
comment: accepted to EMNLP 2026, code available at GitHub
summary: Generative AI enables scalable production of educational videos, but current systems largely focus on producing visually coherent content rather than supporting learning. As a result, generated videos often lack explicit pedagogical structure, reliable quality control, and mechanisms for assessing learner understanding or addressing misconceptions. In this work, we introduce PIVOT (Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring), a generative video tutoring framework for STEM learning via learning-centered instructional support.1 Inspired by conventional teaching workflows, our framework integrates pedagogy into the full generation pipeline: it first uses instructional principles to guide storyboard generation, then produces verified multimodal videos through code-centric generation and a pedagogical verification harness, and finally connects videos with assessment and misconception-aware remediation. Experiments and expert evaluations across four STEM domains show that our framework produces educational videos with pedagogically aligned content, clear and engaging presentation, coherent instructional flow, and perceived effectiveness for learning. These findings suggest a human-centered perspective on educational content generation: generative systems should be evaluated and designed not only by what they produce, but also by how they support teaching practices, learner understanding, and corrective feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出PIVOT框架，将教学法融入生成式视频辅导全流程，覆盖故事板生成、多模态视频生成与评估补救，实验证明其教学效果更佳。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI教育视频系统侧重视觉连贯性，而非支持学习，缺乏明确教学结构、质量控制和评估学习者理解及纠正误解的机制。
AI.method: 受传统教学工作流启发，将教学法融入生成全流程：先用教学原则指导故事板生成，再通过代码中心生成与教学验证机制产出可靠多模态视频，最后连接评估与误解感知补救。
AI.result: 在四个STEM领域的实验与专家评估表明，框架生成的视频内容与教学法对齐、表达清晰有吸引力、教学流程连贯，并被感知为对学习有效。
AI.conclusion: 提出以人为本的教育内容生成视角：生成系统不应仅以产出物评价和设计，还应以其如何支持教学实践、学习者理解和纠正性反馈为标准。

title: Duality in Optimization: A Visual Tutorial
summary: Lagrangian duality is fundamental to optimization, from the development of solver techniques to the interpretation of solutions; yet its geometric intuition can be difficult to grasp through mathematical derivation alone. This tutorial explains duality and its implications in a highly visual way for a broad audience of students and practitioners. It develops the motivation for the Lagrangian, the two-player game interpretation, and the connection to Fenchel duality. Throughout, it emphasizes the geometric meaning of the solution from both the primal and dual

AI.tldr: 本教程以高度可视化的方式讲解拉格朗日对偶，面向广泛的学生与实践者群体。
AI.motivation: 拉格朗日对偶在优化中至关重要，但其几何直觉难以仅通过数学推导把握。
AI.method: 通过可视化方式阐释对偶，包括拉格朗日量的动机、双人博弈解释以及与Fenchel对偶的联系。
AI.result: 提供了对偶及其含义的直观几何理解，强调从原始和对偶两个角度解读解的意义。
AI.conclusion: 该教程有助于读者以几何视角理解拉格朗日对偶及其应用。

title: Beyond Point Prediction: Artificial Representative Trees with Uncertainty
summary:
Random forests (RFs) predict well but are opaque, whereas single decision trees are interpretable but unstable. Artificial representative trees (ARTs) were developed as interpretable surrogate models for RFs, but their use as standalone prediction models with uncertainty quantification has not been systematically investigated. We combine ARTs with leaf-wise Mondrian conformal predictive systems (CPS), enabling a single tree to provide continuous predictions, prediction intervals, and probabilities of exceeding arbitrary thresholds.
  We compared ARTs with CPS against decision trees with CPS and separate regression and probability trees across five simulation scenarios, 21 benchmark datasets, and a cross-sectional NHANES example data set. Repeated cross-validation assessed predictive performance, interpretability, and stability.
  ARTs with CPS yield compact, structurally stable trees with substantially more reproducible split-variable selection than decision trees across benchmark datasets and NHANES. Decision trees showed slightly better predictive performance and narrower prediction intervals, while coverage was broadly comparable. CPS-based trees generally achieved lower and less variable Brier scores than multi-model approaches.
  Combining ARTs with CPS therefore provides a single, interpretable, and stable model for continuous predictions and calibrated probabilities, balancing predictive performance with reproducibility and transparency in settings where stability and interpretability are essential.

AI.tldr: 该论文将人工代表树（ARTs）与基于叶节点的Mondrian共形预测系统（CPS）结合，使单棵可解释树能同时输出连续预测、预测区间和超阈值概率，并在多数据集上验证其在稳定性、可解释性与预测性能间的平衡。
AI.motivation: 随机森林预测精度高但缺乏可解释性，单棵决策树可解释但结构不稳定；已有的人工代表树（ARTs）虽可作为随机森林的可解释代理模型，但尚未被系统研究其作为独立预测模型并具备不确定性量化的能力。
AI.method: 将ARTs与叶节点级别的Mondrian共形预测系统（CPS）相结合，从而让单棵树提供连续预测、预测区间及超过任意阈值的概率。实验对比ARTs+CPS、决策树+CPS以及分离的回归树与概率树，在5个模拟场景、21个基准数据集和NHANES横断面数据上进行重复交叉验证，评估预测性能、可解释性与稳定性。
AI.result: ARTs+CPS生成紧凑、结构稳定的树，在基准数据集和NHANES上分裂变量选择的可复现性显著优于决策树。决策树预测性能略好、预测区间更窄，但覆盖率大体相当。基于CPS的树通常比多模型方法获得更低且更稳定的Brier分数。
AI.conclusion: ARTs与CPS结合可提供单一、可解释且稳定的模型，同时给出连续预测与校准概率，在需要稳定性与可解释性的场景中平衡了预测性能、可复现性与透明度。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogates with Polynomial Chaos-Based Uncertainty Propagation for Stochastic Model Predictive Control
summary: Stochastic partial differential equations (PDEs) govern critical engineering and geophysical systems but are challenging to use for real-time control under parametric uncertainty. We present a unified framework that couples Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) with Polynomial Chaos Expansion (PCE) to construct a fast and differentiable surrogate. The PCE representation enables analytical propagation of parametric uncertainty and computation of the corresponding moments without requiring Monte Carlo sampling. We provide an error decomposition for the PINN-PCE surrogate that separates PCE truncation, stochastic quadrature, and PINN approximation errors. Embedding this surrogate into a stochastic model predictive control (SMPC) scheme enables finite-horizon control updates based on analytic mean and covariance predictions. We further show how the surrogate approximation error can be incorporated into tightened probabilistic constraints. The approach is validated on three benchmarks: the Korteweg-de Vries equation, Burgers' equation, and the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, representing dispersive, convective, and convective-diffusive dynamics. Across all cases, the surrogate enables real-time control updates while maintaining prescribed risk levels and closely matching the corresponding high-fidelity solvers at substantially lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PINN与多项式混沌展开(PCE)耦合的统一框架，构建快速可微代理模型，用于随机PDE的参数不确定性传播与实时随机模型预测控制。
AI.motivation: 随机PDE在工程与地球物理系统中很关键，但在参数不确定性下的实时控制十分困难，需要能快速传播不确定性并支持控制的代理模型。
AI.method: 将PINN与PCE结合构造可微代理；PCE实现参数不确定性的解析传播与矩计算，避免蒙特卡洛采样；给出误差分解（PCE截断、随机求积、PINN近似误差）；将代理嵌入SMPC，基于解析均值与协方差进行有限时域控制；并将代理误差纳入收紧的概率约束。
AI.result: 在KdV方程、Burgers方程和二维不可压Navier-Stokes方程三个基准上验证，覆盖色散、对流与对流扩散动力学；代理实现实时控制更新，维持指定风险水平，且与高保真求解器结果高度吻合，计算成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: PINN-PCE代理框架能有效处理随机PDE的参数不确定性，实现低成本实时SMPC控制并保证风险约束，具有良好泛化性。

title: The Limits of Speculation: Bounding Speculative Decoding in Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Speculative decoding in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models faces the problem of unstable verification cost caused by input-dependent expert loading. To study the physics of this process, we formulate speculation-budget selection as an offline Stochastic Shortest Path (SSP) problem over reference sequences and build a diagnostic Oracle that uses counterfactual simulation to account for MoE verification cost. A detailed analysis of the Oracle's decisions on the Qwen3-Coder and EAGLE-3 pairing, in the space of marginal deltas (Delta Space), shows that rejected candidates form a strict linear boundary. This result demonstrates that a complex global optimization is locally governed by a necessary condition balancing marginal cost against expected progress ($\frac{Δ\mathbb{E}[Cost]}{Δ\mathbb{E}[a]}$), providing a rigorous mathematical reference point for designing future adaptive online heuristics.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究MoE模型投机解码中因专家加载依赖输入导致的验证成本不稳定问题，将投机预算选择建模为离线随机最短路径（SSP）问题，并构建Oracle分析最优决策结构。
AI.motivation: MoE模型的投机解码中，验证成本随输入变化的专家加载而不稳定，缺乏对最优投机预算选择这一过程的理论理解。
AI.method: 将投机预算选择形式化为参考序列上的离线SSP问题，构建基于反事实模拟的Oracle以计入MoE验证成本；在Qwen3-Coder与EAGLE-3组合上于边际增量空间（Delta Space）分析Oracle决策。
AI.result: 被拒绝的候选形成严格的线性边界，表明复杂的全局优化在局部由必要条件支配：边际成本与期望进展之比（ΔE[Cost]/ΔE[a]）。
AI.conclusion: 为未来自适应在线启发式设计提供了严格的数学参考基准，揭示了MoE投机解码预算选择的局部判别结构。

title: Observational Equivalence of LLM and Human Annotation
summary: In this paper, we show that LLM and human coding are observationally equivalent in terms of annotation quality: recent LLMs agree with expert coders at rates comparable to those observed among experts themselves. We demonstrate this through replications of text-classification tasks from 14 peer-reviewed political science studies, in which ten LLMs, three human experts, and 165 crowdsourced workers independently classify the same texts using identical codebooks. We find that this equivalence is driven by ambiguity in the texts and coding rules. When LLMs disagree with experts, experts are also more likely to disagree with one another, and clarifying coding rules reduces disagreement among both experts and sufficiently capable LLMs. Thus, there is little empirical basis for preferring human coding on the basis of annotation quality alone, while LLMs offer substantial advantages in speed and cost. We therefore argue that the central challenge of text annotation is no longer choosing between human and machine coders, but developing coding rules that minimize ambiguity and accounting for the ambiguity that remains. To this end, we propose using disagreement across LLMs to identify difficult cases and refine codebooks, and we develop ambiguity-aware bounds for downstream inference when a unique annotation cannot be defined for every text.

AI.tldr: LLM与人类标注质量在观察上等价，分歧主要源于文本和编码规则的模糊性；因此核心挑战已从"人vs机"转向如何减少并处理编码模糊性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍默认人类标注优于机器标注，但缺乏系统证据；作者希望检验在相同码本下LLM与专家的标注质量是否真的存在差异。
AI.method: 复现14篇政治学同行评审研究中的文本分类任务，让10个LLM、3位人类专家和165名众包工作者使用相同码本独立标注同一批文本。
AI.result: LLM与专家的标注一致率与专家之间的一致率相当；当LLM与专家分歧时，专家彼此也更易分歧；澄清编码规则可同时降低专家和足够强LLM的分歧。
AI.conclusion: 仅以标注质量为由偏好人类标注缺乏实证依据，LLM在速度与成本上优势明显；核心挑战变为制定低模糊性的编码规则、用LLM间分歧识别难例以改进码本，并为下游推断开发模糊性感知的界限方法。

title: A Survey on the Linear Representation Hypothesis
summary: The term "linear representation hypothesis" (LRH) has appeared across diverse subfields of artificial intelligence, neuroscience, and cognitive science. But previous works have not consistently treated the LRH as a falsifiable scientific hypothesis; we analyze these inconsistencies and examine their implications for how prior theoretical and methodological results should be interpreted. Based on this analysis, we argue that claims regarding linear representations become well-defined only through careful examination of the model, representation location, feature definition, and evaluation dataset. We therefore propose a more rigorous formalization of the LRH that makes these dependencies explicit and allows the hypothesis to be evaluated as a falsifiable scientific claim. Finally, we identify some non-trivial open problems that warrant further attention from the research community.

AI.tldr: 本文对"线性表示假设"(LRH)进行了批判性分析，指出以往研究未将其作为可证伪的科学假设，并提出更严格的公式化框架。
AI.motivation: LRH在AI、神经科学和认知科学等多个领域广泛出现，但先前工作对它的处理不一致，未将其视为可证伪的科学假设，导致理论和方法的解释存在问题。
AI.method: 分析先前研究中的不一致之处，考察其对既有理论和方法的解释影响；提出更严格的LRH公式化，明确模型、表示位置、特征定义和评估数据集等依赖关系。
AI.result: 论证了线性表示的主张只有在仔细考察模型、表示位置、特征定义和评估数据集后才能明确定义。
AI.conclusion: 提出更严格的LRH形式化，使假设可被评估为可证伪的科学主张，并指出若干值得社区关注的开放性难题。

title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
summary: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估新兴"决策模型"（decision models）在计算社会科学文本标注任务上的表现，发现其精度略逊于最佳LLM但成本极低、置信度校准良好，适合用作标注流水线的初筛环节。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学日益依赖大语言模型进行文本标注，标注质量直接决定研究结论的效度。决策模型作为面向分类问答的新模型类别，以低成本给出标签、概率分布和置信分数，但其在社会 sci建设构上的准确性及置信度可靠性尚不明确，亟需实证检验。
AI.method: 沿用Ziems et al. (2024)的评估框架，在18个计算社会科学分类任务（7,977个条目）上，采用相同零样本协议，将首个商用决策模型及两个开源对应模型与19个前沿及开源语言模型进行对比。
AI.result: 决策模型在15个评估任务中的14个上落后于各任务最佳LLM，宏F1中位差距11.6分，但实测成本中位数低约44倍；其置信度校准优于19个LLM中的16个，但三个前沿模型校准误差更低（0.157 vs 0.066）。置信度高于0.9的条目通常标注准确（中位准确率0.815），但在"同伴支持对话中的共情"任务上，模型高置信却接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型适合作为标注流水线的第一环节：将低置信度条目路由给LLM，可在仅四分之一至一半成本下达到或超过单独使用LLM的效果。

title: The Exponential Price of Determinism in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
summary: We study the complexity of finding $(δ,ε)$-Goldstein stationary points of nonsmooth nonconvex Lipschitz functions. By now, it is known that randomized first-order algorithms can solve this task with a dimension-free oracle complexity [Zhang et al., 2020], whereas deterministic algorithms cannot, as their complexity must scale at least linearly with the dimension $d$ [Jordan et al., 2023, Tian and So, 2024]. This leaves open whether deterministic algorithms can nevertheless solve the problem with oracle complexity polynomial in $d$. We answer this question negatively by proving a lower bound of order $(1/ε)^{Ω(d)}$ for deterministic algorithm, closing the exponential gap between the previously known lower and upper bounds and resolving an open problem posed by Jordan et al. [2023]. We further discuss several extensions and implications of this result to weaker stationarity notions, finding a descent direction and deterministic smoothing. Overall, our results establish an exponential computational advantage in nonsmooth nonconvex optimization offered by randomization.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明确定性算法求解非光滑非凸Lipschitz函数的(δ,ε)-Goldstein稳定点的预言机复杂度下界为(1/ε)^{Ω(d)}，解决了Jordan等人提出的开放问题，并表明随机化带来指数级计算优势。
AI.motivation: 随机一阶算法可以维度无关的复杂度求解(δ,ε)-Goldstein稳定点，而确定性算法复杂度至少随维度d线性增长；但确定性算法能否以关于d的多项式复杂度求解此前未知。作者旨在回答这一由Jordan等人提出的开放问题。
AI.method: 通过证明确定性算法的一个阶为(1/ε)^{Ω(d)}的预言机复杂度下界，关闭了此前已知上下界之间的指数差距。
AI.result: 证明确定性算法的下界为(1/ε)^{Ω(d)}，将此前已知的下界与上界之间的指数差距闭合。
AI.conclusion: 确定性算法无法以关于d的多项式复杂度求解该问题；该结果还扩展到更弱的稳定性概念、寻找下降方向和确定性平滑，整体确立了随机化在非光滑非凸优化中的指数级计算优势。

title: Identifying Representational Biases in Datasets Using PCA: A Max-Disparity Partition Framework
summary: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) minimises aggregate reconstruction error, which can inadvertently represent majority subgroups with substantially higher fidelity than minority subgroups. Fairness-aware extensions of PCA correct this disparity but require group labels as input. We address the logically prior question: given only a data matrix, which binary partition of the data suffers the greatest representational disparity under a shared PCA projection? We formalise this as the max-disparity partition problem and propose a greedy local-search algorithm, grounded in the Fiduccia-Mattheyses bipartitioning framework, that discovers the disparity-maximising partition without any predefined group labels. Two benchmark algorithms, a fixed-projection sorting baseline and a simulated-annealing variant, confirm that the greedy solution is empirically near-optimal. Having identified the partition, we attribute the disparity to specific features via PCA loading scores and association rule mining, enabling a practitioner to assess whether the disadvantaged group corresponds to a human-meaningful minority. On the Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success dataset, representational disparity is driven predominantly by institutional and programmatic proxies for socioeconomic disadvantage, with gender emerging as a secondary but consistent contributor within the disadvantaged group. The discovered partition is then passed directly to Fair PCA, completing a detect-explain-mitigate pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"最大差异划分"问题：在仅有数据矩阵、无群体标签时，找出在共享PCA投影下重建误差差异最大的二元划分，并提出基于Fiduccia-Mattheyses框架的贪心局部搜索算法来检测、解释并缓解这种表示不平等。
AI.motivation: PCA最小化整体重建误差，可能导致多数子群体的表示保真度远高于少数子群体。现有的公平PCA需要群体标签作为输入，但现实中标签往往未知，因此需要先解决"哪个二元划分差异最大"这一更前置的问题。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为最大差异划分问题，提出基于Fiduccia-Mattheyses二划分框架的贪心局部搜索算法，无需预定义群体标签即可找到差异最大化划分；用固定投影排序基线和模拟退火两种基准验证其近最优性；再通过PCA载荷分数和关联规则挖掘将差异归因到具体特征；最后将发现的划分直接用于公平PCA。
AI.result: 两种基准算法证实贪心解在经验上接近最优。在Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success数据集上，表示差异主要由社会经济劣势的制度性和项目性代理变量驱动，性别作为次要但一致的贡献者出现在劣势群体中。
AI.conclusion: 该工作构建了"检测—解释—缓解"的完整流程：在无标签条件下检测差异最大划分，解释差异来源以判断劣势群体是否对应人类可理解的少数群体，并将划分传递给公平PCA进行缓解。

title: Composite Adaptive Higher-Order Control Barrier Functions for Joint Frequency-RoCoF Safety in Low-Inertia SIDS Microgrids
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, code available at https://github.com/sramharack/caribcon26-joint-safety-vsg. Accepted to 2026 IEEE Caribbean Conference (CaribCon) - Track 3 - Smart Systems, Robotics, and Automation
summary: Small Island Developing States (SIDS) face simultaneous frequency nadir and rate-of-change-of-frequency (RoCoF) violations under high renewable penetration. This paper proposes a \emph{Composite Adaptive Higher-Order Control Barrier Function} (CA-HOCBF) for BESS-coupled virtual synchronous generators that jointly enforces IEEE~1547 frequency ($\pm0.8$\,Hz) and ENTSO-E RoCoF ($\pm1$\,Hz/s) limits as hard safety constraints under parametric uncertainty. The method unifies three tools: (i)~a dual barrier architecture with a zeroing CBF for frequency and an algebraic RoCoF constraint with a robust inertia-floor fallback; (ii)~a composite energy function coupling logarithmic safety barriers with quadratic parameter and disturbance error terms, which drives safety-weighted adaptation; and (iii)~a disturbance observer integrated into the barrier dynamics. We prove that the closed-form QP is always feasible under a BESS capacity condition and, under explicitly stated assumptions, that the composite energy remains finite along trajectories, rendering the joint safe set forward invariant \emph{without requiring parameter convergence}. Simulation on a 10\,MW Caribbean microgrid ($H=2$\,s, 70\% renewables) shows the CA-HOCBF eliminates all frequency and RoCoF violations under a compound disturbance, achieving steady-state error of 0.001\,Hz and RoCoF of 0.50\,Hz/s, where fixed-gain VSGs suffer a 0.62\,Hz offset with 2.25\,Hz/s RoCoF violations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出复合自适应高阶控制障碍函数（CA-HOCBF），用于BESS耦合虚拟同步发电机，在参数不确定性下将IEEE 1547频率与ENTSO-E RoCoF限值作为硬安全约束联合强制执行。
AI.motivation: 小岛屿发展中国家（SIDS）在高可再生能源渗透率下面临频率最低点与RoCoF同时越限的问题，需要在参数不确定性下保证频率安全。
AI.method: 统一三种工具：(i)双障碍架构，频率用零化CBF、RoCoF用带鲁棒惯量下限回退的代数约束；(ii)复合能量函数，耦合对数安全障碍与二次参数/扰动误差项；(iii)集成到障碍动态中的扰动观测器。
AI.result: 证明QP在BESS容量条件下始终可行，复合能量有限，联合安全集前向不变（无需参数收敛）。10 MW加勒比微电网仿真（H=2 s，70%可再生能源）中，CA-HOCBF消除所有频率与RoCoF越限，稳态误差0.001 Hz、RoCoF 0.50 Hz/s；固定增益VSG有0.62 Hz偏差与2.25 Hz/s的RoCoF越限。
AI.conclusion: CA-HOCBF可在参数不确定性下联合保障频率与RoCoF硬约束，且不依赖参数收敛，性能显著优于固定增益VSG。

title: PAGE: Partition-Aware Gated KV-Cache Eviction
summary: KV-cache eviction methods decide which tokens to keep but not whether to evict at all, so a benchmark mean can hide a class of inputs on which compression drives accuracy from 99\% to 0\%. We reframe eviction as a per-input admission decision and show that inputs separate into a capacity-bound class, where eviction is catastrophic at every budget, and a dilution-prone class, where eviction is safe or beneficial. A single label-free scalar computed from prefill attention, the early-to-late drop in pairwise top-$k$ head agreement, predicts this class before any decoding. PAGE thresholds this drop: it applies any base evictor when the drop is large and retains the full cache otherwise, with no training and no accuracy labels. The drop orders inputs by eviction safety consistently across four architecture families, and a per-model unlabeled pilot of about 100 inputs recalibrates the threshold for a new family. Used as a safeguard, PAGE cuts the harm rate on the capacity-bound regime from 0.75 to 0.026, a 29 $\times$ reduction, across four evictors, four models, and two benchmarks, turning a 99\% to 0\% collapse into a flat 89\% without retraining the evictor. The gate is inert wherever eviction is already safe, and the capacity-bound class it protects is a small, identifiable minority of inputs, so the benefit is a targeted safety gain rather than an average one. PAGE is a per-input safeguard, not a compressor: realized compression is $1.8 - 3.4 \times$ (mean 2.9$\times$) against a nominal 16$\times$ budget and decays toward unity by batch 16 under static provisioning, and a trained evictor wins at matched memory.

AI.tldr: 论文将KV-cache驱逐重构为逐输入的准入决策，提出无标签标量PAGE，通过prefill注意力早期到后期的一致性下降预测输入类别，在容量受限场景作为安全防护，将伤害率从0.75降至0.026。
AI.motivation: 现有KV-cache驱逐方法只决定保留哪些token，而不决定是否应该驱逐；基准均值可能掩盖某些输入上压缩导致精度从99%崩至0%的问题，因此需要逐输入判断驱逐是否安全。
AI.method: 提出PAGE：用prefill阶段成对top-k注意力头一致性的早晚期下降作为无标签标量，在解码前预测输入属于容量受限类（驱逐灾难）还是稀释易感类（驱逐安全/有益）。当下降大时应用基础驱逐器，否则保留完整cache；无需训练和准确率标签，可用约100个无标签输入为新产品线重校准阈值。
AI.result: 作为安全防护，PAGE在容量受限regime将伤害率从0.75降至0.026（29倍降低），覆盖4种驱逐器、4个模型、2个基准，把99%→0%的崩溃转为稳定89%。在驱逐已安全处不产生影响。实际压缩为1.8-3.4倍（均值2.9倍），远低于名义16倍预算，且在静态配置下batch 16时趋近1倍；匹配内存时训练过的驱逐器更优。
AI.conclusion: PAGE是逐输入安全防护而非压缩器，其收益是针对性安全提升而非平均性能提升；保护的容量受限类仅是可识别的小部分输入，代价是实际压缩率显著下降。

title: Read-Best Is Not Steer-Best: A Probing--Steering Layer Dissociation in Omni-Modal Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models integrate text, audio, and image signals into a shared residual stream, where concepts such as emotion can be linearly decoded and causally modified by activation steering. A common but rarely tested assumption is that the layer with the highest probing accuracy is also the best layer for steering, so injection layers are often selected by probe performance. We provide the first causal test of this assumption across three independently developed omni-modal models and find that it fails. Reading and intervention rely on different layers, a phenomenon we call the probing-steering layer dissociation. Using emotion as a controlled testbed, we measure layer-wise readability and steerability across text, audio, and image inputs. Probe-best layers vary widely across architectures, while steering-effective layers consistently fall within a narrow mid-to-late range of normalized depth. Paired random-direction controls show an approximately 26-fold causal gap, ruling out random perturbation and direction quality as explanations. Logit-lens analysis reveals a staged forward process: causal handle, probing saturation, and vocabulary commitment, and motivates a two-factor account in which steering effectiveness depends on both representational readability and downstream plasticity. These results show that probing accuracy is a poor heuristic for selecting intervention layers and suggest a cross-architecture mid-to-late selection criterion. We also identify a cross-modal emotion subspace organized by valence and arousal, with joy acting as a stable anchor across models. Code and data: https://github.com/YiboWang2002/Read-Best-Is-Not-Steer-Best.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次因果性地检验了"探针准确率最高的层也是最佳干预层"这一假设，发现其在三个全模态大模型中均不成立，并提出探针-干预层解离现象及中后层选择准则。
AI.motivation: 全模态大模型将文本、音频、图像信号整合到共享残差流中，情感等概念可被线性解码并通过激活干预进行因果修改。然而，现有做法常假设探针准确率最高的层即最佳干预层，并据此选择注入层，此假设鲜有验证。
AI.method: 以情感为受控测试平台，在三个独立开发的全模态模型上测量各层在文本、音频、图像输入下的可读性与可干预性；使用配对随机方向对照；进行logit-lens分析。
AI.result: 探针最佳层在不同架构间差异很大，而有效干预层稳定落在归一化深度的中后段狭窄范围内；配对随机方向对照显示约26倍的因果差距；logit-lens揭示前向过程的阶段性。
AI.conclusion: 探针准确率是选择干预层的糟糕启发式，建议采用跨架构的中后层选择准则；同时发现按效价和唤醒度组织的跨模态情感子空间，其中"喜悦"在各模型间是稳定锚点。

title: Building Trustworthy Mental Health Benchmarks on Bluesky: A Validation-Aware Weak-Supervision Framework
comment: This is the author's preprint version of a paper accepted for presentation at HICSS 60 (Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences), 2027, Hawaii, USA. The final published version will appear in the official conference proceedings. Conference site: https://hicss.hawaii.edu/
summary: Decentralized social media platforms create new opportunities and challenges for computational mental health research because data access, moderation, labeling, and deployment responsibilities are distributed across multiple technical and governance layers. This paper presents a validation-aware weak-supervision system for constructing and evaluating suicidal ideation (SI) and broader mental health (MH) disclosure benchmarks on Bluesky, a decentralized social media platform built on the AT Protocol. The system integrates public firehose collection, task-specific lexicon filtering, Llama-3-8B-assisted binary annotation, human-adjudicated validation subsets, and transformer-based model benchmarking. Using this pipeline, we construct two task-specific corpora containing 8,346 SI-labeled posts and 9,988 MH-labeled posts. The evaluation shows that model performance depends strongly on both task definition and validation protocol. BERT+LSTM achieves the highest SI stratified cross-validation F1-score, RoBERTa achieves the strongest SI holdout F1-score, and DistilRoBERTa achieves the best MH cross-validation F1-score. Human validation reveals different weak-label failure modes across tasks, with SI labels dominated by false negatives and MH labels dominated by false positives. These findings show that decentralized social media can support reproducible mental health benchmarking, but only when system design, label provenance, validation strategy, and deployment constraints are evaluated together.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个验证感知的弱监督系统，用于在去中心化社交平台Bluesky上构建并评估自杀意念(SI)与心理健康(MH)披露基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 去中心化社交媒体的数据访问、审核、标注与部署责任分散在多个技术与治理层，为计算心理健康研究带来新机遇与挑战，亟需可复现的基准构建与评估方法。
AI.method: 系统整合公共firehose采集、任务专用词典过滤、Llama-3-8B辅助二分类标注、人工裁决的验证子集，以及基于Transformer的模型基准测试。构建了两个任务语料：8,346条SI标注帖和9,988条MH标注帖。
AI.result: 模型表现强烈依赖任务定义与验证协议：BERT+LSTM在SI分层交叉验证F1最高，RoBERTa在SI留出集F1最强，DistilRoBERTa在MH交叉验证F1最佳。人工验证显示不同任务的弱标签失效模式不同：SI以假阴性为主，MH以假阳性为主。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化社交媒体能支持可复现的心理健康基准测试，但前提是系统设计、标签来源、验证策略与部署约束需被共同评估。

title: Convex AI Compositionality and the Governance of AI System Populations
summary: AI governance increasingly requires providers and public authorities to reason about multiple AI instantiations, alternative versions, and deployment configurations of multiple AI systems. Yet current regulation remains predominantly single-system-centric, acknowledging such multiplicity only sparsely without treating collections of related AI systems as governance objects. This creates an AI population governance problem: determining which instantiations can be meaningfully considered together and how their changing configurations can be represented and monitored. The first requirement has recently been addressed through trustworthiness-based accounts of AI identity. We address the second by introducing convex AI compositionality: a formal representation of the configurations generated by finite AI system populations that uses convex spaces. The core idea is that convex compositions of the operational states that a population of AI system instantiations may occupy over time are compatible with lifecycle reachability across the population and can preserve the formal identity relations between these systems. Well-known statistical and geometric constructions, such as weighted state distributions and convex hulls, become AI governance tools for distinguishing operational states, population weights, heterogeneity, and AI configuration change across different governance modes while remaining compatible, under stated conditions, with lifecycle reachability and AI identity. We illustrate our AI population governance framework through distributed healthcare deployments and controlled deployment of recruitment AI variants.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"凸AI组合性"（convex AI compositionality），用凸空间形式化表示有限AI系统种群所生成的配置，以实现AI种群治理。
AI.motivation: 当前AI监管仍以单一系统为中心，仅零散地承认多重性，未将相关AI系统的集合作为治理对象。这带来"AI种群治理问题"：如何确定哪些实例可被有意义地共同考虑，并如何表示和监控其不断变化的配置。
AI.method: 第一个需求（何种实例可一起考虑）由基于可信度的AI身份账户解决；作者针对第二个需求提出凸AI组合性——基于凸空间的形式化表示。核心思想是：AI系统实例种群随时间可能占据的运行状态的凸组合，与种群的生命周期可达性兼容，并能保持系统间的形式身份关系。加权状态分布与凸包等统计和几何构造被转化为AI治理工具，用于区分运行状态、种群权重、异质性与AI配置变化。
AI.result: 加权状态分布和凸包等构造成为分离运行状态、种群权重、异质性和配置变化的治理工具，并在既定条件下与生命周期可达性及AI身份保持兼容。通过分布式医疗部署和招聘AI变体的受控部署两个案例进行说明。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为AI种群治理提供了形式化基础，将几何与统计构造转化为治理工具，支持对多系统、多版本及多部署配置的表示与监控。

title: Accelerated Plug-and-Play Davis-Yin Splitting for Nonconvex Image Reconstruction
summary: In this work, we study a class of structured non-convex and non-smooth optimization problems arising in imaging applications, where the objective is the sum of three functions. We consider the Davis-Yin splitting method, a FISTA-type accelerated variant, along with a quasi-Newton line-search method and a plug-and-play (PnP) extension to solve the problem. We develop a unified convergence analysis based on the Davis-Yin envelope under mild assumptions, including the Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz property. Within this framework, we establish subsequential and global convergence of the iterates to stationary points, together with residual convergence rates. We demonstrate the performance of the proposed methods on image restoration and low-rank matrix completion problems. For low-rank matrix completion, we perform experiments on both synthetic data and public datasets to evaluate recovery accuracy and efficiency. In imaging tasks, including image deblurring, we compare the convergence behaviour and reconstruction quality of several algorithmic variants using peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR). The results show that FISTA-acceleration and line-search methods improve convergence, while PnP denoisers enhance image quality, and the proposed methods remain competitive on matrix completion tasks.

AI.tldr: 研究目标为三函数之和的非凸非光滑优化问题，提出Davis-Yin分裂法及其FISTA加速、拟牛顿线搜索和PnP扩展，建立统一收敛分析，并在图像恢复与低秩矩阵补全上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 成像应用中的优化问题常为非凸非光滑且目标含三项函数，现有方法（如经典分裂法）在收敛性与实用性上仍不足，需要结合加速、线搜索与PnP技术。
AI.method: 采用Davis-Yin分裂方法，结合FISTA型加速、拟牛顿线搜索和PnP扩展；基于Davis-Yin包络，在Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz等温和假设下建立统一收敛分析。
AI.result: 证明了迭代序列依子序列及全局收敛到稳定点，并给出残差收敛速率；在图像去模糊与低秩矩阵补全（合成数据和公开数据集）上验证。FISTA加速和线搜索改善收敛，PnP去噪器提升图像质量，方法在矩阵补全上具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在非凸非光滑图像相关问题中兼顾理论收敛性与实际性能，加速与PnP扩展有效提升收敛和图像质量，矩阵补全任务上表现竞争力。

title: JAREX: An Acquisition Function for Multi-Objective Algorithmic Process Characterization
comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary information. Code available at https://github.com/MSDLLCPapers/obsidian; data and analysis scripts at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21923038
summary: Pharmaceutical process characterization is central to Quality by Design because it defines how variations in process parameters affect the ability to meet product quality specifications, thereby supporting proven acceptable ranges and robust manufacturing. In practice, however, characterization still relies largely on factorial design of experiments (DOE) approaches, which are inefficient for resolving multivariate pass/fail boundaries in higher-dimensional spaces. While Bayesian optimization has transformed process optimization, adaptive methods for multi-objective process characterization remain lacking. Here, we introduce JAREX (Joint Acceptable Region EXploration), a Bayesian active-learning acquisition function for multi-objective process characterization. JAREX formulates characterization as a joint boundary-learning problem and adaptively selects experiments to recover the joint pass region defined by simultaneous satisfaction of threshold criteria across multiple objectives. JAREX combines an optimistic joint-feasibility mask with a multi-objective extension of randomized straddle, focusing sampling on the joint edge of failure. Our benchmark study suggests that JAREX provides more accurate and sample-efficient recovery of the joint pass region than factorial DOE, space-filling designs, and greedy objective-wise strategies over the full experimental budget range. For batched experimentation, it reduces the number of iterative process characterization experiments by more than half while preserving high accuracy for the boundary-identification task. Implemented in the open-source obsidian package, JAREX provides a modular framework for adaptive, data-efficient multi-objective algorithmic process characterization, supporting sample-efficient range finding in high-dimensional spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JAREX，一种用于多目标制药工艺表征的贝叶斯主动学习采集函数，通过联合边界学习高效恢复多目标联合合格区域。
AI.motivation: 制药工艺表征是质量源于设计(QbD)的核心，但实践中仍主要依赖因子DOE，在高维空间中难以高效分辨多元合格/不合格边界；贝叶斯优化虽革新了工艺优化，却缺乏面向多目标工艺表征的自适应方法。
AI.method: JAREX将表征建模为联合边界学习问题，结合乐观联合可行性掩码与随机straddle的多目标扩展，将采样集中在联合失效边缘，自适应选择实验点；并实现于开源obsidian包中。
AI.result: 基准研究表明，JAREX在整个实验预算范围内比因子DOE、空间填充设计和贪心逐目标策略更准确且更样本高效地恢复联合合格区域；在批量实验中可将迭代实验次数减少一半以上，同时保持高边界识别精度。
AI.conclusion: JAREX为自适应、数据高效的多目标算法工艺表征提供了模块化框架，支持高维空间中的样本高效范围寻找。

title: TRACS: A Geometry-Aware Framework for Scalable Multi-Agent Path Finding in Warehouses
summary: Large scale warehouse automation relies on efficient multi agent path finding (MAPF) to coordinate thousands of robots in structured environments. Existing MAPF algorithms primarily improve conflict resolution while representing warehouses as generic navigation graphs, overlooking their inherent geometric structure and traffic patterns.
