summary: Co-stabilization, i.e., designing a single controller that stabilizes multiple systems, is a fundamental problem in robust and data-driven control. While any stabilizable linear system admits a stabilizing linear static state feedback controller, this equivalence does not extend to co-stabilization. In particular, there exist system collections that cannot be co-stabilized by linear static state feedback but can be co-stabilized using linear dynamic state feedback. In this paper, we study the role of controller memory in co-stabilization. We show that linear dynamic state feedback strictly enlarges the set of co-stabilizable systems compared to static feedback, for both scalar systems and high-dimensional examples. At the same time, we identify structural limitations that cannot be overcome even with dynamic controllers. We also develop a path-integral-based algorithm for computing co-stabilizing controllers for a finite set of systems. Numerical results demonstrate that increasing controller memory enlarges the feasible co-stabilization region. These results highlight controller architecture as a key structural factor in co-stabilization, with potential implications for reducing the sample complexity of learning-based control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究控制器记忆（动态状态反馈）在联合镇定中的作用，证明线性动态状态反馈严格扩大了可联合镇定系统的集合，同时指出即使动态控制器也无法克服的结构性限制，并提出基于路径积分的算法。
AI.motivation: 任何可镇定的线性系统都存在线性静态状态反馈镇定控制器，但这一等价性不适用于联合镇定：存在无法用线性静态状态反馈但可用线性动态状态反馈联合镇定的系统集合，因此有必要研究控制器记忆在联合镇定中的作用。
AI.method: 针对标量系统和高维示例，分析线性动态状态反馈与静态反馈在可联合镇定系统集合上的差异；识别动态控制器也无法克服的结构性限制；开发基于路径积分的算法，为有限系统集合计算联合镇定控制器。
AI.result: 线性动态状态反馈严格扩大了可联合镇定的系统集合（标量系统与高维示例均如此）；数值结果表明增加控制器记忆会扩大可行的联合镇定区域。
AI.conclusion: 控制器架构是联合镇定的关键结构性因素，对降低基于学习的控制的样本复杂度具有潜在意义。

title: Industrial Kinematic Trajectory Model (IKTM): Coordinate-Free Autoregressive Generator
summary: Mobility simulation supports logistics, safety, and communications planning in industrial environments such as ports, mines, and airports. Existing trajectory models, however, rely on absolute coordinates, road-network tokens, or semantic zones: representations that are site-specific and not well suited to unstructured industrial terrain. We introduce the Industrial Kinematic Trajectory Model (IKTM), a coordinate-free trajectory generator that represents industrial vehicle motion through kinematic sequences (speed and heading change) with no absolute spatial reference. IKTM uses an autoregressive causal transformer with probabilistic mixture heads and extends our prior coordinate-free Markovian model with deep sequence modelling and an explicit duration-conditioning signal. Trained on one site and evaluated zero-shot on three unseen sites, it matches the small-turn shape of the empirical turn-rate distributions of held-out telematics; across all four sites, the per-site mean Jensen-Shannon divergence over 100 sampling seeds spans approximately 0.035-0.050 bits under an oracle-length duration-target protocol and approximately 0.032-0.042 bits under a fully zero-shot prior-length protocol, with similar ranges whether out-of-distribution (OOD) duration targets are drawn from each held-out site's empirical length distribution or from the Site A prior. Both protocols stay above the metric's sampling-noise floor (<=0.0049 bits). Paired by site, the oracle-length values are 5.3-6.0x lower than those of a re-implementation of our prior Markovian model under the same 1 Hz protocol. Termination is duration-conditioned rather than spatial: rollouts stop on 100% of trials with a length-tracking error of +0.0 +/- 0.0 s against the sampled target (100 of 100 exactly on target; N=100, T=0.2, untouched in-distribution test split).

AI.tldr: 提出无坐标的工业车辆轨迹生成模型IKTM，用运动学序列建模，可跨站点零样本泛化并匹配真实转弯率分布。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹模型依赖绝对坐标、路网token或语义区域，这些表示与具体站点绑定，不适合港口、矿山、机场等非结构化工业地形。
AI.method: IKTM用速度与航向变化的运动学序列表示车辆运动，无绝对空间参考。采用自回归因果Transformer，配概率混合头，并引入显式时长条件信号，扩展了此前的无坐标马尔可夫模型。
AI.result: 单站点训练、三站点零样本测试，匹配真实转弯率分布的小转弯形状。四站点Jensen-Shannon散度约0.035-0.050比特（oracle长度）与0.032-0.042比特（零样本先验长度），高于采样噪声下限。比先前马尔可夫模型低5.3-6.0倍。终止按时长条件，100%试验停止，长度误差+0.0±0.0秒。
AI.conclusion: 无坐标运动学表示能在未见工业站点零样本泛化，性能优于马尔可夫基线，且终止由时长而非空间驱动，验证了该表示的通用性与有效性。

title: Is Imagination Derived from Hallucination? A Cross-Taxonomy Evaluation of Imagination and Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: Imagination performs as a high-level function of large language models (LLMs) which determines the potential of how an LLM creates unseen or creative content. While existing works have built a rich family of creativity benchmarks for this ability, they only measure how far an output departs from common answers and never check whether the departure is licensed by the prompt. Moreover, hallucination, the closest neighbor of imagination, is always measured in a separate pipeline on different generations, so the influential claim that imagination and hallucination stem from the same generative mechanism has never been directly testable. In this paper, we propose Whiteboard, the first LLM imagination evaluation benchmark. Its design follows the authoritative cognitive instruments developed to measure human imagination: seven mechanism-grounded imagination subtypes are adapted from classic paradigms, then crossed with ten support-boundary hallucination subtypes and scored jointly on the same generation. Different from previous creativity or hallucination benchmarks, Whiteboard gates every imagination score with an explicit support check and computes both axes deterministically through an auditable atom matrix, with no LLM judge on the primary path. The full Whiteboard item bank contains 1,660 prompts; on its shared 80-item anchor set, we evaluate 79 state-of-the-art LLMs and validate the instrument against 13,280 human judgments. Additionally, we further explore whether imagination derives from the same generative tendency as hallucination and what key factors shape it. Our analysis indicates a counterintuitive correlation between hallucination and imagination: Most of the subtype couplings are negative, every one of the anchor items reproduces the negative coupling on its own.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Whiteboard，首个 LLM 想象力评测基准：将 7 类机制驱动的想象力子类型与 10 类支持边界幻觉子类型交叉，在同一次生成上联合打分，并用可审计的原子矩阵确定性计算，无 LLM 评判。
AI.motivation: 现有创造力基准只衡量输出偏离常见答案的程度，不检查偏离是否被 prompt 授权；而幻觉作为想象力的近邻却总在不同生成、不同管线上测量，导致"想象力与幻觉同源"的论断无法被直接检验。
AI.method: 借鉴权威人类想象力认知工具，设计 7 种机制驱动的想象力子类型，与 10 种支持边界幻觉子类型交叉；每个想象力得分都需通过显式支持检查，两轴均通过可审计的原子矩阵确定性计算，主路径不使用 LLM 评判。题库共 1,660 条 prompt，并在 80 条共享锚点集上评测。
AI.result: 在 80 条锚点集上评测 79 个 SOTA LLM，并用 13,280 条人类判断验证量表。分析发现幻觉与想象力之间存在反直觉相关：多数子类型耦合为负，且每个锚点条目单独复现该负耦合。
AI.conclusion: Whiteboard 首次在同一生成上将想象力与幻觉联合、可审计地度量，挑战了二者同源的假设，并揭示驱动想象力的关键因素。

title: ISA-Bench: A Benchmark for Computational Reasoning Across Instruction Set Architectures
summary: Large language model code generation benchmarks primarily evaluate well-resourced languages like Python and Java, where models benefit from abundant training data. They provide limited evidence about reasoning in unfamiliar computational models: deriving arithmetic from a single subtract instruction, coordinating parallel programs across communicating nodes, or wiring logic gates into circuits. We present ISA-Bench, a benchmark of programming games with constrained instruction sets. For each game we provide a full execution stack (parser, VM, and verifier), enabling automated evaluation with structured feedback for iterative refinement. Reasoning models achieve higher average solve rates than code-specialized and general-purpose models, but unfamiliar syntax remains a major source of failure. Models solve more tasks with iterative feedback, though the gains vary substantially across architectures. We introduce a reasoning--execution gap (REG) analysis that reveals a recurring disconnect between identifying a plausible computational strategy and expressing it as a correct program in the target ISA. Code is open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ISA-Bench，一个基于受限指令集编程游戏的基准，用于评估模型在陌生计算模型下的推理能力，并提供完整执行栈与自动评测。结果显示推理模型平均求解率更高，但不熟悉的语法是主要失败来源，迭代反馈可提升求解但增益因架构而异，并揭示推理与执行之间的系统性脱节（REG）。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准主要评估 Python、Java 等资源丰富语言，模型可受益于大量训练数据，难以反映其在陌生计算模型（如单减法指令推导算术、跨通信节点协调并行程序、逻辑门电路搭建）中的推理能力，因此需要新的评估方式。
AI.method: 构建 ISA-Bench：一组具有受限指令集的编程游戏；每个游戏提供完整执行栈（解析器、虚拟机、验证器），支持自动化评测与结构化反馈，从而可进行迭代改进评估；并提出 reasoning–execution gap（REG）分析，用于刻画“识别可行计算策略”与“在目标 ISA 中正确表达程序”之间的脱节。
AI.result: 推理模型平均求解率高于代码专用模型和通用模型，但不熟悉语法仍是主要失败来源；引入迭代反馈后模型能解决更多任务，但提升幅度在不同架构间差异显著；REG 分析揭示了策略识别与正确实现之间反复出现的断裂。
AI.conclusion: ISA-Bench 将代码生成评测拓展到受限指令集与陌生计算模型场景，结合执行栈反馈和 REG 分析，更细粒度地暴露模型在策略到程序实现之间的能力瓶颈；代码已开源，便于后续研究与复现。

title: Benign Geometry and Distributional Robustness of $\mathcal{H}_2$ Synthesis
summary: In this paper, we study standard and distributionally robust $\mathcal{H}_2$ synthesis problem of a stabilizing state-feedback controller for discrete-time linear time-invariant systems. Without requiring a nonsingular disturbance controllability Gramian or a positive-definite control penalty, we establish that stationarity of a stabilizing gain in standard $\mathcal{H}_2$ synthesis is equivalent to global optimality and derive an exact Pythagorean identity for the performance difference. We then generalize the $\mathcal{H}_2$ synthesis problem by considering i.i.d. disturbances with zero mean and uniformly bounded second moments, and extend the stationarity-optimality equivalence to the corresponding distributionally robust $\mathcal{H}_2$ synthesis. Moreover, we show that every standard $\mathcal{H}_2$-optimal gain is simultaneously optimal for every such distributionally robust problem. Finally, we specialize the framework to Frobenius, Kullback--Leibler, and Wasserstein-2 ambiguity sets and obtain explicit characterizations of their worst-case covariances, which, in turn, provide performance certificates for a common optimal controller.

AI.tldr: 研究离散LTI系统状态反馈控制器的标准与分布鲁棒H2综合问题，建立平稳性等价于全局最优性的理论，并给出鲁棒问题的显式刻画。
AI.motivation: 传统H2综合通常要求非奇异扰动可控Gramian或正定控制惩罚，限制适用范围；同时需将标准H2扩展到扰动分布不确定的鲁棒场景。
AI.method: 在无需Gramian非奇异或正定惩罚的条件下，证明稳定增益的平稳性等价于全局最优性，并推导性能差的精确Pythagorean恒等式；将问题推广到零均值、一致有界二阶矩的i.i.d.扰动，扩展到分布鲁棒H2综合；针对Frobenius、KL和Wasserstein-2模糊集给出最坏协方差显式刻画。
AI.result: 建立了标准与分布鲁棒H2中平稳性-最优性等价；证明每个标准H2最优增益同时对所有此类分布鲁棒问题最优；给出三种模糊集下最坏协方差的显式形式及共同最优控制器的性能证书。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一并推广了H2综合理论，放宽了正则性假设，揭示了标准H2最优性在分布鲁棒意义下的鲁棒普适性。

title: Partial-Scan-and-Move Source Seeking for Mobile Robots
summary: This paper presents a partial-scan-and-move strategy for source seeking with a mobile robot equipped with an offset scalar sensor. At each robot position, the sensor collects source field measurements while the robot rotates. Instead of requiring a complete circular scan before every move, we ask when the measurements collected over only part of the circle are already sufficient to determine the next action. We develop a gradient estimation method for partial scans together with a confidence set that accounts for measurement noise and local field variation. The robot uses this confidence set to decide whether it is close enough to the source or has enough information to move in a descent direction. We show that, under suitable conditions, each decision can be made within a prescribed partial scan and that the robot reaches a desired neighborhood of the source in finitely many moves with high probability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种部分扫描-移动策略，使搭载偏移标量传感器的移动机器人无需每次完成整圈扫描即可决策移动方向，并在有限步内高概率到达源附近。
AI.motivation: 传统源搜索方法通常要求机器人每次移动前完成完整圆周扫描，效率较低。本文关注是否仅凭部分圆周测量就足以确定下一步动作。
AI.method: 针对部分扫描开发梯度估计方法，并构建考虑测量噪声与局部场变化的置信集；机器人据此判断是否足够接近源，或是否已有足够信息沿下降方向移动。
AI.result: 在适当条件下，每次决策可在规定部分扫描范围内完成，机器人以高概率在有限步移动内到达源的目标邻域。
AI.conclusion: 部分扫描信息足以支持源搜索决策，为减少扫描开销、提升移动机器人源搜索效率提供了理论保证。

title: Contrastive World Models
summary: World models trained via pixel reconstruction can struggle in visually complex environments, where irrelevant information dominates the objective and distract the model from information relevant to planning and control. We present Contrastive World Models, an approach for learning latent dynamics models without pixel reconstruction. Building on Dreamer, we replace observation reconstruction in the standard world model objective with a Deep InfoMax-like lower bound that maximizes the mutual information between state-action sequences and local patch features of future observations, encouraging state representations to retain information that is predictive of the future without requiring the model to reconstruct visually irrelevant details. We evaluate our approach in small-scale experiments across three settings of increasing visual complexity. Our method matches Dreamer and a momentum prediction baseline in the default setting, and substantially outperforms both once distractors or natural video backgrounds are introduced, while also training more efficiently by removing the pixel decoder entirely. Our approach is general and makes minimal assumptions beyond access to state-action sequences and future observations. These results suggest that contrastive, infomax-based objectives are a principled and promising direction for building world models that are robust to visual nuisance factors, a property particularly relevant for transferring model-based RL agents to the real world.

AI.tldr: 提出对比世界模型(Contrastive World Models)，用Deep InfoMax式下界替代像素重建，学习对未来预测有用的潜在动力学，在视觉复杂环境中更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 基于像素重建的世界模型在视觉复杂环境中容易受无关信息干扰，重建目标被视觉细节主导，导致表征偏离规划与控制所需的信息。
AI.method: 在Dreamer基础上，将观测重建替换为类似Deep InfoMax的互信息下界，最大化状态-动作序列与未来观测局部patch特征之间的互信息，从而保留可预测未来的信息，无需像素解码器。
AI.result: 在三种视觉复杂度递增的设置中，方法在默认环境下与Dreamer及动量预测基线相当，在引入干扰物或自然视频背景后显著优于两者，且因去除像素解码器训练更高效。
AI.conclusion: 对比式、基于infomax的目标是构建对视觉 nuisance 因子鲁棒的世界模型的原则性方向，有助于将基于模型的RL智能体迁移到真实世界。

title: Beyond Raw Context Transfer: Representation-based Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) by grounding generation in external knowledge. However, most existing RAG frameworks assume a centralized retrieval corpus, which is often impractical in sensitive domains such as healthcare, where data are inherently distributed and raw content cannot be directly shared across institutions. Recent efforts on decentralized RAG primarily follow prompt-based paradigms that exchange raw, human-readable retrieved content, leading to substantial inference-time computational overhead and direct exposure of retrieved information. To address these limitations, we propose Representation-based Federated RAG (FedRepRAG), a decentralized RAG framework that keeps raw documents at their owning clients and exchanges only compact latent representations during cross-client retrieval. To integrate retrieved knowledge, we introduce a collaboratively trained projector that converts retrieval embeddings into generator-compatible representation tokens for a frozen LLM/VLM backbone. Experiments across decentralized visual question answering (VQA) and question answering (QA) benchmarks show that FedRepRAG consistently outperforms direct inference and local retrieval baselines while substantially reducing retrieval-context length and inference-time computational overhead compared with raw-context transfer. Further analyses confirm the importance of query-relevant retrieved representations and characterize the residual representation-level leakage associated with representation exchange. Overall, FedRepRAG provides an effective and efficient framework for federated RAG without transferring raw retrieved content.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedRepRAG，一种去中心化联邦 RAG 框架，客户端保留原始文档、仅交换紧凑隐表示，并用协同训练投影器将检索嵌入转为冻结 LLM/VLM 可用的表示 token，在 VQA/QA 上优于基线且大幅降低上下文长度与推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 多假设集中式检索语料，在医疗等敏感领域不现实（数据分散、原始内容不可跨机构共享）；已有的去中心化 RAG 多采用 prompt 范式交换原始可读检索内容，导致推理时计算开销大、检索信息直接暴露。
AI.method: FedRepRAG：原始文档留在拥有的客户端，跨客户端检索时仅交换紧凑隐表示；引入协同训练的 projector，把检索嵌入转换为与生成器兼容的表示 token，输入冻结的 LLM/VLM 主干。
AI.result: 在去中心化 VQA 与 QA 基准上，FedRepRAG 稳定优于直接推理和本地检索基线，同时相比原始上下文传输显著降低检索上下文长度和推理计算开销；分析验证了查询相关检索表示的重要性，并刻画了表示交换带来的残余表示级泄漏。
AI.conclusion: FedRepRAG 为联邦 RAG 提供了有效且高效的方案，无需传输原始检索内容。

title: When Should a VLM Look? Paying Only for Visual Calls That Were Needed and Used
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Vision-language agents that crop and zoom are trained with rewards that credit a successful tool call, yet a successful call does not show that the model needed to look or used the pixels it received. On our cold-start checkpoint only 10% to 12% of visual calls were both needed and used, and released agents make spurious calls 36% to 87% of the time on individual benchmarks. Outcome rewards, judge rewards, and branch probes each observe one side of this failure, and about two thirds of what an outcome reward pays goes to calls that were neither needed nor used. CounterCredit asks both questions of every image-returning call at its realized pre-call state, using the policy's own gold-answer score. A decision value compares the realized visual branch with answering immediately; an evidence value compares the returned crop with random same-size patches substituted into the same call. A call verified on both earns cashback and every other executed call pays rent; the price is bounded so that every correct trajectory outranks every wrong one, and a dual-channel GRPO advantage keeps the price in its own units. From the same cold start, prompt pool, and budget, CounterCredit reaches 89.5% on V*, 80.2% on HR-Bench-4K, and 76.4% on HR-Bench-8K, 6.3 to 9.4 points above outcome-only GRPO at 1.78 against 1.84 calls per question, and lowers the spurious-call rate to 31% to 36%, the lowest among the agents evaluated. The same recipe lifts a Qwen3-VL-8B base from 75.4 to 80.8 on average.

AI.tldr: CounterCredit提出一种信用分配方法，用决策价值和证据价值双重验证每个图像调用，奖励既被需要又被使用的调用，提升视觉语言智能体的裁剪缩放性能并降低虚假调用率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言智能体虽能裁剪缩放，但奖励只认可成功的工具调用。然而成功调用不代表模型确实需要查看或利用了返回的像素。冷启动检查点中仅有10%-12%的视觉调用既被需要又被使用，已发布智能体虚假调用率高达36%-87%。现有结果奖励、评判奖励和分支探测都只能观察失败的一面，约三分之二的结果奖励流向了既非需要也非使用的调用。
AI.method: CounterCredit在每个图像返回调用的真实调用前状态上提出两个问题，使用策略自身的金答案分数。决策价值比较真实视觉分支与立即作答；证据价值比较返回的裁剪与替换到同一调用中的随机同尺寸图块。两个价值均验证通过的调用获得返现，其他执行的调用支付租金；价格有界以保证正确轨迹优于错误轨迹，并用双通道GRPO优势使价格保持自身单位。
AI.result: 在相同冷启动、提示池和预算下，CounterCredit在V*达89.5%，HR-Bench-4K达80.2%，HR-Bench-8K达76.4%，比仅用结果奖励的GRPO高6.3-9.4分，每问题调用数为1.78对1.84，虚假调用率降至31%-36%，为所评估智能体中最低。相同方法将Qwen3-VL-8B基座平均从75.4提升至80.8。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时验证调用是否需要和是否被使用，CounterCredit有效改进了视觉语言智能体的信用分配，在多个基准上取得显著提升，并大幅降低虚假调用率，同时具有跨模型的泛化能力。

title: Complexities of Weak Proximal Oracle Methods for Composite Convex Optimization
summary: We consider a standard convex composite optimization problem with either smooth or nonsmooth objective function, and under quadratic growth. In recent years, several works gave algorithms based on a \textit{weak proximal oracle} (WPO) that essentially match in oracle complexities proximal (sub)gradient methods relying on exact prox operations. Importantly, such WPOs, which relax the strong optimality condition of the standard prox operator, may admit much more efficient implementation in terms of runtime when optimal solutions have some sparse structure. A question remained if such WPO-based methods can be accelerated (in the sense of Nesterov's accelerated gradient). In this work we provide a negative answer by establishing lower bounds against both deterministic and randomized methods. Thus, while WPOs can substantially reduce the cost of individual oracle calls, this comes with an inherent loss in oracle complexity. We also provide a new upper-bound for WPO-based nonsmooth convex composite optimization, nearly matching the proximal subgradient method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于弱邻近预言机(WPO)的凸复合优化，证明其无法实现Nesterov式加速，并给出确定性/随机方法的下界及新的上界。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明，在二次增长条件下，基于弱邻近预言机(WPO)的算法在预言机复杂度上可媲美依赖精确prox操作的邻近(次)梯度法，且当最优解稀疏时WPO实现更高效。一个悬而未决的问题是：这类WPO方法能否像Nesterov加速梯度那样被加速？作者希望对此给出明确回答。
AI.method: 针对光滑与非光滑目标函数的凸复合优化问题（在二次增长条件下），分别对确定性与随机方法建立下界，以论证WPO方法无法被加速；同时为基于WPO的非光滑凸复合优化推导新的上界。
AI.result: 作者给出否定答案：建立了确定性与随机方法的下界，证明WPO方法无法实现加速。这意味着WPO虽能大幅降低单次预言机调用成本，却伴随预言机复杂度的固有损失。此外，作者给出基于WPO的非光滑凸复合优化新上界，几乎匹配邻近次梯度法。
AI.conclusion: 基于弱邻近预言机的方法在预言机复杂度上不能像Nesterov加速梯度那样被加速；用单次调用成本的降低换来了固有的复杂度损失。同时新上界使其接近邻近次梯度法的性能。

title: Classification with Abstention Under Class-Conditional Error Constraints
summary: We study binary classification with abstention under separate class-conditional error constraints, with the objective of minimizing abstention while keeping both errors below prescribed thresholds. We characterize the distribution-free minimax rate of excess abstention risk, up to logarithmic factors, in terms of the complexity of the hypothesis class and the sample size. To make the framework amenable to computation with models such as neural networks, we introduce surrogate-loss formulations and derive finite-sample guarantees for excess surrogate ambiguity risk. We formulate the resulting learning task as a constrained optimization problem and characterize its computational complexity in the convex setting. Finally, we evaluate our approach on various datasets and compare its performance with a competing method for this problem.

AI.tldr: 研究在分别约束两类条件错误率下的带弃权二分类，刻画了无分布假设的最优超额弃权风险率，并提出可计算的可替代损失框架。
AI.motivation: 在保持两类错误均低于给定阈值的前提下最小化弃权，同时需要适用于神经网络等模型的、可计算的学习方法。
AI.method: 从理论上刻画与假设类复杂度和样本量相关的极小极大超额弃权风险率（至对数因子）；引入替代损失形式并推导超额替代歧义风险的有限样本保证；将学习任务建模为约束优化问题，并在凸设定下分析其计算复杂度。
AI.result: 给出了无分布假设的极小极大超额弃权风险率以及替代损失的有限样本保证；刻画了凸情形下的计算复杂度；在多个数据集上评估并与竞争方法比较。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分别约束错误率下的带弃权分类提供了理论率与可计算的替代损失学习框架，并在实验中验证了其有效性。

title: Minimax-Optimal Robust Identification of Continuous-Time Systems: Handling Narrow-Band Disturbances in the Frequency Domain
summary: The high-frequency spectral roll-off of continuous-time ARMA (CARMA) models can magnify the effect of narrow-band disturbances when aliasing is weak, making standard maximum-likelihood Whittle estimation sensitive to affected ordinates. We show that a logarithmic transformation $r_k = \log ρ_k$ converts the Whittle scale problem into a Gumbel location problem, connecting robust spectral estimation to the classical minimax theory of Huber and Rieder. A piecewise centering correction---closed-form for small $b$, implicit closed-form for the practitioner range---preserves Fisher consistency for any clipping level without numerical optimisation. Clipping the Gumbel score symmetrically and transforming back yields a two-sided clipped Gumbel score (the standard Rieder--Hampel bounded-influence form) whose normalised influence curve is proved locally asymptotically minimax under shrinking gross-error contamination. The efficiency loss is quantified by a single scalar $K(b)$: at $b = 1.5$, only $16\%$ nominal asymptotic variance overhead. In the stated AR(2) Monte Carlo design, the sample-size trends are compatible with the asymptotic rate, and at $b=1.5$ the bias reductions are about $40\%$, $90\%$, and $96\%$ for $a_1$, $a_2$, and $λ$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文将鲁棒Whittle谱估计问题转化为Gumbel位置问题，提出基于对数变换与分段中心校正的截断（Rieder--Hampel型）稳健估计，并证明其局部渐近极小极大性且量化效率损失。
AI.motivation: CARMA模型高频谱滚降在弱混叠下会放大窄带扰动影响，使标准Whittle极大似然估计对受污染谱坐标敏感，需要稳健的谱估计方法。
AI.method: 通过对数变换r_k=log ρ_k将Whittle尺度问题转为Gumbel位置问题，与Huber--Rieder极小极大理论联系；采用小b闭式及实用范围隐式闭式的分段中心校正以保持任意截断水平的Fisher相合性；对称截断Gumbel得分并反变换得到双侧截断Gumbel得分（标准Rieder--Hampel有界影响形式）。
AI.result: 证明归一化影响曲线在收缩总误差污染下局部渐近极小极大；效率损失由标量K(b)量化，b=1.5时仅有约16%的渐近方差开销；AR(2)蒙特卡洛中样本量趋势与渐近率一致，b=1.5时a_1、a_2、λ的偏差分别降低约40%、90%、96%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在无需数值优化的情况下实现稳健且高效的谱估计，兼顾Fisher相合性与极小极大最优性，并在模拟中显著降低偏差。

title: OpenBlock: Constructive and Verified Content Generation for Adaptive Tile-Matching Games
summary: Tile-matching puzzle games serve hundreds of millions of players, yet the content-generation algorithms that decide which pieces to present at each turn remain proprietary, and no open platform exists for studying adaptive difficulty in this genre. We present an adaptive tile-matching platform whose central algorithmic contribution is a dual-track content-generation architecture: a deterministic rule-based generator that is always available, and an optional learned generator, both subject to a common verification gate that establishes, by exhaustive sequential-placement search, that every delivered piece set is fully placeable so the learned track can never degrade the constructive-feasibility guarantee of the rule track. A self-play reinforcement-learning placement agent, supervised by auxiliary tasks that expose per-shape placeability to shared representations, is used to diagnose the game's dominant failure mode: at high board fill, long-bar pieces lose the majority of their legal placements. Across 234,000+ self-play episodes the agent reaches a 35.6\% win rate (median score 4,200), and controlled simulation shows that at board fill rates of 70--75\%, 33--56\% of long-bar pieces have no legal placement, while spawn difficulty distributions are statistically indistinguishable between won and lost games---evidence that board-state degeneration, not content difficulty, drives late-game failure. Head-to-head ablations show that per-shape placeability supervision---not aggregate difficulty features---drives the representation gain, and a 14-day online gray rollout (48,000 players; sample-ratio verified, CUPED-adjusted) lifts day-1 retention by 1.8 percentage points and session duration by 7\% over the rule track alone, quantifying the neural track's asymmetric upside in live play.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于三消类拼图游戏的自适应内容生成开放平台，核心是双轨生成架构：确定性的规则生成器与可选的学习生成器，二者都通过统一验证门（穷举顺序放置搜索）保证每个下发的棋子组完全可放置。
AI.motivation: 三消游戏玩家众多，但决定每回合呈现哪些棋子的内容生成算法均为专有，且该品类缺乏研究自适应难度的开放平台。
AI.method: 采用双轨内容生成架构（规则轨 + 学习轨），共用验证门以保证可放置性；并用自博弈强化学习放置智能体，辅以暴露每形状可放置性的辅助任务进行监督，用于诊断游戏主要失败模式。
AI.result: 在23.4万+自博弈局中智能体胜率达35.6%（中位得分4200）；仿真显示棋盘填充率达70–75%时，33–56%的长条棋子无合法放置；胜负局间的生成难度分布无统计差异，表明后期失败源于棋盘状态退化而非内容难度。头对头消融显示每形状可放置性监督（而非聚合难度特征）带来表征增益；14天在线灰度（4.8万玩家，经样本比验证与CUPED调整）相比规则轨纯版本使次日留存提升1.8个百分点、会话时长提升7%。
AI.conclusion: 平台验证了学习轨具有非对称上行收益且不会破坏规则轨的构造可行性保证，可用于研究该品类的自适应难度。

title: MechaTerp-TRACE: A Novel Approach for Component Ablation Analysis in Language Models
summary: Interpretability research on large language models has produced accounts of factual recall in feed-forward layers and of token relationships in self-attention, but little work offers a unified way to compare the causal contribution of different architecture components to a model's output. We introduce MechaTerp (the Mechanistic Interpretability suite) -TRACE (subset for Teacher-forced Registry of Ablated Component Effects), an architecture and study that measures how much each registered component of a language model supports the production of a named entity. TRACE ablates one component at a time and measures the resulting change in the output distribution at a fixed answer token, so component types from whole transformer blocks down to individual neurons and output logits can be compared on a common scale. We apply it to thirteen instruction-tuned dense decoder models spanning five families and one to thirty billion parameters, ablating 49,656 components across 48 medical and 42 general-knowledge prompts. We find that the components carrying the most effect are the same few, positionally fixed components in every model, regardless of which entity a prompt asks about, and that once these are removed, the remaining support is close to evenly spread in eleven of the thirteen models. Apparent localisation of entity knowledge is therefore largely attributable to generic generation machinery, which has direct consequences for methods that assume entity knowledge sits in a findable place, including targeted knowledge editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TRACE方法，通过逐组件消融，在统一尺度上比较语言模型不同架构组件对命名实体输出的因果贡献，发现主导组件是少量位置固定的通用生成机制，而非实体知识本身。
AI.motivation: 现有对大模型的可解释性研究分别描述了前馈层的事实回忆和自注意力的token关系，但缺乏统一方法比较不同架构组件对模型输出的因果贡献。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（MechaTerp套件的一部分），逐个消融已登记的模型组件，测量固定答案token处输出分布的变化，使从整个transformer块到单个神经元和输出logits的组件类型可在同一尺度上比较。应用于13个指令微调密集解码模型（5个家族，10亿到300亿参数），在48个医学和42个常识提示上消融49,656个组件。
AI.result: 影响最大的组件在每个模型中都是相同且位置固定的少数组件，与提示所问实体无关；移除这些组件后，13个模型中有11个的剩余支持近乎均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: 表面上实体知识的局部化很大程度上归因于通用生成机制，这对假设实体知识位于可定位位置的方法（包括定向知识编辑）有直接影响。

title: Beyond Linear Context: Graph-Guided Evidence Navigation for Long-Novel Reasoning with a Local 9B Language Model
comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables. Code, graph data and an interactive demo: https://github.com/fuxiaoji/novel-graph-lab
summary: Long-context models read a novel the way a person reads a printout: one token after another, in narrative order, with the whole history competing for a fixed budget of attention. A detective does not work that way. They sort what happened when, and they keep a map of who relates to whom, so a clue from chapter one can meet a question asked at the end of the book. We test whether a frozen knowledge graph can give a small local model that same freedom. Thirty detective novels and 234 multiple-choice questions are answered by one fixed qwen3.5:9b reader under nine conditions: five graph routes, a recent-window baseline, whole-book compression, ordinary vector retrieval, and a question-only control. The strongest graph route reaches 53.85% (126/234) against 46.15% for the recent window, 51.28% for compression, 51.71% for vector retrieval and 40.17% for question-only. On the subset that no model can answer without the book, the graph route reaches 42.86%. None of the fifteen graph-baseline contrasts survives Holm correction, so we present the result as exploratory evidence about a design. Two structural findings survive scrutiny better than the headline number: annotated evidence concentrates in the topological core of these graphs (2.35x enrichment, pooled), and the two graph-building pipelines differ so much in annotation coverage (16% versus 73% of clue paragraphs) that pooled accuracy alone would hide which bottleneck is being measured.

AI.tldr: 用小模型(qwen3.5:9b)读30本侦探小说回答234道选择题，检验冻结知识图谱能否赋予模型"侦探式"非顺序阅读能力。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型像按顺序读打印稿的人，历史争抢固定注意力预算；而侦探需要按时间整理事件、维护人物关系图，使早期线索能与结尾问题对接。作者想测试冻结知识图谱能否给小型本地模型这种"自由"。
AI.method: 固定qwen3.5:9b阅读器，9种条件：5种图路径、近期窗口基线、整书压缩、普通向量检索、仅问题对照；并设计了无书不可答子集作为更严格的测试。
AI.result: 最强图路径53.85%(126/234)，优于近期窗口46.15%、压缩51.28%、向量检索51.71%、仅问题40.17%；无书不可答子集上图路径达42.86%。十五个图-基线对比均未通过Holm校正，属探索性证据。两个结构发现更稳健：标注证据集中于图谱拓扑核心(合并后2.35倍富集)；两条建图流程的标注覆盖率差异巨大(16% vs 73%)，可能掩盖真正的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 结论为探索性：知识图谱设计有潜力但效应未达统计显著；拓扑核心富集与建图流程覆盖率差异提示未来应关注图谱构建质量与瓶颈定位。

title: Numerical approximation of distributed optimal control problems governed by linear thermo-poroelasticity
summary: In this paper, we propose and analyze a novel three-field symmetric formulation for optimal control problems governed by linear thermo-poroelasticity. The state variables are the solid displacement $\boldsymbol{u}$, the fluid pressure $p$, and the temperature $θ$, and both the distributed fluid source $m_p$ and the distributed heat source $m_θ$ serve as control variables. We prove well-posedness of the symmetric differentiated formulation, establish the existence and uniqueness of an optimal control pair $(\bar{m}_p,\bar{m}_θ)$, and derive the first-order necessary optimality conditions via a coupled three-field adjoint system. For the fully discrete scheme based on dG(0) time discretization, we employ a variational discretization approach for both controls and derive a priori error estimates of order $\mathcal{O}(h^s + Δt)$ for the state, adjoint, and control errors. We also present manufactured-solution experiments that validate the fully discrete optimality system and illustrate the storage-degenerate regime covered by our analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析线性热孔弹性最优控制问题的三场对称格式，证明适定性与最优控制对的存在唯一性，给出最优性条件及全离散先验误差估计 O(h^s+Δt)。
AI.motivation: 针对线性热孔弹性方程支配的最优控制问题，需要一种对称、良态的数学框架来处理位移、压力与温度三场耦合及双源控制。
AI.method: 提出三场对称（微分）格式，状态变量为固体位移 u、流体压力 p、温度 θ，控制为流体源 m_p 与热源 m_θ；证明适定性，推导耦合三场伴随系统的一阶最优性条件；采用变分离散法处理控制，结合 dG(0) 时间离散构造全离散格式。
AI.result: 证明最优控制对 (m̄_p, m̄_θ) 的存在唯一性；得到状态、伴随与控制的先验误差估计 O(h^s + Δt)；用制造解实验验证全离散最优性系统，并展示所分析覆盖的存储退化情形。
AI.conclusion: 该三场对称框架为热孔弹性最优控制提供了严格的理论基础与误差分析，制造解实验验证了方法的有效性。

title: Monotone-Constrained Diffusion Models for Long-Horizon Production Forecasting
comment: 34 pages, 4 figures. Under review at the Journal of Machine Learning Research. Extended version of a paper at Canadian AI 2026 (PMLR 318, pp. 332-341)
summary: Forecasting a long horizon from only the first observations of a sequence is ill-posed: many trajectories are consistent with the same short history. We study this problem in oil and gas production forecasting, where forecasts made after roughly the first fifth of a well's producing life drive development and abandonment decisions, and where a usable forecast must describe a monotone decline. We present Physics-SIMS-TS, a conditional diffusion forecaster that combines negative guidance against synthetic artifacts, decline-curve constraints and an isotonic projection applied during sampling, spatial training augmentation, and an ensembled stochastic sampler yielding a full predictive distribution. Across three jurisdictions and more than 35,000 wells, under a shared-space, validation-frozen protocol, Physics-SIMS-TS is the most accurate diffusion forecaster in the comparison and is competitive with, but not superior to, ensembled transformer forecasters. Its forecasts are monotone by construction at a cost of at most 0.5% in mean squared error, and its trajectory ensemble yields calibrated intervals after one dispersion factor is fitted per jurisdiction. On six standard benchmarks a reversible-instance-normalization variant of the backbone is the leading diffusion baseline. We also quantify four protocol choices on which the measured ranking depends. Code and evaluation artifacts are released.

AI.tldr: 提出 Physics-SIMS-TS 条件扩散预测模型，用于油井产量长时程预测，融合负引导、递减曲线约束、等渗投影、空间增强与集成随机采样，在 3 个辖区 3.5 万口井上取得最准确的扩散预测表现，并支持单调预测。
AI.motivation: 仅凭序列最初少量观测预测长时程本质上是病态问题：同一短历史对应多条可能轨迹。在油气产量预测中，约生产期前五分之一后做出的预测会影响开发与废弃决策，且可用预测必须呈单调递减。
AI.method: Physics-SIMS-TS：条件扩散预测器，结合针对合成伪影的负引导、递减曲线约束、采样中的等渗投影、空间训练增强，以及集成随机采样器输出完整预测分布。在共享空间、验证集冻结协议下评估，并考察六项标准基准及四个影响排名结论的协议选择。
AI.result: 跨 3 个辖区、超 3.5 万口井：Physics-SIMS-TS 是所比较中最准确的扩散预测器，与集成 transformer 预测器相当但未超越。预测按构造单调，MSE 代价至多 0.5%；轨迹集成在每个辖区拟合一个离散因子后区间校准良好。六个标准基准上，可逆实例归一化骨干变体为领先的扩散基线。
AI.conclusion: Physics-SIMS-TS 在病态长时程油井预测中提供准确、单调且校准的扩散预测，可媲美最强 transformer 方法，且公开代码与评估工件。

title: Stability of Slow-Fast Nonlinear Dynamics: Moving Equilibrium Case
comment: 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC), Honolulu, HI, USA, Dec. 2026
summary: We study the stability of nonlinear systems subject to both slow and fast time variations. Both can have discontinuities, covering switched systems as a special case. The fast variation is assumed to be periodic; thus, we rely on averaging to construct an average system. Importantly, the equilibrium of the average system depends on the slow variation and is assumed to be exponentially stable when this slow input is frozen. Using perturbation and Lyapunov analyses, we establish a practical stability result showing that the system state remains within a neighborhood of the moving equilibrium when the total variation (flows and jumps) of the slow variation is appropriately bounded and the fast input varies sufficiently fast. The result is illustrated via a nonlinear switched system with slow-fast switching and a mode-dependent equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 研究含慢变与快变（均可含不连续）的非线性系统稳定性，借助平均法与Lyapunov分析给出实用稳定性结论。
AI.motivation: 慢变与快变同时存在且可含不连续（含切换系统）的稳定性分析尚不完善，需要刻画系统状态跟踪移动平衡点的条件。
AI.method: 假设快变周期，采用平均法构造平均系统；平均系统平衡点依赖慢变输入，冻结慢输入时假设指数稳定；用扰动与Lyapunov分析推导实用稳定性。
AI.result: 证明当慢变的总变差（连续流与跳变）适当有界、快变足够快时，系统状态保持在移动平衡点的邻域内；并用带慢快切换、模态依赖平衡点的非线性切换系统示例说明。
AI.conclusion: 给出覆盖切换系统情形的慢快变化非线性系统实用稳定性框架，为移动平衡点的近似跟踪提供充分条件。

title: Beyond Task Completion: Training Capable and Safe Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have made rapid progress in completing complex tasks through graphical user interfaces, yet post-training centered on task success alone does not induce reliable safety behavior. A reliable CUA must condition its execution on risk: it should complete ordinary benign tasks, avoid environmental hazards and continue when a safe completion path remains, and refuse when the goal is harmful or no safe path exists. To learn this conditional policy, we develop Safety and Capability Optimization for Policy Execution (SCOPE), which jointly post-trains a CUA for task-execution capability and safety-aware decision making. To provide aligned training data for this joint objective, we further introduce SCOPE-Gen, an automated pipeline that synthesizes verifiable capability tasks and converts them into paired environment-risk variants while preserving their original goals. Using the resulting tasks, we construct SATraj-OS, a trajectory dataset comprising capability demonstrations, safe continuations, and explicit refusals. SCOPE first learns from all three trajectory types through supervised fine-tuning and then further improves task completion through online reinforcement learning. Starting from Qwen3.5-9B, SCOPE-RL achieves a 54.17% task success rate on OSWorld and a 64.30% attack-avoidance rate on OS-BLIND, yielding the best aggregate capability--safety score of 58.80% among the evaluated agents. Ablations reveal asymmetric but complementary roles for the two forms of safety supervision: refusal trajectories account for most of the attack-avoidance gain, whereas risk-handling trajectories preserve greater task utility at comparable attack-avoidance levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE，通过联合后训练让计算机使用智能体（CUA）同时具备任务执行能力与安全意识决策；并设计SCOPE-Gen自动合成配对的环境风险变体、构建SATraj-OS轨迹数据集，采用SFT+在线RL训练，在OSWorld与OS-BLIND上取得最佳能力-安全综合表现。
AI.motivation: 仅以任务成功为目标的CUA后训练无法产生可靠的安全行为。可靠的CUA需依据风险条件化执行：完成良性任务、规避环境危害并在有安全路径时继续、在目标有害或无安全路径时拒绝。这种条件策略缺乏对齐的训练数据。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE联合后训练CUA的任务执行能力与安全决策；SCOPE-Gen自动流水线合成可验证能力任务并转为保留原目标的配对环境风险变体；构建SATraj-OS数据集（能力示范、安全续行、显式拒绝三类轨迹）；先SFT再用在线强化学习提升任务完成。
AI.result: 从Qwen3.5-9B出发，SCOPE-RL在OSWorld任务成功率54.17%、OS-BLIND攻击规避率64.30%，综合能力-安全得分58.80%，为所评智能体中最优。消融显示两类安全监督作用不对称但互补：拒绝轨迹贡献大部分攻击规避增益，风险处理轨迹在同等攻击规避水平下保留更高任务效用。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE及其数据构建管线表明，联合能力强化的安全后训练可有效赋予CUA条件化安全行为，且拒绝与风险处理两类监督互补；未来可进一步提升能力-安全综合表现。

title: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Source-Grounded Synthetic Note Generation from Longitudinal Structured EHR
comment: Accepted at the FMSD Workshop, ICML 2026
summary: Structured EHR is abundant but sparse, coded, and difficult to use directly for note-centric clinical modeling. We present MedNotes, a multi-agent synthetic data generation pipeline that converts longitudinal structured EHR into source-grounded clinical note representations under explicit quality control. MedNotes treats structured-data-to-text synthesis as a closed-loop agentic process: a generator proposes a note, evaluator agents diagnose factual, coverage, structural, and hallucination-related failures, and a router accepts, revises, or rejects the draft. On 1,485 EHRSHOT encounters, MedNotes achieves a 91.4% pass rate, with mean factual accuracy of 0.980, completeness of 99.1%, structural fidelity of 0.761, and 0.028 critical hallucinations per encounter. Iterative refinement improves acceptance from 69.4% to 91.4%. The resulting synthetic corpus improves downstream CPT prediction and paragraph-level section prediction when combined with limited real data.

AI.tldr: MedNotes 是一个多智能体合成数据生成管线，将结构化 EHR 转换为有来源依据的临床笔记表示，并带显式质量控制。
AI.motivation: 结构化 EHR 虽丰富但稀疏、编码化，难以直接用于以笔记为中心的临床建模。
AI.method: 将结构化数据到文本的合成视为闭环智能体过程：生成器提出笔记，评估智能体诊断事实、覆盖、结构和幻觉相关失败，路由器决定接受、修订或拒绝草稿。
AI.result: 在 1,485 个 EHRSHOT 就诊上达到 91.4% 通过率，事实准确率均值 0.980，完整性 99.1%，结构保真度 0.761，每次就诊关键幻觉 0.028。迭代精修将接受率从 69.4% 提升至 91.4%。合成语料在与有限真实数据结合时，改善下游 CPT 预测和段落级章节预测。
AI.conclusion: MedNotes 能高质量地将结构化 EHR 合成临床笔记，并提升下游临床建模任务。

title: AgentRouter: Heterogeneous Model Routing for Cost-Optimal Multi-Step Agentic Workflows
comment: Accepted at the AgenticUQ Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Enterprise agentic systems that route every trajectory step to a frontier model waste 60-80% of their inference budget on subtasks that smaller models handle equally well. Existing routing solutions optimize single-turn query assignment but ignore a property unique to agentic workflows: subtask complexity varies widely within a single trajectory. A planning step may require frontier-class reasoning while a subsequent formatting step needs only a 7B model. We formalize step-level model routing as a sequential assignment problem over agent trajectories and propose AgentRouter, a lightweight classifier (12M parameters, <5ms overhead per step on an A100 GPU) that maps each trajectory step to one of four model tiers using five features extractable at routing time. Trained on 50,000 annotated agent trajectory steps spanning planning, coding, research, and data analysis tasks, AgentRouter achieves 72% cost reduction relative to frontier-only baselines, retaining 97.3% of frontier-only quality (less than 3% degradation in end-to-end task completion); per-step routing accuracy reaches 91% on minimal-complexity steps and 85% on efficient-tier steps, with 76-82% on the harder mid-range and frontier tiers. On the same benchmarks, RouteLLM and FrugalGPT (applied per-step) achieve only 31% and 44% cost reduction respectively, because their single-turn training signal misses trajectory-level quality dependencies.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentRouter，将智能体轨迹的每一步路由到不同模型层级，实现大幅成本下降且质量基本保持。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体系统将每一步都路由到前沿模型，浪费60-80%推理预算；现有路由方法只优化单轮查询分配，忽略了智能体工作流中单条轨迹内子任务复杂度差异极大的特性。
AI.method: 将步级模型路由形式化为轨迹上的序列分配问题；训练一个12M参数的轻量分类器AgentRouter，基于5个可在路由时提取的特征，将每步映射到4个模型层级；训练数据为5万条标注的智能体轨迹步。
AI.result: 相比仅用前沿模型的基线，成本降低72%，保留97.3%质量（端到端任务完成度下降<3%）；每步路由准确率：最小复杂度步91%、高效层85%、中端和前沿层76-82%；同等基准下RouteLLM与FrugalGPT（逐步应用）仅降本31%和44%。
AI.conclusion: 步级路由能显著节省成本并保持质量，优于单轮训练信号的现有方法，凸显轨迹级质量依赖的重要性。

title: The logarithmic spiral is optimal for shoreline search: a computer-assisted proof
comment: 20 pages (13 of main text, then four appendices), 3 figures, 1 table
summary: A ship starts at a point of the plane and moves at unit speed; it has to reach an unknown straight line, of which neither the distance nor the direction is known. The competitive ratio of a path is the supremum, over all lines, of the time at which the line is reached divided by its distance. Baeza-Yates, Culberson and Rawlins conjectured that a logarithmic spiral, with ratio $C_{\mathrm{sp}} = 13.8111351794611\ldots$, is optimal. We give a computer-assisted proof. Paths are arbitrary: the distance from the start and the polar angle may both decrease. The proof lifts the set of found directions to the universal cover of the circle, where unfolding the polar angle can only increase it (Kneser-Poulsen on the line); a bookkeeping inequality with a monotone final source then bounds the covered measure by the reward of a three-state relaxed control problem, in which inward motion is an ordinary control and excursions below the guaranteed disk are impulses. An explicit $C^1$ storage function, a tensor cubic B-spline plus a closed-form term, satisfies the dissipation inequalities of that problem at the spiral's level and is tight only at the spiral; this is verified with about $10^6$ boxes of Arb ball arithmetic, an exact jet and an interval Hessian at the spiral.

AI.tldr: 该论文用计算机辅助证明验证了Baeza-Yates、Culberson和Rawlins关于对数螺线（比值约13.8111351794611…）在寻找未知直线问题中最优的猜想。
AI.motivation: 船以单位速度从平面上一点出发，需到达一条未知直线，距离和方向均未知；此前只有关于对数螺线最优性的猜想，缺乏严格证明。
AI.method: 允许任意路径（距离与极角均可减小）；将已发现方向集合提升到圆的一般覆盖，利用Kneser–Poulsen性质；建立记账不等式并用单调终源，将问题归约为三状态松弛控制问题，其中向内运动为普通控制、低于保证圆盘的远足视为脉冲；构造显式C^1存储函数（张量三次B样条加闭式项），并用约10^6个Arb球算术盒子、精确jet和螺线处的区间Hessian验证耗散不等式。
AI.result: 构造的存储函数满足该控制问题在对数螺线水平上的耗散不等式，且仅在螺线处取等，从而证明该螺线的竞争比最优。
AI.conclusion: 以计算机辅助方式严格证明了寻找未知直线问题中对数螺线的最优性，确认了原猜想。

title: Multi-Armed Bernoulli Bandits via Minimax Single-Arm Stopping
comment: This work is a preprint and has not been submitted to any conference or journal yet
summary: We develop an index policy for finite-horizon Bernoulli multi-armed bandits from minimax solutions to single-arm bandit (SAB) problems. Each SAB problem involves choosing between an unknown Bernoulli arm and a known reward. We show that minimizing worst-case regret of SAB problems over all non-anticipative policies admits an exact semi-infinite linear programming formulation. The resulting stopping policies offer a natural way to compare arms: the higher the known reward against which a policy continues sampling, the more promising the unknown arm. We turn this intuition into indices based on cumulative continuation probabilities, with a monotone adjustment and a reward-shortfall cap. By relating index errors to the regret of single-arm stopping policies, we establish a distribution-free regret bound of $4.45\sqrt{KT}+10.75K$ for $K$ arms and horizon $T$. This bound matches the minimax-optimal regret order established in the literature. The guarantee extends to rewards supported on $[0,1]$ through Bernoulli randomization. We also provide a finite-grid implementation with quantified approximation loss. In numerical experiments, the SAB-based index policy achieves lower worst-case regret than every tested benchmark policy across all evaluated numbers of arms and horizons, while closely matching the grid-based MAB minimax policy in the two-arm setting.

AI.tldr: 本文基于单臂老虎机(SAB)问题的极小极大解，为有限时域Bernoulli多臂老虎机构造了一种指数策略，实现了分布无关的近似最优遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 有限时域多臂老虎机中最优遗憾需要达到极小极大阶(约√(KT))，而现有策略往往依赖分布假设或缺乏对一般奖励的保证。作者希望利用单臂博弈的极小极大解来导出具有理论保证的指数策略。
AI.method: 将每个单臂问题形式化为在所有非预期策略上最小化最坏遗憾，并证明其可精确写成半无限线性规划。由停止策略的比较逻辑出发，构造基于累积继续概率的指数，并加入单调调整与奖励亏空上限。通过将指数误差关联到单臂停止策略的遗憾来证明界，再经Bernoulli随机化推广到[0,1]奖励，并给出有限网格实现及近似损失量化。
AI.result: 得到分布无关遗憾界4.45√(KT)+10.75K，与文献中的极小极大最优阶一致；理论上可推广到[0,1]奖励并有有限网格近似保证。数值实验中，该SAB指数策略在所有测试臂数和时域下最坏遗憾均低于所有基准策略，且在双臂情形接近基于网格的MAB极小极大策略。
AI.conclusion: 单臂极小极大视角为多臂老虎机提供了自然且可实现的指数策略，兼具最优阶遗憾保证与强实证表现。

title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Evaluation of Game-Theoretic Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper evaluates Nash- and Stackelberg-based decision-making controllers for autonomous intersection crossing using a three-stage evaluation pipeline culminating in physical Quanser QCar 2 experiments with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) execution. The controllers are implemented in MATLAB/Simulink, deployed through Quanser Real-Time Control (QUARC) software, and executed on the onboard NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin processor. The evaluation includes MATLAB numerical simulation, qualitative validation in Quanser Interactive Labs (QLabs), and physical QCar 2 experiments. The experiments consider symmetric and asymmetric intersection approaches, leader-follower interactions, conflicting Stackelberg role assignments, and non-cooperative obstacle-vehicle behaviors. The results characterize the effects of hierarchy assignment, obstacle-vehicle behavior, and physical implementation on the considered game-theoretic autonomous driving controllers. Comparison between software simulations and hardware experiments further highlights the importance of accounting for sensing and state-estimation uncertainty when translating game-theoretic controllers from simulation to physical systems. A video demonstration of the QLabs simulations and physical QCar 2 hardware experiments is available at https://youtu.be/gkV6lz0twRk.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过仿真、QLabs验证与物理QCar 2硬件实验三阶段流程，评估基于Nash和Stackelberg博弈的自动驾驶交叉口决策控制器，揭示了层级分配、非合作障碍车行为及传感/状态估计不确定性对控制器性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 博弈论控制器多停留在仿真阶段，缺乏从仿真到物理系统的实证验证，特别是层级角色分配、非合作障碍车以及传感与状态估计不确定性在实际硬件中的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在MATLAB/Simulink中实现Nash与Stackelberg决策控制器，经QUARC部署至NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin车载处理器，采用三阶段评估：MATLAB数值仿真、QLabs定性验证、物理QCar 2硬件在环实验。实验涵盖对称/非对称交叉口接近、领导-跟随交互、冲突的Stackelberg角色分配及非合作障碍车行为。
AI.result: 实验结果刻画了层级分配、障碍车行为及物理实现对博弈论自动驾驶控制器的影响；仿真与硬件实验对比表明，从仿真迁移到物理系统时须考虑传感与状态估计不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 博弈论交叉口决策控制器可在真实硬件上运行，但其性能高度依赖层级设定与传感不确定性，仿真到实车的迁移需显式建模感知与状态估计误差。

title: Gaussian Process Decorrelation for Spatiotemporal Deep Learning-Based Snow Water Equivalent Prediction
summary:
In the Western United States, snowmelt is essential to the agricultural industry in addition to being a key source of municipal drinking water. Consequently, accurate snowpack forecasting is critical for water policy and management. Automated Snow Telemetry (SNOTEL) stations provide accurate daily measurements of snow water equivalent (SWE) that exhibit strong correlations in space and in time. We tackle the problem of predicting future SWE values across the SNOTEL network.
  Specifically, we use a Gaussian Process-based linear transformation to remove spatial correlations before training a long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network on the decorrelated SWE data. This approach allows the LSTM to learn a clean temporal signal at each station. We show that this separation of spatial and temporal components yields better predictive success than multiple baseline models.
  Furthermore, we incorporate conformal prediction to quantify uncertainty in the resulting SWE forecasts, providing a distribution-free approach to illustrate a potential framework for establishing predictive intervals for spatiotemporal data. Together, accurate point forecasts and distribution-free uncertainty quantification provide a framework for SWE accumulation forecasting on subseasonal scales or projecting SWE with future data while motivating and supporting future work in predicting a large-scale, spatiotemporally complete SWE map.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用高斯过程线性变换去除SNOTEL网络SWE数据的空间相关性，再用LSTM学习各站点时间信号，并结合保形预测进行不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 美国西部雪融水对农业和城市饮用水至关重要，准确的积雪（SWE）预测对水资源政策与管理十分关键；SNOTEL站点数据在时空上强相关，直接建模困难。
AI.method: 先用基于高斯过程的线性变换去除SNOTEL网络SWE数据的空间相关性，再在去相关数据上训练LSTM神经网络以学习各站点的时间信号；同时引入保形预测来量化预测不确定性，提供无分布假设的预测区间框架。
AI.result: 将空间与时间成分分离的建模方式优于多个基线模型，取得更好的预测效果，并给出了SWE预测的不确定性区间。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为次季节尺度SWE累积预测及未来数据投影提供了框架，并支持未来构建大规模、时空完整的SWE图谱。

title: A Compact Stance-Indexed Anterior-Posterior COP Representation for Parkinson's Disease Classification from Plantar VGRF
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material is included in the same PDF
summary: Parkinson's disease alters gait and bilateral coordination, but machine-learning performance also depends on how continuous gait signals are represented. This study investigates whether preserving anterior-posterior center-of-pressure (AP-COP) information at fixed locations across normalized stance provides a compact and informative representation of plantar-force gait signals. Bilateral vertical ground reaction force recordings from 165 participants in the Gait in Parkinson's Disease Database were evaluated using repeated fully nested participant-level cross-validation. We propose AP-COP10, comprising AP-COP position and bilateral asymmetry across five stance windows. AP-COP10 achieved an AUC of 0.894 and outperformed three harmonized literature-derived COP representations under the same evaluation pipeline. The complementary 25 non-AP-COP descriptors alone achieved an AUC of 0.856, while the complete 35-feature representation achieved 0.908. Removing AP-COP10 from the complete representation produced a statistically supported loss in discrimination, whereas adding the complementary descriptors to AP-COP10 yielded only a small, unsupported improvement. Feature competition indicated that the most informative stance-indexed descriptors were concentrated in early and early-mid stance, while source-study holdout and sensor-perturbation analyses supported the robustness of the representation. These findings indicate that stance-indexed AP-COP retains discriminative information that is not readily recovered by broader engineered gait descriptors, supporting compact and interpretable representations for machine-learning analysis of pathological gait.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AP-COP10表征（5个站立期窗口的AP-COP位置与双侧不对称性），用于帕金森病步态信号分类，在165名受试者数据上取得AUC 0.894，优于三种文献衍生COP表征。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病会改变步态与双侧协调，但机器学习性能依赖于连续步态信号的表示方式。作者希望验证：在归一化站立期固定位置保留前后向压力中心（AP-COP）信息，能否构成足底力步态信号的紧凑且信息量大的表征。
AI.method: 使用Gait in Parkinson's Disease数据库中165名受试者的双侧垂直地面反作用力记录，采用重复完全嵌套的受试者级交叉验证。提出AP-COP10，包含5个站立窗口的AP-COP位置与双侧不对称性；与三种统一处理的文献COP表征对比，并做互补特征、消融、特征竞争、源研究留出及传感器扰动分析。
AI.result: AP-COP10的AUC为0.894，优于三种文献衍生COP表征；25个非AP-COP描述子单独达0.856，完整35特征达0.908。从完整表征中移除AP-COP10导致统计显著判别损失，而向AP-COP10加入互补描述子仅带来微小且不显著的提升。最具信息量的站立索引描述子集中在早期与早中期站立，稳健性分析支持该表征。
AI.conclusion: 站立索引化的AP-COP保留了更广泛工程化步态描述子难以恢复的判别信息，支持用于病理步态机器学习分析的紧凑、可解释表征。

title: Parallel Optimization: Theory, Algorithms, and Applications,
summary: This 30 years old book is posted for free download by the generosity of Oxford University Press that granted permission to allow access to future generations of young scientists. A printed copy can be purchased from the publisher. The authors received for this book "The 1999 INFORMS Computing Society Prize for Research Excellence in the Interface Between Operations Research and Computer Science" from the Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS). For a book review by Janos D. Pinter go to: Journal of Global Optimization, 16: 107-108, 2000.

AI.tldr: 这是一本30年前出版、现由牛津大学出版社免费开放下载的运筹学/计算机科学交叉领域经典著作，曾获1999年INFORMS计算学会研究卓越奖。
AI.motivation: 作者的动机在于让未来 generations 的年轻科学家能够免费获取该书，因此获得牛津大学出版社许可提供免费下载。
AI.method: 不适用（内容为书籍开放获取与获奖通告，非研究论文，无具体研究方法）。
AI.result: 该书获得1999年INFORMS计算学会"运筹学与计算机科学交叉领域研究卓越奖"，并有Janos D. Pinter在《Journal of Global Optimization》上的书评。
AI.conclusion: 该书是运筹学与计算机科学交叉领域的重要著作，现可免费下载，印刷版可从出版社购买。

title: On attention heads and bilinear forms
summary: We study the symmetric and antisymmetric parts of bilinear forms in the attention heads of trained large language models. We introduce an orthogonally invariant profile map from real bilinear forms to a three-dimensional simplex and observe that profiles of trained bilinear forms accumulate near profiles of rank-one bilinear forms. We prove that the symmetric part of a bilinear form in an attention head is the sum of a hyperbolic form and a zero form for a Zariski-dense subset of query-key matrices.

AI.tldr: 研究训练后大语言模型注意力头中双线性形式的对称与反对称部分，引入正交不变profile映射，发现训练后的profile接近秩一双线性形式的profile，并证明对称部分可分解为双曲形式与零形式之和。
AI.motivation: 理解训练后LLM注意力头中双线性形式（query-key矩阵）的内在结构，从对称/反对称分解角度刻画其代数性质，揭示训练如何塑造注意力机制。
AI.method: 对双线性形式作对称与反对称分解；引入正交不变profile映射，将实双线性形式映到三维单纯形；对训练后query-key矩阵的profile进行观察；通过代数几何方法证明对称部分的分解定理（Zariski-稠密子集上）。
AI.result: 训练后双线性形式的profile聚集在秩一双线性形式的profile附近；证明注意力头中双线性形式的对称部分是双曲形式与零形式之和（对query-key矩阵的Zariski-稠密子集成立）。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头中的双线性形式具有显著的低秩（近似秩一）结构，且其对称部分具有明确的代数分解，为理解Transformer注意力机制提供代数几何视角。

title: Quasi-Static Fault-Tolerant Feedback Control of a Quadrotor under Rotor Failure with Provable Safety Guarantees
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures (14 panels). Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Control Technology and Applications (CCTA)
summary: This paper presents a nonlinear control law for a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) under single-rotor failure that guarantees set stabilization via quasi-static feedback (QSF). Given a geometric curve in three-dimensional space, we characterize and stabilize the zero-dynamics manifold, also known as the path-following manifold, which represents all feasible motions along the path. Stabilizing this manifold ensures path-invariance: a UAV with a failed rotor initialized on the path with an appropriate orientation remains on the path for all future time. Furthermore, local exponential convergence to the manifold is guaranteed under certain conditions, implying that, under the stated assumptions, rotor failure during flight does not cause transverse deviation from the path. The proposed controller thus provides theoretical safety guarantees, which are validated through numerical experiments in the Drake physics-based simulation engine. The code is publicly available at https://gradslab.github.io/quasistatic-ftc/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于准静态反馈(QSF)的非线性控制律，使单旋翼故障的四旋翼无人机沿给定三维几何曲线实现路径不变与整定稳定。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼单旋翼失效后控制能力受限，飞行安全亟需理论保证；希望利用路径跟随流形来刻画可行运动，从而保证故障后不产生横向偏离。
AI.method: 针对单旋翼故障四旋翼设计非线性控制律，用准静态反馈(QSF)刻画并镇定零动态流形（即路径跟随流形）；在适当初始位姿条件下分析其局部指数收敛性。
AI.result: 实现路径不变性与整定稳定：若无人机在路径上以适当姿态初始化，故障后仍始终留在路径上；在特定条件下保证流形的局部指数收敛。数值实验在Drake物理仿真引擎中验证，代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该控制器为单旋翼故障下四旋翼沿路径飞行提供理论安全保证，说明在给定假设下旋翼故障不会导致路径横向偏差，并通过仿真验证了有效性。

title: CleanScore: Black-Box Benchmark Audits with Negative Controls and Sensitivity Bounds
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 21 tables. Item bank, code and pre-registrations released
summary: Public benchmark scores may reflect skill, prior exposure to the questions, or both, and for most models the training data are unknown. We present CleanScore, a black-box audit using scored outputs only. Each benchmark question becomes a parent item with one public form and two independently written fresh forms preserving its numbers, facts and answer. The audit reports an interval for the public-form advantage rather than a verdict, and a private negative-control bank with an explicit transport radius separates exposure from ordinary form mismatch. A registered controlled-exposure experiment detects planted exposure and stays quiet under fresh-form exposure. A registered audit of five open models on 200 GSM8K and 200 ARC-Challenge items finds no exposure-consistent advantage, bounding surface-form inflation below five points. Registered positive controls then bound what such a null can mean. Leaking an item raises accuracy on paraphrases the model never saw almost as much as on the leaked wording, leaving 52% to 110% of the effect invisible to a paraphrase audit. On ARC a planted 49-point advantage shows an observable gap of -0.020, and about 20 points survive rewriting stem and options, across four training seeds. A surface-form null bounds far less than the phrase contamination audit implies.

AI.tldr: CleanScore：一种仅用评分输出的黑盒审计方法，通过公开题与两份新写变体对比，给出"公开形式优势"区间；实验发现五个开源模型在 GSM8K 和 ARC 上无污染一致优势，且形式改写审计可能漏掉 52%–110% 的暴露效应。
AI.motivation: 基准分数可能混合了真实能力与训练数据污染（事前曝光），而多数模型训练数据不公开，因此需要一种不依赖模型内部信息、能区分"曝光"与"普通题目形式差异"的审计手段。
AI.method: 将每题构造为父题，含一个公开形式和两个独立撰写的新形式（保留数字、事实与答案）；仅用评分输出做黑盒审计，报告公开形式优势的区间而非单一结论；设计带明确"迁移半径"的私有负对照题库以分离曝光与普通形式差异；并进行注册的受控曝光实验与正向对照。
AI.result: 在 200 道 GSM8K 与 200 道 ARC-Challenge 上审计五个开源模型，未发现污染一致优势，将表面形式通胀上界压到 5 分以内；正向对照显示：题目泄露使模型在未见过的改写上准确率几乎与泄露原文一样高，使 52%–110% 的效应在改写审计中不可见；ARC 上植入 49 分优势仅表现为 -0.020 的可观测差距，改写题干与选项后仍约有 20 分优势保留（跨四个训练种子）。
AI.conclusion: 表面形式上的零结果所能排除的污染远少于短语污染审计所暗示的程度；仅靠形式改写审计可能严重低估曝光效应，CleanScore 提供的区间框架与负/正对照能更诚实地界定审计结论的边界。

title: Quantifying Hidden Salt for Precision Healthcare: Sodium Assessment via Joint-Factor Retrieval and Chain-of-Thought Inference
comment: Accepted in EMNLP 2026 Main Conference; 16 pages, 7 figures
summary: Precision healthcare, particularly for conditions like hypertension and cardiovascular disease, necessitates monitoring of dietary sodium intake. However, tracking this is hindered by the prevalence of hidden salt in cooking, such as sodium in soy sauce and ketchup. While recipes offer a valuable data source for dietary analysis, sodium-rich seasonings are frequently omitted or described ambiguously in instructions. To solve this issue, we propose SALT, a Sodium Assessing & Level Tracking framework adopting an RAG framework to assess sodium content in recipes. Our framework first introduces a Joint-Factor Embedding Retrieval module to locate similar recipes with specified sodium content for addressing the lack of contextual references. These retrieved samples provide contexts for subsequent inference. Then we design a structured 4-hop Chain-of-Thought inference module to refine the vague estimation from language models through a multi-step sodium estimation. To facilitate our study, we further construct a recipe dataset SALT54k with $54,151$ entries labeled with sodium quantities across $11$ common seasonings. Results on SALT54k demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in sodium estimation. Additional real-world validations confirm the effectiveness of our method, demonstrating its potential as a practical solution for AI-assisted precision healthcare.

AI.tldr: SALT是一个基于RAG的框架，用于评估食谱中的钠含量，解决隐藏盐（如酱油、番茄酱）在食谱中被省略或描述模糊的问题，并在新构建的SALT54k数据集上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 精准医疗（如高血压、心血管疾病）需要监测膳食钠摄入，但烹饪中的隐藏盐使得追踪困难。食谱虽是有价值的数据源，但富钠调味料常被省略或描述模糊，导致难以准确评估钠含量。
AI.method: 提出SALT框架，采用RAG方法：1）联合因子嵌入检索模块（Joint-Factor Embedding Retrieval）定位具有指定钠含量的相似食谱，为推理提供上下文参考；2）结构化4跳思维链推理模块（4-hop Chain-of-Thought），通过多步钠含量估计细化语言模型的模糊估计。同时构建了SALT54k数据集，包含54,151条食谱，标注了11种常见调味料的钠含量。
AI.result: 在SALT54k上达到钠含量估计的最先进性能，并通过额外的真实世界验证确认了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SALT展示了作为AI辅助精准医疗实用解决方案的潜力，可有效评估食谱中的钠含量以支持膳食监测。

title: R-GEAN: Regimen-Guided Edit Action Network for Within-Admission Medication Change Prediction
summary: The medications prescribed to a patient often change during a hospital admission as clinicians start, stop, or continue therapies. We study whether models can predict which medication classes are added or removed between 24 hours after admission and discharge. Metrics that compare the complete discharge regimen can reward models for copying medications that remain unchanged, even when they identify no actual changes. We therefore introduce a leakage-controlled benchmark that predicts net ATC3 additions and removals using only prior completed admissions and information available within the first 24 hours of the current admission. Addition candidates are classes not active at 24 hours, whereas removal candidates are classes active at that time. We also introduce R-GEAN, an asymmetric candidate-scoring network with independent addition and removal predictors. Across 240,480 admissions from 82,286 patients, R-GEAN achieves the highest predefined summary of addition, removal, changed-regimen, and action-pattern performance, termed the edit composite (0.464), compared with 0.435 for the strongest primary comparator. Reimplemented RETAIN, GAMENet, and MICRON baselines obtain 0.428, 0.420, and 0.288, respectively. R-GEAN's advantage is concentrated in correctly identifying medication classes no longer active at discharge, while rare additions and admissions with multiple medication changes remain difficult. Rankings based on micro-F1 over the reconstructed discharge regimen and the edit composite correlate weakly across the evaluated models (Spearman r = 0.20). The continuation baseline achieves the highest complete-regimen score despite predicting no additions or removals. These results show that complete-regimen and edit-level evaluation measure different aspects of medication prediction. The benchmark evaluates observed prescribing changes, not treatment appropriateness

AI.tldr: 提出泄漏受控基准预测住院期间药物类别的净新增/停用，并提出非对称候选打分网络R-GEAN，在24小时内信息下取得最优编辑综合分0.464。
AI.motivation: 现有评估比较出院完整处方，会奖励模型照抄未变药物，即使未识别任何实际用药变化，掩盖真实改动预测能力。
AI.method: 构建仅用既往完成入院与当前入院前24小时信息的基准，预测ATC3净新增（24小时未用类别）与停用（24小时在用的类别）；提出R-GEAN，含独立新增与停用预测器的非对称候选打分网络。
AI.result: 240,480次入院、82,286名患者中，R-GEAN编辑综合分0.464，优于最强对照0.435；RETAIN/GAMENet/MICRON为0.428/0.420/0.288。优势集中在识别出院时不再使用的类别；罕见新增与多次改药仍难。完整处方微F1排名与编辑综合分排名仅弱相关（Spearman r=0.20），延续基线完整处方分最高却不预测任何改动。
AI.conclusion: 完整处方级与编辑级评估衡量药物预测的不同方面，需区分；该基准评估观察到的处方变化，而非治疗 appropriateness 的适宜性。

title: Convergence of Rotation-based Matrix Optimizers: A Unified Analysis of SOAP, Conda, and SPlus
comment: This paper subsumes our prior manuscript: Convergence Rate Analysis of SOAP with Arbitrary Orthogonal Projection Matrices, arXiv:2604.21616
summary: In this work, we develop a unified theoretical framework for analyzing the convergence of rotation-based matrix optimizers, which apply orthogonal transformations to map the momentum into a rotated space, perform coordinate-wise or normalized updates there, and then rotate the updates back. Our framework encompasses prominent matrix optimizers, including SOAP, Conda, and truncated SPlus, as well as matrix-parameterized Adam as a special case. As our main result, we establish, for the first time, the convergence rate of SOAP with sharp dimensional dependence, as well as the convergence rate of Adam measured by the nuclear norm. Our framework also covers a more general variant of rotation-based optimizers that allows arbitrary orthogonal rotation matrices, allowing these matrices to depend on the current stochastic gradient at each iteration. Technically, our framework leverages a row-column trace-control argument that converts elementwise bounds into bounds on two diagonal control matrices, thereby improving the dimension dependence of the resulting bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一理论框架分析基于旋转的矩阵优化器收敛性，首次建立SOAP的清晰维度依赖收敛率以及Adam在核范数下的收敛率。
AI.motivation: 基于旋转的矩阵优化器（如SOAP、Conda、truncated SPlus及矩阵参数化Adam）广泛使用，但缺乏统一的理论收敛分析，尤其是对SOAP等方法的维度依赖收敛率尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建统一理论框架，涵盖多种旋转式矩阵优化器；允许任意正交旋转矩阵并依赖当前随机梯度；采用行-列迹控制论证，将逐元素界转化为两个对角控制矩阵上的界，以改进维度依赖性。
AI.result: 首次建立了SOAP具有清晰维度依赖的收敛率，以及Adam在核范数度量下的收敛率；框架还覆盖更一般的旋转式优化器变体。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架为旋转式矩阵优化器提供了新的收敛性理论保证，并通过行-列迹控制技术改善了维度依赖，拓展了对SOAP和Adam等方法的理论理解。

title: Decoupled Causal Discovery
summary: Causal discovery from observational data is a fundamental yet challenging task in scientific research. While existing approaches are primarily based on conditional independence tests, structure scores, or restrictive functional assumptions, we propose Decoupled Causal Discovery (DCD), a novel decoupling-based perspective that does not rely on these methodologies. DCD directly identifies the Markov boundary (MB) by decoupling non-target variables via weighting functions, such that only variables within the MB preserve dependence with the target under the decoupled distribution. Building on this, DCD iteratively constructs the Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG) by exploiting structural asymmetries within the MBs. We establish the theoretical identifiability, soundness, and completeness of DCD. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that DCD achieves strong performance, particularly excelling in challenging noise regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出解耦因果发现(DCD)，通过加权函数解耦非目标变量直接识别马尔可夫边界(MB)，并迭代构建CPDAG，理论上证明了可识别性、可靠性与完备性，在噪声环境下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现方法依赖条件独立性检验、结构评分或受限函数假设，存在局限，需要一种不依赖这些方法的新视角。
AI.method: 提出解耦视角：通过加权函数解耦非目标变量，使只有MB内变量在解耦分布下与目标保持依赖，从而直接识别MB；再基于MB内结构不对称性迭代构建CPDAG。
AI.result: 理论上建立了DCD的可识别性、可靠性与完备性；实证表明DCD性能强劲，尤其在挑战性噪声场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: DCD提供了一种不依赖传统方法的因果发现新范式，兼具理论保证与噪声鲁棒性。

title: On sparsity and directional forgetting in adaptive control
summary: This paper develops a sparsity-promoting memory regressor extension (MRE) adaptation law with directional forgetting for nonlinear control-affine systems with linearly parameterized uncertainty. The objective is to use directional forgetting to selectively discount obsolete information and leverage $\ell_1$ regularization to promote sparsity of the parameter estimates. While $\ell_1$ regularization has been applied to the system identification problem in an offline setting, a contribution of this paper is to develop a recursive least squares update law to implement $\ell_1$ regularization in online adaptive control. In particular, we show that $\ell_1$-regularized recursive least squares is realized via a sliding mode update law. A nonsmooth Lyapunov-based stability analysis is then used to show that the tracking and parameter estimation errors are ultimately bounded under a subspace excitation condition. Simulation results on a Van der Pol oscillator demonstrate the ability of the developed sparsity-promoting MRE controller to recover sparse dynamics while maintaining stable tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文为非线性控制仿射系统的在线自适应控制提出了一种带方向遗忘的稀疏促进记忆回归扩展(MRE)自适应律,通过滑模更新律实现ℓ1正则化递归最小二乘,并证明误差最终有界。
AI.motivation: ℓ1正则化此前多用于离线系统辨识,尚缺乏在线自适应控制中的递归实现;同时需要选择性遗忘过时信息以促进参数估计的稀疏性。
AI.method: 针对线性参数化不确定性的非线性控制仿射系统,开发带方向遗忘的稀疏促进MRE自适应律;提出用滑模更新律实现ℓ1正则化递归最小二乘;采用非光滑Lyapunov稳定性分析。
AI.result: 在子空间激励条件下,跟踪误差与参数估计误差最终有界;Van der Pol振荡器仿真表明该控制器能在保持稳定跟踪的同时恢复稀疏动态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将ℓ1正则化从离线辨识扩展到在线自适应控制,借助方向遗忘与滑模实现的递归最小二乘,实现稀疏参数估计并保证稳定性。

title: DPTM-DT: Dual-Pretrained Transformer Multitask Representation Learning for Drug-Target Prediction
summary: Drug-target relation prediction supports candidate screening, drug repositioning, and mechanism analysis. Existing models often use incomplete drug or protein representations, model cross-modal interactions shallowly, or train affinity regression and interaction classification separately, although these tasks describe closely related views of the same drug-target pair. This paper presents DPTM-DT, a dual-pretrained Transformer framework for multitask drug-target prediction. DPTM-DT combines GROVER molecular graph embeddings, ESM protein language-model embeddings, and CTD physicochemical descriptors, then exchanges drug-target information through bidirectional cross-modal attention. A shared pair representation is used for continuous affinity regression, high-affinity binary classification, and six-level affinity classification. Experiments on Davis and KIBA cover random 80/20 and DeepDTA-style standard splits. On the random 80/20 split, DPTM-DT achieves MSE/CI values of 0.193/0.917 on Davis and 0.120/0.918 on KIBA. It also reports binary AUPR/MCC values of 0.727/0.654 and 0.798/0.689, and six-class Macro-F1/Top-2 values of 0.800/0.932 and 0.815/0.962 on Davis and KIBA, respectively. Across the reported regression, binary classification, and multiclass classification settings, DPTM-DT achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods. Results under the standard split show the same relative trend. Ablations indicate that dual target representation, gated fusion, and cross-modal attention each contribute to the final performance. Code and supplementary materials are available at: anonymous.4open.science/r/DPCM-DT-74E0.

AI.tldr: 提出DPTM-DT双预训练Transformer多任务框架，融合GROVER、ESM与CTD特征，通过双向跨模态注意力共享配对表示，联合完成亲和力回归、高亲和二分类与六级分类，在Davis/KIBA上取得最优综合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有药物-靶点关系预测模型常使用不完整的药物或蛋白表示、跨模态交互建模浅、且将亲和力回归与交互分类分开训练，而这些任务实际上描述同一药物-靶点对的密切相关的视角。
AI.method: DPTM-DT结合GROVER分子图嵌入、ESM蛋白语言模型嵌入与CTD理化描述符，通过双向跨模态注意力交换药物-靶点信息，并用共享配对表示同时进行连续亲和力回归、高亲和二分类及六级亲和力分类。
AI.result: 在Davis与KIBA上，随机80/20划分下回归MSE/CI为0.193/0.917与0.120/0.918；二分类AUPR/MCC为0.727/0.654与0.798/0.689；六分类Macro-F1/Top-2为0.800/0.932与0.815/0.962。标准划分下趋势一致，消融显示双靶点表示、门控融合与跨模态注意力均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: DPTM-DT在回归、二分类与多分类设置下整体优于对比方法，验证了双预训练表示、门控融合与跨模态注意力对多任务药物-靶点预测的有效性。

title: SCoR: A Hierarchical Framework for Forecasting Relations Between Scientific Concepts
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables; includes supplementary material. Jingze Wang and Fred Sun contributed equally; Shangqi Guo is the corresponding author
summary: Anticipating emerging research directions is a critical goal of AI-assisted science. Existing methods mainly predict which concepts will co-occur in future papers, but co-occurrence captures shared attention rather than the scientific meaning of a connection, such as whether one method uses, combines, replaces, or contradicts another. We formulate research-direction discovery as hierarchical scientific-relation forecasting over a shared candidate-pair space, comprising three temporally aligned tasks: first co-occurrence, first scientific-relation formation, and relation type at formation. We construct SCoR-Graph from 187,848 cs.CV papers published between 2017 and 2026, yielding 270,687 consolidated concepts, 7.45 million co-occurrence edges, and 615,036 typed, directed relation edges. From cutoff-specific graph snapshots, we derive SCoR-Bench, a leakage-audited benchmark for these three capabilities, with expert-verified gold labels for the entire relation-type test set. We further introduce HiSCoR, a task-adapted model family that models relation emergence as a temporally evolving, hierarchically constrained process by encoding pre-cutoff event histories and conditioning relation formation on future co-occurrence. On the held-out 2025-2026 window, HiSCoR achieves an AUROC of 0.9515, a 2.4% relative improvement over the strongest temporal-graph baseline, and improves population-AUPRC by 14.0%; its relation-type variant achieves a Macro-AUROC of 0.7795. Ablations show that semantic, co-occurrence, and typed-relation views provide complementary predictive evidence. SCoR advances research-direction forecasting from predicting which concepts will co-occur to anticipating whether and how evidence-backed scientific relations will emerge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将研究方向发现形式化为“分层科学关系预测”任务（共现→关系形成→关系类型），构建SCoR-Graph数据集与SCoR-Bench基准，并提出HiSCoR模型，在2025-2026预测窗口上取得AUROC 0.9515等显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要预测概念未来是否共现，但共现仅代表共同关注，无法刻画连接的科学语义（如使用、结合、替代或矛盾）。因此需要从“预测共现”升级为“预测是否有证据支撑的科学关系及关系类型”。
AI.method: 1) 将研究方​向发现定义为共享候选对空间上的分层科学关系预测，包含三个时间对齐任务：首次共现、首次科学关系形成、形成时关系类型。2) 构建SCoR-Graph：基于2017-2026年187,848篇cs.CV论文，得到270,687概念、745万共现边、615,036条带类型的有向关系边。3) 构建SCoR-Bench：基于特定时间切片的图快照，防泄漏审查，关系类型测试集全量专家验证。4) 提出HiSCoR模型族：编码截断前事件历史，以未来共现为条件，将关系涌现建模为时间演化、层级约束过程。
AI.result: 在2025-2026留出窗口上，HiSCoR达到AUROC 0.9515，较最强时序图基线相对提升2.4%；population-AUPRC提升14.0%；关系类型变体Macro-AUROC为0.7795。消融实验表明语义、共现与类型化关系三种视图提供互补预测证据。
AI.conclusion: SCoR将研究方向预测从“预测概念是否共现”推进到“预测是否有证据支撑的科学关系将出现以及如何出现”，为AI辅助科学发现提供了更细粒度的预测框架与基准。

title: OptiSkill: A Hierarchical and Evolving SkillBank for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
summary: Automated operations research (OR) modeling requires LLMs to translate natural-language decision problems into correct mathematical programs. Existing methods can improve individual formulations, but they often solve problems in isolation, retaining little reusable experience and repeating similar formulation errors. Prior memory-based approaches store examples, thoughts, or insights as references, while OR modeling requires reusable formulation skills that transfer across problem narratives and guide concrete modeling decisions. We propose OptiSkill, a skill-augmented framework that builds a hierarchical and evolving SkillBank for LLM-based OR modeling. SkillBank stores solver-verified experience as reusable skills, with Global Strategies for problem-level formulation skeletons and Step Experiences for local error-prevention rules. It is further refined through stable batch-level test-time evolution, where candidate skills are incorporated only after validation. Experiments on eight OR modeling benchmarks show that OptiSkill improves formulation accuracy across LLM backbones, outperforms strong agentic baselines, and gains further by expanding SkillBank coverage and reliability. Code and data are available at https://github.com/rachhhhing/OptiSkill

AI.tldr: 提出OptiSkill，通过构建分层且持续演化的SkillBank，将求解器验证的经验存为可复用建模技能，显著提升LLM自动化运筹建模的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM运筹建模方法多孤立求解、缺乏可复用经验，重复犯错；而记忆类方法仅存样例/思路，无法转移跨问题的可复用建模技能。
AI.method: 构建分层演化SkillBank：全局策略（问题级建模骨架）+ 步骤经验（局部防错规则），存储求解器验证的经验；通过稳定的批级测试时演化精炼，候选技能须验证后才纳入。
AI.result: 在八个运筹建模基准上，OptiSkill跨多个LLM骨干提升建模准确率，优于强智能体基线，并随SkillBank覆盖与可靠性扩展进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 技能增强框架可有效提升LLM运筹建模的可复用性与准确率，SkillBank扩展与验证带来持续增益，代码数据已开源。

title: Scalable Dynamic Pricing of Substitutable Products through Structure-Guided Policy Learning
summary: Problem definition: We study dynamic pricing of substitutable products with finite, product-specific inventories. Customer substitution couples pricing decisions across products, while the inventory state makes exact dynamic programming intractable at realistic scale. Methodology / results: We develop two MNL-guided policy-learning approaches that replace the dynamic program with a statistical mapping from inventory states to pricing decisions. The first learns prices directly, while the second learns inventory opportunity costs and converts them into prices using the optimal MNL pricing rule. Both policies are trained using decision-focused learning. We also propose an efficient method to generate anticipative customer-choice targets to train our policies. Managerial implications: We conduct an extensive numerical evaluation of our approaches. On small instances for which the optimal dynamic program can be computed, the learned policies achieve average optimality gaps below 0.4%. On larger airline-motivated instances, they consistently improve on the tested revenue-management benchmarks. The comparison between the two architectures also highlights the role of model structure: using the MNL pricing characterization is particularly effective when demand is well described by MNL, while directly learning prices provides greater flexibility under heterogeneous mixed-MNL demand.

AI.tldr: 研究有限库存下可替代产品的动态定价，提出两种MNL引导的策略学习方法来替代难解的动态规划。
AI.motivation: 客户替代性使定价决策跨产品耦合，而库存状态导致动态规划在现实规模下难以求解。
AI.method: 开发两种MNL引导的策略学习方法，用从库存状态到定价决策的统计映射替代动态规划：第一种直接学习价格，第二种学习库存机会成本并用最优MNL定价规则转换为价格；均通过决策导向学习训练，并提出高效方法生成前瞻性客户选择目标。
AI.result: 在可求最优动态规划的小实例上，平均最优性差距低于0.4%；在航空动机的较大实例上，持续优于测试的收入管理基准。比较显示：MNL定价刻画在需求符合MNL时尤为有效，直接学习价格在异质混合MNL需求下灵活性更强。
AI.conclusion: MNL引导的策略学习能有效解决大规模可替代产品动态定价问题，且两种架构各有适用场景，凸显了模型结构的作用。

title: Sufficient and Necessary Continuous Barrier-like Conditions for Discrete-Time Stochastic Reach-Avoid Verification
summary: This paper develops necessary and sufficient barrier-like characterizations using continuous barrier functions for infinite-horizon reach-avoid verification of discrete-time stochastic systems. Existing results establish necessary and sufficient conditions in terms of functional inequalities involving measurable or lower semicontinuous barrier functions. However, the limited regularity of such functions may hinder their numerical approximation and computational synthesis. Building on our previous barrier-like condition for finite-horizon reach-avoid verification, we show that this condition can also be used for infinite-horizon reach-avoid verification and, under a uniform absolute continuity condition on the transition kernels, admits a continuous barrier function whenever the exact reach-avoid probability is strictly larger than the prescribed threshold for every state in the initial set. We further show that the resulting continuous barrier function can be uniformly approximated by a polynomial one while preserving the required barrier-like conditions. For polynomial systems, we formulate these conditions as polynomial positivity constraints over compact basic semialgebraic sets. Putinar's Positivstellensatz then converts the positivity conditions into sum-of-squares (SOS) certificates, yielding semidefinite programming (SDP) formulations for synthesizing polynomial barrier functions. We establish both soundness and completeness of the resulting SOS-based procedure. Finally, two numerical examples illustrate the theoretical results and demonstrate the resulting SDP approach.

AI.tldr: 本文为离散时间随机系统的无限时域reach-avoid验证，提出基于连续障碍函数的充要刻画，并给出多项式SOS-SDP综合方法。
AI.motivation: 现有充要条件依赖可测或下半连续障碍函数，其正则性不足，阻碍数值近似与计算综合，需引入连续障碍函数以支持可计算求解。
AI.method: 基于先前有限时域reach-avoid障碍条件，将其推广到无限时域；在转移核一致绝对连续条件下，当初始集上reach-avoid概率严格大于阈值时构造连续障碍函数，并可被多项式一致逼近。对多项式系统将条件化为紧基本半代数集上的多项式正性约束，用Putinar Positivstellensatz转成SOS证书，得到SDP综合公式。
AI.result: 证明了连续障碍函数的存在性及多项式一致逼近性；建立SOS-SDP程序的可靠性与完备性；两个数值例子验证理论并展示SDP方法效果。
AI.conclusion: 连续障碍函数克服了低正则性障碍，实现无限时域reach-avoid验证的多项式障碍函数可计算综合，SOS-SDP框架兼具理论保证与实用性。

title: Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Blasius Boundary-Layer Problem
summary:
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free approach
  for solving differential equations, but their performance can depend
  strongly on loss weighting, collocation placement, and optimization
  strategy. This study develops an adaptive PINN framework for the Blasius
  boundary-layer equation using gradient-norm-based adaptive loss
  weighting, nonuniform and residual-based collocation, and sequential
  Adam--L-BFGS optimization. In the representative run using the
  architecture $[1,100,100,1]$, the model predicts
  $f''(0)=0.3320762918$, compared with the high-accuracy benchmark
  $0.332057336215$, giving an absolute error of
  $1.896\times10^{-5}$. The final weighted loss is
  $6.789\times10^{-8}$, and the predicted stream-function, velocity, and
  shear profiles agree closely with an independent numerical
  boundary-value solution. A separate full-training architecture study
  shows that the two-hidden-layer model achieves the smallest wall-shear
  error among the four tested architectures, $1.629\times10^{-6}$,
  whereas the deepest network attains the smallest weighted objective
  but a substantially larger wall-shear error. Compared with the
  previously reported PINN value $f''(0)=0.33165$, the representative
  run reduces the wall-shear error by approximately a factor of $21.5$.
  The results show that the combined adaptive training framework can
