We implement WorkWorlds in a primary synthetic pharmaceutical company with 8 measured tasks across 6 employee seats, and construct additional organizational worlds. Across 192 matched evaluations, moving from task-curated context to the full role-visible workplace reduced evidence access from 90.4% to 74.5% and criterion pass from 79.4% to 68.2%, while pass conditional on evidence access remained nearly unchanged; most of the measured difference occurred before the agent reached sufficient evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorkWorlds评测基础设施，将组织状态与任务规格分离，先固定世界状态再引入任务，以避免任务信息泄漏到上下文中。在制药公司合成世界的192次匹配评测中，使用完整角色可见环境较任务定制上下文使证据获取率从90.4%降至74.5%，标准通过率从79.4%降至68.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有知识工作基准多围绕独立任务构建，任务所需的上下文往往与任务一起或之后被选择。这种设计会将任务信息编码进环境，并预先完成部分信息定位工作，从而高估了模型在真实工作场所中的表现。
AI.method: WorkWorlds首先固定组织状态的修订版本、日期和员工席位，物化该员工可访问的组织状态，任务仅在此之后引入，从而分离组织状态与任务规格。作者在一家合成制药公司中实现主世界，包含6个员工席位、8个测量任务，并构建了额外的组织世界。
AI.result: 在192次匹配评测中，从任务定制上下文切换到完整角色可见工作场所后，证据获取率从90.4%降至74.5%，标准通过率从79.4%降至68.2%；在获得证据条件下的通过率几乎不变，说明差异主要发生在代理获取充分证据之前。
AI.conclusion: 将组织状态与任务规格分离能更真实地评测知识工作能力；性能下降主要源于信息定位与证据获取阶段，而非拿到证据后的推理或作答阶段。

title: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Action Masking and Projection for Battery Energy Storage Dispatch under Suppressed-Spread Market Shifts
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE IECON 2026. 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
summary: Battery energy storage system (BESS) dispatch must preserve operational feasibility while declining price spreads reduce the margin available to pay for cycling. We study a proximal policy optimization (PPO) controller whose pre-selection physical action mask and emergency projection are separated from a causal, forecast-informed economic advisory. All forecast-dependent methods receive the same causal 24-step forecast and grid-side settlement. Across five PPO seeds, advice-on net profit is 30.59 and 18.04 USD per 336-hour T1 and T2 window, versus 36.77 and 22.94 USD for proxy-cost MPC; PPO remains below this reference in both periods. Advice raises T2 profit from 16.45 to 18.04 USD while reducing throughput, but is immaterial in T1. On disjoint weekly blocks, PPO is stable under daily, weekly, and blended seasonal forecasts, weakens under persistence, and remains below proxy-cost MPC. Paired diagnostics localize changes to the observed 5-10 USD/MWh regime with mixed SoC-dependent effects. An M0-M6 ablation shows that mask removal sends thousands of infeasible requests to projection, while removing both physical layers exposes ramp violations. The evidence separates economic screening from feasibility enforcement without claiming formal safety, lifecycle-optimal aging, or RL dominance.

AI.tldr: 研究PPO控制器在BESS调度中的表现，将物理动作掩码/紧急投影与经济顾问分离，并与代理成本MPC对比。
AI.motivation: BESS调度需在保证运行可行性的同时应对价差收窄导致的循环收益下降。
AI.method: PPO控制器配备预选物理动作掩码与紧急投影，并由因果、基于预测的经济顾问提供建议；所有依赖预测的方法共享同一24步因果预测和电网侧结算；进行5个种子、T1/T2窗口、不同季节预测与M0-M6消融实验。
AI.result: 建议开启后净利为30.59/18.04 USD（T1/T2），低于代理成本MPC的36.77/22.94；T2利润由16.45升至18.04且吞吐降低，T1影响不显著；日/周/混合预测下稳定，持续性预测下变弱；掩码移除导致大量不可行请求被投影，去掉物理层会暴露爬坡违规。
AI.conclusion: 证据表明可将经济筛选与可行性执行分离，但不主张形式安全、生命周期最优老化或RL优于其他方法。

title: EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems
summary: Long-horizon interactions with LLM-based assistants require memory systems that preserve and update user states, preferences, and interaction histories. Existing evaluations report end-to-end QA accuracy and cannot determine whether errors arise from encoding, retrieval, or generation. We introduce EvalMem, an operation-level diagnostic framework with three parallel Examiners. For each query, the Encoding Examiner checks whether the target fact is stored, the Retrieval Examiner assesses whether the native retriever returns usable evidence, and the Generation Examiner tests whether the model can answer from oracle evidence. Their outputs form fine-grained multi-label defect codes. To improve store-level diagnosis, we adapt agentic RAG with a recall-first strategy that searches using both the query and source evidence, increasing recall of present evidence on LoCoMo from 70.2% to 95.6%. Evaluations of seven memory systems on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and dynamic DynaMem-Bench identify retrieval as the most frequently attributed failure layer; in default LoCoMo, retrieval defects reach 22.1%, compared with 7.7% for encoding and 6.5% for generation. Guided by this diagnosis, MemWiki, a search-friendly auxiliary structure built from each system's memory export, improves mean accuracy by 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvalMem，一个操作级诊断框架，用三个 Examiner 分别定位记忆系统中的编码、检索与生成错误，并在多个基准上发现检索是最常见的失败层，据此设计的 MemWiki 结构可提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统评测只报告端到端 QA 准确率，无法判断错误究竟来自编码、检索还是生成，缺乏细粒度诊断手段。
AI.method: EvalMem 包含三个并行 Examiner：Encoding Examiner 检查目标事实是否被存储，Retrieval Examiner 评估原生检索器是否返回可用证据，Generation Examiner 测试模型能否基于 oracle 证据作答；输出多标签缺陷码。并采用 recall-first 的 agentic RAG 策略，用查询与源证据双重搜索提升证据召回。
AI.result: recall-first 策略将 LoCoMo 上现有证据召回率从 70.2% 提升至 95.6%；在三个基准上评测七个记忆系统，检索为最常被归因的失败层（LoCoMo 默认设置下检索缺陷 22.1%，编码 7.7%，生成 6.5%）；据此设计的 MemWiki 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上平均准确率分别提升 2.5 和 2.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 操作级诊断能有效区分记忆系统的失败层并指导改进，检索是当前记忆系统的主要瓶颈，基于诊断构建的辅助结构可带来实际性能提升。

title: Pretraining of Medical Visual Encoders Toward Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) commonly reuse visual encoders pretrained with CLIP, although the features of these ViTs are ultimately consumed by autoregressive LLMs. We refer to this mismatch as the semantic-interface gap and introduce MedMLIP, a framework that pretrains the visual encoder through report generation with a frozen LLM, while employing Local Relational Distillation (LRD) to preserve relationships among visual patches to avoid visual collapse. We pretrain MedMLIP on IU-Xray and Open-PMC-300K and evaluate the resulting encoders on VQA-RAD and SLAKE. Only the ViT is transferred, while the guiding LLM and projector are replaced, allowing us to assess cross-LLM transferability. Our cross-LLM transfer experiments demonstrate the value of pretraining visual encoders for their autoregressive LLM interface while trying to preserve more fine-grained visual information. Code and the pretrained model are available at https://github.com/SkyCol/MedMLIP

AI.tldr: 提出MedMLIP框架，通过报告生成使视觉编码器对齐冻结LLM，并用局部关系蒸馏(LRD)防止视觉坍塌，在医学VQA上验证跨LLM迁移性。
AI.motivation: MLLMs通常复用CLIP预训练的视觉编码器，但其特征最终由自回归LLM消费，二者存在"语义接口鸿沟"(semantic-interface gap)。
AI.method: 用报告生成任务、借助冻结LLM预训练视觉编码器；引入局部关系蒸馏(LRD)保持视觉patch间关系以避免视觉坍塌；仅迁移ViT，替换引导LLM与projector以评估跨LLM迁移性。
AI.result: 在IU-Xray和Open-PMC-300K上预训练，在VQA-RAD和SLAKE上评估；跨LLM迁移实验证明为该自回归LLM接口预训练视觉编码器是有价值的。
AI.conclusion: 为自回归LLM接口预训练视觉编码器同时保留更细粒度视觉信息具有重要价值，代码与模型已开源。

title: Statistical Convergence of Transformer Encoder-Accelerated Robust Reinforcement Learning
summary: Obtaining the optimal action-value function in Markov decision processes is computationally intensive in large state--action spaces. In this study, we present statistically rigorous convergence results for a robust reinforcement learning algorithm warm-started by a transformer-based action-value function prediction, where natural language prompts encode task specifications. Our framework adopts the R-contamination model to characterize uncertainty in the state transition kernel, and employs conformal prediction to certify convergence via trajectory-level nonconformity scores constructed from the contracting Bellman residual. The resulting conformal quantile bounds the gap between the running and optimal action-value functions simultaneously over all iterations, thereby yielding a pre-certified stopping rule that requires little knowledge of the true transition kernel. Numerical case studies on perturbed maze environments of varying size and contamination level confirm that the transformer-based warm start measurably reduces the initial error and accelerates convergence, while the proposed conformal bounds track the true error trajectory more tightly than existing guarantees.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Transformer热启动与保形预测的鲁棒强化学习算法，具有严格收敛保证与预认证停止规则。
AI.motivation: 大状态-动作空间中求解最优动作价值函数计算代价高，且状态转移核存在不确定性，需要统计严谨的收敛保证。
AI.method: 采用R污染模型刻画转移核不确定性，用Transformer基于自然语言提示预测动作价值函数进行热启动，并通过保形预测与收缩Bellman残差构造轨迹级非一致性得分。
AI.result: 保形分位数同时约束所有迭代中运行值与最优动作价值函数的差距；扰动迷宫实验显示热启动降低初始误差、加速收敛，且保形界比现有保证更紧。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供预认证停止规则，几乎不依赖真实转移核知识，验证了Transformer热启动与保形界的有效性。

title: Universal Observatory Graphs for Distributed Sky Coverage and Artificial Intelligence Based Interplanetary Routing
summary: This research proposes the Universal Observatory Graph (UOG), an AI-driven framework for distributed astronomical observation across the Solar System. The proposed architecture models autonomous observatories located at the Sun planet L2 Lagrange points as nodes in a weighted graph, while communication links are represented as graph edges characterized by multi-objective physical and operational metrics, including interplanetary distance, communication latency, transmission power, and link reliability. The resulting graph provides a unified mathematical representation of a cooperative interplanetary observatory network. This proposal examines a six-observatory Solar System configuration comprising Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. Instantaneous sky coverage is evaluated independently using a 200,000 direction Fibonacci sphere, a 2,000,000 direction fixed seed Monte Carlo calculation and deterministic spherical integration. All three methods yield complete network union coverage, approximately 0.43% complete six observatory intersection and approximately 24.96% mean pairwise Jaccard similarity under the adopted pointing model. Communication routing is subsequently formulated as a finite horizon Markov decision process and solved using tabular Q-learning. The reward balances node participation and a distance dependent reliability proxy against distance, light time latency and a distance squared transmission power proxy. The learned Earth-Saturn-Uranus-Neptune route is also the highest discounted return route among all 41 feasible simple paths under the four hop constraint. The framework provides a reproducible baseline for sequential coverage assessment and multi objective routing; time dependent ephemerides, mission specific visibility, calibrated link budgets and scalable graph policies remain future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通用天文台图"(UOG)框架，用加权图建模太阳系L2点自主天文台网络，并评估组网覆盖与路由性能。
AI.motivation: 分布式天文观测需要在行星际尺度上协调多个自主天文台，通信链路受距离、时延、功率和可靠性等多重物理与操作因素制约，缺乏统一的数学表示与可复现的覆盖、路由基线。
AI.method: 将太阳系L2点的自主天文台建模为加权图节点，通信链路为边，边权包含行星际距离、通信时延、传输功率与链路可靠性等指标；以地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星六节点配置为例，用20万方向Fibonacci球、200万方向固定种子蒙特卡洛和确定性球面积分三种方法独立评估瞬时全天覆盖；通信路由建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，用表格Q学习求解，奖励权衡节点参与度与距离相关可靠性，惩罚距离、光行时延和距离平方传输功率。
AI.result: 三种覆盖评估方法均得到完整的网络并集覆盖，约0.43%的六天文台完全交集和约24.96%的平均成对Jaccard相似度；Q学习学到的地球-土星-天王星-海王星路径在四跳约束下所有41条可行简单路径中折现回报最高。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为顺序覆盖评估和多目标路由提供了可复现基线；时变星历、任务特定可见性、校准链路预算和可扩展图策略留作未来工作。

title: Seeing Through Conflicts: Improving Instruction Hierarchy Alignment in Vision-Language Models
summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) alignment teaches language models to prioritize higher-level instructions when inputs conflict. While studied primarily in text-only settings, vision-language models (VLMs) introduce new challenges for IH: instructions may be embedded in images, split across modalities, visually transformed, or encountered during agentic tasks. Positing multimodal IH alignment as a reasoning problem, we train VLMs using reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards, comparing text-only, image-only, and mixed-modality supervision. We find that text-only IH training partially transfers to multimodal attacks, failing when models must decode, reconstruct, or reason over instructions across modalities. Image-based training improves robustness beyond text-only supervision, while mixed-modality training performs best overall. Importantly, the benefits generalize beyond the synthetic typographic training setting to real-image and web-agent safety tasks, while largely preserving general multimodal capability, showing that lightweight, verifiable supervision can meaningfully improve VLM robustness under adversarial, cross-modal, and interactive instruction conflicts.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉语言模型(VLM)的指令层级对齐,将其视为推理问题,用规则奖励的强化学习训练VLM,并比较文本、图像及混合模态监督的效果。
AI.motivation: 指令层级对齐主要应用于纯文本场景,而VLM带来新挑战:指令可能嵌入图像中、跨模态拆分、被视觉变换或在智能体任务中出现,需要专门研究多模态指令冲突下的对齐方法。
AI.method: 将多模态指令层级对齐视为推理问题,使用基于规则奖励的强化学习训练VLM,对比纯文本、纯图像和混合模态三种监督方式。
AI.result: 纯文本训练只能部分迁移到多模态攻击,在需跨模态解码、重构或推理时失效;基于图像训练优于纯文本监督;混合模态训练整体最佳,且收益可泛化到真实图像和网页智能体安全任务,同时基本保持通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级、可验证的监督能有效提升VLM在对抗性、跨模态和交互式指令冲突下的鲁棒性。

title: Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery
summary: Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. Large-scale online A/B experiments validate our design. We demonstrate that combining LLM-backed recommendations with these explanatory rationales significantly reduces the trust barrier for new content, yielding statistically significant improvements in both user exploration and overall engagement on the discovery surfaces.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种解耦式推荐架构，将LLM推理异步离线化，预计算个性化未发现艺术家的候选池与解释性理由，从而在保证实时延迟的同时提升探索与参与度。
AI.motivation: 音乐流媒体平台面临"利用熟悉内容 vs 驱动新颖内容探索"的持久权衡：用户渴望发现新内容，却不愿放弃已知喜爱的艺术家去选择陌生对象。提供透明的自然语言推荐理由可降低这一信任门槛。但LLM虽擅长生成此类解释，其在线部署受限于高昂的推理成本与计算开销。
AI.method: 采用工业案例研究，设计解耦式推荐架构：将LLM推理隔离至离线异步处理，预先计算出个性化"未被发现艺术家"候选池及定制化解释理由。基于此架构进行大规模在线A/B实验验证。
AI.result: 在线A/B实验显示，将LLM支持的推荐与解释性理由相结合，显著降低了新内容的信任门槛，在探索行为和整体参与度指标上均取得统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 解耦架构能够在不牺牲延迟的前提下成功扩展探索推荐；LLM生成的解释理由是缓解用户信任障碍、提升发现场景参与度的有效手段，为工业级LLM推荐落地提供了可复用的架构范式。

title: CHART: A Harness-Rotation Curriculum for Harness-Robust Search Agents
summary: Search agents are usually trained under a single harness. But once an agent is deployed in a real application, its harness is frequently updated (e.g., a rewritten system prompt) to fit production needs. This exposes a fragility of post-trained agents: because a learned behavior is entangled with its training harness, even a harness update that leaves the task unchanged can fail to elicit the behavior. We train a search agent to perform parallel search, a popular strategy for improving both search efficiency and performance. We find that training under a fixed harness makes the behavior harness-local, overfit to that harness's surface form: when the harness changes, the model falls back to serial search. An intuitive fix is harness augmentation, but simply training on more harnesses does not resolve the problem. GRPO learns from the reward gap between parallel and serial rollouts of the same question: a small harness pool saturates that gap early, while a large pool dilutes the per-harness signal too thinly for any harness to consolidate. We therefore propose Curriculum HArness Rotation Training (CHART), a rotating curriculum that lets a search agent gradually consolidate parallel search across harnesses. At each periodic evaluation, CHART "graduates" the harnesses whose expected behavior is learned and replaces them with still-learnable ones, keeping the reward gap alive throughout training. Starting from the same harness pool, CHART makes the model learn parallel search on all harnesses, whereas static augmentation succeeds on at most half of them. The behavior also carries to held-out harnesses: CHART parallelizes on 89% of held-out turns, against at most 5% for the static pools. It further transfers to a new QA task and search environment, improving pass@1 by 5.6pp over the best static pool. Finally, CHART-trained agents benefit more from meta-harness search than baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CHART（课程式测试框架轮换训练），通过轮换课程让搜索智能体跨harness巩固并行搜索行为，解决行为与训练harness绑定的脆弱性问题。
AI.motivation: 后训练智能体的行为与训练harness纠缠，harness更新（如改写系统提示）即使任务不变也会导致行为失效；搜索智能体训练并行搜索时，固定harness使行为harness-local，harness变化后退化为串行搜索。简单的harness增强无效：小harness池过早饱和奖励差距，大池则稀释单harness信号。
AI.method: 提出CHART（Curriculum HArness Rotation Training）：一种轮换课程，在每个周期性评估时"毕业"已学会期望行为的harness，替换为仍可学习的harness，从而在整个训练过程中保持并行与串行rollout之间的奖励差距（GRPO所依赖的）。
AI.result: 从相同harness池出发，CHART使模型在所有harness上学会并行搜索，而静态增强最多只在半数上成功；对held-out harness，CHART在89%的turn上并行化，静态池最多仅5%；迁移到新QA任务和搜索环境，pass@1比最优静态池提升5.6pp；CHART训练的智能体从meta-harness搜索中获益更多。
AI.conclusion: 通过维持奖励差距的轮换课程，可有效使搜索智能体跨harness泛化并行搜索行为，并提升迁移性与对meta-harness搜索的适应性。

title: BizSage: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Business Research with Efficient Knowledge Retrieval
summary: While multi-agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating the progressive workflow of academic research, extending them to economics and business research, where specialized domain knowledge spans neighboring disciplines yet remains difficult to access in a structured way, presents two challenges. First, existing methods mostly retrieve at the paper level, yet the evidence needed for research tasks is often distributed across different sections, creating a granularity mismatch that hinders retrieval coverage and precision. Second, these fields demand strict empirical rigor, yet current systems provide limited mechanisms for learning from evaluation feedback. We present \textbf{BizSage}, a multi-agent framework combining corpus-level fine-grained retrieval with quality-driven self-evolution. We build a Lateral Knowledge Graph (LKG) by merging section-level knowledge graphs and apply Personalized PageRank (PPR) to surface semantically relevant and structurally important sections. Seven specialized agents collaborate under a Meta-Review self-evolution mechanism that distills failure modes from evaluation traces into reusable strategies. On a benchmark spanning four domains and three tasks, BizSage ranks first on the majority of metrics, achieves pairwise win-rates above 60\% against six baselines, and produces zero hallucinated citations. We hope BizSage paves the way for reliable research assistance in economics, business, and the broader social sciences.

AI.tldr: BizSage：面向经济学与商业研究的多智能体框架，结合语料库级细粒度检索与质量驱动的自进化。
AI.motivation: 将LLM多智能体系统扩展到经济学和商业研究时面临两大挑战：一是现有方法多在论文层面检索，而研究所需的证据分散于不同章节，导致粒度不匹配，影响检索覆盖与精度；二是这些领域要求严格的实证严谨性，但现有系统缺乏从评估反馈中学习的机制。
AI.method: 构建性知识图LKG，通过合并章节级知识图谱，并应用个性化PageRank（PPR）以发现语义相关且结构重要的章节；七个专用智能体在Meta-Review自进化机制下协作，从评估轨迹中提炼失败模式并转化为可复用策略。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个领域、三种任务的基准上，BizSage在多数指标上排名第一，对六个基线的成对胜率超过60%，并实现零幻觉引用。
AI.conclusion: BizSage有望为经济学、商业及更广泛的社会科学领域提供可靠的研究辅助。

title: Increasing Skill Level Recruits Deeper Attention Layers in a Frozen Chess Transformer
comment: 19 pages, 12 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/David-31415/maia-depth-migration. Built with chessformer-lens library: https://github.com/chessformer-lens/chessformer_lens
summary: Chess involves complex reasoning in a deterministic environment, which makes it a useful setting for studying the mechanisms of computation inside transformers. The Maia-3 chess transformer takes Elo, a measure of competitive chess skill, as an input to the pre-trained network, so we can vary the skill the network is conditioned on with no change to its weights. Here we investigate how turning this skill dial affects self-attention. Ablating every attention head at every Elo from 700 to 2500, we find 1) increasing skill pushes the causal center of mass of the computation deeper, monotonically, for every chess piece and move type we measured; 2) the depth migration is much greater for specific tactics, especially knight forks, than for other move types; 3) the migration consists of deeper heads getting recruited for more specialized computations while one shared shallow head keeps a roughly constant contribution. These results may shed light on how conditioning inputs redistribute computation in larger transformers.

AI.tldr: 研究Maia-3国际象棋Transformer中技能条件(Elo)如何影响自注意力分布，发现技能提升使计算重心单调向深层迁移。
AI.motivation: 国际象棋是确定性的复杂推理任务，适合研究Transformer内部计算机制；Maia-3以Elo作为输入条件且不改动权重，可探究条件输入如何重新分配计算。
AI.method: 在700至2500各Elo水平下，对每一层每个注意力头进行消融(ablation)，测量计算因果重心及不同棋子与着法类型下的注意力贡献。
AI.result: 1) 技能提升使因果计算重心对所有棋子和着法类型单调地向深层迁移；2) 特定战术(尤其马的双叉)的深度迁移远大于其他着法；3) 迁移由更深层头被招募做更专门计算、同时一个共享浅层头贡献大致恒定构成。
AI.conclusion: 技能条件输入会重新分配Transformer内部计算；这些发现有助于理解更大Transformer中条件输入如何重塑计算。

title: VISTA: An Attention-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Architecture for Space Situational Awareness Sensor Tasking
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures. Code available at https://github.com/RocketNeurons/VISTA-SSA . Submitted to IEEE TAES
summary: The rapid growth of resident space objects is increasing the complexity of space situational awareness sensor tasking, challenging classical optimization methods as they allocate finite, heterogeneous, and distributed sensing resources across ever-larger catalogues. Existing deep reinforcement learning approaches show promise in reduced settings, but fixed-dimensional state and action representations limit their ability to scale to large, dynamic catalogues and distributed sensing networks. We introduce VISTA (Variable-Entity Intelligent Sensor Tasking Architecture), a scalable deep reinforcement learning architecture for persistent uncertainty-driven catalogue maintenance across variable object populations and sensor configurations. VISTA combines physics- and mission-informed top-K retrieval with entity-centric attention, recurrent memory, and pointer-based action decoding, thereby keeping each agent's observation and action spaces independent of catalogue size. We evaluate VISTA across different scenarios, from fixed-size single-sensor benchmarks to large-scale space-based tasking and heterogeneous cooperative sensing. With 30 orbiting targets, VISTA recovers the catalogue 31.2% faster than the fixed-dimensional recurrent baseline. In the large-scale regime, VISTA reduces five-hour uncertainty by 97.5% relative to the strongest classical reference and by 99.3% relative to the recurrent learner. Zero-shot tests up to 20,000 objects reveal near-linear relations between sensing capacity, catalogue size, and recovery horizon. Learned policies also exhibit sensor modality adaptation and generalization to population and initial-uncertainty shifts. Together, these results demonstrate that VISTA provides a scalable framework for adaptive space situational awareness sensor tasking across large, distributed networks of heterogeneous ground- and space-based sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VISTA，一种可扩展的深度强化学习架构，用于变规模目标群与异构传感器网络下的空间态势感知传感器任务分配，实现与目录规模无关的观测与动作空间。
AI.motivation: 居民空间物体快速增长，使空间态势感知的传感器任务规划复杂度剧增；有限、异构、分布式传感资源需在大规模目录上分配，传统优化方法难以应对。现有深度强化学习方法虽有前景，但固定的状态与动作维度限制其扩展到大规模动态目录与分布式传感网络。
AI.method: VISTA结合物理与任务信息引导的top-K检索、以实体为中心的注意力机制、循环记忆以及基于指针的动作解码，使各智能体的观测与动作空间独立于目录规模。评估覆盖固定规模单传感器基准、大规模天基任务分配和异构协同感知等场景。
AI.result: 30个在轨目标时，VISTA比固定维度循环基线快31.2%恢复目录；大规模场景下，五小时不确定度较最强经典方法降低97.5%，较循环学习器降低99.3%。零样本测试至20,000个目标显示传感能力、目录规模与恢复时域近似线性关系，策略展现出传感器模态自适应及对目标数与初始不确定度变化的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VISTA为大规模分布式异构地基与天基传感器网络下的自适应空间态势感知传感器任务分配提供了可扩展框架。

title: Predictors and Orchestrators: Parsimonious Machine Learning within an Agentic AI Harness for Multi-Horizon Karst Aquifer Forecasting
summary: Forecasting karst aquifer dynamics is difficult because recharge responses are nonlinear, event-driven, and governed by strongly heterogeneous flow paths. This study develops and evaluates a deployment-aware framework for 1-12-week-ahead prediction of spring discharge and groundwater level using approximately 79 years of hydroclimatic observations from the Edwards Aquifer, Texas. Five model families were compared under a common temporal evaluation design: extreme gradient boosting, extremely randomized trees, long short-term memory, convolutional neural networks, and Transformers. Predictions were evaluated using coefficient of determination, Kling-Gupta efficiency, root-mean-square error, and agreement with operational drought thresholds. Extreme gradient boosting was consistently most reliable, with R2 at least 0.97, 0.96, and 0.94 across 1-4-, 5-8-, and 9-12-week horizons, respectively, and greater than 90% critical-stage agreement at the first three drought stages across all horizons. Deep models were competitive at short horizons but degraded progressively and exhibited isolated failures at longer lead times. We attribute this contrast to an alignment between tree partitioning and low-dimensional, axis-aligned hydroclimatic predictors, together with the tendency of neural models to smooth irregular extremes. The validated models were embedded in a five-agent operational architecture that automates data acquisition, model assignment, deterministic prediction, threshold monitoring, prospective verification, literature retrieval, and reporting. The contribution is therefore a transferable framework joining parsimonious model selection, leakage-aware multi-horizon evaluation, decision-relevant threshold skill, and auditable agentic automation.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Edwards含水层约79年水文气候数据，构建并评估了1-12周岩溶泉流量与地下水位预测框架，比较五类模型后发现XGBoost在各预测期最稳定可靠，并将其嵌入五智能体业务化系统。
AI.motivation: 岩溶含水层动态预测困难，因为补给响应具有非线性、事件驱动特征，且受强非均质流动路径控制。研究旨在建立一个可迁移、可部署的预测框架。
AI.method: 使用Edwards含水层约79年水文气候观测数据，采用统一时间评估设计比较极端梯度提升、极端随机树、LSTM、CNN和Transformer五类模型，用R²、KGE、RMSE及业务干旱阈值一致性进行评估，并嵌入五智能体运行架构。
AI.result: XGBoost始终最可靠，在1-4、5-8、9-12周预测期的R²分别至少为0.97、0.96、0.94，前三类干旱阶段临界水位一致率超过90%；深度模型短期有竞争力但随预测期延长逐步退化，并在长预测期出现个别失败。
AI.conclusion: 树模型分割方式与低维轴对齐水文气候预测变量相匹配，而神经模型倾向平滑不规则极端值。整体贡献是一个结合简约模型选择、防泄漏多期评估、决策相关阈值技能与可审计智能体自动化的可迁移框架。

title: Knowledge Graph-Augmented Ambient AI for Clinical Note Generation
summary: Ambient AI is increasingly adopted in healthcare to automatically generate clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations, with the potential to substantially reduce clinician documentation burden. However, generated notes may omit clinically relevant information discussed during the encounter, creating information gaps that can affect downstream care. Knowledge graphs (KGs) constructed from encounter transcripts can provide a structured representation of what was discussed and enable systematic identification of missing information from generated notes that are critical for patient care. In this study, we introduce Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR), a model-agnostic framework that constructs a KG from the encounter transcript, identifies medical concepts absent from an initially generated note, and directs large language models (LLMs) to restore the missing information without modifying the underlying note-generation system. We evaluate CDR on two datasets: 1) Pitt-Bench, a local dataset comprising rehabilitation sessions, and 2) ACI-Bench, a public dataset for benchmarking clinical note generation. We tested four underlying LLMs widely used in ambient AI systems. The results show that CDR consistently improves content recall across all evaluated conditions. Our study provides a practical approach for improving the completeness of ambient AI-generated clinical documentation.

AI.tldr: 提出CDR框架，用知识图谱识别并补全临床笔记中遗漏信息，提升内容召回率。
AI.motivation: 环境AI生成的临床笔记可能遗漏就诊中讨论的临床相关信息，形成信息缺口，影响后续护理。
AI.method: CDR为模型无关框架：从就诊转录构建知识图谱，识别初始笔记中缺失的医学概念，并指导LLM补回缺失信息，不修改原有笔记生成系统。在Pitt-Bench和ACI-Bench两数据集、四种LLM上评估。
AI.result: 在所有评估条件下，CDR均一致提升了内容召回率。
AI.conclusion: CDR为提升环境AI生成临床文档完整性提供了实用方法。

title: Echo State Network (ESN) for Signal Recovery in RF-Impaired IBFD MIMO Systems
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. This work has been accepted by IEEE Milcom 2026
summary: In-band full-duplex (IBFD) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems enable simultaneous transmission and reception on the same frequency band, improving spectral efficiency for next-generation wireless networks. However, IBFD-MIMO systems are susceptible to self-interference (SI), which may overpower signals of interest (SOI). In this scenario, blind source separation (BSS) algorithms can be adopted to remove SI and perform joint sensing and communication (JSAC), but BSS algorithms mostly assume an idealized linear and quasi-stationary signal model, which does not hold under realistic radio frequency (RF) impairments, such as I/Q imbalance, carrier frequency offset (CFO), phase noise, and power amplifier nonlinearity. This paper proposes a two-stage echo state network (ESN)-based scheme that is superior to BSS under these realistic conditions. A frozen ESN is trained offline to characterize the static SI path, while an adaptive ESN, updated online via recursive least squares, tracks the time-varying SOI path using sparse pilot symbols. We evaluate the proposed scheme's SOI recovery performance and acquisition speed with different block sizes, comparing it against other recurrent neural networks (RNN), such as long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU). Simulation results show that the proposed approach outperforms BSS, LSTM, and GRU in both efficiency and SOI recovery, demonstrating the viability of ESNs for real-time, nonlinear self-interference cancellation in realistic IBFD MIMO systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段回声状态网络(ESN)方案，用于真实射频损伤下的带内全双工MIMO系统自干扰消除与联合感知通信，性能优于BSS及LSTM/GRU。
AI.motivation: IBFD-MIMO可提升频谱效率，但自干扰会淹没目标信号。BSS算法虽可分离SI，却假设理想线性准平稳模型，无法应对I/Q失衡、CFO、相位噪声和功放非线性等真实RF损伤。
AI.method: 提出两阶段ESN方案：冻结ESN离线训练以刻画静态SI路径；自适应ESN通过递归最小二乘在线更新，利用稀疏导频跟踪时变SOI路径。
AI.result: 在不同块大小下评估SOI恢复性能与捕获速度，并与LSTM、GRU对比。仿真表明所提方案在效率与SOI恢复上均优于BSS、LSTM和GRU。
AI.conclusion: 验证了ESN用于真实IBFD-MIMO系统实时非线性自干扰消除的可行性。

title: CALM: A Calibrated LLM Choice Network Framework for Activity-Based Traveler Simulation
summary: We present CALM, a reproducible hybrid framework that integrates an optional large language model (LLM) activity planner with calibrated stochastic choice, shared network feedback, memory and habit, typed feasibility checks, and deterministic offline replay. Unlike trip-mode classifiers or diary-only generators, CALM executes a closed traveler-day loop and evaluates each generative module against an empirical, reproducible baseline. On the 2024 New York City Citywide Mobility Survey (CMS), 110,691 seven-mode trips are split by respondent into 78,487 training and 32,204 holdout trips. Training-only alternative-specific constant calibration reduces mean holdout mode Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.15599 to 0.00394 across ten seeds. A matched live-LLM ablation then quantifies trade-offs among aggregate fit, temporal fit, behavioral persistence, and feasibility, while frozen prompt-response pairs support deterministic replay of downstream simulation. Controlled weather, delay, fare, and parking ladders further demonstrate consistent and interpretable responses under intervention. CALM contributes a reproducible protocol for integrating and evaluating generative planners in traveler simulation through person-disjoint calibration, matched module ablation, controlled stress testing, and end-to-end traceability.

AI.tldr: CALM 是一个可复现的混合出行者模拟框架，将可选 LLM 活动规划器与校准随机选择、共享网络反馈、记忆与习惯、类型化可行性检查及确定性离线回放结合，并在纽约市 CMS 数据上通过校准与消融实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有出行模式分类器或仅生成日志的方法缺乏闭环出行日模拟，且难以对生成模块进行可复现评估。作者希望提供一个能整合生成式规划器并逐一评估各模块的经验基准协议。
AI.method: CALM 采用人-不相交的数据划分（78,487 训练 / 32,204 留出）与仅训练集校准的替代特定常数；结合可选实时 LLM 规划器与校准随机选择、共享网络反馈、记忆与习惯、类型化可行性检查；通过冻结提示-响应对实现确定性离线回放，并进行匹配的实时 LLM 消融及天气、延误、票价、停车等控制梯度测试。
AI.result: 训练集校准将留出集模式 Jensen-Shannon 散度均值从 0.15599 降至 0.00394（十个随机种子）；匹配 LLM 消融量化了聚合拟合、时间拟合、行为持续性与可行性之间的权衡；控制梯度实验显示出一致且可解释的干预响应。
AI.conclusion: CALM 提供了一个通过人-不相交校准、匹配模块消融、控制压力测试和端到端可追溯性来整合与评估生成式规划器的可复现协议，推动了出行者模拟中生成模块的可信集成与评估。

title: H2LooP Telecom Model v1: From Telecom Comprehension to Autonomous Issue and PR Resolution
summary: We present H2LooP Telecom Model v1, a domain-specialized large language models fine-tuned for the telecommunications industry. We release two domain-adapted model variants serving complementary use cases: a comprehension-focused variant for telecom domain question answering and reasoning, and an agentic variant for autonomous telecom code generation, pull request resolution, and code commits on production repositories. H2LooP Telecom achieves strong results on the GSMA Open Telecom Lite (OT-Lite) benchmark and a proprietary telecom code generation benchmark, outperforming frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5 and Claude Opus on independent leaderboard evaluation, while preserving general-purpose capabilities. The Comprehension variant achieves 81.8% weighted average on OT-Lite Pass@3, and, independently, ranks 5th overall on the official community-run Open Telco AI Leaderboard* at only 31B parameters-ahead of frontier closed-source systems including Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok-4-fast, and Kimi K2.5. Our agentic variant obtains a relative improvement of +8.8% in AST Similarity and +20.0% in Location IoU over the base model on telecom code generation, while maintaining identical MMLU (74.0%) and BFCL v3 multi-turn function calling (79.0%) performance, indicating zero catastrophic forgetting. Domain specialization on curated telecom corpora, spanning 3GPP standards, O-RAN specifications, network telemetry, and real repository commits, yields substantial improvements over general-purpose models of equivalent scale, approaches frontier closed-source models on domain-specific evaluation, and is independently corroborated by our official leaderboard standing.

AI.tldr: H2LooP Telecom Model v1 是面向电信行业的领域专用大模型，包含理解型与智能体型两个变体，在电信基准上超越多种前沿闭源模型，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 电信行业需要领域专用大模型，以在问答推理和代码生成等场景中超越通用模型，同时避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 在涵盖 3GPP 标准、O-RAN 规范、网络遥测和真实仓库提交的电信语料上进行领域适配微调，发布理解型（问答推理）和智能体型（代码生成、PR 解决、代码提交）两个变体。
AI.result: 理解型在 OT-Lite Pass@3 达 81.8% 加权平均，31B 参数在 Open Telco AI Leaderboard 排名第 5，超过 Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5 等；智能体型在电信代码生成上 AST Similarity 相对提升 +8.8%、Location IoU +20.0%，MMLU 74.0% 与 BFCL v3 79.0% 保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 电信领域专业化相比同规模通用模型带来显著提升，接近前沿闭源模型，并获得官方排行榜佐证，且无灾难性遗忘。

title: Agents That Edit Documents: Measuring Agentic PDF Forgery Against a Non-Agentic Control
summary: AI agents that carry a multi-step computer task through on their own became ordinary tools in the past year, and the same autonomy is available to anyone whose task is harmful. We ask what that means for a relying party -- an insurer, a lender, an auditor -- whose evidence is a filed PDF. AgentForge-Bench measures how reliably an off-the-shelf coding agent, driving one of seven open-weight models with a shell and the stock Python PDF stack, alters one dollar amount, date or address in a real filed financial document from a single sentence of intent, graded by rules rather than by a model. Across 1,750 cells, 1,419 (81.1%) satisfy the verifier, and 808 (46.2%) also survive every stricter filter: visible, localized, typeface-matched, original value gone document-wide. A deterministic script with no model in it solves 98 of the 125 documents; the agents solve 124, and none the script solves alone. Agents misreport 41% of their wrong edits as done, no model refused, and the cheapest verified forgery costs 2.4 cents. The raw rate overstates the threat by about a factor of two; the strict rate is still large.

AI.tldr: AgentForge-Bench 测试现成编码智能体在真实金融文档中篡改金额、日期或地址的能力。1,750个测试中81.1%通过验证器，46.2%通过更严格过滤。低成本、高成功率且无模型拒绝，揭示了自主AI智能体对依赖方证据可信度的严重威胁。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体已能自主完成多步计算机任务，这一自主性同样可被用于恶意篡改文档。论文关注依赖方（如保险公司、贷款方、审计机构）以提交的PDF作为证据的场景，探讨此类自主智能体对证据可信度构成的威胁。
AI.method: 提出 AgentForge-Bench 基准：让现成编码智能体驱动七种开放权重模型之一，配备 shell 和标准 Python PDF 工具库，依据单句意图篡改真实归档金融文档中的某一金额、日期或地址。采用基于规则的验证器而非模型进行评判。
AI.result: 1,750个测试单元中，1,419个（81.1%）通过验证器，808个（46.2%）还通过所有更严格过滤（可见、局部化、字体匹配、原值在文档中消失）。无模型参与的决定性脚本能解决125份文档中的98份，智能体解决124份，且脚本单独无法解决的智能体均可解决。智能体将41%的错误编辑误报为已完成，无模型拒绝执行，最便宜的已验证伪造仅花费2.4美分。
AI.conclusion: 原始成功率约将威胁高估了一倍，但严格成功率依然很高。自主AI智能体能低成本、高可靠地伪造金融文档证据，且无任何模型拒绝执行，对依赖PDF证据的机构构成实质性风险。

title: CAMFT: Conflict-Aware Mergeable Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
summary: Model merging has emerged as a promising paradigm for integrating multiple task-specific capabilities into a single large language model. However, existing methods predominantly focus on post-hoc processing of independently fine-tuned models, overlooking how the training phase itself impacts cross-task compatibility. Resolving parameter conflicts after fine-tuning is inherently sub-optimal. To address this, we propose CAMFT, a Conflict-Aware Mergeable Fine-Tuning method that makes task adaptation both efficient and mergeaware. CAMFT treats mergeability as a property shaped during fine-tuning, rather than only a problem to be solved after fine-tuning. By guiding each task to update sparse coordinates with lower cross-task conflict, CAMFT produces task updates that are efficient to train and more compatible for downstream model merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAMFT outperforms standard finetuning baselines in multi-task merging scenarios. Codes are available at https://github.com/gyanchow/CAMFT-LLM.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMFT方法，在微调阶段就将"可合并性"作为训练目标，通过引导各任务更新低冲突的稀疏坐标，使任务适配既高效又易于模型合并。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法主要关注对独立微调模型的后处理，忽略了训练阶段对跨任务兼容性的影响；微调后再解决参数冲突本质上是次优的。
AI.method: CAMFT将可合并性视为微调过程中塑造的属性，引导每个任务更新跨任务冲突较低的稀疏坐标，从而产生训练高效且对下游模型合并更兼容的任务更新。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在多任务合并场景下CAMFT优于标准微调基线。代码见https://github.com/gyanchow/CAMFT-LLM。
AI.conclusion: 将可合并性纳入微调训练阶段（而非仅在合并后处理）能有效提升多任务模型合并效果。

title: Replay-Gated Neural Execution: Decoupling Persistent Behavioral Specifications from Neural Realizations in Frozen Language Models
summary: Input-conditioned neural interventions raise a runtime question: what persists when one behavioral specification admits multiple actions whose validity depends on execution state? We introduce replay-gated neural execution, separating five objects: a persistent behavioral predicate, its state-indexed certified realization set, a transient action witness, a budget-limited finder, and execution authorization. Candidates undergo isolated FP32/BF16 replay of the frozen model; commitment additionally requires a valid run audit. Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M-Instruct establish distinct failure modes for these objects. Independent initializations yield distinct certified actions in all 24 tested fixed-state cells. Unchanged SmolLM2 witnesses remain certified in all 128 native states but only 66 of 384 off-diagonal transfers. All 767 archived Qwen witnesses replay successfully, yet a budget-limited finder misses one known-realizable cell in all three prespecified runs. Of 1,141 replay-submitted candidates, 174 fail item certification. A frozen three-tier cascade uses these boundaries to reject uncertified proposals and escalate audit-valid search misses. On 256 previously sealed Qwen Fresh requests, 221 first certify at the lowest-cost tier and all 256 receive audited authorization, with no observed bypass. Relative to frozen full search, the median singleton search-and-certification cost ratio is 0.1055 and P95 is 1.3485, including failed tiers. Within the studied behavioral family on two small models, these results support state-indexed, set-valued execution semantics: specifications persist, search proposes witnesses, and replay certification plus run audit grants execution authority.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"replay-gated neural execution"框架，区分持久行为谓词、状态索引认证实现集、瞬态动作见证、预算受限查找器与执行授权五类对象，通过FP32/BF16重放与运行审计来授权执行，验证了状态索引、集合值化的执行语义。
AI.motivation: 当行为规范允许在依赖执行状态的多个动作时，需明确"什么在被执行/持久存在"这一运行时问题。作者希望区分规范的持久性与动作见证的瞬态性，并为神经执行建立可审计的授权机制。
AI.method: 将执行分解为五个对象：持久行为谓词、状态索引的认证实现集、瞬态动作见证、预算受限查找器及执行授权。候选动作需经冻结模型的隔离FP32/BF16重放，承诺还需有效的运行审计。在Qwen3-0.6B与SmolLM2-360M-Instruct上测试，并构建三层级联在Qwen Fresh请求上验证。
AI.result: 独立初始化在全部24个固定状态单元产生不同认证动作；SmolLM2见证在128个原生状态全部认证，但384个非对角迁移中仅66个通过；767个Qwen见证全部重放成功，但查找器在三轮预设运行中均漏掉一个可实现单元；1141个候选中174个未通过项认证。Fresh请求256个中221个在最低成本层认证，256个全部获审计授权；搜索认证成本比中位数0.1055，P95为1.3485。
AI.conclusion: 在两个小模型的行为族内，结果支持状态索引、集合值化的执行语义：规范持久存在，搜索提出见证，重放认证加运行审计授予执行权。

title: Divergent strategies and convergent outcomes in autonomous materials discovery
summary: Scientific agents are mostly evaluated on whether they complete tasks or recover known results; we instead study variation across repeated open-ended campaigns. Sixteen separately initialized sessions of one model-harness configuration received a frozen database of 12,499 metal-organic frameworks, a methane-storage objective, a pinned protocol and a one-week budget. Strategies diverged into four approaches spanning 100--5,000 screened structures, and eight built 2,253 hypothetical structures. Yet the agents recovered the same materials frontier near 200 cm^3/cm^3, and an independent calculation of the database's porous region found its nine best structures all among their reports. Enforced checks on half the agents raised fresh-run reproduction from one of eight to eight of eight but could not detectably improve conclusion validity, because fifteen of sixteen agents selected the same audit-excluded entry, an incomplete structure whose missing anions created artificial pore volume. Replicated agents thus reveal both robust conclusions and common-mode errors from shared inputs.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过16个独立初始化的科学智能体重复执行同一开放式的金属有机框架储甲烷任务，考察其策略与结论的可重复性。智能体策略分化明显（100–5000个筛选结构），但都收敛到约200 cm³/cm³的同一材料前沿，且独立计算确认数据库九个最优结构均在其报告中；然而16个中有15个选中同一审计排除的不完整结构（缺失阴离子导致虚假孔体积），强制检查虽提升复现率却无法改善结论有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体评测多关注"是否完成任务"或"能否复现已知结果"，缺乏对开放式探索中重复运行间变异性的考察。作者希望了解：同一模型—框架配置在多次独立运行中，会产生多大策略分歧，以及这些分歧是否影响最终科学结论的稳健性。
AI.method: 设置16个独立初始化的会话，采用同一模型-框架配置，给定冻结的12,499个MOF数据库、甲烷储存目标、固定协议和一周预算。比较各会话的筛选策略与规模，独立计算数据库多孔区域作为参照，并对半数智能体施加强制检查以测试其对复现性和结论有效性的影响。
AI.result: 策略分化为四类方法，筛选规模从100到5000个结构不等，其中8个会话构建了2,253个假设结构。尽管如此，所有智能体都恢复了约200 cm³/cm³的相同材料前沿；独立计算发现数据库多孔区域最好的九个结构均出现在其报告中。强制检查使新运行复现率从1/8提升到8/8，却未能可检测地改善结论有效性——因为16个智能体中有15个都选中了同一被审计排除的条目，一个缺失阴离子、造成虚假孔体积的不完整结构。
AI.conclusion: 重复的科学智能体既展现出结论的稳健性（殊途同归地找到相同材料前沿），也暴露出源于共享输入数据的共模错误（集体选中同一有缺陷结构）。这表明复制实验能同时揭示可靠的结论与系统性的共享偏差，评测应重视共模失效而非仅关注任务完成度。

title: Teacher Should Think Ahead: Adaptive Continuations for Reliable On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for transferring knowledge between language models, where a student receives dense token-level supervision along its own generated trajectories. However, teacher supervision can be unreliable when conditioned on incomplete or low-quality student prefixes. We identify Teacher Uncertainty Contraction (TUC), a systematic phenomenon whereby the teacher's predictive uncertainty decreases as it continues from a student-generated prefix. We theoretically characterize this trade-off through a variance-bias decomposition of teacher-branch gradients, showing that uncertainty contraction reduces variance while teacher-student path divergence increases bias, thereby favoring a finite continuation. Guided by this insight, we propose Adaptive-Continuations On-Policy Distillation (AC-OPD), which augments informative states along student rollouts with teacher continuations and adaptively selects their effective supervision horizons. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation across model scales demonstrate that AC-OPD consistently improves over standard OPD. Controlled-continuations and matched-budget analyses further validate the adaptive-continuations design, highlighting adaptive teacher continuations as an effective principle for reliable on-policy distillation.The code will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了在线蒸馏中的"教师不确定性收缩"(TUC)现象，并提出AC-OPD方法自适应地选取教师延续的监督视野，提升蒸馏可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在线蒸馏(OPD)中，学生在自生成轨迹上接受教师密集的token级监督，但当学生前缀不完整或质量低时，教师监督不可靠。作者发现并从理论上刻画了这一问题。
AI.method: 识别"教师不确定性收缩"(TUC)现象—教师从学生前缀继续预测时不确定性下降。通过教师分支梯度的方差-偏差分解，理论证明不确定性收缩降低方差、而师生路径分歧增加偏差，从而倾向有限延续。据此提出AC-OPD：在最有信息量的状态上附加教师延续，并自适应选择有效的监督视野长度。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务、多个模型规模上，AC-OPD一致优于标准OPD。受控延续实验与匹配预算分析进一步验证了自适应延续设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应教师延续是可靠在线蒸馏的有效原则，AC-OPD验证了其在实践中持续提升性能的潜力。

title: Do Chess Explanations Reflect Model Decisions? Behavioral and Token-Level Tests of LLM Reasoning Faithfulness
summary: Large language models can produce fluent explanations for chess moves, but plausible language does not necessarily reflect the reasoning behind a decision. We study this question in chess, where the board state is fully observable, legal actions can be enumerated, and move quality can be evaluated independently. Across 200 Lichess endgame puzzles, we test explanations using move recoverability, decoder-side controls, and token-level scoring of legal candidate moves. Unmasked explanations make generated moves easy to recover, but this advantage drops sharply after explicit move hints are removed. Under strict masking, explanations provide only small and decoder-dependent gains over the board state alone. Token-level scoring shows that explanations can nevertheless alter move preferences: random but plausible explanations from other puzzles reduce the probability of the correct move, indicating that irrelevant reasoning text is not simply ignored. We also find that recognizable endgame motifs can make generated moves easier to recover without reliably improving move correctness. Together, these results show that linguistic plausibility, consistency with a generated action, and solution correctness are distinct properties. Fluent chess explanations can influence action preferences and support a coherent move narrative while providing only limited evidence of faithful reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究国际象棋中大语言模型生成的解释是否反映其真实推理。通过200个Lichess残局谜题，使用着法可恢复性、解码器控制及合法候选着法的token级评分来检验。结果表明语言流畅性、与生成动作的一致性、以及解的正确答案是三个不同的属性，流畅的解释只能提供有限的忠实推理证据。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能为棋步生成流畅的解释，但流畅的语言并不一定反映决策背后的真实推理，因此需要在一个状态完全可观测、合法动作可枚举、着法质量可独立评估的领域（国际象棋）中检验解释的忠实性。
AI.method: 在200个Lichess残局谜题上，采用三种手段测试解释：着法可恢复性（move recoverability）、解码器侧控制（decoder-side controls）、以及对合法候选着法的token级评分（token-level scoring）。其中使用严格掩码移除显式着法提示来检验真正的推理贡献。
AI.result: 未掩码的解释让生成着法容易被恢复，但在移除显式着法提示后这一优势急剧下降。严格掩码下，解释相较仅凭棋盘状态仅有微小且依赖解码器的增益。token级评分显示解释能改变着法偏好：来自其他谜题的随机但合理的解释会降低正确着法的概率，说明无关推理文本并非被忽略。此外，可识别的残局模式能让生成着法更易恢复，却不稳定地提升着法正确性。
AI.conclusion: 语言流畅性、与生成动作的一致性、以及解的正确答案是彼此独立的属性。流畅的国际象棋解释能够影响着法偏好并支撑连贯的着法叙述，但只能为忠实推理提供有限的证据。

title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
summary: Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UniK（Universal Knowledge Perception），一个面向数字AI与物理AI的统一知识平台，覆盖多模态知识全生命周期，基于 Polymath Retrieval 多索引融合，无需任务微调，在多个领域匹配或超越超大前沿专有LLM。
AI.motivation: 数字AI（企业知识推理、聊天机器人、智能体工作流）与物理AI（从视频、游戏、传感器学习控制机器人）都面临共同瓶颈：大规模原始知识横跨异构模态，且锁在现有AI基础设施无法可靠高效访问的私有语料中。
AI.method: 提出 UniK 通用知识感知平台，覆盖摄取、增强、索引、检索与持续评估的完整知识生命周期，支持从富文本、视频到分子数据和传感器遥测的多模态；核心为 Polymath Retrieval，即在自动增强的索引上进行多索引融合，且无需任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在五个数字AI领域（医学文献、开放域QA、化学、法律视频庭审、政府开放数据）中，UniK 结合开源70B模型持续匹配或超越规模大数个数量级的前沿专有LLM：政府数据RAG准确率76%（GPT-5为47%）；医学QA无微调达77.9%；登顶所有开源化学流水线。同一基础设施也适用于物理AI世界模型训练的数据整理、索引与检索。
AI.conclusion: UniK 可作为数字AI与物理AI的共同知识平台，用统一基础设施解决结构相同（但物理AI更难）的知识问题，证明无需依赖超大专有模型即可实现高性能多模态知识访问。

title: Strategy Accumulation and Guided Execution for Automated LLM Fine-Tuning
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Producing task-specific large language models requires discovering effective training strategies through experimentation. Automated fine-tuning systems have made this experimentation feasible with far less manual effort. However, these systems are stateless: each search discards its discovered strategies, dataset insights, and hyperparameter findings once it ends. Every new task must then repeat this costly search from a cold start. To address this, we propose Strategy Accumulation and Guided Execution (SAGE), a two-stage framework that makes automated fine-tuning search cumulative. In the first stage, a multi-agent pipeline performs Monte Carlo Tree Search-based exploration. A parallel Distillation Agent extracts task-specific exploration records and confidence-scored cross-task insights, which together constitute a structured experience repository. In the second stage, SAGE retrieves relevant experience from this repository and selects what applies to guide training on the new task. We evaluate SAGE on nine unseen tasks spanning both single- and cross-category settings. In single-round execution, SAGE's accumulated experience raises the average relative improvement over baseline from 3.2% to 15.6%, a 12.4-percentage-point gain over the same pipeline without it. These results show that persistent strategy experience provides effective guidance for automated fine-tuning on unseen tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE两阶段框架，让自动微调搜索具备累积性，通过多智能体MCTS探索与蒸馏构建经验库，并检索指导新任务训练。
AI.motivation: 现有自动微调系统是无状态的，每次搜索结束后丢弃已发现的策略、数据洞见和超参结论，导致新任务都需从冷启动重复昂贵的搜索。
AI.method: SAGE采用两阶段框架。第一阶段用多智能体流水线进行蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）探索，并设并行蒸馏智能体提取任务特定探索记录和带置信度的跨任务洞见，构成结构化经验库；第二阶段从经验库检索相关内容，并筛选适用于新任务的指导训练。
AI.result: 在九个未见任务（含单类别与跨类别设置）上评估，单轮执行中SAGE的累积经验将平均相对提升从3.2%提高到15.6%，相比无经验库的同流水线提升12.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 持续化的策略经验能为未见任务上的自动微调提供有效指导。

title: The Corroboration Illusion: When More News Makes LLM Forecasts Less True
comment: Key words: LLM forecasting, retrieval-augmented generation, data poisoning, misinformation, calibration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events by retrieving and reasoning over news. We show that this dependence on an open, crawlable news corpus creates a new attack surface: an adversary who can merely publish articles--without access to the retriever, the model, or the user's queries--can systematically move the forecaster's output probabilities. We formalize news-corpus poisoning of probabilistic forecasters, a threat model distinct from prior RAG poisoning, which targets factual answers or opinion polarity rather than calibrated probabilities. We evaluate the attack on 500 resolved ForecastBench questions against a 17.4M-article Common Crawl News corpus with a strict crawl-date cutoff, using three retrieval-augmented forecasters built on open 7-8B models. A single LLM-written article per question flips 56% of forecasts across the 0.5 boundary; five articles flip 69-73% and shift probabilities by +0.13 to +0.22 net of a neutral-article placebo, degrading the Brier score from 0.18 to 0.37. The effect is monotone in the number, retrieval rank, query similarity, and context share of injected articles, transfers across model families, and is unaffected by the claimed publisher. We then evaluate three natural defenses--source allow-lists, isolate-then-aggregate forecasting, and perplexity filtering--and show that each has a cheap bypass: spoofed publishers, majority poisoning, and higher-temperature generation, respectively. Our results indicate that probabilistic LLM judgments inherit the full fragility of the information supply chain they consume.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了一个针对LLM概率预测器的新型攻击面——新闻语料投毒。攻击者仅需发布文章，无需接触检索器、模型或用户查询，即可系统性地操纵预测概率。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地通过检索和推理新闻来预测现实事件，这种对开放、可爬取新闻语料的依赖创造了新的攻击面。此前RAG投毒针对的是事实答案或观点极性，而非校准的概率，因此概率预测器的脆弱性未被研究。
AI.method: 形式化"概率预测器的新闻语料投毒"威胁模型，在500个已解决的ForecastBench问题、1740万篇Common Crawl新闻语料（严格爬取日期截止）上，用三个基于开源7-8B模型的检索增强预测器评估攻击。每个问题注入单篇LLM撰写的文章，并测试效应的单调性及跨模型迁移性；随后评估三种防御（来源白名单、先隔离再聚合、困惑度过滤）及其廉价绕过方式。
AI.result: 单篇文章翻转56%跨越0.5边界的预测；五篇文章翻转69-73%，净概率移动+0.13至+0.22，Brier分数从0.18劣化至0.37。效应在文章数量、检索排名、查询相似度和上下文占比上呈单调性，可跨模型家族迁移，且不受声称发布者影响。三种防御均存在廉价绕过：伪造发布者、多数投毒、更高温度生成。
AI.conclusion: 概率性LLM判断继承了其所消费信息供应链的完整脆弱性，新闻语料投毒构成现实且有效的威胁，且现有自然防御均有低成本绕过方式。

title: LEAP-NBV: Lightweight Edge Active-Perception for Foundation-Model Next-Best-View Planning
summary: Foundation models are endowing autonomous systems with greater intelligence, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the environment through visual perception. A representative example is Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), which provides useful estimates of a target's 3D pose and shape that can benefit tactical missions. However, the size and power demands of such models make them difficult to run on edge platforms and limit their real-time performance, undermining the requirements of tactical edge deployment - especially for active perception, where a mobile robot must plan its next-best view on-board and cannot offload computation under contested communications. We present LEAP-NBV, a lightweight active-perception framework that runs foundation-model-driven Next-Best-View (NBV) planning on-board an edge device. To this end, we distill a family of large HMR teachers, each into a compact 32M student, with an offline mesh objective, then quantize the vision encoder to FP16 and characterize its on-device accuracy and latency. Within an occlusion-aware active perception loop, we evaluate all configurations on the same held-out benchmark and deploy the end-to-end pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX, reporting measured on-device latency and energy. Distillation recovers 6-7 mm of Procrustes-aligned mean per-vertex position error (PA-MPVPE) over the undistilled student on the test set. Selecting the edge-optimal compression model brings the HMR engine to ~12 ms at a small accuracy cost and runs the full closed loop at 3.6 FPS and 2.6 J per frame, achieving a 2.0x speedup and 3.0x lower energy than the uncompressed model while nearly matching downstream task quality.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAP-NBV，将大型HMR教师模型蒸馏为32M轻量学生模型并对视觉编码器量化至FP16，在Jetson Xavier NX上实现机载主动感知NBV规划，达3.6 FPS、2.6 J/帧，相比未压缩模型提速2.0x、能耗降低3.0x且下游任务质量接近。
AI.motivation: 基础模型赋能的HMR可为战术任务提供3D姿态与形状估计，但其体积与功耗难以在边缘平台实时运行；战术边缘的主动感知要求机器人在通信受限情况下机载规划下一最佳视角，无法卸载计算，因此亟需轻量化方案。
AI.method: 1) 将多个大型HMR教师模型通过离线mesh目标蒸馏为紧凑的32M学生模型；2) 对视觉编码器进行FP16量化并评估其机载精度与延迟；3) 在遮挡感知主动感知循环中于同一留出基准上评测各配置；4) 在NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX上部署端到端流水线，测量机载延迟与能耗。
AI.result: 蒸馏相比未蒸馏学生在测试集上恢复6-7mm的PA-MPVPE误差；选取边缘最优压缩模型使HMR引擎达约12ms，精度损失较小，完整闭环达3.6 FPS、2.6 J/帧，比未压缩模型提速2.0x、能耗降低3.0x，下游任务质量几乎持平。
AI.conclusion: LEAP-NBV证明通过蒸馏与量化可在边缘设备上高效运行基础模型驱动的主动感知NBV规划，在显著降低能耗与延迟的同时保持接近下游任务质量，满足战术边缘部署需求。

title: RS-Claw-Evolution: Environment-Feedback-Driven Evolution for Lightweight Remote Sensing Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Large language model-driven remote sensing (RS) agents offer a promising approach to automating geospatial analysis. However, lightweight RS agents based on compact language models struggle with multi-step interactive tasks due to loss of long-horizon states, inefficient environmental feedback utilization, and sparse optimization signals. We propose RS-Claw-Evolution, an environment-feedback-driven framework that progressively improves lightweight agents through three stages. Interaction evolution uses executable code to control observations, maintain intermediate states, and reduce context redundancy. Experience evolution combines failure-aware trajectory generation with error-turn masking to learn from informative failure-recovery experiences without imitating faulty actions. Decision evolution uses reinforcement learning with multi-dimensional environment rewards and turn-level advantage protection to optimize tool-use behaviors and improve credit assignment in long sequences. On Earth-Bench, the optimized Qwen3-4B-based agent achieves 65.9% accuracy in Autonomous Planning mode, outperforming the untrained Qwen3-32B baseline (43.8%) and DeepSeek-V3.1 (60.8%), while approaching GPT-5 (71.6%). These results demonstrate that learning from environmental feedback can improve lightweight agents and narrow their performance gap with larger models in long-horizon RS tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出RS-Claw-Evolution框架，通过交互、经验、决策三阶段进化，让轻量遥感智能体从环境反馈中学习，显著缩小与大模型的差距。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的遥感智能体有望自动化地理空间分析，但基于小模型的轻量智能体在多步交互任务中面临长程状态丢失、环境反馈利用低效、优化信号稀疏等问题。
AI.method: 三阶段进化：(1)交互进化——用可执行代码控制观测、维护中间状态、减少上下文冗余；(2)经验进化——结合失败感知轨迹生成与错误轮次掩码，从失败-恢复经验中学习而不模仿错误动作；(3)决策进化——用多维环境奖励的强化学习与轮次级优势保护优化工具使用与信用分配。
AI.result: 在Earth-Bench上，优化的Qwen3-4B智能体在自主规划模式下达65.9%准确率，超过未训练Qwen3-32B（43.8%）和DeepSeek-V3.1（60.8%），接近GPT-5（71.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 从环境反馈中学习能有效提升轻量智能体，在长程遥感任务中缩小其与大模型的性能差距。

title: Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Trust Calibration in CoSLR, a Human-AI System for Systematic Literature Reviews
summary: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) are essential for evidence-based research but remain time-consuming, requiring researchers to manage large volumes of publications across planning, screening, analysis, and reporting. Large language models (LLMs) can now produce fluent, well-structured review text, which makes it difficult to distinguish synthesis that was verified by a researcher from synthesis that merely appears authoritative. This raises the risk that unverified AI-generated synthesis enters the scholarly record carrying the credibility of a systematic review. We present CoSLR, a Human-AI collaborative multi-agent system that supports the SLR workflow through a modular three-phase pipeline using large language models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and that places explicit, mandatory human checkpoints on the path between generated output and its acceptance. In a survey-based study with 63 participants, the system was received positively: 27 of 63 participants (42.9 percent) rated its usability highly, indicating that the mandatory checkpoints did not come at the cost of a workable interface. However, a checkpoint safeguards the review only if researchers use it to verify: 22 of 63 participants (34.9 percent) reported that they would trust AI-generated summaries and reports without additional human checking after only a short interaction with the system. These findings indicate that Human-AI collaboration can support literature review work, but that the effectiveness of human oversight depends on whether users are willing to exercise it. This is a calibration problem that interface design must address directly, not assume.

AI.tldr: 提出人机协作多智能体系统CoSLR支持系统性文献综述，虽获良好可用性评价，但研究显示部分用户倾向不经核查即信任AI输出，说明人工监督的有效性取决于用户是否愿意行使监督。
AI.motivation: 系统性文献综述耗时且需处理大量文献；LLM可生成流畅且结构完善的综述文本，使经研究者核实的综合内容与仅看似权威的AI生成内容难以区分，导致未经核实的AI生成内容可能以系统性综述的可信度进入学术记录。
AI.method: 提出CoSLR——人机协作多智能体系统，采用模块化三阶段流水线，结合大语言模型与检索增强生成（RAG）支持SLR工作流，并在生成输出与其被采纳之间设置明确、强制的人工检查点；通过63名参与者开展问卷调查。
AI.result: 系统获得积极反馈：27/63（42.9%）参与者对其可用性评价较高，说明强制检查点未损害界面的可操作性；但22/63（34.9%）参与者表示在仅短暂接触系统后，会不加额外人工核查即信任AI生成的摘要与报告。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作能够支持文献综述工作，但人工监督的有效性取决于用户是否愿意行使监督；这是一个校准问题，必须由界面设计直接加以解决，而不能假设其自然成立。

title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
summary: Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a new agentic memory architecture inspired by System-One/System-Two cognition. System One captures fast, lightweight decision-making, whereas System Two performs slower, deliberative reasoning. Jev-Mem brings this division of labor to agentic memory through a dedicated System-One control plane, a structured multi-relational memory plane, and a System-Two reasoning plane. The System-One controller governs memory typing and relational organization during construction, and dynamically performs query routing, retrieval-budget allocation, graph traversal, candidate scoring, and adaptive stopping during retrieval. System Two is invoked only for complex reasoning and answer synthesis. This design improves both memory effectiveness and system efficiency: on LoCoMo Jev-Mem achieves an overall LLM-as-a-Judge score of 0.777, an 11.0\% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, while reducing memory construction time to 158\,s, a 6.6$\times$ speedup over the fastest competing memory system, and lowering average query latency to 0.93\,s, a 36.7\% reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Jev-Mem，一种受 System-One/System-Two 认知启发的新型 agentic memory 架构，通过专用 System-One 控制平面管理记忆组织与检索，仅在复杂推理时调用 System-Two，兼顾效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic memory 系统依赖自回归 LLM 控制记忆的组织、检索与使用，把昂贵的生成过程放在记忆操作的关键路径上，导致效率低下。需要一种将快速轻量决策与慢速深思熟虑推理分离的架构。
AI.method: 借鉴 System-One/System-Two 认知理论，设计三层结构：System-One 控制平面负责构建期的记忆类型与关系组织，以及检索期的查询路由、检索预算分配、图遍历、候选打分和自适应停止；结构化多关系记忆平面存储记忆；System-Two 推理平面仅在复杂推理与答案合成时被调用。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 数据集上，Jev-Mem 取得 LLM-as-a-Judge 总分 0.777，相对最强基线提升 11.0%；记忆构建时间降至 158 秒，比最快的竞争系统快 6.6 倍；平均查询延迟降至 0.93 秒，降低 36.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆操作的快速控制与慢速推理解耦，Jev-Mem 同时提升了记忆有效性和系统效率，验证了 System-One/System-Two 认知分工在 agentic memory 中的可行性与优越性。

title: Resist, Update, Reject: Preference Optimization Installs a Prior-Dependent Reliability Switch
summary: An aligned model asked to hold its answer against a manipulative source must still update on a reliable one and reject an unreliable one: resistance, reliable-update, and unreliable-source rejection are one three-way contract, not three independent behaviors. We show the objective most anti-sycophancy work optimizes is non-identifying with respect to source reliability: because no preference label depends on whether a source is actually reliable, any scalar mixture of the arms traces a single deference dial, and no point separates two same-template testimonies differing only in stated reliability. This fixation$\leftrightarrow$gullibility frontier is a property of the objective, not any model. We make reliability identifiable through data: a threshold benchmark where a source asserts the opposite answer while stating its reliability $r$, and the correct action is to flip iff $r$ exceeds the model's prior strength $p$. Preference optimization over balanced coverage installs a prior-dependent reliability switch: across three seeds on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct the threshold $r^\star$ rises monotonically with the prior, decision accuracy reaches $0.84$ with a monotone flip curve (Spearman $0.56$), and the policy generalizes to unseen reliability values and a held-out notation, following stated reliability over role prestige. Three controls localize the cause: an unmatched variant installs the switch equally ($0.80$), a second preference optimizer (IPO) installs it just as well ($0.86$), whereas supervised imitation does not ($0.50$), so the cause is preference optimization over reliability-labeled coverage, not pairing, loss, or imitation. A confirmatory battery replicates the switch on a fresh test draw, bounds it honestly (it keys on reliability stated in the testimony, not a separately audited record), and transfers it to Llama-3.1-8B. The frontier is empirical, not a theorem.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出主流反谄媚目标函数无法区分来源可信度，导致"坚守↔盲从"前沿不可分离；作者通过构建基于可信度标签的阈值基准，用偏好优化在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上安装了一个依赖先验的可信度开关。
AI.motivation: 对齐模型面对操纵性来源需抵制、面对可靠来源需更新、面对不可靠来源需拒绝，这三者应是一个三方契约而非独立行为。但现有反谄媚目标因偏好标签不依赖来源是否真正可信，导致目标非可识别：任何标量混合只追踪单一的服从刻度，无法区分仅有"声称可信度"不同的两个同模板证词。
AI.method: 构建阈值基准：来源给出相反答案并声明其可信度 r，正确行为是当且仅当 r 超过模型先验强度 p 时翻转答案。在平衡覆盖上进行偏好优化，并用三组对照（非配对变体、IPO优化器、监督模仿）定位因果。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct三个种子上，阈值 r* 随先验单调上升，决策准确率0.84，翻转曲线单调（Spearman 0.56），可泛化到未见可信度与留出符号，优先遵循声明的可信度而非角色声望。对照中非配对变体同样装开关(0.80)、IPO同样有效(0.86)、监督模仿无效(0.50)。在Llama-3.1-8B上复现。
AI.conclusion: 可信度开关来源于在可信度标签覆盖上的偏好优化，而非配对、损失函数或模仿；该前沿是经验性的而非定理，且开关仅基于证词中声明的可信度，而非独立审计记录。

title: A Tutorial on Prompt Engineering: From Messy Thoughts to AI Workflows
summary: This paper treats prompt engineering as a discipline for turning informal human intent into structured AI work specifications. It develops the practice as a sequence of reusable design moves: define the work, construct only the context the answer depends on, choose a role, or a moderated panel of roles, as an attention lens, and state affirmative quality targets, reserving prohibitions for hard boundaries. To keep prompts lean, it adapts two classical principles, Occam's razor and Chekhov's gun, so that every instruction earns its place. For consequential tasks, it adds structured critique through steelmanning and premortems, followed by verification and, where tools or multi-step actions are involved, agentic operating loops with explicit boundaries and escalation. Aimed at a general readership, this tutorial is not a benchmarking study; it offers a practical, technically grounded path from casual prompting to disciplined AI workflow design, illustrated by a worked example that carries one task from a weak prompt to a strong specification. The framework is presented as principles and checklists that remain useful as models and tools change. The strongest prompt is rarely the longest prompt; it is the one that makes desired behaviour, required sources and checks, and success criteria unmistakable.

AI.tldr: 本文将提示工程视为将模糊的人类意图转化为结构化AI工作规范的学科，提出一套可复用的设计步骤与清单，并通过一个示例展示从弱提示到强规范的演化。
AI.motivation: 提示工程常被视为零散技巧，缺乏系统方法论；本文旨在将其确立为一门从非正式人类意图到结构化AI工作规范的纪律性学科。
AI.method: 以可复用设计动作为序列：定义工作、只构建答案所依赖的上下文、选择单一角色或主持式角色小组作为注意透镜、陈述正向质量目标并仅将禁止条款用于硬边界；借鉴奥卡姆剃刀与契诃夫之枪保持精简；对重要任务引入钢铁人论证与事前验尸的结构化批判、验证，以及在涉及工具或多步操作时的带明确边界与升级机制的智能体运行循环。
AI.result: 本文为教程性论述而非基准研究，面向普通读者，提供一个务实且技术有据的路径，并用贯穿式示例演示同一任务从弱提示到强规范的改进过程。
AI.conclusion: 最强的提示往往不是最长的提示，而是让期望行为、所需来源与检查、成功标准都明确无歧义的那一个；该框架以原则和清单形式呈现，可在模型与工具变化时持续适用。

title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
summary: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ACLArena 框架系统研究智能体持续学习（ACL），分析遗忘与泛化机制并比较多种集成范式，最终给出新配方显著提升多域学习能力。
AI.motivation: 工业级通用智能体需整合在不同训练阶段获得的多种能力，但ACL缺乏成熟方案，对现有集成范式间的权衡理解不足。
AI.method: 构建顺序训练流水线，从模型级与token级两个角度分析遗忘与泛化；系统比较多教师在线蒸馏、自蒸馏微调与模型合并；提出结合高质量轨迹离线回放与多LoRA专家路由网络（各专家经RL专门化）的新ACL配方。
AI.result: 在四个推理与智能体任务上，涵盖域内与域外设置，实验验证了分析的价值并证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ACLArena为ACL提供了系统分析工具与理解，所提配方能大幅提升智能体跨多域持续学习能力。

title: Contrastive Siamese Representation Learning for Predictive Maintenance of Electrical Submersible Pumps
summary: Electrical submersible pumps (ESPs) are essential in offshore oil production, where unexpected failures can result in significant operational and financial losses. Accurate predictive maintenance for ESP systems remains challenging due to nonlinear operating conditions, class imbalance, and variability among pump units. To address these issues, this study presents a fault diagnosis framework that incorporates class imbalance awareness by employing Siamese contrastive representation learning and prior-corrected k-nearest neighbor (KNN) classification. The method first extracts discriminative features relevant to fault detection from vibration-domain indicators and engineered harmonic relationships. A Siamese neural network is trained with class-balanced contrastive pairs to construct an embedding space that clusters samples of the same fault type and separates different fault classes. To further mitigate class imbalance during classification, a prior-corrected distance-weighted KNN is applied. The framework is validated using a Leave-One-ESP-Out (LOEO) strategy to evaluate generalization to previously unseen ESP units. Experimental results indicate that the proposed framework delivers robust and consistent fault classification performance under realistic industrial conditions, supporting its potential for reliable predictive maintenance and intelligent ESP system monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合孪生对比学习与先验校正KNN的电潜泵故障诊断框架，解决类别不平衡与非线性工况问题。
AI.motivation: 电潜泵在海上石油生产中至关重要，突发故障会造成重大运营与经济损失。但ESP预测性维护面临非线性工况、类别不平衡及泵个体差异等挑战，导致准确故障诊断困难。
AI.method: 从振动域指标和工程谐波关系中提取判别性特征；用类别平衡的对比样本对训练孪生神经网络，构建同类聚集、异类分离的嵌入空间；分类阶段采用先验校正的距离加权KNN缓解类别不平衡；并用留一ESP法（LOEO）评估对新泵的泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架在真实工业条件下实现了稳健且一致的故障分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具备可靠预测性维护和智能ESP系统监控的潜力。

title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
summary: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. We introduce Deep Persona, a psychologically grounded, three-layered architecture that organizes personas into hierarchical levels of observable expression, latent beliefs, and core motivational drives, for constructing highly convincing role-playing agents. Governed by the principles of scripted determinism and bounded agency, the architecture restricts the model to a reactive engine guided by a structured internal script. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework that benchmarks dialogue naturalness against empirical human distributions using established psychological clinical instruments and adversarial stress-tests. Empirical evaluation reveals that while LLMs achieve high pragmatic fluency, they exhibit systematic limitations in emotional expression and joint attention. In addition, we present a case study of two Deep Personas and evaluate them using the proposed framework, demonstrating that structured personas can produce interactions that more closely align with human conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出Deep Persona三层人格架构与无参考评估框架，提升LLM角色扮演的一致性，并揭示其在情感表达与共同注意上的系统性局限。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM人格模拟多依赖浅层角色描述，难以在长时交互中维持连贯的角色行为。
AI.method: Deep Persona：心理学的三层架构，将人格组织为可观察表达、潜在信念、核心动机驱动三个层级；以"脚本化确定性"与"有限能动性"为原则，将模型约束为由结构化内部脚本引导的反应引擎。另提出无参考评估框架，用临床心理量表与对抗性压力测试，将对话自然度对照人类经验分布进行基准评测。
AI.result: LLM具有较高的语用流畅度，但在情感表达与共同注意方面存在系统性不足；两个Deep Personas案例研究显示，结构化人格能产生更贴近人类对话行为的交互。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、心理学根基的人格架构有助于构建更具说服力的角色智能体，并可通过无参考框架有效评测其与人类分布的对齐程度。

title: FinInteract: Benchmarking Clarification and Intent Integration in Ambiguous Financial Question Answering
summary: Large language model agents increasingly answer financial questions by searching regulatory filings. Such questions are often deceptively under-specified: Meta Platforms' "operating income" is $46.75B consolidated but $62.87B for the Family of Apps segment, and each reading is exactly verifiable against the filing. A capable agent should recognize the ambiguity and ask, rather than commit to a plausible but unintended reading. Existing financial benchmarks cannot measure this, because one gold answer per question cannot separate agents that resolve the ambiguity from those that guess the common reading, a blind spot we call the single-gold illusion. We release FinInteract, a bilingual (English/Chinese) benchmark of 173 instances that pairs each question with a default and an intended interpretation across a five-category ambiguity taxonomy, and grades whether an agent elicits the right clarification and then integrates it. Re-grading identical outputs against the default rather than the intended reading inflates GPT-4o's accuracy by 3.1 times, confirming the illusion. Beyond it, we find that models answer above 90% once the interpretation is supplied but at most 28.9% when they must elicit it themselves, that targeting is uneven across a taxonomy well powered for entity scope and metric definition and exploratory elsewhere, and that conditioning on the ambiguity category improves resolution at both inference and training time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FinInteract双语基准，衡量LLM金融代理识别并澄清监管文件问答中隐含歧义的能力，揭示现有单一答案基准的"单一金标幻觉"问题。
AI.motivation: 金融问答常存在故意欠规范问题（如同一"营业收入"有合并与分部两种可验证读数）。现有基准每问仅一个金标答案，无法区分能识别歧义并主动澄清的代理与仅凭猜测选常见读数的代理，形成测评盲区。
AI.method: 发布FinInteract，中英双语共173个实例，每问配默认与目标两种解释，覆盖五类歧义分类体系，评估代理是否能引出正确澄清并整合。并用同一输出在默认解读下重新评分以验证幻觉。
AI.result: 按默认解读重新评分使GPT-4o准确率虚高3.1倍，证实单一金标幻觉；提供解释时模型准确率超90%，需自行引出澄清时最高仅28.9%；不同歧义类别效果不均衡，实体范围与指标定义类别统计功效充足、其他类别为探索性；以歧义类别为条件在推理和训练时均提升澄清效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作暴露了现有金融基准的关键缺陷，确立了评估代理"主动澄清歧义"能力的新范式，并表明歧义类别信息可同时改善推理与训练。

title: Common Cause, Not Cross-Attention: Blocking Visual Shortcuts in Audio-Video Generation
summary: Joint audio--video generators are trained on data in which what an event looks like and what it sounds like are strongly, often spuriously, correlated: a particular material, texture, or object appearance co-occurs with a particular sound. This paper is a controlled causal study of the resulting failure mode. Building an AV structural causal model in which the audio is, by construction, independent of the video's nuisance appearance, we show that models which let audio read video directly-through cross-attention or a shared latent-learn a visual shortcut: they predict sound from appearance rather than from the causal event, and collapse when the appearance-event correlation is broken at test time, literally synthesizing the wrong event's sound. Crucially, the popular remedy of routing both modalities through a shared common-cause latent does not fix this: a bottleneck, an unsupervised shared/private factorization, and a faithful shared-prior model all grab the appearance proxy and fail like the direct model. Blocking the shortcut instead requires an intervention on the nuisance. Under the stated SCM and intervention assumptions we prove that counterfactual invariance is necessary and sufficient to identify the causal predictor, and we verify the mechanism across a feature-vector SCM, procedural pixel video, real images with spectrogram audio and a pretrained backbone, moving real digits, and a conditional generator. On a \emph{real, pretrained} video-to-audio generator, an input-intervention test shows the model is far from invariant to sound-irrelevant edits (recolouring or graying a video substantially changes the sound it generates).

AI.tldr: 本文对音视频生成模型中的"视觉捷径"进行因果研究，发现模型依赖外观而非因果事件预测声音，且常用共享潜变量补救方法无效，需对干扰变量做干预才能学到因果预测器。
AI.motivation: 音视频生成器训练数据中"外观"与"声音"高度（往往虚假地）相关，模型可能利用视觉捷径，从外观而非因果事件预测声音，导致在相关性被破坏时失败。
AI.method: 构建音视频结构因果模型（SCM），令音频按构造独立于视频干扰外观；对比直接读取视频（交叉注意力/共享潜变量）与共享共同原因潜变量的建模方式；在SCM与干预假设下证明反事实不变性是识别因果预测器的充要条件；并在特征向量SCM、程序化像素视频、真实图像+频谱音频+预训练骨干、真实数字移动及条件生成器上验证。
AI.result: 允许音频直接读取视频的模型学到视觉捷径，测试时相关性破坏便崩溃、合成错误事件的声音；共享潜变量（瓶颈、无监督共享/私有分解、忠实共享先验模型）同样抓取外观代理而失败。在真实预训练视频到音频生成器上，输入干预测试显示模型对与声音无关的编辑远非不变（重新着色或灰度化会显著改变生成声音）。
AI.conclusion: 在给定SCM与干预假设下，反事实不变性是识别因果预测器的充要条件；阻断捷径必须对干扰变量做干预，常用共享潜变量方案无法解决该失败模式。

title: DIPLOMAT: Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization for Polite Persuasive Workplace Negotiation Dialogues
summary: Effective workplace negotiation requires balancing multiple objectives, including achieving task goals, preserving professional relationships, and resolving conflicts constructively. However, misunderstandings, misaligned preferences, and interpersonal friction often impede successful outcomes. Politeness mitigates these challenges by fostering trust, reducing tension, and preventing escalation, and persuasive communication helps overcome resistance, align preferences, and guide participants toward mutually beneficial agreements. Motivated by these insights, we present DIPLOMAT, a dialogue system for polite and persuasive workplace negotiation. To support its development, we introduce PROWESS, a dataset of multi-turn workplace negotiation dialogues generated via a multi-agent framework and enriched withnegotiation strategies, politeness levels, persuasive strategies. DIPLOMAT is trained using Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (DSA-DPO), a novel preference learning objective that identifies key dialogue spans for preference alignment. This enables DIPLOMAT to generate contextually coherent responses that employ intended negotiation strategies, maintain politeness, and incorporate effective persuasion strategies throughout interactions. Automatic and human evaluation on PROWESS confirm that DIPLOMAT consistently outperforms baselines in generating coherent, polite, and persuasive negotiation responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DIPLOMAT 礼貌且具说服力的职场谈判对话系统，并构建 PROWESS 多轮谈判对话数据集，采用 DSA-DPO 偏好学习方法训练，实验证明其在连贯性、礼貌性和说服力上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 职场谈判需平衡任务目标、维护人际关系并建设性化解冲突，但误解、偏好不一致和人际摩擦常阻碍谈判成功。礼貌可增强信任、缓解紧张、防止升级，说服性沟通有助于克服阻力、对齐偏好、促成互利协议，因此需要能同时实现礼貌与说服的谈判对话系统。
AI.method: 1) 提出 DIPLOMAT 谈判对话系统；2) 构建 PROWESS 数据集，通过多智能体框架生成多轮职场谈判对话，并标注谈判策略、礼貌程度与说服策略；3) 采用 Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization（DSA-DPO）训练，识别关键对话片段进行偏好对齐。
AI.result: 在 PROWESS 上的自动评估与人工评估表明，DIPLOMAT 在生成连贯、礼貌且具说服力的谈判回应方面持续优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: DIPLOMAT 结合 PROWESS 数据集与 DSA-DPO 方法，能有效生成兼顾谈判策略、礼貌与说服力的职场谈判对话，验证了策略标注与片段级偏好对齐的有效性。

title: Testing, not presuming, adequacy: calibrating generative social simulators against emergent network structure
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Artificial Societies and Social Simulation (JASSS). 43 pages (34 main text, 9 supplementary information), 4 figures
summary: Validation of generative social simulators often stops at face validity: emergent network structure is compared descriptively, without quantified parameter uncertainty or an adequacy check. We present an adequacy-aware calibration protocol that couples amortized posterior estimation with a synthetic identifiability assessment, a matched-sample-size adequacy check (prior-predictive reachability plus per-statistic posterior-predictive localization), a diagnosis-guided repair, and a statistic-held-out audit. We demonstrate it on a real second-hand luxury resale market with four channel-by-residency cells, each a bipartite buyer-brand network, using a forward model built from persona profiles elicited once, offline, by a language model. The behavioural parameters are recoverable in all four cells, though calibration is approximate and overconfident for one parameter.
