The observed summary falls outside the simulator's reachability reference in every cell, with the mean purchased tier as the pervasive discrepancy. The repair meets the value-block criterion in two of four cells but does not restore adequacy, and the held-out audit surfaces a buyer-breadth-dispersion miss no earlier diagnostic detected. A profile-source ablation finds the language-model profiles beat a flat rule baseline in all four cells, yet within-category brand relabelling causes no consistent degradation, so the profiles are a partially validated input whose value rests on structure, not brand identity. Making no causal claim, we conclude that an independent-aggregation account, without agent interaction or a buyer-breadth mechanism, cannot jointly reproduce the market's purchased-tier level, head-brand concentration, community structure and buyer-breadth heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"充分性感知"校准协议，结合摊销后验估计、可识别性评估、充分性检验、修复与留出审计，用于验证生成式社会模拟器，并在二手奢侈品转售市场数据上示范。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式社会模拟器的验证多停留在表面效度：仅描述性比较涌现网络结构，缺少量化的参数不确定性与充分性检验。
AI.method: 协议包含：摊销后验估计；合成可识别性评估；匹配样本量的充分性检验（先验预测可达性 + 逐统计量后验预测定位）；诊断引导的修复；统计量留出审计。应用于真实二手奢侈品转售市场的四个"渠道×居住地"单元（各为买家-品牌二部网络），正向模型由语言模型一次性离线生成的persona档案构建。
AI.result: 四个单元的行为参数均可恢复（但某参数校准近似且过度自信）；各单元观测摘要均落在模拟器可达性参考之外，平均购买层级是普遍差异；修复在两单元满足value-block标准但未恢复充分性；留出审计发现早期诊断未察觉的买家广度离散度缺失；消融显示语言模型档案优于平坦规则基线，但类内品牌重标不造成一致退化。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型档案是部分验证的输入，其价值在于结构而非品牌身份。不作因果主张的前提下，结论是：无智能体交互、无买家广度机制的独立聚合模型无法同时复现该市场的购买层级水平、头部品牌集中度、社区结构和买家广度异质性。

title: Complex-valued Phase-Coherent Transformers
summary: Complex-valued Transformers have inherited softmax attention over the raw complex inner product. Outside natively complex domains this standard form stays near chance, and no complex attention had been shown to correct it. We show that the match must be a scaled cosine score: L2-normalise queries and keys, so the score reads their cosine similarity and ignores their magnitudes, and hold that score at order-one scale. With this the same models train on four diagnostic tasks under two different gates; without the normalisation they stay at chance on ListOps and Needle under both gates and fall far below on the other two, and a normalised score placed at too small a scale fails as well. The resulting family of phase-coherent Transformers (\PCT) matches or exceeds the strongest real-valued baseline across long-range memory, positional retrieval, hierarchical reasoning, frequency-domain classification and physical complex signals; it shows no degradation up to depth 20; and its loss decreases log-linearly over a 61-fold range of parameters. A member of the family, complex screening combined with a phase-coherent recurrence, is the first genuinely complex-valued neural network to solve Path-X, with 91.6% of its trainable parameters complex-valued against 38.2% for S4. We record these as signs of generalisation not previously seen in complex-valued neural networks.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出复值Transformer的softmax注意力需采用缩放余弦分数（L2归一化Q/K并保持量级为一），据此提出的相相干Transformer（PCT）在多个任务上匹配或超越实值基线，并首次让真正复值网络解决Path-X。
AI.motivation: 复值Transformer沿用基于原始复内积的softmax注意力，在非原生复域任务上表现接近随机水平，且此前没有复值注意力被证明能纠正这一问题。
AI.method: 将查询和键进行L2归一化，使注意力分数为忽略幅值的余弦相似度，并将该分数保持在order-one量级；构建相相干Transformer（PCT）家族，其中包含复值筛选与相相干递归的组合。
AI.result: 在四个诊断任务、两种门控下，归一化后模型可训练；不做归一化时ListOps和Needle保持随机水平，其余两个任务也远低于基线，缩放过小同样失效。PCT在长程记忆、位置检索、层级推理、频域分类和物理复信号任务上匹配或超越最强实值基线；深度20无退化；损失在61倍参数范围内对数线性下降；其成员首次真正解决Path-X，复值参数占91.6%（S4为38.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 缩放余弦分数是复值注意力有效训练的关键，PCT展现出复值神经网络此前未见的泛化能力。

title: Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: Context layers, curated documentation that an analytics agent fetches at query time, produce large accuracy gains on text-to-SQL benchmarks. A with/without comparison cannot say which part of the layer does the work: the semantic content, the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it, or the pre-computed views that usually accompany it. We report a four-arm ablation on DABStep on four models that separates the three. The instrument is a data contract: a YAML artifact that carries a domain's semantics and the rules an agent's tools enforce. One arm empties every field of prose in the frozen contract while holding the tool surface, retrieval instruction, table allow-list and operation rules byte-for-byte fixed. Compiling the contract's own SQL expressions into views gives the ceiling a pre-computed layer would reach: gold on all 176 tasks it covers. Content dominates. It raises hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, beating the same knowledge pasted into the prompt on every model. Scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models. Against the compiled ceiling the contract arm's shortfall is a failure to derive, and it falls from 39 points to 5 with model capability. The contract beats the prompt because the rule it needs is one lookup away rather than buried in a long prompt: its SQL carries the fee semantics up to 98% of the time against the prompt arm's 4%, and at the lowest cost per correct answer on three of four models. For practitioners: semantics first, scaffolding second, pre-computed macros only where an agent demonstrably fails to derive. Ungoverned arms submitted 166 mutating statements; governed arms none. The gain is confined to the contract's domain. On one model the benchmark's own withheld golds grade the contract arm at 51.9% against 18.8% for the prompt baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四臂消融实验证明：上下文层的准确性增益主要来自语义内容，而非检索脚手架或预计算视图。
AI.motivation: 上下文层能大幅提升text-to-SQL准确性，但with/without对比无法区分增益来源——是语义内容、检索脚手架，还是预计算视图。作者希望分离这三个因素。
AI.method: 在DABStep上对四个模型做四臂消融，使用"数据契约"（YAML工件，承载领域语义及工具规则）作为实验工具。一个臂清空冻结契约中的所有文字字段，同时逐字节固定工具面、检索指令、表白名单和操作规则；另将契约的SQL表达式编译为视图作为预计算层的上限。
AI.result: 内容占主导：将困难任务准确率提升（13.9→55.1%、22.6→56.6%、22.9→68.4%、37.0→77.4%），且优于将同样知识粘贴进提示词。无内容的脚手架仅值0-5分（两个flash模型）和14-15分（两个前沿模型）。契约臂的SQL在98%的情况下携带费用语义，而提示词臂仅4%，且三/四模型上每正确答案成本最低。受治理臂无变更语句提交，未受治理臂提交166条。
AI.conclusion: 实践建议：语义优先，脚手架次之，仅在agent明确无法推导时才使用预计算宏。增益仅限契约领域内，且契约臂比提示词基线更优。

title: Connected Content Retriever: Dense Graph Edge Features Powering Pre-Ranking at LinkedIn
summary: In large-scale recommendation systems like the LinkedIn Feed, content generated by a member's network (connections and follows) makes up over 70% of impressions and engagement. It is therefore essential that the pre-ranking layer forwards the best possible few hundred candidates to the ranking layer. LinkedIn's professional knowledge graph carries engagement signals across both the first degree network (connections and follows) and the second-degree network: posts that a 1st-degree connection reacted to, commented on or reshared but did not author (a.k.a. stranger viral). Due to this fan out, the resulting candidate index exceeds one billion; selection of activities from the viewer's network narrows it down to roughly tens of thousands of activities that must be scored within a 120 ms p99 latency budget. We present Connected Content Retriever (CC Retriever), a pre-ranking system that scores these candidates with a full deep ranking model on GPUs at low latency. At its core is a sorted-search GPU primitive that joins dense graph affinity features (viewer to author) with document level features stored on the GPU at runtime in 5-10 ms. The shift to GPU served scoring enabled a 50x scale up of the ranking model's parameters and delivered a +2.5% lift in content time spent on the LinkedIn Feed in online experiments, significantly higher than the typical gains observed in LinkedIn Feed experiments. In this work, we describe the feature set we leverage from LinkedIn's economic graph and the model architecture used for scoring, with a particular emphasis on the online system that scales the stack.

AI.tldr: LinkedIn提出CC Retriever预排序系统,利用GPU上的排序搜索原语,在120ms p99预算内对来自网络的上万候选项打分,模型参数扩大50倍,线上内容停留时间提升+2.5%。
AI.motivation: LinkedIn Feed中70%以上的曝光和互动来自用户网络内容,预排序层需从超十亿候选索引中筛选最优的几百个候选给排序层。由于一度/二度网络的互动信号(如陌生人病毒传播)导致候选规模庞大,需在120ms p99延迟内对约数万活动打分。
AI.method: 提出Connected Content Retriever(CC Retriever),在GPU上以低延迟运行完整深度排序模型。核心是排序搜索GPU原语,在运行时5-10ms内将密集图亲和特征(viewer到author)与存储在GPU上的文档级特征进行连接,并利用LinkedIn经济图谱的特征集。
AI.result: 转向GPU服务打分使排序模型参数扩大50倍,线上实验带来LinkedIn Feed内容停留时间+2.5%的提升,显著高于LinkedIn Feed实验中常见增益。
AI.conclusion: CC Retriever通过GPU服务打分与排序搜索原语,在严格延迟预算下实现了网络内容的规模化深度预排序,取得显著线上收益。

title: Synthesizing Reactive Character Behaviors for Continuous Games via Programmatic Policy Search
comment: To be presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026
summary: We present a method for synthesizing reactive character behaviors for continuous games as compact, human-readable programs. Game AI practice still relies heavily on manually authored behavior trees, state machines, and scripts, while academic reinforcement learning typically produces opaque neural controllers that are expensive to train and difficult to edit. Our approach bridges this gap by searching directly over a domain-specific language for continuous-space game policies. The language is designed around reactive geometric decisions and includes higher-order constructs such as direction maximization. These constructs help discretize a continuous behavior space into enumerable program structures. To make program search practical, we introduce a large set of synthesis antipatterns that remove redundant program forms while preserving behavioral coverage. We further combine bottom-up symbolic enumeration with top-down guidance from a coding agent. Our resulting method, agentic sketching, has the agent propose high-level policy structure and call an enumerator to complete local program slots. We evaluate the method on a benchmark of 14 continuous games, ranging from classic control tasks to multi-agent football. We find that pure enumeration is often more efficient than using a coding agent alone, while the combined method substantially outperforms both. Our results suggest that programmatic policy search can be a practical authoring tool for game AI: designers specify reward functions, and the system discovers editable behaviors that are effective, portable, and often surprising.

AI.tldr: 提出"agentic sketching"方法，用符号枚举结合编码智能体搜索DSL程序，为连续游戏合成可读、可编辑的反应式AI行为。
AI.motivation: 游戏AI仍依赖手工编写行为树/状态机，而强化学习生成难训练、难编辑的神经控制器。作者试图弥合两者：获得既自动化又可读、可编辑的策略。
AI.method: 设计围绕反应式几何决策的DSL，含方向最大化等高阶构造，将连续行为空间离散为可枚举程序；引入大量合成反模式去除冗余程序形式；结合自底向上符号枚举与编码智能体的自顶向下引导（智能体提出高层结构，枚举器补全局部槽位）。
AI.result: 在14个连续游戏（从经典控制到多智能体足球）上评测：纯枚举常比单用编码智能体更高效，而组合方法显著优于两者。
AI.conclusion: 程序化策略搜索可作为实用的游戏AI创作工具——设计师只需指定奖励函数，系统即发现有效、可移植且常出人意料的可编辑行为。

title: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts with Speculative Decoding via Expert Coactivation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are increasingly deployed alongside Speculative Decoding (SD) to accelerate inference, but combining the two is challenging. SD improves the inference speed of dense models by verifying groups of tokens in parallel. However, the inference speedup for SD with MoEs depends heavily on the number of tokens being verified. Using more verification tokens results in more experts being transferred from DRAM to the Neural Processing Unit (NPU), which increases the memory transfer cost. This negatively impacts model runtime, as memory transfer is typically the bottleneck in inference. In this work, we investigate the impact of MoE router design during training on the speed of MoEs with SD. We find that routers with high degrees of expert coactivation result in much faster runtimes, mitigating the impact of using more verification tokens. Motivated by this observation, we assess the impact of various router design choices on expert coactivation and runtime using billion-parameter transformer models. We find that combining a global load-balancing loss, shared experts, a consistency loss, and an autoregressive expert selection mechanism during training results in significantly stronger expert coactivation. This increased coactivation translates into higher overall runtime throughput: our exploration yields a model that improves throughput by 21% over MoE baselines, while maintaining on-par accuracy with the baseline MoE.

AI.tldr: 通过改进MoE路由器设计提升专家共激活度，从而加速MoE+投机解码推理，吞吐量提升21%且精度不降。
AI.motivation: MoE与投机解码（SD）结合可加速推理，但SD验证更多token会导致更多专家从DRAM传输到NPU，内存传输成为瓶颈，限制了加速效果。
AI.method: 研究训练时MoE路由器设计对SD速度的影响，发现高专家共激活度的路由器运行更快。评估多种路由器设计对共激活度和运行时的影响，采用十亿参数Transformer模型进行实验。
AI.result: 结合全局负载均衡损失、共享专家、一致性损失和自回归专家选择机制，可显著增强专家共激活；最终模型吞吐量比MoE基线提升21%，精度与基线持平。
AI.conclusion: 路由器设计（尤其是提升专家共激活度的组合设计）能有效缓解MoE+SD的内存传输瓶颈，在保持精度的同时显著提升推理吞吐量。

title: Structured Decomposition for Reliable LLM-Generated Access Control Policies
summary:
This paper presents an LLM-based system that translates natural-language access control policies (NLACPs) into executable Rego code for Open Policy Agent (OPA). It provides a modular, end-to-end pipeline for policy detection, component extraction, schema validation, linting, compilation, and automated test generation and execution. The system is designed to bridge the gap between human-readable access requirements and machine-enforceable policy-as-code (PaC), with a focus on deployment reliability and security correctness.
  We evaluate the system on 372 ACRE-complete access control statements with non-null subject, action, and resource annotations against a direct single-prompt LLM baseline to isolate the contribution of structured decomposition and schema-aware validation. The system achieves a 50.3% end-to-end policy correctness rate, compared with 15.3% for the baseline, representing a 3.3x improvement. A policy is counted as correct only if it satisfies compilation, linting, and both positive and negative tests, making this a strict measure of deployable correctness.
  On security-critical patterns, the system generates correct deny semantics for 87.5% of deny policies (baseline: 37.5%), ownership conditions for 100% of ownership-qualified policies (baseline: 40%), and status-qualified conditions for 100% of status-qualified policies (baseline: 55.6%). These results indicate that structured decomposition and schema-aware validation play a critical role in improving the reliability of LLM-generated authorization policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于LLM的模块化流水线，将自然语言访问控制策略（NLACP）翻译为可执行的Rego代码（Open Policy Agent），通过结构化分解与模式感知验证显著提升策略生成的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在人类可读的访问控制需求与机器可执行的Policy-as-Code（PaC）之间存在鸿沟，直接单提示的LLM生成方式可靠性不足，难以满足部署可靠性与安全正确性的要求。
AI.method: 构建端到端模块化流水线，涵盖策略检测、组件抽取、模式验证、linting、编译及自动化测试生成与执行；在372条ACRE完整访问控制语句上，与直接单提示LLM基线对比，以隔离结构化分解和模式感知验证的贡献。
AI.result: 端到端策略正确率达50.3%，基线为15.3%，提升3.3倍（正确性需同时满足编译、linting及正负测试）。安全关键模式上：deny语义正确率87.5%（基线37.5%），ownership条件100%（基线40%），status条件100%（基线55.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分解与模式感知验证对提升LLM生成授权策略的可靠性至关重要，有效缓解自然语言到可执行策略间的鸿沟。

title: COREM: Cosine-Relation Momentum Reshaping with Stateful Writeback
summary: Matrix-valued optimizer states may contain relational structure that is not captured by treating their entries independently. We study whether relations within matrix-valued optimizer states can be exploited to improve optimization. To this end, we introduce a unit-relation-transform abstraction and instantiate it as COREM, a Cosine-Relation Momentum Reshaping method with stateful writeback. COREM partitions the momentum state into update units, computes cosine relations among them, and uses these relations to reshape the momentum before writing the transformed state back to the optimizer. This stateful mechanism allows the reshaped momentum to affect not only the current update but also future optimization dynamics. We evaluate COREM on CIFAR-10 with an MLP and on enwik8 with a Transformer. Compared with Muon, COREM shows lower early-stage step efficiency but stronger improvement in the mid-to-late stages of training, achieving better final validation performance on CIFAR-10 and comparable final performance on enwik8. Spectral diagnostics on enwik8 show that COREM consistently increases entropy effective rank and reduces the concentration of singular energy in dominant modes, while preserving an anisotropic spectrum. For square matrix updates, COREM requires approximately 13.3% of the transformation FLOPs of Muon with five Newton-Schulz iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COREM，一种利用矩阵型优化器状态内部关系（余弦关系）来重塑动量的方法，提升中后期训练效果并降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 矩阵型优化器状态可能含有不同于独立处理各项元素的关系结构，作者探究能否利用这些关系来改进优化。
AI.method: 提出unit-relation-transform抽象，并实例化为COREM（余弦关系动量重塑，带状态写回）。将动量状态划分为更新单元，计算单元间余弦关系来重塑动量，并将变换后的状态写回优化器，使重塑动量影响当前及未来优化动态。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10（MLP）与enwik8（Transformer）上评估。相比Muon，COREM早期步效率较低，但中后期提升更强，CIFAR-10最终验证性能更好，enwik8相当。谱分析显示COREM提高熵有效秩、降低主导模态的奇异能量集中，同时保持各向异性谱。方阵更新时，COREM仅需Muon（5次Newton-Schulz迭代）约13.3%的变换FLOPs。
AI.conclusion: 利用矩阵优化器状态内部关系可有效改进优化，COREM在中后期训练表现更好且计算更高效，谱诊断验证其改变状态谱结构。

title: Contextual Causality with Large Language Models: A Survey
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Understanding contextual causality is critical for large language models (LLMs), as it enables them to accurately identify causal relations in specific situations and support more reliable decision-making. Despite its significance, a systematic exploration of contextual causality with LLMs is still lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive survey on this topic. In this survey, we first propose a taxonomy of contextual causality, consisting of semantic, intervention, and counterfactual causality, and characterize each category by its core causal question, required model capabilities, representative tasks, and practical uses in causality analysis. We then analyze existing studies and discuss their key limitations. Finally, we examine the gaps between current benchmarks and real-world needs and outline promising directions for future research. Our goal is to clarify the research landscape of contextual causality with LLMs, emphasize its importance, and highlight promising future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLMs）上下文因果性的综述，提出语义、干预、反事实三类因果的分类体系，分析现有研究与局限，指出基准与真实需求的差距及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 理解上下文因果性对LLMs至关重要，能帮助其准确识别特定情境下的因果关系并支持更可靠的决策。然而，目前缺乏对LLMs上下文因果性的系统性探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 综述方法：首先提出上下文因果性的分类体系，涵盖语义因果、干预因果与反事实因果，并从核心因果问题、所需模型能力、代表性任务及其在因果分析中的实际应用四个维度刻画各类别；随后分析现有研究及其主要局限；最后考察现有基准与真实需求的差距并展望未来方向。
AI.result: 通过分类体系系统梳理了上下文因果性的研究格局，归纳了各类别的核心问题、能力需求与代表任务，识别出既有研究的关键局限，并明确了基准与现实需求之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 本文旨在厘清LLMs上下文因果性的研究版图，强调其重要性，并突出有前景的未来研究方向。

title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
summary: Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的表示引导上下文学习(RG-ICL)框架,用冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的示范,在8个医学影像数据集上显著提升分类与VQA性能,无需领域微调。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大模型适配医学影像常需资源密集的领域微调,成本高;作者希望找到一种无需参数更新即可适配的实用替代方案。
AI.method: RG-ICL:一种免训练的推理框架,利用冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的示范样本,不进行任务特定参数更新;对VQA进一步使参考案例同时对齐图像内容与问题意图。
AI.result: 在涵盖组织病理、放射与视网膜眼底的8个数据集上,分类平均提升20个百分点,VQA平均提升13个百分点,优于无上下文与传统ICL,接近或超过基于训练的方法;检索质量比数量更重要(6个对齐案例优于最多32个随机案例),固定或随机案例常使准确率低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 对医学影像理解而言,精心挑选MLLM所见的参考案例,是替代重新训练的一种切实可行方案。

title: EmbeddGAN: A Novel GAN Framework Using an Embedding Network and Gini Distance Correlation
comment: 18 Pages, 14 Figures, Submitted to IEEE Access, Awaiting Revisions
summary: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have demonstrated strong performance in generating high-quality synthetic data. However, they are limited by no formal guarantees regarding convergence and the effectiveness of the learning process. In practice, this leads to training instability, mode collapse, and sensitivity to hyperparameters. To address this, we propose EmbeddGAN, a novel adversarial training framework based on a dependence-based objective. Instead of relying on a discriminator that classifies samples as real or fake, EmbeddGAN introduces an embedding network that learns a representation in which statistical dependence between samples and their real/fake labels is maximized, while the generator is trained to minimize this dependence. This objective is implemented using the Gini distance correlation (gCor), which equals zero if and only if the embeddings are statistically independent of the real/fake label. Minimizing this objective therefore encourages real and generated samples to become statistically indistinguishable in the learned embedding space. The embedding network projects both real and generated data into a shared low-dimensional space, where distributional discrepancies can be measured directly through pairwise distances. We adopt a minimax training strategy: the embedding network maximizes the Gini distance correlation (maximizing dependence), while the generator minimizes it (minimizing dependence). Experiments on the MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CelebA datasets demonstrate that EmbeddGAN achieves competitive performance relative to established baselines while exhibiting notably stable training dynamics on the evaluated datasets.

AI.tldr: EmbeddGAN 是一种基于依赖关系的对抗训练框架，用嵌入网络替代判别器，通过 Gini 距离相关(gCor)衡量真伪标签与样本的统计依赖，以极小极大策略训练，实现稳定生成。
AI.motivation: GAN 生成质量高，但缺乏收敛与学习有效性的形式化保证，导致训练不稳定、模式崩溃和超参数敏感。作者希望从依赖度量角度提供更可靠的对抗目标。
AI.method: 提出 EmbeddGAN：用嵌入网络学习一个表示空间，将真实与生成样本投影到共享低维空间，用 Gini 距离相关(gCor)度量嵌入与真/伪标签的统计依赖。gCor 为零当且仅当独立。采用极小极大训练：嵌入网络最大化 gCor（最大化依赖），生成器最小化 gCor（最小化依赖），使真伪样本在嵌入空间中统计不可区分。
AI.result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CelebA 数据集上，EmbeddGAN 相对已有基线取得有竞争力的性能，并在所评估数据集上表现出显著稳定的训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 用基于依赖的目标（gCor）替代传统真假分类判别器，可在无显式收敛保证问题下提升训练稳定性，是 GAN 训练的一种有效替代范式。

title: Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models
summary: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at https://vox-infinity.github.io.

AI.tldr: Vox-Infinity 是首个专为评估语音语言模型长上下文理解能力设计的基准，通过扩展音频历史的轮次和时长，揭示模型存在明显的“近因效应”。
AI.motivation: 长上下文理解对 LLM 是根本挑战，输入过长会导致模型遗忘关键信息；在语音领域由于音频压缩率低、需更多嵌入来保留语义和声学线索，该问题更严重，而此前缺乏专门评估语音长上下文的基准。
AI.method: 提出 Vox-Infinity 基准，从轮次数（turn count）和轮次时长（turn duration）两个维度系统扩展音频历史，覆盖多种交互结构与语义复杂度的代表性场景；提供显式的答案来源标注，并按解决查询所需的历史上下文量组织样本，实现精确且长度感知的评估。
AI.result: 对七个代表性语音语言模型的广泛评估显示出一致的整体近因效应：当支持答案的证据更接近查询时准确率更高，但模型难以检索和利用对话历史中更早的证据。
AI.conclusion: 语音语言模型在长上下文理解上仍存在明显短板，尤其表现为近因偏差；Vox-Infinity 为长度感知、可溯源的长上下文评估提供了工具，推动该方向研究。数据集与案例见 https://vox-infinity.github.io。

title: Incremental Consistency Execution for Autonomous Intelligent Systems
summary: Long-horizon autonomous intelligent systems rely on heterogeneous components such as large language models, databases, external APIs, and rule engines, while their external states continuously change during execution. Re-executing the entire workflow after every change introduces substantial redundant computation. This paper proposes an incremental consistency execution method based on task fact contracts, field-level dependency masks, and state perturbation result invariant domains. After an initial verified execution, the system constructs conservative invariant domains for critical inputs and uses them to determine whether downstream results can be safely renewed without re-invoking expensive components. When re-execution is required, only the smallest affected output fields are recomputed, and an equivalence barrier prevents unnecessary downstream propagation. A submission-time version consistency gate further ensures the safety of side-effecting actions. Experiments on industrial fault diagnosis, enterprise analytics, and LLM-based multi-tool assistants show that the proposed method significantly reduces expensive component calls and end-to-end latency while maintaining high consistency and low incorrect-reuse rates.

AI.tldr: 提出基于任务事实契约、字段级依赖掩码与状态扰动结果不变域的增量一致性执行方法，避免外部状态变化时全流程重算。
AI.motivation: 长时程自主智能系统依赖LLM、数据库、外部API、规则引擎等异构组件，且外部状态持续变化；每次变化后重跑整个工作流会产生大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 初次验证执行后，为关键输入构造保守不变域，判断下游结果能否安全复用；需重算时仅重算最小受影响输出字段，并用等价屏障阻止不必要传播；提交时设版本一致性门控保障副作用动作安全。
AI.result: 在工业故障诊断、企业分析和基于LLM的多工具助手实验中，显著减少昂贵组件调用与端到端时延，同时保持一致性和低错误复用率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在外部状态动态变化下实现高效、安全的增量执行，兼顾性能与一致性。

title: The Ups and Downs of Backprop Weights
summary: Backpropagation (BP) has driven the remarkable success of modern deep learning by enabling large hierarchical networks to learn complex functions end-to-end. Yet it does not by itself determine how parameters should be organized so that functional components can be reused and adapted selectively. For example, object recognition and motion prediction may depend on overlapping parameter sets, making them difficult to isolate or modify independently. We call this condition weight entanglement. Modern architectures dynamically select which parts of a network process each sample: nonlinearities gate units, attention selects interactions, and Mixture-of-Experts architectures route inputs to modules. Yet such selection does not ensure that the same functional component remains linked to an identifiable parameter set across samples. We propose weight operators: parameterized modules that implement reusable functional components and can be composed at inference to form the function required by each sample. Learning proceeds in two stages: the model first infers the required operator composition, then updates only the selected operators' parameter sets. Vector Networks (VNs) provide one implementation. They couple operator selection to local error-driven updates within each layer and show that learned operators can be reused in combinations absent from training while updates remain restricted to the selected parameter sets. This provides a basis for testing functional parameter identifiability: whether an operator remains linked to the same functional component during learning. We argue that functional parameter identifiability may provide an organizing principle for models that systematically reuse and recombine learned functions while adapting only the components that need to change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"权重纠缠"问题，即参数难以组织为可复用、可独立修改的功能组件。作者提出"权重算子"——实现可复用功能组件的参数化模块，可在推理时组合。Vector Networks作为实现验证了功能参数可识别性，为系统复用与重组功能提供组织原则。
AI.motivation: BP虽使深度网络能端到端学习复杂函数，但未解决参数应如何组织的问题。功能组件（如物体识别与运动预测）可能依赖重叠的参数集，导致难以独立隔离或修改（即"权重纠缠"）。现有动态选择机制（门控、注意力、MoE）虽选择网络部分，但不能保证同一功能组件在跨样本时始终与可识别的参数集绑定。
AI.method: 提出权重算子（weight operators）：实现可复用功能组件的参数化模块，可在推理时组合形成每个样本所需函数。学习分两阶段：先推断所需的算子组合，再仅更新被选中算子的参数集。以Vector Networks（VNs）作为实现，将算子选择与层内局部误差驱动更新耦合。
AI.result: VNs表明学到的算子可被复用于训练中未出现的组合，且更新仅限被选中的参数集。这为检验"功能参数可识别性"（算子在学习中是否始终与同一功能组件绑定）提供了基础。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张功能参数可识别性可作为模型的组织原则，使模型能系统复用与重组已学函数，同时仅调整需要改变的组件。

title: Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts
summary: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of P.Herc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.

AI.tldr: Apollo Restore是一个24B参数的大语言模型，用于修复古希腊残篇中的物理空白（lacunae），基于Mistral Small以填充中间（FIM）目标微调，无需预先知道缺失长度。它是首个面向古希腊语及任何古地中海语言的大规模解码器模型。
AI.motivation: 古希腊文本常有物理破损造成的空白，传统修复依赖专家知识且困难。此前没有面向古希腊语等古地中海语言的大规模解码器模型，需要专门模型来自动、准确地重建缺失文本。
AI.method: 基于Mistral Small（24B参数）以fill-in-the-middle目标微调，构建Apollo Restore，可在不知道缺失跨度长度的情况下重建缺失文本。评估采用既有协议（≤10字符短空白）及新的长度平衡指标，并进行20位专家（纸草学家、铭文学家、语文学家）的盲测，还应用于P.Herc. 1667的重新解读。
AI.result: 在短空白（≤10字符）上，将正确修复排入前20候选的比例为80.6%/54.6%/61.0%（文献纸草/文学纸草/石刻铭文），超过最强已发表模型1.6×/2.6×/1.4×。在长度平衡指标下优势增至2.3×/3.5×/1.6×，且在长度提示错误时性能下降平缓。盲测中专家强烈偏好Apollo Restore，77%情况认为其表现至少与人类修复相当。还改进了P.Herc. 1667的已发表释读。
AI.conclusion: Apollo Restore是首个面向历史希腊语的大规模解码器模型，显著优于现有基线并能媲美人类专家修复，可实际改进真实纸草的释读。它是奥地利科学院主导的Decoding Antiquity计划为历史语言和手稿构建专用LLM的成果之一。

title: DocMIDE: Learning Multi-Hop Implicit Derivation in Visually Rich Documents
summary: Real-world document processing systems rely on rigid, predefined schemas, yet critical target fields often lack direct visual counterparts on the page. Extracting these implicit values requires multi-hop derivation, such as aggregating sub-categories or reasoning over visual marks. While existing methods handle explicit text spans or simple implicit queries, they fail at multi-hop visual reasoning even after standard fine-tuning: models retrieve incorrect visual evidence, or retrieve it correctly and then skip the intermediate steps of the derivation. To address this, we introduce DocMIDE, a fine-tuning framework that trains compact vision-language models to retrieve visual evidence explicitly before deriving an answer. DocMIDE constrains generation to a plan-retrieve-derive structure and optimizes it with Group Relative Policy Optimization under a four-component, rule-based reward that scores output format, the retrieved evidence block, every intermediate derivation step, and the final value against a verified reference trace. On a 4,151-pair implicit extraction benchmark, DocMIDE raises accuracy from 70.8% to 95.9% on Qwen3.5-4B from only a small set of annotated examples, and transfers to a second backbone architecture. Supervised demonstrations alone do not close this gap at any budget we tested; rewarding the intermediate steps is what does.

AI.tldr: 提出DocMIDE微调框架，训练紧凑VLM先检索视觉证据再进行多跳推导，在隐式抽取基准上把准确率从70.8%提升到95.9%。
AI.motivation: 真实文档处理依赖固定schema，但关键目标字段常无直接视觉对应，需要多跳推导（如聚合子类别、视觉标记推理）。现有方法只能处理显式文本或简单隐式查询，即使微调后也在多跳视觉推理上失败：要么检索错误视觉证据，要么检索正确却跳过中间推导步骤。
AI.method: DocMIDE将生成约束为"计划-检索-推导"结构，并用Group Relative Policy Optimization优化，配合四部分规则化奖励：分别对输出格式、检索到的证据块、每个中间推导步骤及最终值（对照已验证参考轨迹）打分。
AI.result: 在4,151对隐式抽取基准上，DocMIDE仅用少量标注样本即将Qwen3.5-4B准确率从70.8%提升至95.9%，并迁移到第二种骨干架构。仅靠监督示范在任何预算下都无法弥补这一差距。
AI.conclusion: 奖励中间步骤（而非仅监督最终答案）是解决多跳视觉推理隐式抽取的关键。

title: Benchmarking Hybrid Deep Learning Architectures for Predictive Maintenance in Industry 4.0
comment: Published in: 2026 IEEE International Conference on AI and Data Analytics (ICAD)
summary: Predictive maintenance in Industry 4.0 refers to using data from sensors, machines, and production systems to estimate when equipment is likely to fail, so maintenance can be planned before a breakdown occurs [1]. However, a model that predicts maintenance may work perfectly in the lab but fail unexpectedly when applied to real factory data [2]. To solve this "reliability" gap, we evaluated six deep learning architectures across more than 700 experimental runs. We focused on the two dominant approaches in the field: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), which process data step-by-step, like reading a sentence [3], and Transformers, a recent dominant approach, which look at the entire sequence at once to spot important connections [4]. We examined whether Transformers still outperform recurrent neural networks (RNNs) when the data includes noise [5]. We found that while Transformers excelled at tracking stable, slow-moving processes, they tend to overreact to chaotic data, mistakenly taking sensor noise for meaningful signals [6]. We also found that the hybrid method that combines a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) layer with a Transformer layer is more resilient to noisy data from factory shops [7]. Functioning as a noise filter, the LSTM smooths out data volatility, allowing the Transformer to focus on the bigger picture without being distracted [8]. The hybrid model did not just improve accuracy; it proved to be significantly more consistent than complex models, delivering reliable predictions regardless of how chaotic the underlying system became.

AI.tldr: 本文评估六种深度学习架构、700+次实验，发现Transformer在噪声数据下不如混合LSTM+Transformer模型稳健，混合模型既能提升准确率又能保证一致性。
AI.motivation: 工业4.0预测性维护中，模型常出现"实验室表现优异、真实工厂数据失效"的可靠性鸿沟，需探究Transformer与RNN在含噪数据下的实际表现差异。
AI.method: 对六种深度学习架构进行700余次实验，重点对比RNN（逐步处理序列）与Transformer（整体处理序列），并引入LSTM+Transformer混合模型，考察其在噪声数据中的稳健性。
AI.result: Transformer擅长跟踪稳定、缓慢变化的过程，但对混沌数据反应过度，易将传感器噪声误认为有效信号；LSTM+Transformer混合模型对工厂噪声更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型中的LSTM层起到噪声过滤器作用，平滑数据波动，使Transformer专注整体趋势，从而不仅提升准确率，还比复杂模型更一致、更可靠，无论底层系统多混沌。

title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
summary: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段框架，用多智能体LLM从无标注可穿戴数据生成睡眠指导，再蒸馏至小模型实现本地个性化睡眠指导。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的睡眠总结与问答难以提供个性化睡眠指导，而训练专用模型需昂贵的专家标注，且隐私与可访问性需求推动轻量化本地部署。
AI.method: 阶段1：多智能体LLM流水线从无标注可穿戴记录推理出结构化睡眠指导，实现可扩展的数据集构建；阶段2：通过监督微调将指导推理轨迹蒸馏到小语言模型（SLM），并集成了无需训练的最佳N选一（Best-of-N）策略来增强推理。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法优于商业通用与医疗LLM及开源模型；人工评估进一步支持生成指导的质量及SLM实现个性化睡眠指导的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段框架无需专家标注即可构建数据，并以轻量小模型实现高质量的个性化睡眠指导，兼顾隐私与可及性。

title: When More Evidence Hurts: Publication-Bias Drift and Principled Stopping for Biomedical Causal Search
summary: Automated biomedical evidence synthesis depends on retrieving published studies, but the biomedical literature is systematically skewed toward positive findings. Deeper retrieval can therefore make a system \emph{more} likely to falsely infer benefit when the true effect is null. We formalise this phenomenon as \emph{evidence drift} and prove that, under a standard publication-bias model, the false-positive probability on null-effect queries follows a strictly increasing large-sample envelope in retrieval depth, approaching one. Empirically, on a held-out test set of 140 Cochrane-derived queries, drift rises monotonically from 7.9\% to 15.7\% as the retrieval budget grows from 3 to 20 steps, and concentrates in the null-effect class. We present DACG-agent, a drift-aware causal-graph agent that incrementally builds a causal knowledge graph from PubMed abstracts and applies a two-layer stopping policy with complementary roles: a KL-divergence monitor that detects posterior convergence (the accuracy layer), and a Bradley--Terry process reward model (PRM) whose online decline detection halts retrieval once evidence quality peaks (the efficiency layer). Against full-budget retrieval, DACG-agent reduces evidence drift from 15.7\% to 6.4\% and improves null-effect accuracy by 21 percentage points (40.0\%$\to$61.4\%) while using 67\% fewer retrieval steps; overall accuracy rises from 61.4\% to 69.3\% (95\% CI 61--77). A simulation confirms the drift result transfers from the analysed vote-counting aggregator to the deployed noisy-OR one.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"证据漂移"现象：检索越深越易因发表偏倚产生假阳性，并设计DACG-agent通过因果图和双层停止策略缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 生物医学文献系统性偏向阳性结果，自动化证据合成中更深检索反而可能增加假阳性风险，现有系统未形式化并解决这一问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义"证据漂移"，在标准发表偏倚模型下证明假阳性概率随检索深度单调递增趋于1；提出DACG-agent，从PubMed摘要增量构建因果知识图谱，采用双层停止策略：KL散度监控后验收敛（精度层）与Bradley-Terry过程奖励模型在线衰退检测（效率层）。
AI.result: 在140个Cochrane衍生查询上，漂移随预算从3增至20步由7.9%升至15.7%；DACG-agent将漂移降至6.4%，零效应准确率提升21个百分点（40.0%→61.4%），检索步数减少67%，整体准确率从61.4%升至69.3%（95% CI 61–77）。
AI.conclusion: 证据漂移在理论与仿真中均可迁移至实际部署的noisy-OR聚合器，漂移感知的因果图智能体可同时提升准确率与效率。

title: Augmenting PID Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Hybrid Approach to the Industrial Benchmark
comment: Published in: 2026 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Control (AIRC)
summary: As industrial processes grow in complexity, traditional Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers are often insufficient for handling their non-linear, multi-input dynamics. We propose using advanced Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to prove its advantages in these complex environments. To do this, we rely on the Industrial Benchmark (IB). The IB is a realistic simulation that tests DRL algorithms against the key challenges of industrial applications: high-dimensional state spaces, delayed effects, and conflicting multi-criterial objectives. This testbed highlights DRL's core trade-off: while its final policies can often be unstable, its unique strength is the ability to autonomously discover optimal, non-obvious policies in multi-dimensional spaces where simple controllers fail. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid PID-RL controller that leverages DRL's discovery capability while ensuring Reliability. After developing a multi-objective reward function to make DRL viable, we use a twin-delayed deep deterministic (TD3) agent as a discovery tool to find the optimal, non-obvious settings for the IB's 'Gain' and 'Shift' parameters. By feeding these discovered parameters to a simple, tuned PID controller, our hybrid model successfully combines all three characteristics: it achieves the optimal Performance and Efficiency of the best DRL agent with the Reliability of a classical controller. This work demonstrates a practical methodology for using DRL to augment, rather than replace, trusted industrial control systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合PID-RL控制器，利用TD3强化学习"发现"IB基准的最优Gain和Shift参数，再交给简单调优的PID执行，从而同时获得最佳性能、效率与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 工业过程日益复杂、非线性且多输入，传统PID控制器难以应对；而直接用DRL虽能自主发现最优策略，但最终策略往往不稳定，缺乏工业所需的可靠性。
AI.method: 基于Industrial Benchmark（IB）仿真环境，先设计多目标奖励函数使DRL可行，再用TD3智能体作为"发现工具"搜索IB中Gain与Shift参数的最优、非显然取值，并将这些参数送入简单且已调优的PID控制器形成混合架构。
AI.result: 混合模型同时具备三种特性：达到最佳DRL智能体的最优性能与效率，并保留经典控制器的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了用DRL增强而非替代受信任工业控制系统的实用方法，为复杂工业场景提供了兼顾探索能力与可靠性的落地路径。

title: CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems
summary: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.

AI.tldr: 本文对375余篇文化自然语言处理(Cultural NLP)论文进行系统性综述，回答三个问题：目标文化能力、文化数据资源创建方式、提升文化能力的方法，总结趋势、指出研究空白，并发布交互式网页资源库。
AI.motivation: Cultural NLP领域近年研究激增，文献快速增长导致难以追踪方法与数据资源的趋势，缺乏系统梳理，因此需要全面综述以厘清现状与空白。
AI.method: 对超过375篇文化NLP相关论文进行分析，围绕三个互补问题（目标文化能力、文化数据资源创建方式、提升文化能力的方法）进行归类与趋势分析，并识别研究空白。
AI.result: 总结出三个问题维度上的研究趋势，识别出该领域的相关研究缺口，并发布包含全部被分析论文的交互式网络界面，支持研究者自行添加工作。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为Cultural NLP领域提供了系统性的研究地图和可扩展资源库，有助于社区跟踪趋势并推动未来研究。

title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improvement of 2 percent to 42 percent on tau2bench airline domain, while other baseline methods show degradation for some models. On the other hand, for harness optimization, our method shows a mean progress improvement of 10 percent and 30 percent over the human-curated and base harnesses, respectively, for the Gemma-4-e4b model.

AI.tldr: EdgeGen 从智能体规范中提取合规规则，生成以数据库为基础、刻意为违反规则的边缘用例任务，与现有合成数据方法结合形成全自动闭环优化系统，在 tau2bench 航空领域显著提升微调与 harness 优化效果。
AI.motivation: 工具调用 LLM 智能体在企业中日益普及，但高质量、多样化的评估与优化数据集因隐私等限制难以获取。现有合成任务生成方法生成的通用任务忽视智能体底层状态或数据库，无法反映真实使用多样性。
AI.method: EdgeGen 框架：从智能体规范中提取合规规则，据此生成以数据库为基础、旨在违反这些规则的边缘用例任务；再与现有合成数据生成技术结合，通过微调和 harness 优化改进智能体，形成无需人工标注的全自动闭环系统。
AI.result: 在 tau2bench 航空领域，用 EdgeGen 生成数据微调可使平均进度一致提升 2%–42%，而其他基线方法在部分模型上出现性能下降；在 harness 优化方面，对 Gemma-4-e4b 模型，相比人工整理和基础 harness 分别平均提升 10% 和 30%。
AI.conclusion: EdgeGen 能生成反映真实使用多样性的数据库相关边缘任务，构建全自动闭环优化，持续提升智能体表现，优于现有基线方法。

title: TWIG: A Time-Causal Wavelet Operator for Autoregressive Forecasting on Irregular Graphs
summary: We introduce TWIG (Time-Causal Wavelet Operator for Irregular Graphs), a graph-native neural operator for autoregressive surrogate modeling on static irregular graphs. TWIG transforms each node history into causal multiscale temporal features that separate recent variation from progressively slower memory components, then propagates these features through graph-wavelet operator blocks with gated pointwise channel mixing. The architecture is causal by construction and designed for closed-loop forecasting, where predictions are recursively reused as future inputs. We evaluate TWIG on three irregular-domain forecasting problems spanning regional diffusion, three-dimensional subsurface hydrology, and aerodynamic flow, with graphs ranging from 400 to 5,233 nodes and model capacities from approximately 70k to 10M parameters. TWIG achieves the lowest aggregate rollout errors on the subsurface-hydrology and regional-diffusion benchmarks and ranks second on the 10M-parameter aerodynamic-flow benchmark, behind the GPS Transformer. Across all three settings, TWIG consistently outperforms the corresponding non-time-causal Graph WNO baseline. These results demonstrate that TWIG provides an effective and scalable approach to stable autoregressive forecasting of dynamical fields on irregular graphs.

AI.tldr: TWIG是一种面向静态不规则图自回归代理建模的图原生神经算子，通过时间因果多尺度小波特征与图小波算子块实现稳定闭环预测。
AI.motivation: 在静态不规则图上进行动态场自回归预测时，需要兼顾时间因果性与多尺度时间记忆，同时保证闭环递归预测的稳定性与可扩展性。
AI.method: 将每个节点历史转化为因果多尺度时间特征，分离近期变化与逐步变慢的记忆成分；再通过带门控逐点通道混合的图小波算子块传播特征。架构天然具备因果性，专为闭环预测设计。
AI.result: 在区域扩散、三维地下水文、气动流三个不规则域预测任务上评估（图规模400–5233节点，参数量约70k–10M）。TWIG在地下水文与区域扩散基准上取得最低整体滚动误差，在10M参数气动流基准上排名第二（仅次于GPS Transformer），并在全部设置中优于非时间因果的Graph WNO基线。
AI.conclusion: TWIG为不规则图上动态场的稳定自回归预测提供了一种有效且可扩展的方法。

title: When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models
summary: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.

AI.tldr: 余弦相似度会低估对话LLM隐藏状态中线性可解码的人物角色结构，尽管该结构可被监督子空间恢复。
AI.motivation: 余弦相似度被广泛用于分析Transformer表示，默认相似度能反映任务相关结构。本文研究该假设在对话条件化大语言模型中何时失效。
AI.method: 在三个7-8B对话微调模型上，比较余弦kNN与线性探针在同一隐藏状态上的表现（30类任务）；用低维监督子空间与匹配秩PCA子空间对比；在SST-5情感分类及基数匹配控制中检验；并预注册了子空间可分性不变性与轮次不变性准则。
AI.result: 余弦相似度显著低估线性可解码人物角色结构（线性探针AUC 0.73-0.97，余弦kNN仅0.56-0.77）。监督子空间可挽回大部分差距，匹配秩PCA不能甚至更差。该失配在单句情感分类中消失，基数匹配控制排除属性基数混淆；不随对话轮次系统性增大，任务对齐子空间保持稳定。但3个模型中2个违反子空间可分性不变性（|ΔAUC|≤0.03），1个违反轮次不变性（|ΔL|≤0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 在对话表示中，即使任务对齐结构线性可及，余弦相似度也可能无法反映该结构，说明其作为表示分析工具需谨慎。

title: Self-Healing Harness for Runtime Oversight of Agent Self-Modification
summary: LLM agents can change their own future behavior, raising a basic control question of which self-generated changes should be allowed to persist. We formulate this as admission control for self-modification. The agent may propose changes to its operating instructions, while an external runtime gate controls persistence. We implement this principle as a model-agnostic self-healing harness that runs a Detect, Notice, Heal, Validate loop around an otherwise unmodified agent. The agent authors candidate behavioral rules in an external workspace, where they receive provisional execution authority during evaluation and acquire persistent cross-episode authority only after measured improvement on the triggering failure without regression beyond a fixed margin on protected cases. Replay provides matched evidence when available, forward trials provide a weaker fallback, and a corpus-level guard re-tests the accumulated active rule set. Across 16 matched Baseline and Harness runs spanning AppWorld, Terminal-Bench, and $τ^2$-Bench, the gate rejected 383 replay-decided proposals. Of these, 211 (55%) improved their triggering failure while degrading a case that previously worked. This shows that locally beneficial self-modifications can introduce collateral regressions often enough to materially affect gate decisions, providing direct empirical motivation for external admission control. Task-completion score is higher under the Harness in all 16 pairs, with two paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero, while repeated-trial reliability is higher in 12 pairs, tied in 4, and lower in none. Because adaptation modifies the policy-inducing context while leaving model weights fixed, admitted changes remain inspectable, reversible, and compatible with closed-weight models.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM智能体的自我修改形式化为“准入控制”问题，提出一个模型无关的自愈框架（Detect-Notice-Heal-Validate），通过外部运行时门控决定候选行为规则能否持久化，并在多个基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能够改变自身未来行为，因此核心问题是：哪些自生成的改动应被允许持久保留。局部有益的自我修改可能带来附带回归，需要外部准入控制机制。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的自愈框架，在未修改的智能体外围运行Detect-Notice-Heal-Validate循环。智能体在外部工作区撰写候选行为规则，评估期获得临时执行权；仅在触发失败上有可测改进且受保护案例回归不超固定阈值时，才获得跨情境持久权。采用重放提供匹配证据、前向试验作弱后备，并用语料级守卫重测累积规则集。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、Terminal-Bench和τ²-Bench共16对Baseline/Harness运行中，门控拒绝了383个重放决定的提案，其中211个（55%）改善了触发失败但损害了原本正常的案例，说明局部有益修改常引入附带回归。所有16对中Harness任务完成分更高（两个配对bootstrap区间排除零），重复试验可靠性12对更高、4对持平、0对更低。
AI.conclusion: 外部准入控制对自我修改智能体具有直接实证必要性。由于适应只修改诱导策略的上下文而保持模型权重不变，被接纳的改动可检查、可逆，并兼容闭权重模型。

title: User-Level Handover Decision Making Based on Machine Learning Approaches
summary: This letter covers a broad comparison of methods for classification and regression applications for a user-level handover decision making in scenarios with adverse propagation conditions involving buildings, coverage holes, and shadowing effects. The simulation campaigns are based on network simulator ns-3. The comparison encompasses classical machine learning approaches, such as KNN, SVM, and neural networks, but also state-of-the-art fuzzy logic systems and latter boosting machines. The results indicate that SVM and MLP are the most suitable for the classification of the best handover target, although fuzzy system SOFL can perform similarly with lower processing time. Additionally, for the download time estimation, LightGBM provides the smallest error with short processing time, even in hard propagation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了多种机器学习与模糊逻辑方法在恶劣传播条件下的用户级切换决策中的表现。
AI.motivation: 在涉及建筑物、覆盖空洞和阴影效应的恶劣传播场景中，用户级切换决策面临挑战，需要找到适合分类（最佳切换目标）和回归（下载时间估计）的方法。
AI.method: 基于ns-3网络仿真器开展仿真，对比了经典机器学习方法（KNN、SVM、神经网络）、先进模糊逻辑系统（如SOFL）以及提升机（boosting machines）等方法。
AI.result: 分类任务中，SVM和MLP最适合选择最佳切换目标，模糊系统SOFL性能相近且处理时间更短；回归任务（下载时间估计）中，LightGBM误差最小且处理时间短，即使在困难传播场景下亦然。
AI.conclusion: SVM/MLP适合切换目标分类，LightGBM适合下载时间估计；模糊系统SOFL在分类上具有良好的时间效率权衡。

title: Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI
comment: Accepted for Publication in IEEE 3rd INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON COMPUTING, APPLICATIONS AND SYSTEMS (COMPAS 2026)
summary: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨方言孟加拉语NER框架，基于ANCHOLIK-NER数据集(17,405句/101,817词,5种方言)采用留一方言交叉验证策略，评测8种预训练Transformer模型，Multilingual-E5 Large表现最佳(F1最高97.26%，最低82.38%)，并用LIME分析发现模型决策主要依赖实体词表面形式。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语方言多样(Barishal、Chattogram、Sylhet、Noakhali、Mymensingh)在词汇、形态和句法上有差异，给NER带来挑战，导致在标准孟加拉语或单一方言上训练的模型泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 使用ANCHOLIK-NER数据集，采用Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation(LODOCV)策略，在四种方言上训练、在未见方言上评估；在相同实验设置下评测8种预训练Transformer模型(BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa、Multilingual-E5等)，并应用LIME进行词级解释。
AI.result: Multilingual-E5 Large在每个fold中F1最高，在Mymensingh上达97.26%，在最具挑战的Chattogram上最低为82.38%。LIME显示模型决策主要由目标实体词表面形式驱动，而非周围句子上下文。
AI.conclusion: 建立了跨方言孟加拉语NER基准，证明基于Transformer的迁移学习对低资源区域方言有效，同时指出当前模型的表面形式依赖是未来工作方向。

title: APEXA: Execution-Integrity Enforcement for Multi-Agent LLM Automation of Synchrotron Data Reduction
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 4th TPC Workshop @ SC'26 (Building Open AI Infrastructure, Models, and Agentic Systems for Science). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/AdvancedPhotonSource/APEXA-APS-Beamline-Assistant ; data: https://doi.org/10.18126/tgg4-1m26
summary: Synchrotron data reduction, detector calibration followed by azimuthal integration of terabyte-scale diffraction series, is a multi-step, expert-bound bottleneck that increasingly limits the science rate of user facilities. LLM agents promise to collapse it, but driving a real pipeline with a stochastic model creates a failure mode chat benchmarks cannot see: an agent can report a calibration that was never computed. Correctness here is a property of what executed, not of the transcript. We present APEXA, a deployed multi-agent framework (61 tools over heterogeneous compute, run as a single reasoning loop) automating calibration and integration from natural language at a major light source. We make three contributions. First, execution-integrity enforcement: a deterministic tool-layer guard that refuses to surface any result not backed by an executed tool call, with a parser tolerant of cross-model tool-call format drift: in deployment, a frontier model fabricated a complete calibration-comparison report for commands that never ran, which the guard converts to an explicit non-result; the same code gates an optional motor-control surface at 0/200 adversarial violations against a simulated IOC, versus 15/200 for an equivalent safety prompt. Second, we release APEXA-Bench, an evaluation harness of 58 facility tasks (50 base plus an 8-task cross-detector slice) organized by a four-class physical-consequence taxonomy, the first benchmark axis we know of separating a wasted compute cycle from a damaged instrument; its cross-detector grading against NIST-traceable lattice constants surfaced two latent pipeline bugs. Large-scale agent scoring is left to a full-length study. Third, we validate APEXA on real beamline data: from one natural-language prompt it recovers detector geometry and integrates a full attenuation/exposure sweep. We release the framework, harness and traces.

AI.tldr: APEXA是一个已部署的多智能体框架（61个工具、单一推理循环），用自然语言自动化同步辐射光源的数据校准与方位角积分，核心创新是"执行完整性"强制机制。
AI.motivation: TB级衍射数据的高精度校准与积分是多步、依赖专家的瓶颈，限制用户设施的科学产出速率。LLM智能体有望突破，但用随机模型驱动真实流水线会产生聊天基准无法发现的失效模式：智能体可能报告一个从未真正计算的校准结果。正确性属于"实际执行了什么"，而非对话记录。
AI.method: 1) 执行完整性强制：确定性工具层守卫，拒绝呈现任何无实际工具调用支撑的结果，解析器可容忍跨模型的工具调用格式漂移；2) 发布APEXA-Bench：58个设施任务（50基础+8跨探测器切片），按四类物理后果分类法组织，首次区分"浪费算力周期"与"损坏仪器"；3) 在真实光束线数据上验证。
AI.result: 部署中一个前沿模型为从未运行的命令伪造了完整校准对比报告，守卫将其转为显式"无结果"；同一代码守护可选电机控制面，对抗模拟IOC达0/200违规，而等效安全提示为15/200。跨探测器与NIST可溯源晶格常数比对暴露了两个潜在流水线bug。真实数据上仅凭一个自然语言提示即恢复探测器几何并完成整套衰减/曝光扫描的积分。大规模智能体评分留待完整研究。
AI.conclusion: 提出并部署了APEXA，通过执行完整性强制解决智能体幻觉与真实流水线正确性的鸿沟，并开源框架、测试集与执行轨迹。

title: Concurrency-Aware Process Model Forecasting with Causal Nets
summary: Process model forecasting (PMF) aims to predict the process model that will characterize a future period, thereby providing a process-level view of how behavior is expected to evolve. Existing PMF methods, however, forecast directly-follows graphs, which cannot explicitly represent concurrency. We extend PMF to causal nets by forecasting time series of relation and binding counts and using these forecasts to reconstruct future process models with AND/XOR semantics. To evaluate the resulting models, we introduce a protocol that accounts for partial traces and constructs the workflow nets required for conformance checking. Experiments on four event logs show that the forecasted models achieve conformance levels close to those of models re-mined from observations in the corresponding future windows. They also outperform static discovery baselines, which retain high precision on the structurally stable log but exhibit substantial precision losses on the other three logs. Filtering infrequent bindings improves most conformance metrics, although it also removes much of the concurrent behavior captured by the models.

AI.tldr: 将流程模型预测(PMF)从直接跟随图扩展到因果网，通过预测关系/绑定计数时间序列重建含AND/XOR语义的未来流程模型。
AI.motivation: 现有PMF方法直接预测直接跟随图，无法显式表达并发关系。作者希望预测过程模型以提供行为演化的流程级视角。
AI.method: 预测关系(relation)和绑定(binding)计数的时间序列，用这些预测重建具有AND/XOR语义的未来因果网；并提出考虑部分迹的评估协议，构建合规性检查所需的工作流网。
AI.result: 在四个事件日志上，预测模型的合规性水平接近在对应未来窗口观测上重新挖掘的模型；优于静态发现基线（基线在结构稳定日志上精度高，但在其他三个日志上精度大幅下降）。过滤低频绑定能提升多数合规性指标，但也会移除大量并发行为。
AI.conclusion: 因果网预测方法可行且合规性良好，但过滤低频绑定在提升合规性的同时牺牲并发行为的表达，存在精度与并发表达的权衡。

title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
summary: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available

AI.tldr: 该论文研究命题逻辑证明辅导中的推理错误诊断问题，提出将诊断与语言生成分离的"验证器接地"架构。实验表明：零样本检测器宏F1仅0.191，微调后升至0.709但仍存在系统性错误；错误诊断会沿理由生成与反馈生成流程被忠实传播，表面上高质量的反馈可能掩盖上游的诊断错误。
AI.motivation: 有效的LLM辅导需要先正确识别学生推理中的具体错误，再生成反馈。然而现有方法可能生成看似优质但针对错误错误的反馈，因此需要将诊断与生成解耦，并研究诊断错误如何影响下游流程。
AI.method: 提出验证器接地的架构，将诊断与语言生成分离。在命题逻辑证明辅导场景下（学生动作可依据形式推理规则校验），使用600个平衡的学生动作，对比三种诊断器：零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器、符号验证器。每个诊断结果交由共享的理由生成与反馈生成智能体处理，以隔离初始诊断的影响。
AI.result: 零样本检测器宏F1为0.191；微调提升至0.709，但在结构相关的类别间仍保留系统性错误。理由生成通常保留输入的诊断，说明错误诊断可被忠实传播。反馈可同时忠实于理由、不泄露答案、在教学上合理，却针对了错误的错误。验证器接地的反馈达到最高诊断正确率。专家评分与自动反馈评估在很大程度上不一致。
AI.conclusion: 表层反馈质量可能掩盖上游诊断错误，因此忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。验证器接地有助于提升诊断正确性，但反馈评估需谨慎，不能仅凭表面质量判断教学有效性。

title: CREDO: Variance-Guided Rubric Evolution for Replay-Corrected Credit Assignment
summary: Long-horizon language agents receive sparse terminal feedback, while intermediate rubrics provide structured but potentially misspecified assessments of progress. In resettable training environments, counterfactual continuation rollouts can measure local credit, but exhaustive replay is costly. We propose Credo, a framework that couples evolving semantic rubrics with selective, execution-based credit correction. A frozen judge maps visible transitions to rubric features, and a credit head predicts the change in expected terminal reward associated with the realized transition. Independently sampled two-sided replays correct prediction residuals using their recorded inclusion probabilities. We derive conditional unbiasedness and a variance decomposition that connects two design choices: which rubric features to retain, and where to allocate a fixed expected replay budget. The resulting criterion weights prediction errors by policy-score sensitivity and missing replay coverage; its allocation rule additionally accounts for continuation cost. We also describe a practical mixture with terminal leave-one-out advantages and distinguish its clipped, token-normalized PPO implementation from the ideal policy-gradient estimator. This preliminary report provides the method, proofs, an exact finite-model audit, and a controlled evaluation protocol. It makes no claim of empirical superiority on language-agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出Credo框架，将演化语义评分标准与选择性基于执行的信用校正结合，用于长时程语言智能体的信用分配，提供理论证明与评估协议但未声称基准性能优越。
AI.motivation: 长时程语言智能体仅获得稀疏的终端反馈，而中间评分标准虽提供结构化进展评估但可能设定错误。在可重置训练环境中，反事实延续回放可测量局部信用，但穷举回放成本高昂。
AI.method: Credo用冻结评判器将可见转移映射为评分特征，信用头预测期望终端奖励变化；通过独立采样的双侧回放并用其包含概率校正预测残差。推导了条件无偏性与方差分解，据此设计特征保留准则（按策略分数敏感度和缺失回放覆盖率加权预测误差）和固定回放预算的分配规则（兼顾延续成本），并给出结合终端留一优势的实用混合方法及其PPO实现。
AI.result: 提供方法、证明、精确有限模型审计和受控评估协议，未在语言智能体基准上声称实证优越性。
AI.conclusion: Credo为长时程语言智能体信用分配提供了理论基础与实用框架，将评分标准演化与选择性执行校正耦合，并为后续实证研究提供评估协议。

title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.

AI.tldr: 提出Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD)，通过基于教师预测跨环境不变性的动态样本重加权，缓解知识蒸馏学生在分布外(OOD)场景下的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏压缩大模型时，学生在OOD设置下性能显著下降，此问题研究不足。作者识别出两个复合机制：(1)数据虚假性——学生易学到蒸馏数据中的虚假相关而非因果特征；(2)教师能力——标准KD均匀对待所有样本，忽视教师在某样本上是被因果特征引导还是被虚假捷径误导。
AI.method: IWD通过多个合成环境下教师预测的不变性估计教师的因果依赖度，对训练样本动态重加权。具体做法是扰动虚假线索同时保留核心语义，对教师预测保持不变的样本赋予更高蒸馏权重（表明更依赖因果特征）。理论上证明IWD相比均匀加权的标准KD能降低学生的Spurious-to-Causal (S2C)梯度比，推动学生学得更不变的表示。
AI.result: 在四个NLP基准(MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER、SST-2)和两个模型族(DeBERTa-v3、Qwen-2.5)上，IWD在OOD评估中持续优于强KD基线，同时保持有竞争力的ID性能。在16个OOD基准中15个取得最高准确率，平均OOD性能比标准KD在NLI上提升4.34个百分点，在QA上提升14.94个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IWD通过强调教师因果依赖的样本，有效缓解知识蒸馏学生的OOD性能退化，是一种理论扎实且经验有效的框架。

title: LIMIT: Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL
summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on Text-to-SQL through reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on massive instruction corpora under the assumption that scale drives performance. We challenge this paradigm by investigating a fundamental question: what is the minimal data requirement for effective Text-to-SQL instruction tuning? We propose LIMIT(Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL), a data-centric framework that demonstrates strong database reasoning can emerge from an extremely compact training set when examples are strategically selected. LIMIT operates through four stages: difficulty-aware filtering that identifies samples within the model's learning frontier, chain-of-thought synthesis with consistency-based selection, multi-dimensional quality scoring via LLM-as-judge, and genetic algorithm optimization that jointly maximizes schema coverage and sample quality. On the BIRD and Spider benchmark, LIMIT selects only 796 and 863 samples while achieving 100% table coverage, enabling Qwen3-8B to reach 69.1% and 88.9% execution accuracy.This result surpasses methods trained on 20 times more data and establishes a new state-of-the-art among open-source approaches. Our findings suggest that careful data curation, rather than scale, is the key to efficient Text-to-SQL learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIMIT框架，证明通过精心挑选极少量数据即可实现高效Text-to-SQL指令微调，而非依赖大规模语料。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法依赖海量指令语料，假设规模驱动性能。本文质疑这一范式，探究有效指令微调的最小数据需求。
AI.method: LIMIT包含四阶段：难度感知过滤（识别学习前沿样本）、带一致性选择的思维链合成、基于LLM评判的多维质量打分、以及联合优化schema覆盖与样本质量的遗传算法。
AI.result: 在BIRD和Spider上分别仅选796和863个样本即实现100%表覆盖，使Qwen3-8B达到69.1%和88.9%执行准确率，超越使用20倍数据的训练方法，创开源SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 精心的数据策划而非数据规模，才是高效Text-to-SQL学习的关键。

title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the AIMS Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.

AI.tldr: 提出 Semantic Scaffold 评估框架，从源文本抽取事实/问题/实体属性的层级结构作为固定参考，衍生 FPS、QPS、EPS 三个诊断指标，在 ROUGE 与 LLM-as-judge 失效时仍具信息量。
AI.motivation: 模型选择依赖摘要质量度量，但现有指标不足：ROUGE 仅捕捉表层重叠，LLM-as-judge 分数饱和到近乎相同的值，无法有效排序模型。该饱和现象在三个公开数据集、两个私有数据集及多语言场景中均被观察到。
AI.method: Semantic Scaffold 框架：从源文本中抽取事实、问题与实体属性的层级表示，并标注每个条目为主要点或支撑细节；将该结构复用为评分摘要的固定参考。基于此表示导出三个诊断指标——事实保留分数（FPS）、问题保留分数（QPS）、实体保留分数（EPS），奖励关键信息保留并惩罚细节过载。
AI.result: 在多个公开与私有数据集及多语言设置中观察到 LLM-as-judge 的饱和现象；实验表明 scaffold 评估在传统指标（ROUGE、LLM-as-judge）崩塌处仍保持信息量，并总结出四类反复出现的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: scaffold-based 评估可定位为可解释诊断工具，在整体性评估轴失效时提供有效区分度，弥补 ROUGE 与 LLM-as-judge 的不足。

title: SKstars at SHROOM: Visions Agreement-Guided Ensembling of Zero-Shot and LoRA-Adapted Vision--Language Models
comment: This paper has been accepted at the SHROOM-Visions 2026 Shared Task, co-located with EMNLP2026
summary: This paper describes the SKstars submission to SHROOM-Visions 2026, a shared task on fine-grained hallucination detection in large vision-language model outputs. The task requires systems to identify hallucinated character spans, assign hallucination categories, and provide confidence estimates for their predictions. Our approach combines zero-shot predictions from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct with those of a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model. The outputs of the two models are integrated through a lightweight ensemble procedure, followed by span refinement and confidence adjustment. We evaluate the main system components on a small internal development subset and report the performance of the submitted system on the official English test set. SKstars achieved a Cor+Lbl score of 0.2902, ranking 15th among 29 teams, and obtained Cor and IoU scores of 0.3642 and 0.3151, respectively, ranking 18th on both metrics. The results show that combining a large zero-shot model with a smaller adapted model provides a practical framework for multilingual and fine-grained hallucination localization, while also highlighting the difficulty of transferring development-set improvements to hidden test data. Code and predictions: https://github.com/aliathar1401/SK-Stars-shroom-visions-2026

AI.tldr: SKstars团队参加SHROOM-Visions 2026细粒度幻觉检测任务，融合Qwen2.5-VL-72B零样本预测与LoRA微调的7B模型，通过轻量集成、span精修和置信度调整，在官方英文测试集上Cor+Lbl得分0.2902，排名29队中第15名。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型输出存在细粒度幻觉，需要检测幻觉字符span、分类幻觉类别并给出置信度。该任务要求系统具备多语言与细粒度定位能力，而如何有效融合大模型零样本能力与小模型适配能力仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct的零样本预测与LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct预测相结合；通过轻量级集成程序融合两模型输出，随后进行span精修与置信度调整。在小型内部开发子集上评估主要组件。
AI.result: 在官方英文测试集上，Cor+Lbl得分为0.2902（29队中第15名）；Cor得分0.3642、IoU得分0.3151，两项均排名第18。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，大零样本模型与小适配模型结合可为多语言、细粒度幻觉定位提供实用框架，但也凸显了将开发集改进迁移至隐藏测试数据的困难。代码与预测已公开。

title: Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation
comment: 11 pages in body, 36 with appendices. 7 figures. 8 tables
summary: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑当前"指令微调助手模型扮演角色"的LLM人类模拟做法（产生刻板、缺乏多样性的预测），提出用短对话样本进行"人格绑定"，并定义Persona Mixture Models（PMMs）；进一步提出将预训练基座与指令微调监督者结合的tandem模型，在准确性与多样性上取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 当前主流做法是指令微调助手LLM通过角色扮演模拟人类，但这种方法不准确且输出刻板化、缺乏自然多样性。已有研究表明可用自然自由文本对话实现无刻板印象的人格绑定，作者希望探索更简单（短对话样本）的绑定方式并提升模拟准确性与多样性。
AI.method: 1) 使用特定人物的短小个体对话样本将LLM绑定到人格；2) 通过简单查询模型即可在后期添加人口统计信息且无负面影响；3) 将校准良好的人类模型称为PMMs，目前以预训练基座模型实现；4) 提出并探索tandem模型，即预训练模型加指令微调监督者的组合。
AI.result: PMMs比指令微调模型产生更准确的预测，并保留更多人对话中的词汇、语义和语用多样性；在跨开放域文本、人机聊天、人类任务导向对话等多语料上测量了真实性与多样性。但基座预训练模型可能产生域外对话，且在长上下文中可能丢失说话者内部状态。tandem模型在准确性与多样性综合表现上最佳。
AI.conclusion: 基于短对话样本的人格绑定与PMMs能更好地模拟人类且减少刻板化；tandem模型（预训练+指令微调监督）在实验中实现了最佳的整体准确性与多样性，是一种有前景的方向。

title: Recovering Lost Details: Multi-Scale Frequency Compensation for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Long-term time series forecasting has made significant progress by leveraging multi-scale information to capture hierarchical temporal patterns and model long-range dependencies. However, temporal downsampling in existing multi-scale methods inevitably smooths detailed temporal fluctuations, and this information loss is further aggravated by their emphasis on dominant trends across scales, resulting in insufficiently expressive representations. To address this, we propose a Multi-Scale Wavelet Mixing (MWMixer) model, which incorporates a Bidirectional Frequency-Bands Mixing strategy to recover lost temporal details across scales, enabling complementary cross-scale information interactions. Then, a Dynamic Scale-Adaptive Fusion module learns time-varying weights for each scale to fuse multi-scale forecasts into the final prediction, enhancing the flexibility of multi-scale aggregation. In addition, a cross-scale consistency loss aligns each coarse-scale prediction with the interval-averaged fine-scale outputs, while a multi-scale supervision loss enforces prediction accuracy at each scale, promoting consistent learning across scales. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets demonstrate that MWMixer achieves competitive performance in long-term forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出MWMixer模型，通过双向频带混合与动态尺度自适应融合解决多尺度时序预测中的信息损失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多尺度方法在时间下采样时会平滑细节波动，且过度强调主导趋势，导致表示表达力不足。
AI.method: MWMixer含三部分：双向频带混合策略恢复跨尺度丢失的时序细节；动态尺度自适应融合模块学习时变权重融合多尺度预测；跨尺度一致性损失与多尺度监督损失促进跨尺度一致学习。
AI.result: 在七个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MWMixer在长期预测中取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: MWMixer有效缓解多尺度下采样信息损失，提升长期时间序列预测表现。

title: Autonomous Model Lifecycle Management for Digital Twin-Based Manufacturing Control
comment: The paper has been accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026). The final published version will be made available on IEEE Xplore
summary: Manufacturing AI systems must autonomously adapt to continuous distributional shift from raw-material variability, ambient changes, and equipment aging, under strict safeguard and operator-trust requirements where model failures risk physical damage. This paper presents a closed-loop Cyber-Physical System (CPS) for autonomous model lifecycle management in automotive manufacturing, deployed since 2023. The system manages product-specialized model pairs: a sequence-to-sequence physics model (LPP) serving as a digital twin, and a deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) control policy (LCP) trained against it. Per retraining cycle, multiple model variants spanning architecture families and RL algorithms compete; only the best-scoring candidate advances. A Conductor orchestrator autonomously manages plant-wide model inventories with dependency-aware retraining and Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) fallback. Reflecting the principle of Human-Centric Intelligence, the LCP composite score embeds an operator-trust gate penalizing policies deviating from established practice; without it, 23% of policies are rejected by operators despite passing accuracy thresholds. Across multiple facilities, LCP-controlled processes achieve process stability improvements of 28-45% over uncontrolled baselines with zero safety incidents.

AI.tldr: 提出并在汽车制造中落地一个闭环CPS系统，用于自主管理模型全生命周期，应对持续分布漂移，兼顾安全与操作员信任。
AI.motivation: 制造AI需应对原材料波动、环境变化、设备老化带来的持续分布漂移，且模型失效有物理损坏风险，须满足严格安全和操作员信任要求。
AI.method: 闭环CPS管理产品专用模型对：作为数字孪生的序列到序列物理模型(LPP)与在其上训练的深度强化学习控制策略(LCP)。每轮重训中多架构/多RL算法变体竞争择优；Conductor编排器以依赖感知重训与PID回退管理全厂模型库存；LCP综合评分嵌入操作员信任门控。
AI.result: 若无信任门控，23%策略虽过精度阈值仍被操作员拒绝；系统自2023年部署，LCP控制流程相比无控制基线稳定性提升28-45%，零安全事故。
AI.conclusion: 该闭环CPS实现了制造场景下自主且可信的模型生命周期管理，验证了人在中心智能原则在安全关键制造中的价值。

title: Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing
summary: Bilingual language models (LMs) offer a controlled setting for studying how training conditions shape second-language (L2) behaviour, but prior work typically varies exposure structure, scale, and architecture at once, making it difficult to attribute effects to any single factor. We introduce Beetle, a controlled language model pretraining framework in which tokeniser, target language, training budget, and exposure structure are each independently manipulable, enabling systematic and comparable experimentation of training conditions. Using Beetle, we train and release 285 bilingual and 45 monolingual open-source LMs with rich checkpoints across a range of exposure schedules, data scales and first languages (L1s) to study multilingual pretraining and computational modelling of bilingualism and second language learning. Evaluating models on human bilingual and second language reading-time prediction and grammaticality judgement tasks, we find that staged and temporally structured curricula consistently improve alignment with language learner reading time compared to balanced bilingual training, with the largest gains at smaller data scales and for typologically closer language pairs.
