Comparing two prompt revisions of the same agent, the revised system (V2) reached a Valid SQL Rate of 93% (from 87%), an Execution Accuracy of 60% under a hybrid relational equivalence metric (from 47%; 19% from 12% under strict JSON matching), and a mean Synthesis Quality of 4.34 out of 5 (from 3.91). The single largest driver was removing a LIMIT 10 instruction from the system prompt, which had been truncating multi-row answers. Error analysis attributes the residual failures to relevance-checker false rejections, ambiguous question semantics, and free-tier API rate limits rather than to the language generation step. We report no comparison against an external baseline system or a public benchmark; the study is a single-model engineering evaluation.

AI.tldr: 构建了一个六节点 LangGraph Text-to-SQL agent（仅用提示工程，无微调），在芝加哥犯罪数据集（约850万条、22属性）和100题基准上评估；V2 提示使有效 SQL 率升至93%、执行准确率60%、合成质量4.34/5。
AI.motivation: 非技术利益相关者常无法编写 SQL 来从业务数据库中提取洞察，存在自然语言到数据库查询的能力鸿沟，需要端到端可用的 Text-to-SQL 代理。
AI.method: 六节点 LangGraph StateGraph 流程：问题相关性检查、获取实时 schema、生成 PostgreSQL、dry run 校验、失败重试、执行查询、用平实英语叙述结果集。仅使用提示工程，未微调模型。在芝加哥犯罪数据集上，用100题（30 Easy/40 Medium/30 Hard）带真值 SQL 的手工基准对比两版提示（V1 vs V2）。
AI.result: V2 有效 SQL 率93%（V1 87%）；混合关系等价度量下执行准确率60%（V1 47%），严格 JSON 匹配19%（V1 12%）；合成质量均值4.34/5（V1 3.91）。最大改进来自移除系统提示中的 LIMIT 10 指令（此前截断了多行答案）。残余失败主要归因于相关性检查器误拒、问题语义歧义和免费 API 速率限制，而非语言生成环节。
AI.conclusion: 该代理可在无微调下端到端完成 Text-to-SQL 并取得可观指标，提示措辞（如移除 LIMIT 10）对性能影响显著；但研究仅为单模型工程评估，未与外部基线或公开基准对比，结论的外部有效性有限。

title: Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications
summary: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究在标注数据和算力受限的全球健康文献场景下，如何选择和适配NLP模型，覆盖语义标签发现、命名实体识别和多标签主题分类三项任务。
AI.motivation: 全球健康文献领域缺乏标注数据和计算资源，需要明确在什么条件下应使用领域专用模型或轻量适配方法，以及在什么条件下Transformer的高精度值得其高昂推理成本。
AI.method: 1) 用逐步扩大的专用语料训练skip-gram word2vec并对比BioWordVec，评估语料规模与领域上下文对标签发现的影响；2) 在1000条标注句子上比较卷积spaCy模型与RoBERTa Transformer的NER表现，并微调卷积模型、集成疾病识别器（NCBI Disease Corpus），结合PDF预处理、实体过滤和MeSH增强；3) 在50个主题、1000条手工测试句上比较MiniLM少样本分类与BART-MNLI零样本推理。
AI.result: 词表覆盖率更广并不必然产生更有用的领域关联。NER中Transformer宽松评分下micro-F1为0.80，卷积模型为0.65-0.69，但耗时82秒 vs 5-6秒；疾病识别器在NCBI Disease Corpus测试F1达81.33%。主题分类中BART-MNLI单标签准确率95.2% vs MiniLM 59%，多标签准确率88% vs 32%，但BART-MNLI推理成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果界定了领域专门化和轻量适配具有实用价值的场景，以及Transformer精度足以抵消更高推理成本的场景，为资源受限下构建知识系统提供实证依据。

title: Towards Full Pipeline FP8 Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key technique for improving the reasoning and agentic abilities of large language models (LLMs). Although FP8 quantization can accelerate RL training, maintaining stability throughout an FP8 RL pipeline remains challenging. While previous works have focused on resolving train-inference mismatches using correction techniques like TIS, we reveal that full-pipeline FP8 RL still suffers from severe training instability, manifesting as anomalous mid-training entropy surges and garbled outputs. We trace this instability to a previously overlooked cause: compounded FP8 quantization noise distorts the importance ratio, disproportionately pushing negative-advantage tokens outside the trust region and erroneously zeroing out their gradients. As a result, pathological outputs are not properly penalized and accumulate over the course of training. To address this, we propose Calibrated Clipping, a dynamic method that aligns the FP8 clipping bounds with high-precision BF16 distributions by matching the lower-bound clipping quantile and rebalancing the upper bound accordingly. Extensive experiments across GRPO and DAPO algorithms, model scales from 8B to 32B, and multiple FP8 scaling granularities demonstrate that our approach successfully eliminates entropy surges and restores performance comparable to the BF16 baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示FP8强化学习训练不稳定的根因是全流程FP8量化噪声扭曲重要性比率，导致负优势token梯度被错误置零；提出Calibrated Clipping方法，动态校准FP8裁剪边界，消除熵激增并恢复BF16级别性能。
AI.motivation: FP8量化可加速RL训练，但全流程FP8 RL存在严重训练不稳定（中期熵激增、输出混乱）。已有工作用TIS等纠正技术解决训练-推理不匹配，但仍无法解决该问题，其真正原因被此前忽视。
AI.method: 将不稳定性归因于复合FP8量化噪声扭曲重要性比率，使负优势token被不成比例地推出信任域、梯度被错误置零。据此提出Calibrated Clipping：通过匹配下界裁剪分位数，对齐FP8裁剪边界与高精度BF16分布，并相应重新平衡上界。
AI.result: 在GRPO与DAPO算法、8B至32B模型规模及多种FP8缩放粒度上实验，方法成功消除熵激增，性能恢复至与BF16基线相当。
AI.conclusion: Calibrated Clipping是一种有效的动态裁剪方法，解决了全流程FP8 RL训练不稳定问题，使FP8训练在保持加速的同时达到BF16级别性能。

title: Measuring Behavioural Signatures of Large Language Models through Psychometric Profiling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human decisions and communication, yet their behavioural regularities remain difficult to characterize systematically. We develop a cross-linguistic psychometric profiling framework and evaluate nine LLMs using seven psychological instruments, with five repeated administrations per model and language in Chinese and English. Items unresolved after a prespecified retry procedure are retained as NA. Joint analysis of scored and NA responses captures response tendencies and boundaries of self-report applicability. LLMs exhibit structured, model-specific profiles despite a shared alignment-shaped pattern of higher prosocial and self-regulatory responses and lower dominance, disengagement and harmful-intent endorsement. NA responses are structured rather than uniformly distributed, indicating where outputs are treated as inapplicable, refused or cannot be mapped to valid response options. Language condition and provider origin are associated with profile configuration and answerability, whereas repeated administrations show high reproducibility and permit recovery of model identity. Human-reference and prompt-robustness analyses further indicate that these signatures are context dependent. Joint analysis of psychometric profiling and answerability offers a framework for quantifying deployment-level behavioural signatures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出跨语言心理测量画像框架，用7种心理量表评估9个LLM（中英各重复5次），联合分析计分与NA（无法作答）响应，发现模型具有结构化、可识别的行为特征，NA分布亦有结构，反映可作答性边界。
AI.motivation: LLM日益介入人类决策与交流，但其行为规律难以系统刻画；同时自评问卷中存在大量"无法映射到有效选项"的回答，传统只分析计分响应的做法无法捕捉模型行为的适用边界。
AI.method: 构建跨语言心理测量画像框架；用7种心理工具评估9个LLM；每种模型与语言重复施测5次；按预设重试流程后仍无法解决的条目记为NA；联合分析计分响应与NA响应，并开展人类参照与提示稳健性分析。
AI.result: LLM呈现结构化、模型特异的画像，共享"对齐塑形"模式（亲社会与自我调节得分较高，支配性、疏离与伤害意图认同较低）；NA响应呈结构化分布而非均匀分布；语言条件与供应商来源关联画像配置与可作答性；重复施测再现性高，可恢复模型身份；上述特征依赖具体情境。
AI.conclusion: 联合心理测量画像与可作答性分析，为量化LLM在部署层面的行为特征提供了框架，可用于区分、识别与监控不同模型的行为表现。

title: DUMA-Bench: A Dual-Control Multi-Agent Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agent Security
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly operate in environments where they interact with users, tools, and external systems. Yet most security evaluations assume passive users and static control, ignoring the interactive dynamics that shape real agent behavior. We introduce \textbf{DUMA-Bench}, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for measuring agent security under \emph{dual-control} interaction, where both the agent and the user can influence the shared environment state. DUMA-Bench extends $τ^2$-bench ~\cite{barres2025tau} with adversarial environments covering eight vulnerability classes, including RAG poisoning, cross-agent manipulation, and unsafe output handling. We evaluate \textbf{14 models from five model families} (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Z.ai) across eight domains and multiple user-behavior regimes. Across our experiments, introducing dual-control interaction increases the attack success rate from \textbf{26.9\%} to \textbf{41.1\%}. These results show that agent security is not solely a property of the model but emerges from the interaction between the model, the user, and the environment. DUMA-Bench provides a missing evaluation layer for studying security in realistic agent deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出DUMA-Bench基准，用于在双控制交互下评测LLM智能体安全，揭示交互动态显著提升攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评测多假设用户被动、控制静态，忽视真实部署中智能体与用户共同影响环境状态的交互动态，无法反映实际安全风险。
AI.method: 扩展τ²-bench，构建对抗环境，覆盖RAG投毒、跨智能体操纵、不安全输出处理等八类漏洞；在八个领域和多种用户行为模式下，评测OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、Qwen、Z.ai五个家族共14个模型。
AI.result: 引入双控制交互后，攻击成功率从26.9%升至41.1%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体安全不仅取决于模型本身，而是模型、用户与环境交互中涌现的性质；DUMA-Bench为真实部署中的安全研究提供了缺失的评测层。

title: Prioritized Rollouts for Efficient World Model-based Vision-Language-Action Policy Optimization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, but fine-tuning them with reinforcement learning (RL) remains constrained by the cost of real-world robot interaction. Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) reduces this cost by using a learned world model to generate rollouts for policy optimization. However, it becomes computationally expensive as VLA policies and world models scale. Existing methods typically treat states equally, overlooking substantial differences in their utility for policy improvement. In this paper, we show that policy uncertainty helps identify states with greater potential for policy improvement. The policy exhibits high uncertainty at only a small subset of states, often during decision-sensitive stages where small action differences can alter task outcomes, suggesting that policy improvements at these states could be particularly valuable. Building on these findings, we introduce U-GROW, a lightweight, plug-and-play sampling layer that directs more model rollouts to these informative states. By modifying only the branched-start distribution, U-GROW can be integrated into existing MBRL pipelines without changing the policy optimization objective. Experiments in both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of U-GROW, supporting the use of policy uncertainty to guide experience generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 U-GROW，一个轻量级即插即用的采样层，利用策略不确定性识别对策略改进更有价值的状态，从而在基于模型的强化学习中更高效地生成 rollout。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型用强化学习微调受限于真实机器人交互成本；基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）虽能降低成本，但随着 VLA 策略和世界模型规模增大，计算开销剧增。现有方法平等对待所有状态，忽略了不同状态对策略改进的价值差异。
AI.method: 发现策略不确定性高的状态只占一小部分，多出现在决策敏感阶段，此时微小动作差异会改变任务结果，因此这些状态对策略改进价值更高。基于此提出 U-GROW：一个轻量级、即插即用的采样层，通过仅修改分支起始分布，将更多模型 rollout 导向这些高信息量状态，无需改变策略优化目标即可集成到现有 MBRL 流程中。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务中，U-GROW 表现出更高的效率与有效性，验证了用策略不确定性引导经验生成的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 策略不确定性可作为状态价值的有效信号，用于指导 MBRL 中的经验生成；U-GROW 提供了一种低成本、易集成的方式来提升 VLA 模型 RL 微调的效率。

title: Automatic multimodal UX improvement recommendations from LLM agent user simulations
summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) on live websites through user testing is expensive, subjective, and difficult to scale. LLM agents offer a promising route to automating UX testing by simulating realistic user behaviour. However, existing simulation approaches typically lack multimodality and require time-consuming manual review to extract actionable insights. We formalise UX improvement recommendation from simulation data as a structured natural language generation and ranking problem, and establish an evaluation protocol using expert annotation and LLM-as-a-Judge. We present AMUSER, a multimodal framework which simulates user behaviour and automatically generates prioritised UX improvement recommendations from resulting data. We evaluate AMUSER on commercial websites and show that its recommendations substantially outperform those from text-only simulation (NDCG@3 = 0.758 versus 0.359) at an 89% lower simulation cost. Our results suggest an asymmetric role of multimodality: visual access during simulation improves recommendations through richer traces, while providing visual inputs during recommendation generation can modestly degrade quality. We also discuss practical deployment lessons from applying AMUSER to commercial websites.

AI.tldr: 提出AMUSER多模态框架，通过模拟用户行为自动生成并排序UX改进建议，在商业网站上性能大幅优于纯文本模拟且成本降低89%。
AI.motivation: 传统网站UX测试昂贵、主观且难以规模化；现有LLM模拟方法缺乏多模态能力，且需耗时人工审阅才能提取可执行洞见。
AI.method: 将UX改进建议形式化为结构化自然语言生成与排序问题，建立基于专家标注和LLM-as-a-Judge的评估协议；提出AMUSER多模态框架，模拟用户行为并从模拟数据自动生成优先级排序的UX改进建议。
AI.result: 在商业网站上，AMUSER建议显著优于纯文本模拟（NDCG@3为0.758对0.359），模拟成本降低89%。多模态呈现不对称作用：模拟阶段视觉输入通过更丰富的轨迹提升建议质量，而生成建议时提供视觉输入反而可能轻微降低质量。
AI.conclusion: 多模态LLM代理可高效自动化UX测试与建议生成；视觉信息的作用因使用阶段而异，为实际部署提供了实践经验和指导。

title: Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents convert interaction feedback into persistent artifacts, such as memories or skills, which in turn guide subsequent decisions. As these artifacts are iteratively updated throughout an experience stream, the capabilities they support may evolve. Consequently, endpoint performance alone offers an incomplete view of self-evolution. Process-level evaluation is therefore essential to identify when a target capability emerges and whether later updates strengthen, preserve, or weaken it. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{EvoPathBench}, a benchmark that tracks individual capabilities during artifact-level self-evolution. EvoPathBench fixes the base model, tools, freezes evolving artifacts at successive checkpoints, and evaluates the target capability on held-out episodes. This benchmark evaluates agent self-evolution using public trading data and calibrated trajectories. It tests three capabilities: generalization to unseen tasks, retention after unrelated learning, and rule adaptation to new evidence. Experimental results show that gains on similar unseen tasks often weaken under distribution shift, retention losses are concentrated in a minority of evolution paths, and no method achieves reliable rule adaptation. Moreover, while self-evolution enables agents to generate candidate artifacts with substantial held-out gains, the selected updates consistently fall short of realizing this potential. Together, these findings establish capability-level process evaluation as a foundation for analyzing self-evolution, identifying candidate evaluation and selection as key targets for improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoPathBench基准，通过固定基础模型与工具、在连续检查点冻结演化工件并在留出任务上评估目标能力，实现自演化智能体的过程级能力追踪。
AI.motivation: 自演化智能体将交互反馈转为持久工件（记忆/技能）并迭代更新，但仅看端点性能无法反映能力何时出现及后续更新是增强、保持还是削弱，故需过程级评估。
AI.method: EvoPathBench固定基础模型与工具，将演化工件在连续检查点冻结，并在留出情景上评估目标能力；使用公开交易数据与校准轨迹，测试三种能力：对未见任务的泛化、无关学习后的保持、对新证据的规则适应。
AI.result: 相似未见任务的增益在分布偏移下常被削弱；保持损失集中在少数演化路径；无方法实现可靠规则适应；自演化能生成具有显著留出增益的候选工件，但被选中的更新始终未能兑现该潜力。
AI.conclusion: 能力级过程评估是分析自演化的基础，候选评估与选择是关键改进目标。

title: Merge++: Universal Merge Refinement Through Data-Free Checkpoint Inversion
summary: Model merging consolidates fine-tuned experts into one multi-task model without retraining. All existing data-free methods approach this problem entirely in weight space. Restricted to arithmetic on parameters, these methods never observe how each expert behaves, a signal that only emerges through forward evaluation. Accessing this behavioral signal requires inputs to evaluate on, which the data-free setting prohibits. We propose Merge++, a post-hoc method that addresses this by inverting the expert checkpoints to synthesize task-representative images, then distilling expert knowledge into the merged model using those images. Merge++ requires no additional data beyond the checkpoints themselves. It applies universally across merging algorithms and operates as a complementary refinement stage independent of the underlying weight-space method. The method consistently improves merging algorithms ranging from simple task arithmetic to state-of-the-art spectral methods, with average gains of +2 to +8 points and up to +25.9 on individual configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出 Merge++，一种无数据模型合并的事后方法，通过反演专家检查点合成任务图像，再蒸馏专家知识进合并模型，显著提升多种合并算法性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无数据模型合并方法仅在权重空间进行参数算术，无法观察专家行为信号（需前向评估），而无数据设定禁止提供输入。作者希望利用行为信号改进合并效果。
AI.method: 反演专家检查点以合成任务代表性图像，然后用这些图像将专家知识蒸馏到合并模型中；方法无需额外数据，只依赖检查点本身，且与底层合并算法解耦，作为互补精炼阶段。
AI.result: 在从简单任务算术到最先进谱方法的多种合并算法上均取得一致提升，平均增益 +2 到 +8 点，个别配置最高提升 +25.9 点。
AI.conclusion: Merge++ 通过引入反演生成的行为信号，突破纯权重空间限制，为无数据模型合并提供通用的即插即用精炼方案。

title: Rethinking Pivot Programming Languages in Code Language Models
summary: Multilingual code language models transfer skills across programming languages (PLs), but whether any PL occupies a privileged pivot position remains contested: geometric analyses point to C-family languages and Go, while behavioral evidence highlights Python. We revisit this question under controls for representational anisotropy and length variation across PLs, two confounds that compromise prior cosine-based analyses. Across three code models on multilingual competitive-programming data, we study three views of cross-PL organization: pairwise PL geometry, PL-English alignment, and pivoted retrieval through candidate PL representation spaces. The results are relation-dependent. Code-code geometry reveals structured language regions but no universal center; code-English alignment favors high-level scripting languages; and pivoted retrieval favors different intermediate spaces for code-to-code and English-to-code transfer. These findings suggest that Python's special role is better understood as English-facing affinity than as universal geometric centrality.

AI.tldr: 该论文在控制表征各向异性和长度差异这两个混淆因素后，重新审视“是否存在一个特权枢纽编程语言”的问题，发现答案是关系依赖的：代码-代码几何没有普适中心，代码-英语对齐偏好高级脚本语言，而枢轴检索对代码到代码与英语到代码转移偏好不同的中间空间。Python的特殊地位更应理解为面向英语的亲和性，而非普适的几何中心性。
AI.motivation: 多语言代码语言模型能跨编程语言迁移技能，但哪种编程语言占据特权枢纽位置仍有争议：几何分析指向 C 系语言和 Go，而行为证据强调 Python。作者指出，先前的余弦相似度分析受到表征各向异性和编程语言间长度差异两个混淆因素的影响，因此需要在这些因素受控的条件下重新检验该问题。
AI.method: 在三个代码模型和多语言竞赛编程数据上，控制表征各向异性与长度变化，从三个视角研究跨编程语言组织：成对编程语言几何结构、编程语言-英语对齐、以及通过候选编程语言表征空间进行枢轴检索。
AI.result: 结果与具体关系有关：代码-代码几何揭示了结构化的语言区域，但不存在普适中心；代码-英语对齐偏好高级脚本语言；枢轴检索显示代码到代码与英语到代码转移偏好不同的中间空间。
AI.conclusion: Python 的特殊作用更适合被理解为面向英语的亲和性，而非普适的几何中心性；这为多语言代码模型的跨语言迁移与枢纽语言选择提供了更细致的理解。

title: TimeLitmus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Cross-Modal Understanding and Explanation Faithfulness in Event-Conditioned Time-Series Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make predictions from numerical time-series histories and textual events. Yet accuracy alone cannot reveal whether correct answers reflect effective integration of the two inputs or instead arise from event polarity, unimodal priors, or superficial cues. Likewise, plausible explanations may rationalize predictions without faithfully reflecting the evidence that drives model behavior. We introduce TimeLitmus, a diagnostic benchmark for cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction. TimeLitmus contains 4,856 evaluation records across Finance and Traffic, combining natural prediction with controlled counterfactual and contrastive interventions, explanation-targeted faithfulness tests, and systematic shortcut controls. Across ten representative LLMs, standard prediction accuracy substantially overstates reliable cross-modal understanding: Hard Paired Contrast (HPC) pair correctness peaks at only 19.2% in Finance and 11.7% in Traffic, and all ten models show lower-than-expected consistency on Finance series-side controls. Models often recognize scenario relations explicitly yet fail to apply them during independent prediction. Explanation faithfulness shows a similar gap: in Traffic, most models cite the manipulated temporal factor in over 90% of cases, while behavioral support remains below 22%. Human annotators outperform LLMs on matched controlled and hard-pair diagnostics, confirming that these distinctions are recoverable from the inputs. Natural-only adaptation yields selective gains in evidence selection and input sensitivity, but not consistent gains in controlled or hard-pair behavior. The benchmark, evaluation suite, and supervised adaptation data will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: TimeLitmus是一个诊断基准，揭示LLM在事件条件时间序列预测中，标准准确率高估了跨模态理解与解释忠实度，硬配对对比正确率极低。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于结合数值时间序列与文本事件做预测，但仅凭准确率无法判断正确回答是否真正整合了两种输入，还是源于事件极性、单模态先验或表面线索；且看似合理的解释可能只是对预测的事后合理化，未忠实反映驱动行为的证据。
AI.method: 提出TimeLitmus诊断基准，包含Finance和Traffic两个领域的4,856条评估记录，融合自然预测、受控反事实与对比干预、面向解释的忠实度测试以及系统性捷径控制。评测十种代表性LLM并对比人类标注者，还进行了仅自然数据适配实验。
AI.result: 标准预测准确率显著高估了可靠的跨模态理解：硬配对对比（HPC）成对正确率最高仅Finance 19.2%、Traffic 11.7%，十模型在Finance序列侧控制上一致性均低于预期。解释忠实度同样存在差距，Traffic中多数模型在90%以上案例引用被操纵的时间因素，但行为支持低于22%。人类标注者在受控和硬配对诊断上优于LLM。仅自然数据适配带来证据选择与输入敏感性的选择性提升，但受控和硬配对行为无一致改善。
AI.conclusion: TimeLitmus表明现有LLM在事件条件时间序列预测中缺乏可靠的跨模态理解与忠实解释，标准准确率具有误导性。基准、评测套件和监督适配数据将公开。

title: Are Coreset Selection Methods Worth Their Cost?
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. Benchmark artifacts include per-run result tables, selected indices, and raw timing-audit tables
summary: Coreset selection picks a representative subset of the labeled training set to make training cheaper. However, it is usually evaluated by downstream accuracy at a fixed subset size, ignoring both the time spent selecting the subset and the training recipe behind each reported number. We introduce an end-to-end benchmark that standardizes downstream training and charges selection and training to the same auditable wall-clock budget, spanning 4 datasets from CIFAR-10 to ImageNet-1K, 11 selectors, 5 fractions, and 3 seeds, with over 1,500 released runs. Repeated-sampling work has shown that budget-aware evaluation already favors random strategies. Our two budget studies test whether that verdict survives when every selector is granted its most favorable operating point. Across eight wall-clock budget anchors on each of CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet, no anchor is won by a sophisticated selector: every winner is class-balanced random sampling, repeated random sampling, or full-data training. In fixed-budget duels on ImageNet-1K, training on all data for fewer epochs beats every selection strategy we probe while also costing the least. A per-dataset cost audit shows that selection cost is dominated at every scale by a fixed full-dataset scan, so it cannot be amortized away by selecting a smaller fraction, and its absolute size does not extrapolate from one dataset to another. We further quantify when selection does pay back through subset reuse, and document 9 correctness fixes to a widely used codebase, one of which shifts a standard Herding baseline by nearly 6 points. Selection time is not free preprocessing, and an evaluation that ignores it measures the wrong quantity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出端到端基准，将选择与训练计入同一wall-clock预算，发现无选择器优于随机/全数据训练。
AI.motivation: 现有coreset选择评价只用固定子集大小下的下游精度，忽略选择耗时和训练配方，导致结论可能失真。
AI.method: 构建统一基准：4数据集(CIFAR-10到ImageNet-1K)、11选择器、5比例、3种子、超1500次运行；在选择器最优操作点下，用8个wall-clock预算锚点评估CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet；在ImageNet-1K做固定预算对决，并进行逐数据集成本审计。
AI.result: 没有任何预算锚点由复杂选择器胜出，胜者均为类别均衡随机、重复随机或全数据训练；ImageNet-1K上全数据少epoch训练优于所有选择策略且成本最低；选择成本由固定全数据扫描主导，难以通过小比例摊薄；记录9处代码正确性修复，其中一处使标准Herding基线变化近6点。
AI.conclusion: 选择时间不是免费预处理，忽略它的评估衡量了错误指标；选择仅在子集复用等特定情形下才可能回本。

title: World State Generator
summary: Language agents solve complex tasks through plans and actions. A single step the world refuses puts the goal out of reach, and what the agent does next decides the task. Prompted planners fail at exactly this point, rewriting the refused step in new words, meeting the same refusal, and burning the attempt budget without moving. They fail because the plan was never tied to the world, so a refusal has nothing in the plan to attach to. A world is where a task runs, and it has its own rules, its own admissible actions, and its own constraints. We build synthetic worlds across 7 domains and extract training data from them. A program enforces each world's rules and grades its goal, and every world is admitted only if its goal is reachable from its initial state. Agents run inside and leave verified failures paired with repairs that carried the run to a state the world certified, a record of about 226K trajectories. On this record we train the World State Generator, a model that writes a plan as checkable states of the world and keeps that plan aligned with the world it runs in. That alignment is what a plan written in language lacks, since the world it runs in has physical limits, logical dependencies, and required orders the language never states, and the plan encounters these rules only when a state fails. WSG takes that failure as the rule the world has stated and rewrites the remaining states to obey it, so the plan bends to the world as the run goes on. Across 7 public benchmarks, WSG raises end-to-end success for two open models near 30B parameters over prompting and brings to the level of proprietary model.

AI.tldr: 提出World State Generator (WSG)，通过合成世界与可验证轨迹训练，将计划写成可检查的世界状态并在执行中依据失败修正计划，在7个基准上显著提升开源模型成功率。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体用语言写计划，但计划从未与世界绑定；当某一步被世界拒绝时，提示式规划器只会换词重写，反复碰壁直至耗尽尝试预算。世界有其规则、可行动作与约束，语言却从未声明这些物理限制、逻辑依赖和必须的顺序，因此需要让计划在执行中随世界反馈而调整。
AI.method: 构建覆盖7个领域的合成世界，用程序强制执行规则并对目标打分，仅当目标从初始状态可达时才接纳该世界。智能体在其中运行，留下约226K条"已验证失败—修复"轨迹。据此训练WSG模型，将计划表示为可检查的世界状态，并在状态失败时把失败当作世界给出的规则，重写剩余状态以遵守该规则。
AI.result: 在7个公开基准上，WSG相比提示方法将近30B参数的两个开源模型的端到端成功率显著提升，并达到专有模型的水平。
AI.conclusion: 将计划从语言表述转为可检查的世界状态，并让计划在执行中依据失败持续对齐世界规则，是提升语言智能体任务成功率的关键。

title: Attributable Post-Rationalization in RAG Citations: A Controlled Reproduction and an RLVR Comparison
summary:
A RAG system can hand you the right answer and cite a source it did not actually use. Models output these unfaithful citations via post-rationalization: they write the answer first and then attach a citation to whatever passage looks close enough. Search agents are now trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which pays them for getting the answer right. We asked whether that training also teaches them to cite honestly.
  Improving an existing methodology with a required control, we compared an instruction-tuned model against three RLVR agents trained from it, on four question-answering datasets, using only free-tier Kaggle GPUs. Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.

AI.tldr: 在RAG系统中，模型常出现"事后合理化"式的不忠实引用（尤其Wikipedia问题上约1/7引用不忠实）；本文用RLVR训练的搜索agent与指令微调模型对比，发现RLVR并不能改善引用忠实性。
AI.motivation: RAG系统可能给出正确答案却引用并未实际使用的来源。模型通过"先写答案、再随便找个看似相关的段落贴上"来完成引用，即事后合理化(post-rationalization)。当前搜索agent普遍用RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）训练，奖励只看答案正确性。作者想探究：这种训练是否也能让模型学会诚实引用。
AI.method: 在现有方法基础上加入必要控制，对比一个指令微调模型与其衍生的三个RLVR agent。在四个问答数据集上评测，且仅使用Kaggle免费GPU。
AI.result: 事后合理化现象普遍存在：基于Wikipedia的问题中约七分之一的引用不忠实。RLVR未能解决该问题：各agent的不忠实引用率与基座模型相近，其中一个还略差。
AI.conclusion: 奖励答案正确并不能带来引用忠实性的提升。忠实性必须作为独立目标单独训练和度量，而不能指望答案正确性奖励顺带解决。

title: Epi-Logic: A Conceptual Framework for Epistemic Runtime Control, Schema Validity Checking, and Controlled Accommodation in Autonomous AI Agents
summary:
Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed in areas where wrong decisions are hard to reverse. This paper examines schema mismatch: the condition in which an agent operates within an interpretive frame that no longer applies to the current context. Outputs produced under such a mismatch can appear internally consistent, linguistically plausible, and largely factually correct; output-quality metrics alone therefore capture the underlying loss of validity only partially.
  The paper introduces Epi-Logic, a conceptual framework for epistemic runtime control. It couples the detection of schema dissonance, a graduated reduction of autonomy, and the auditable switch to a validated schema. A schema is formalised as a tuple of variable space, expectation model, validity conditions, axioms, and metadata. The Epi-Score aggregates seven graded dimensions of epistemic dissonance; the temporal validity dimension D8, violations of the validity conditions G, and axiom violations are carried as separate categorical paths that are not offset against the aggregate.
  The architecture rests on a checking asymmetry: formalised validity conditions can be checked at runtime, whereas the correctness of many actions is established only ex post. The paper separates two architectural properties, a conditional result from sequential changepoint detection, and an empirical remainder. Eight falsifiable propositions with named baselines describe the transition to empirical validation. All propositions are empirically testable hypotheses, not established results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Epi-Logic 概念框架，用于自主 AI 智能体的"认知运行时控制"，通过检测图式失配（schema mismatch）、分级降低自主性、并审计式切换到已验证图式，以应对输出质量指标无法充分捕捉的有效性丧失问题。
AI.motivation: 自主 AI 智能体日益部署于决策难以逆转的领域。当智能体运行于不再适用于当前情境的解释框架中时，会产生"图式失配"：其输出看似内部一致、语言合理、甚至大体事实正确，因此仅靠输出质量指标只能部分捕捉底层的有效性丧失。
AI.method: 提出 Epi-Logic 概念框架，将图式形式化为（变量空间、期望模型、有效性条件、公理、元数据）五元组。方法耦合三项机制：图式失调检测、自主性的渐进式削减、以及向已验证图式的可审计切换。Epi-Score 聚合七个分级失调维度；时间有效性维度 D8、有效性条件 G 的违反、公理违反作为独立分类路径，不与聚合分相互抵消。架构基于"校验不对称性"：形式化的有效性条件可在运行时检查，而许多动作的正确性只能事后确立。
AI.result: 论文区分了两类架构性质、一个来自序贯变点检测的条件性结果，以及一个经验性剩余项。并提出八条带命名基线的可证伪命题，用于描述向经验验证的过渡。
AI.conclusion: 全部命题均为可经验检验的假设，而非已确立的结果。该工作为概念与架构层面的贡献，其有效性有待实证验证。

title: Joint Domain-Class Modeling for Federated Learning Under Feature Skew
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without centralizing private data, but performance often degrades under feature skew: clients share labels while the conditional input distributions $p_i(x\!\mid\!y)$ vary due to latent, client-specific appearance factors. We propose Joint Domain-Class Federated Learning (JDFL), a lightweight, optimizer-agnostic extension that makes this latent domain variation usable without sharing raw data. JDFL first infers domain clusters called pseudo-domains from brief local update signals. It then expands the classifier head to output $M\times C$, joint (domain-class) logits. This allows the model to represent domain-conditioned appearance while keeping a shared backbone. To train the expanded head we introduce two complementary supervision strategies based on simple intuitions: a similarity-aware soft-labeling that transfers evidence between nearby inferred domains while allowing domain-specific specialization, and a per-sample randomized target assignment that perturbs supervision across the joint outputs and serves as a low-cost training-time regularizer. JDFL integrates with existing standard FL methods (e.g., FedAvg, SCAFFOLD) with minimal changes. Empirically, both supervision modes consistently improve global test accuracy on standard domain-shifted image benchmarks; ablations and sensitivity studies show the gains stem from the proposed supervision and parametrization rather than mere capacity increase.

AI.tldr: JDFL 通过推断"伪域"并将分类头扩展为域-类联合输出(M×C)，配合相似性感知软标签与随机目标分配两种监督策略，以轻量、与优化器无关的方式缓解联邦学习中的特征偏斜问题。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在特征偏斜下性能下降：客户端标签共享，但条件输入分布 p_i(x|y) 因客户端特有的潜在外观因素而变化。这种潜在的域差异未被利用，且不能共享原始数据。
AI.method: JDFL 先从简短的本地更新信号推断域聚类（伪域）；将分类头扩展为 M×C 的联合(域-类)logits，共享骨干网络以表示域条件化的外观；引入两种监督：(1) 相似性感知软标签，在邻近伪域间传递证据同时允许域特化；(2) 逐样本随机目标分配，扰动联合输出监督作为低成本正则化。可与 FedAvg、SCAFFOLD 等无缝集成。
AI.result: 在标准域偏移图像基准上，两种监督模式均持续提升全局测试准确率；消融与敏感性研究表明增益来自所提监督与参数化，而非单纯的容量增加。
AI.conclusion: JDFL 是一种轻量、优化器无关的扩展，使潜在域变化可用而无需共享原始数据，最小改动即可融入现有 FL 方法并有效提升域偏移下的性能。

title: Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文对比agentic与static RAG，发现聚合分数相近但在70.83%问题上答案不同，通过事后选择器利用二者互补性可显著超越任一单一流程。
AI.motivation: agentic RAG能否持续优于精心设计的static RAG尚不明确，且传统聚合比较可能掩盖问题层面的差异，需要受控对比来厘清两者关系。
AI.method: 在台湾历史问答任务上，共享同一生成器与混合检索后端，受控对比agentic与static RAG；并引入一个事后选择器，比较两种回答及其引用的证据，按问题选择更优答案。
AI.result: 两种流程聚合性能相近，但在70.83%的问题上结果不同、优势相互抵消；oracle按题选择比更优单一流程提升复合分数0.2417；选择器显著超过任一单一流程，并回收60.34%的oracle提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 聚合比较会掩盖检索策略在问题层面的实质差异，应利用不同流程的互补性，而非追求单一普遍最优流程。

title: Construting Reverse Thinking: Developing Large Language Models' Reverse Thingking Ability
summary: When facing complex problems, humans tend to try various ideas for different issues. Human thinking patterns exhibit remarkable flexibility in adapting to diverse scenarios. GPT-o1, GPT-o3, and DeepSeek-R1 adopt long chain-of-thought models to address complex problems by increasing reasoning depth, which default to a forward reasoning mode. We conducted statistical analysis on the accuracy of different mathematical problem datasets on models of different scales, and found five reasons for errors: Insufficient solution-space coverage, Computational mistakes, Unverified assumptions, Ignoring constraint conditions, Maximum response length limitation. To address the above issues, we proposed a backward reasoning pattern construction method aimed at enhancing the model's reverse thinking ability and dynamic adaptability. First, we constructed an easy-hard two-stage Math dataset for training large models and gradually improving their inference ability at different difficulty levels. The dataset contains forward reasoning paths as well as backward reasoning paths. And a two-stage supervised fine-tuning process is applied to progressively train the model's backward reasoning capability. Furthermore, a fine-grained reward mechanism is developed, employing smoothed reward signals to strengthen the model's ability to autonomously select thinking modes during the reasoning process, thereby avoiding reward hacking. A linear-decay balanced sampling strategy is designed to maintain a balance between forward and backward reasoning path samples during training, enabling the model to converge quickly and stably. Experimental results show that our method significantly improves reasoning efficiency and accuracy in tasks such as mathematical proofs, offering a flexible and efficient reasoning paradigm for solving complex problems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种"后向推理模式构建"方法，通过易-难两阶段数学数据集、两阶段监督微调、细粒度奖励机制和线性衰减平衡采样，增强模型逆向思维与动态适应能力，从而提升复杂数学推理的效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有长思维链模型（GPT-o1、GPT-o3、DeepSeek-R1）默认采用前向推理并靠增加推理深度解题。作者统计分析不同规模模型在数学数据集上的错误，发现五类问题：解空间覆盖不足、计算错误、未验证假设、忽略约束条件、最大响应长度限制。
AI.method: 1) 构建易-难两阶段数学数据集，含前向与后向推理路径，用于逐步训练大模型；2) 两阶段监督微调，渐进训练后向推理能力；3) 细粒度奖励机制，用平滑奖励信号强化模型自主选择思维模式，避免奖励黑客；4) 线性衰减平衡采样策略，维持前向与后向样本平衡，加快稳定收敛。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在数学证明等任务上显著提升了推理效率与准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为求解复杂问题提供了一种灵活高效的推理范式，通过引入后向推理与动态思维模式选择弥补单一前向推理的不足。

title: Token Utility Is Selection-Conditioned: Coupled Selection of Prompt Context and Response Supervision for Efficient Instruction Tuning
summary: Efficient large language model (LLM) instruction tuning requires selecting response supervision with supporting prompt context. Existing methods typically value both sides separately, risking selection-state mismatch between valuation and retained training subsets. BRIDGE (Budgeted Response-Prompt Interaction via Directional Gradient-guided Efficient Token Selection) captures selection-conditioned token utility through a shared validation-directed interaction surrogate valuing each side under the other's retained state. Budgeted alternating selection coordinates retained subsets by aggregating precomputed interactions over the current opposite-side subset to update conditional scores. Structure-aware projection converts conditional response scores into coherent supervision spans. Across three model families, BRIDGE leads compared selection methods overall in mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following. In mathematical reasoning, its advantage over independent selection grows with compression.

AI.tldr: BRIDGE提出一种面向LLM指令微调的高效数据选择方法，通过共享的验证导向交互代理联合评估prompt与response，并利用预算交替选择与结构感知投影生成连贯的监督片段，在多任务上优于现有选择方法且随压缩率提升优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 现有指令微调数据选择方法通常分别评估prompt和response，忽略了二者在对方保留状态下的相互影响，导致评估状态与最终保留训练子集之间不匹配。
AI.method: 提出BRIDGE方法，通过共享的验证导向、选择条件化的交互代理来评估token效用；采用预算交替选择，在当前对侧保留子集上聚合预计算交互以更新条件分数；并使用结构感知投影将条件response分数转化为连贯的监督片段。
AI.result: 在三种模型家族上，BRIDGE在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随任务中整体优于对比的选择方法；在数学推理任务中，其相对独立选择方法的优势随压缩率增加而扩大。
AI.conclusion: 联合考虑prompt与response交互作用的数据选择可有效缓解选择状态不匹配问题，提升指令微调效率与下游性能。

title: From Concept Alignment to Causal Grounding: An Intervention Test of Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) can sound plausible yet be unfaithful to the model's underlying reasoning. Most prior work probes CoT faithfulness through input--output behavior or input attributions, leaving internal computation largely underexplored. We instead cast faithfulness as internal concept grounding: Does a large language model's (LLM) CoT reasoning engage the same internal concepts that support the LLM's direct prediction, and do the shared concepts causally drive its answer? Encoding a prediction pass and a CoT pass with a single shared sparse autoencoder (SAE), a reliable approximator of the latent concepts LLMs use, makes their internal concepts directly comparable. We introduce three correlational metrics of concept-level alignment and a causal metric, $Δp$, which ablates the shared concepts and measures the drop in answer probability. Across five LLMs and four datasets, concept alignment is generally high, as indicated by the correlational metrics; yet these only identify which concepts are shared, not how much they causally contribute. $Δp$ fills this gap: causal faithfulness varies substantially with model depth, peaking at mid-to-late layers rather than the final ones, and model scale reshapes the layer-wise profile. Moreover, causally important shared concepts are not always verbalized in the CoT. These dissociations suggest that faithfulness cannot be reliably assessed from surface-level or representational correspondence alone; assessing it requires causal tests of whether the internal concepts underlying a CoT actually drive the model's prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将CoT忠实性视为内部概念对齐问题，用共享SAE比较预测与CoT推理的内部概念，并引入因果度量Δp，发现概念相关性与因果贡献并不一致。
AI.motivation: 已有CoT忠实性研究多依赖输入-输出行为或输入归因，忽视了模型内部计算过程，无法判断CoT是否真正使用了支撑其预测的内部概念。
AI.method: 用同一稀疏自编码器（SAE）分别编码预测过程与CoT过程，使二者内部概念可直接比较；提出三个概念级相关对齐指标，以及因果指标Δp——消融共享概念并测量答案概率下降。
AI.result: 在5个LLM、4个数据集上，概念相关对齐普遍较高；但Δp显示因果忠实性随模型深度显著变化，在中后层达峰而非末层，且模型规模改变层级分布；因果重要的共享概念未必在CoT中被表述出来。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠表层文本或表征对应无法可靠评估CoT忠实性，必须通过因果测试检验CoT背后的内部概念是否真正驱动模型预测。

title: Beyond Similarity: Coverage-Aware Prompt Selection for Time Series Forecasting with LLMs
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables
summary: Similarity-based retrieval is the dominant rule for conditioning large language models (LLMs) in in-context learning, retrieval-augmented generation, and prompt-based time series forecasting. The rule concentrates on near-duplicate candidates, an issue that has motivated diversity-aware retrieval but remains unexamined in other retrieval-conditioned pipelines. We study this issue using prompt-based time series forecasting as a test bed, where a learned prompt pool is retrieved by similarity. Dominant methods in this setting retrieve top-K entries by cosine similarity without redundancy control, producing a bias toward dominant temporal patterns while overlooking rare but informative events. We propose CASP-LLM, a coverage-aware semantic prompting framework that addresses this prompt selection bias by combining usage-tracking and saturating-gate techniques into a coverage regularizer that adds no learnable parameters. On six long-term benchmarks and the M4 short-term benchmark, CASP-LLM matches or improves on similarity-based LLM forecasters on most dataset-horizon settings, with the exceptions of Electricity, M4-Monthly, and the few-shot long-horizon setting. A controlled study locates the failure mode at the cross-batch usage level rather than per-retrieval redundancy: within-retrieval diversification such as MMR does not help, whereas regularizing anchor usage across training does.

AI.tldr: 论文指出相似度检索偏重近重复候选，提出无参数覆盖正则CASP-LLM，在时间序列预测基准上多数设置匹配或超越相似度基线。
AI.motivation: 相似度检索主导LLM的条件化（ICL、RAG、提示式时间序列预测），但集中于近重复候选造成对 dominant 模式的偏置、忽略稀有但信息丰富的事件；多样性感知检索虽已提出，其他检索条件化流程尚未被检验。
AI.method: 以提示式时间序列预测为试验台（prompt pool按相似度检索）。提出CASP-LLM覆盖感知语义提示框架，将usage-tracking与saturating-gate结合成覆盖正则项，不增加可学习参数，以缓解top-K余弦相似度检索的prompt选择偏置。
AI.result: 在六个长期基准与M4短期基准上，CASP-LLM在多数数据集-预测跨度设置上匹配或优于相似度LLM预测器；例外为Electricity、M4-Monthly和few-shot长期设置。受控实验定位失败模式在跨batch使用层面而非单次检索冗余：MMR类检索内多样化无帮助，而跨训练正则化anchor使用有效。
AI.conclusion: 相似度检索的偏置应通过在训练中正则跨批次使用覆盖而非单次检索内多样化来解决；覆盖感知提示为检索条件化LLM管线提供无参数改进路径。

title: Directing large language models to follow the letter or spirit of the law
summary: The distinction between the spirit and letter of the law is a central issue across research and everyday life, and a growing concern for building safe, intelligent machines. What is this distinction based on, and how can we develop machines that follow the intention behind a rule? We used targeted adaptation that made large language models prioritize the spirit or letter of the law. With minimal modifications, our method significantly changed LLM behavior across diverse measures, novel vignettes, real-world scenarios, and influential legal cases. An analysis of model internals revealed a low-dimensional space with three interpretable dimensions matching a formal pre-specified framework for the geometry of legal concepts. These findings show how legal thought in LLMs may be organized and directed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM如何区分法律的精神与字面，通过针对性适配使其分别优先遵循法律精神或字面，并揭示模型内部存在三维可解释的法律概念几何结构。
AI.motivation: 法律精神与字面的区分是法学研究和日常生活的重要议题，也对构建安全智能机器至关重要。作者希望探究这一区分的依据，以及如何让机器遵循规则背后的意图。
AI.method: 采用针对性适配方法，对大型语言模型进行最小修改，使其偏向于遵循法律的精神或字面；并在多样指标、新颖情境、真实场景和著名法律案例上检验行为变化，同时分析模型内部表征。
AI.result: 最小修改显著改变了LLM在多种测量、情境、真实场景和法律案例中的行为；模型内部存在一个低维空间，包含三个可解释维度，与预先设定的法律概念几何形式框架相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明LLM中的法律思维可以被组织和引导，为构建遵循规则意图的智能机器提供了可能。

title: GRUET: Quantifying Uncertainty of Agentic Reasoning-and-Acting Processes
summary: Agents have attracted considerably increasing attention due to the power of executing both Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) in open and dynamic environments. The ReAct process typically exhibits a multi-turn trajectory in which one drives Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate both reasoning chains and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. However, agents often suffer from significant uncertainty, where identical tasks yield divergent trajectories; trajectories with higher uncertainty often produce incomprehensible behaviors, severely undermining agent credibility. This work conjectures that such trajectory-level uncertainty frequently stems from cumulative turn-level reasoning uncertainty induced by LLMs; the latter often exhibits a collection of branches of divergent reasoning chains and their resulting actions. Built upon this, we present the Graph-based Reasoning UncErtainty in Trajectories (GRUET) method for the uncertainty quantification of ReAct, comprising turn-level reasoning uncertainty quantification and trajectory-level uncertainty aggregation; the former precisely quantifies reasoning uncertainty via modeling the reasoning space spanned by potential reasoning branches as a graph and then approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity, while the latter employs simple aggregation strategies for quantifying the overall trajectory credibility. Empirical evaluations across nine LLMs and five benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed GRUET in terms of selective generation performance, measured by AUROC, AUPRC, and AUARC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRUET方法，用于量化ReAct智能体轨迹级不确定性，通过图建模轮级推理不确定性并聚合为轨迹可信度。
AI.motivation: ReAct智能体在开放动态环境中存在显著不确定性，相同任务产生分歧轨迹，高不确定性轨迹行为难以理解，严重损害智能体可信度。作者推测轨迹级不确定性源于LLM累积的轮级推理不确定性。
AI.method: GRUET包含两部分：(1) 轮级推理不确定性量化，将潜在推理分支构成的推理空间建模为图，用图复杂度近似推理空间复杂度；(2) 轨迹级不确定性聚合，采用简单聚合策略量化整体轨迹可信度。
AI.result: 在九个LLM和五个基准上，以AUROC、AUPRC、AUARC为指标的选择性生成性能验证了GRUET的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRUET能有效量化ReAct轨迹不确定性，提升智能体可信度评估。

title: LPINNs: First-Layer Gated Localization for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use one shared representation over the computational domain, which can become difficult to optimize on long domains and for high-order operators. We study a minimal alternative: multiply the first hidden activation of an otherwise unchanged dense PINN by input-dependent localization functions, giving first-layer units receptive fields without partitioning the domain or adding interface losses. We screen 13 families of localization functions, in up to three parameterizations each, on a nonlinear harmonic oscillator (HO), a heat equation on a long spatial interval, and a manufactured four-dimensional (4D) fourth-order problem, with ten paired seeds throughout. Three configurations give large reductions in solution error at matched budgets: (i) Fixed Gaussian localization functions on the $2π$ HO domain cut mean solution RMSE from $4.8369\times10^{-1}$ to $8.83\times10^{-3}$ at 3k epochs. (ii) The inverse-quadratic family with learnable centers and widths cuts it from $2.896\times10^{-1}$ to $3.06\times10^{-2}$ on the $8π$ heat domain at 10k epochs. (iii) Fixed bump localization functions cut it from $1.75947\times10^{1}$ to $2.260\times10^{-1}$ on the $4π$ 4D domain at 10k epochs. Every paired seed improves in these three comparisons. The screen also shows that the mechanism is not a free win: on HO only 2 of 13 families beat the baseline, and 10 of the remaining 11 are 9 to 23 times worse; on 4D four families are non-finite and five are more than three orders of magnitude worse than the baseline. The inverse-quadratic family is the only one that beats the baseline on all three equations. Overall, these results show that first-layer localization can provide measurable improvements to baseline PINNs on long-domain and high-order problems.

AI.tldr: 通过在PINN第一隐藏层激活上乘以输入相关的局部化函数，为第一层单元赋予感受野，在不分区、不加界面损失的前提下，显著降低长域与高阶问题上的求解误差。
AI.motivation: 标准PINN在整个计算域共享同一表示，在长域和高阶算子上优化困难；而分区方法需引入界面损失等额外复杂度，故寻求一种最小改动的替代方案。
AI.method: 保留原有稠密PINN结构，仅将第一隐藏层激活乘以输入相关的局部化函数，从而为第一层单元赋予感受野，无需域分区或界面损失。在非线性谐振子（HO）、长空间区间热方程、四维四阶制造解三类问题上，每类测试13个局部化函数族（最多三种参数化），并使用十组配对随机种子进行筛选。
AI.result: 三种配置在同等预算下大幅降低误差：（i）固定高斯局部化在2π HO域上将平均RMSE从4.8369×10⁻¹降至8.83×10⁻³（3k轮）；（ii）可学习中心与宽度的反二次族在8π热域上从2.896×10⁻¹降至3.06×10⁻²（10k轮）；（iii）固定bump函数在4π 4D域上从1.75947×10¹降至2.260×10⁻¹（10k轮），且上述三组比较中每组配对种子均有改善。同时筛选表明该机制并非免费：HO上仅2/13族优于基线，其余11族中10族差9至23倍；4D上有4族非有限、5族比基线差三个数量级以上。反二次族是唯一在三个方程上均优于基线的函数族。
AI.conclusion: 第一层局部化能为基线PINN在长域和高阶问题上带来可测量的改进，但效果高度依赖所选的局部化函数族，并非普适的免费提升。

title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
summary: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.

AI.tldr: OmniEdu 是一套面向 K-12 教学的开放基础模型系列，通过按四种能力（学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理、教学行动与支架）组织的指令微调语料，对 4B/9B/27B 模型进行微调，在多项教育基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有教育语言模型多偏向问题求解或辅导中的单一方向，且训练数据按来源或任务而非能力组织，难以同时覆盖解题、课程理解、诊断与教学支持等教育核心需求，因此需要能力均衡的教育基础模型。
AI.method: 构建 OmniEdu 系列：整合 100+ 教育资源与通用指令源，围绕四种能力组织语料；采用确定性清洗、语义审计与改写、任务特定质量评分、按 token 预算的多样性选择、教学指令分配的流水线，得到 69,999 条样本、15.96M 监督响应 token（含 60,951 条教育专属样本）；微调 4B、9B、27B 模型。
AI.result: 教育导向微调在各模型规模上一致提升三类教育基准。OmniEdu-27B 在 K12-Bench 上达 63.12% EM、76.69% F1，MathFish 85.89%，EDUMATH 86.95%，MathTutorBench 的 Scaffold 设置 78.74%；在 LongTutor 上取得最高 Teaching 平均分 3.02。
AI.conclusion: 精挑细选、能力均衡的监督数据对将通用语言模型适配到涵盖解题、课程理解与教学支持的教育任务具有重要价值。

title: MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution
summary: Medical agents increasingly combine general reasoning models with specialized clinical tools, yet their capabilities remain largely fixed by what clinicians and engineers design before deployment. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a different paradigm in which agents learn from their own failures and autonomously expand their capabilities, but directly applying RSI to medicine introduces fundamental safety challenges. We introduce MedRSI, the first recursive self-improvement framework for medicine, which continuously transforms diagnostic failures into new clinical capabilities through tool composition and task-specific model training. Inspired by clinical practice, MedRSI introduces two mechanisms for clinically aligned self-evolution. Clinical-cost-aware failure prioritization directs improvement toward errors according to their potential clinical consequences rather than frequency alone. Fast discovery with slow registration separates rapid capability invention from conservative adoption, allowing new tools to enter the persistent agent only after demonstrating sustained benefit across subsequent patient cohorts. Across public glaucoma and heart disease benchmarks and two private clinical tasks, MedRSI progressively develops segmentation, measurement, prediction, multimodal reasoning, and generative capabilities, surpasses manually engineered medical agents, and autonomously discovers solutions to clinical problems not anticipated by its original designers. Our results show that medical agents need not remain constrained by capabilities specified before deployment: with clinically grounded mechanisms governing what to improve and what to retain, they can continuously construct, validate, and accumulate new capabilities from diagnostic experience. Code is available at https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI.

AI.tldr: MedRSI 是首个面向医疗的递归自我改进框架，能持续将诊断失败转化为新临床能力，且不需预先设计。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗智能体能力在部署前由临床医生和工程师固定，无法自主扩展；直接将递归自我改进（RSI）用于医疗会带来根本性安全挑战。
AI.method: MedRSI 通过工具组合与任务专用模型训练，将诊断失败转化为新能力。提出两项临床对齐机制：1）临床成本感知的失败优先级排序，按临床后果而非频率决定改进方向；2）快速发现与缓慢注册分离，新工具须在后续患者队列中持续获益才被采纳。
AI.result: 在公开青光眼和心脏病基准及两个私人临床任务上，MedRSI 逐步发展出分割、测量、预测、多模态推理与生成能力，超越人工设计的医疗智能体，并自主发现原始设计者未预见的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 医疗智能体不必受部署前能力的限制；在临床机制引导下，它们能持续从诊断经验中构建、验证并积累新能力。

title: Chronologic: Measuring Language Models' Ability to Represent the Past
summary: Language models are appealing tools for research on the past. But to trust the evidence a model provides, researchers need to know whether its responses fit the period represented. Validation is challenging, because this is not a task living people ordinarily perform, and because many questions have multiple correct answers. We use historical texts to develop a benchmark for a model's representation of English-language contexts 1831-1930, relying on pairwise comparisons to multiple ground truths and strong distractors to score the hardest questions in an appropriately graduated way. We find that generative tasks are harder than discriminative ones; in fact, reasoning models can typically discern the weakness of their own generated answers. While models pretrained exclusively on historical text lead the pack when evaluated by answer likelihood, they cannot compete with commercial models in free generation. None of the models we tested represent historical contexts in a fully persuasive way yet, but progress toward that goal is evident.

AI.tldr: 本文利用历史文本构建了1831-1930年英语语境表征基准，通过多重正确答案与强干扰项的成对比较，分级评估模型最难题，发现生成任务难于判别任务，历史文本预训练模型在似然评估上领先但在自由生成上不及商业模型。
AI.motivation: 研究者希望用语言模型研究历史，但需确认模型回答是否符合所表征的历史时期。由于此类任务并非日常人所做，且许多问题有多个正确答案，验证十分困难，因此需要专门的基准。
AI.method: 使用历史文本构建基准，评估模型对1831-1930年英语语境的表征；采用对多个ground truth和强干扰项的成对比较，对最难题进行分级评分。
AI.result: 生成任务比判别任务更难；推理模型通常能识别自身生成答案的弱点；仅在历史文本上预训练的模型在按答案似然评估时领先，但在自由生成上无法与商业模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: 目前所测试模型均未能完全令人信服地表征历史语境，但已显现出向该目标迈进的进展。

title: Extracting Arguments, Not Just Classifying Them: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Generative Component Detection
summary: Argumentative component detection (ACD) is a core subtask of Argument(ation) Mining (AM) and one of its most challenging aspects, as it requires jointly delimiting argumentative spans and classifying them into components such as claims and premises. While research on this subtask remains relatively limited compared to other AM tasks, most existing approaches formulate it as a simplified sequence labeling problem, component classification, or a pipeline of component segmentation followed by classification. In this paper, we propose ITFACD, a novel approach based on instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) using compact instruction-based prompts, and reframe ACD as a language generation task, enabling arguments to be identified directly from plain text without relying on pre-segmented components. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our approach achieves higher performance compared to state-of-the-art systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first attempts to fully model ACD as a generative task, highlighting the potential of instruction tuning for complex AM problems. Our code and the datasets used are openly available in the following GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ITFACD，基于指令微调的大语言模型，将论证组件检测（ACD）重构为语言生成任务，直接从纯文本中识别论证成分，在标准基准上超越现有最优系统。
AI.motivation: ACD是论证挖掘的核心且最具挑战的子任务，需同时划定论证跨度并将其分类为主张、前提等组件。但现有研究相对有限，多数方法将其简化为序列标注、组件分类，或"先分割再分类"的流水线，限制了性能。
AI.method: 提出ITFACD方法：基于指令微调的大语言模型（LLM），使用紧凑的指令式提示（compact instruction-based prompts），将ACD重新定义为语言生成任务，使论证可直接从纯文本中识别，无需依赖预先分割的组件。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的实验表明，该方法相比当前最先进的系统取得了更高的性能。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首次将ACD完全建模为生成任务的尝试之一，凸显了指令微调在复杂论证挖掘问题上的潜力。代码与数据集已开源于GitHub。

title: Interpretable Multi-Hypersphere Deep Anomaly Detection for Open-set Supervised Anomaly Detection
summary: Multi-class open-set anomaly detection requires a model to characterize the normal acceptance domain formed by multiple heterogeneous subdistributions using only class-labeled samples from known normal classes, and to identify previously unseen anomalies at test time. Existing single-hypersphere methods cannot explicitly represent class-specific locations and acceptance ranges, while current multi-hypersphere or multi-class approaches do not fully integrate inter-class boundary constraints, learnable acceptance ranges, and interpretable decisions. To address these limitations, we propose Interpretable Multi-Hypersphere Deep Anomaly Detection (IMHD-AD). IMHD-AD constructs an independent hypersphere for each known normal class in a shared feature space. With target-inside and non-target-outside constraints, IMHD-AD embeds the class-specific hypersphere centers and radii directly into the final network layer and jointly optimizes them with the shared representation. The minimum signed boundary score across hyperspheres simultaneously determines open-set acceptance or rejection and provides a faithful geometric explanation of each decision. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, IMHD-AD achieves the highest AUC in 28 of 30 open-set comparisons. A two-dimensional synthetic study further shows that model architecture must balance the compactness of known normal classes against the separability of unknown anomalies.

AI.tldr: 提出IMHD-AD方法，为每个已知正常类构建独立超球体，实现可解释的多类开集异常检测，在多数对比中取得最高AUC。
AI.motivation: 多类开集异常检测需仅用已知正常类样本刻画由多个异构子分布组成的正常接受域，并识别测试时未见异常。现有单超球方法无法显式表示类特定位置与接受范围；现有多超球或多类方法未充分整合类间边界约束、可学习接受范围与可解释决策。
AI.method: IMHD-AD在共享特征空间中为每个已知正常类构建独立超球体。通过目标在内、非目标在外的约束，将类特定超球中心与半径直接嵌入最终网络层，并与共享表示联合优化。跨超球的最小带符号边界分数同时决定开集接受/拒绝，并提供忠实的几何解释。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上，IMHD-AD在30个开集对比中的28个取得最高AUC。二维合成研究进一步表明，模型架构需在已知正常类的紧凑性与未知异常的可分性之间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: IMHD-AD为多类开集异常检测提供了整合类间边界约束、可学习接受范围与可解释决策的统一框架，并通过实验验证其有效性与架构设计启示。

title: Low resource cross-modal alignment using HGNN to enhance speech representation
summary: Speech-text space alignment is a multimodal representation learning method consisting to map different speech and text into a shared representation space, leading to enrichment of the representation of each modality. Proposed architectures, such as SAMU-XLSR, typically follow a student/teacher framework, with the goal of fine-tuning an audio encoder to produce representations that closely match those of the text. In this way a speech representation is semantically enriched. However, such systems generally require large amounts of training data and considerable computational resource, making them difficult to apply to low resources languages under frugal constraints. The present work proposes a data-efficient space alignment method based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks and link prediction. The core idea is to leverage message passing to explicitly transfer information from the text modality to the speech modality, thereby reducing the need for large training datasets and intrinsically enriching the acoustic representations, all in a more interpretable manner. Although thoroughly explored for high-resource languages, word-level tasks in speech remain relevant for certain low-resource languages. Therefore, we conducted experiments on speech-text alignment at the word level using the TIMIT (English) dataset and Yemba (a Cameroonian language). Our approach yields results comparable to those of SAMU-XLSR, a state-of-the-art method, and even surpasses it for the Yemba language in the task of word retrieval, while using far fewer resources, demonstrating its power, frugality, and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于异构图神经网络与链接预测的数据高效语音-文本空间对齐方法，用消息传递将文本信息传递到语音模态，在TIMIT和Yemba上以更少资源达到甚至超越SAMU-XLSR表现。
AI.motivation: 现有语音-文本空间对齐方法（如SAMU-XLSR）采用师生框架，需大量训练数据和计算资源，难以应用于资源匮乏的低资源语言。
AI.method: 基于异构神经网络（Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks）与链接预测（link prediction）的数据高效对齐方法，核心是借助消息传递将文本模态信息显式迁移到语音模态，减少训练数据需求并提升可解释性。
AI.result: 在词级语音-文本对齐任务上，基于TIMIT（英语）和Yemba（喀麦隆语言）实验，性能与SAMU-XLSR相当，在Yemba词检索任务上甚至超越，且使用资源远少。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明在资源受限条件下可高效、节俭地实现语音-文本对齐，对低资源语言尤具潜力。

title: Partner-Specific Affective Precision in Social Active Inference
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures. Accepted as a full paper at the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026). Code: https://github.com/har5h1l/affect_aif
summary: In multi-agent social settings, model reliability varies across relationships. Beyond inferring what others will do, an agent must calibrate how confidently those inferences should guide policy selection for each relationship. An agent may maintain a well-validated model of one partner, a fragile model of another, and a model under revision for a third; collapsing these into a single confidence estimate loses information relevant to policy selection. We therefore formalize affective precision as a relationship-specific metacognitive estimate of confidence in the current partner model. Each partner's behavioral evidence updates a local confidence estimate that modulates policy precision during selection, regulating how strongly current beliefs are expressed in policy rather than changing the content of those beliefs. Simulations in a multi-partner graded trust game show that partner-local affective precision influences behavior primarily through policy commitment rather than direct improvement of partner-state inference. Because the mechanism tracks partner-response predictability rather than realized payoff, greater confidence produces sharper policy commitment without necessarily producing higher rewards. Under abrupt shifts in social behavior, confidence accumulated from previously reliable predictions can remain behaviorally active after the relationship changes, showing that confidence revision can lag behind social change. Finally, varying precision gain and priors produce distinct trust-calibration dynamics, showing how confidence accumulation and revision depend on model parameters. Together, these results show how relationship-specific affective precision can distinguish social prediction from social policy commitment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"关系特异性情感精度"这一元认知机制：每个伙伴的局部置信度调节策略精度，从而区分"社会预测"与"社会策略承诺"。
AI.motivation: 多智能体社交中模型可靠性因关系而异，将不同伙伴的模型置信度合并为单一估计会丢失对策略选择有用的信息，因此需要关系特异性的置信度校准。
AI.method: 形式化"情感精度"为对当前伙伴模型置信度的关系特异性元认知估计；各伙伴的行为证据更新局部置信度，并在策略选择中调节策略精度（改变信念表达强度而非信念内容）；在多伙伴分级信任博弈中进行仿真。
AI.result: 局部情感精度主要通过策略承诺影响行为，而非直接改善伙伴状态推断；机制追踪伙伴反应可预测性而非实际收益，故高置信度带来更锐利的策略承诺却未必更高奖励；社会行为突变时旧置信度仍具行为活性，显示置信度修正滞后于社会变化；不同精度增益与先验产生不同信任校准动态。
AI.conclusion: 关系特异性情感精度能够区分社会预测与社会策略承诺，强调置信度校准在关系层面的重要性。

title: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models repeatedly apply a weight-shared block to increase effective depth without increasing parameter count, but the resulting T sequential recurrent-block calls per generated token substantially increase decoding latency. To address the issue, we introduce Wavefront Decoding (WFD), a training-free self-speculative decoding framework designed for looped language models. WFD exploits two properties of these architectures: intermediate recurrence outputs provide effective draft predictions, and weight sharing allows token states at different positions and recurrence depths to be processed in one batched recurrent-block call. WFD organizes these mixed-depth states into a diagonal wavefront, continuously drafting new positions at shallow depth while advancing earlier positions toward full-depth verification. Unlike the phase-separated draft-then-verify schedule, WFD therefore co-batches drafting and verification within the same recurrent calls, while rejected drafts are corrected using full-depth predictions. Across six Spec-Bench task categories, WFD achieves 2.42x speedup on Ouro-2.6B and 3.54x on Huginn-3.5B over autoregressive decoding, consistently outperforming draft-then-verify. Cross-recurrence KV sharing further reduces wavefront KV traffic and increases WFD's speedup to 4.81x on Huginn-3.5B.

AI.tldr: 提出Wavefront Decoding（WFD），一种面向循环语言模型的无训练自推测解码框架，通过斜向波前组织混合深度状态，将起草与验证共批处理，实现2.42x-4.81x加速。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过权重共享块增加有效深度而不增加参数量，但每个生成token需T次顺序循环块调用，导致解码延迟大幅增加。
AI.method: WFD利用两个特性：中间循环输出可作有效草稿预测；权重共享允许不同位置和循环深度的token状态在单次批处理循环块调用中处理。它将混合深度状态组织为对角波前，持续在浅层起草新位置，同时推进早期位置向全深度验证。不同于分离式的先草稿后验证，WFD在同一循环调用中共批处理起草与验证，被拒草稿用全深度预测修正。
AI.result: 在六个Spec-Bench任务类别上，Ouro-2.6B取得2.42x加速，Huginn-3.5B取得3.54x加速，持续优于先草稿后验证。跨循环KV共享进一步减少波前KV流量，Huginn-3.5B加速提升至4.81x。
AI.conclusion: WFD为循环语言模型提供高效无训练解码方案，通过深度混合的波前调度与KV共享显著降低延迟。

title: Enhancing speech representation learning with cross-modal knowledge transfer with HGNN under low resource settings: the case study of Yemba
summary: Acoustic representation learning is crucial for speech processing, yet low-resource languages (LRLs) face severe data scarcity, limiting the effectiveness of traditional and self-supervised methods. As a promising alternative, in this work, we propose to enhance acoustic representation trough a cross-modal transfer knowledge approach, based on heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs), where acoustic and linguistic entities are modeled as distinct node types within a unified graph. Through message-passing mechanisms, linguistic nodes explicitly transfer knowledge to acoustic nodes, enabling structured and interpretable cross-modal information flow. To highlight this knowledge transfer and its benefits, we measured standard clustering metrics as an intrinsic evaluation of acoustic representation, and to emphasize applicability, we performed isolated-word recognition tasks using an English benchmark and a Cameroonian language dataset in low resources settings . Results demonstrate that acoustic representations consistently benefit from linguistic knowledge propagated through the graph. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of explicit cross-modal knowledge transfer for acoustic representation learning using HGNNs, highlighting a promising direction for speech representation in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 提出基于异质图神经网络(HGNN)的跨模态知识迁移方法，利用语言节点向声学节点传递知识，提升低资源语言的声学表示。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言(LRL)面临严重数据稀缺，传统与自监督方法效果受限，需寻找可替代的表示学习途径。
AI.method: 构建统一异质图，将声学与语言实体建模为不同节点类型，通过消息传递机制让语言节点显式向声学节点迁移结构化、可解释的跨模态信息。
AI.result: 标准聚类指标显示声学表示从语言知识中持续受益；在英语基准及低资源喀麦隆语言数据集上的孤立词识别任务验证了其适用性。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明用HGNN进行显式跨模态知识迁移可增强声学表示，为低资源语音表示提供有前景的方向。

title: Pinocchio: Fast Uncertainty Estimates for Black-Box Language Models
summary: In high-stakes decision-making applications of large language models (LLMs), practitioners require not only accurate LLMs but also uncertainty estimates for their predictions. Existing approaches to uncertainty estimation for LLMs require access to log-probabilities output by the model or require fine-tuning access. However, many industrial LLM products use closed-source API models, and many such API models like GPT do not return log-probabilities and may not allow fine-tuning. We introduce Pinocchio, an external calibrator that estimates the correctness of responses from black-box API models. Trained jointly on responses from seven LLMs, it achieves 0.862 AUROC predicting the correctness of held-out responses from those same models, and shows zero-shot transfer to thirteen unseen models across eight organizations. Our model needs only a single forward pass to generate an uncertainty estimate and requires no access to the target model's logits, weights, or internal states. A lightweight text only 0.8B checkpoint matches our largest model's AUROC. We release code for adding uncertainty estimation to existing repos in only two additional lines of code.

AI.tldr: Pinocchio 是一个外部校准器，仅凭黑盒 API 模型的文本输出即可估计其回答正确性，无需访问 logits、权重或内部状态，在新模型上展现零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 高风险场景下 LLM 不仅要求准确，还需不确定性估计，但现有方法依赖 log-probabilities 或微调权限，而许多闭源 API 模型（如 GPT）不提供这些。
AI.method: 训练一个外部校准器，联合七种 LLM 的回答，仅用单次前向传播生成不确定性估计，不接触目标模型的 logits、权重或内部状态；提供仅需两行代码的集成方案。
AI.result: 在同一批模型留出回答上达到 0.862 AUROC，并零样本迁移到 8 个组织的 13 个未见模型；0.8B 纯文本检查点与最大模型 AUROC 相当。
AI.conclusion: Pinocchio 为黑盒 API 模型提供了实用、轻量的不确定性估计方案，可低成本集成到现有系统中。

title: Optimizers for Diffusion Models: A Controlled Benchmark
summary: Discrete diffusion models now match autoregressive language models on several benchmarks, while the question of how best to train them has received far less attention: the optimizer is inherited from one paper to the next and never compared. New optimizers, meanwhile, are validated almost exclusively on autoregressive pretraining, a different objective on a different loss surface. We present a controlled optimizer benchmark across four diffusion formulations, to our knowledge the first for discrete diffusion: seven optimizers (AdamW, Lion, Muon, SOAP, MARS, MARS-M, Schedule-Free) on masked diffusion (text8), uniform diffusion (QM9, and LM1B through the Gaussian duality) and Gaussian diffusion on images (CelebA-64), each on a task with published reference values. Every optimizer receives the same search protocol, and every winner is retrained at the full budget with three seeds. AdamW is a strong default but not always the right choice: it is beaten by a resolved margin on two of the four tasks, and the winner changes with the formulation, so the optimizer deserves the same care as the rest of the training recipe. Notably, methods validated on autoregressive language model pretraining transfer well: Muon, MARS-M and SOAP each beat the tuned AdamW on at least one diffusion formulation. The benchmark, all runs and every figure are reproducible end to end from the released code at https://github.com/armanbolatov/diffusion-baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统对比离散扩散模型的优化器，发现AdamW虽强但非最优，最佳优化器随扩散形式变化，且自回归预训练验证的Muon等优化器可迁移。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型已能匹配自回归语言模型，但优化器长期沿用、从未被系统比较；新优化器又仅在自回归预训练上验证，与扩散目标损失面不同，缺乏控制变量的基准。
AI.method: 在四种扩散形式上做受控优化器基准：七种优化器（AdamW、Lion、Muon、SOAP、MARS、MARS-M、Schedule-Free），覆盖掩码扩散(text8)、均匀扩散(QM9、经高斯对偶的LM1B)与图像高斯扩散(CelebA-64)，每任务有公开参考值。所有优化器采用相同搜索协议，优胜者以全预算、三随机种子重训。
AI.result: AdamW是强默认但非总是最优：在四个任务中的两个上被显著超越；最优优化器随扩散形式变化。在自回归预训练上验证的方法迁移良好，Muon、MARS-M、SOAP各自在至少一个扩散形式上击败调优后的AdamW。
AI.conclusion: 优化器选择应与训练配方其他部分同等对待，需针对具体扩散形式调优；基准、所有运行与图表均可通过发布代码端到端复现。

title: Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics
summary: Reasoning language models are trained to produce solutions, not to refuse them, and this bias persists when the problem they are handed is false. Asked to prove a corrupted theorem, a strong model will typically comply and produce a confident derivation of something untrue. We present Euston, an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist exactly this. Training data were generated with GraphSynth, a probabilistic factor-graph generator that couples attribute-level diversity to decode-time structural masking and span-synchronized verification, yielding 3{,}026 matched true/corrupted statement pairs (6,052 statements) drawn from arXiv papers spanning 2010--2025. We fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-8B with GRPO under a rule-based, zero-API reward for 189 steps on four H100 GPUs. On a balanced 200-true/200-false held-out split, balanced accuracy rises from 29.50% to 63.75% and the discrimination gap---the difference between the rate of calling false statements false and the rate of calling true statements false moves from -0.5% (z=-0.1) to +27.5% (z=+6.0). Critically, the gain is not purchased with general mathematical ability: AIME 2026 accuracy under official semantics is 65.00% against a 69.17% base, a difference of -4.17% that is not statistically significant, whereas an earlier run of the same recipe on a smaller GraphSynth corpus collapsed to 40.00%. Median response length also falls from 19,217 to 18,296 tokens and the truncation rate from 25.8% to 8.3%, so the improvement does not come from thinking longer. We report the result together with the confounds that bound its interpretation, principally the all-false composition of the official evaluation sets and the low precision implied at realistic error prevalence.

AI.tldr: Euston：一个8B数学命题验证模型，通过GraphSynth生成配对真假命题数据并用GRPO微调DeepSeek-R1-8B，平衡准确率从29.50%提升至63.75%，且未损害通用数学能力。
AI.motivation: 推理语言模型被训练来产出解答而非拒绝，即使面对错误命题也会自信地给出错误推导。本文希望训练模型抵抗这种偏差，能够识别并拒绝被篡改的数学命题。
AI.method: 1) GraphSynth：概率因子图生成器，将属性级多样性、解码时结构掩码与跨度同步验证耦合，生成3026对匹配的真/篡改命题（6052条），取自2010–2025年arXiv论文；2) 用GRPO在规则化、零API奖励下，于4块H100上对DeepSeek-R1-8B微调189步。
AI.result: 在200真/200假的平衡留出集上，平衡准确率从29.50%升至63.75%，判别差距从-0.5%(z=-0.1)升至+27.5%(z=+6.0)。AIME 2026准确率65.00%对比基线69.17%（-4.17%，不显著），而早期小语料版本曾崩溃至40.00%。中位响应长度从19217降至18296 tokens，截断率从25.8%降至8.3%。
AI.conclusion: Euston能显著提升数学真假命题判别能力，且提升并非通过延长思考或牺牲通用数学能力换来。作者同时指出结果受若干混杂因素限制，主要是官方评测集全为假命题、以及在实际错误发生率下精度偏低。

title: MolSC: Leveraging Substituent Contributions to Enhance Fine-grained Molecular Understanding in LLMs
summary: Recent advances in natural language processing have led to molecular Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong performance across diverse chemistry tasks. However, they still struggle to capture fine-grained structure-property relationships, particularly how small, localized modifications alter a molecule's behavior. To address this limitation, we introduce MolSC, a dataset of substituent contributions, defined as property changes induced by attaching specific substituents to molecular scaffolds. Curated from manually annotated bioactivity records, MolSC spans structural-alert liability, target-specific bioactivity, and physicochemical descriptors, and contains 181K substituent-level examples for training. We further propose MolSC-Bench, a held-out evaluation benchmark of 1,541 examples disjoint from MolSC at the scaffold, substituent, and molecule levels. Our experiments show that existing molecular LLMs and strong proprietary models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3-Flash show limited reliability in substituent contribution prediction. In contrast, training on MolSC substantially improves this ability and achieves strong performance across diverse downstream molecular tasks. These results highlight substituent contribution learning as a key component of fine-grained molecular understanding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MolSC数据集（18.1万条取代基贡献样本）及MolSC-Bench评测基准，用于评估分子LLM对细粒度结构-性质关系的理解，发现现有模型表现有限，而基于MolSC训练可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 分子LLM在多种化学任务上表现良好，但难以捕捉细粒度结构-性质关系，尤其是局部小修饰如何改变分子行为（取代基贡献）。
AI.method: 构建MolSC数据集：从人工标注的生物活性记录中整理，覆盖结构警报风险、靶点特异性生物活性和理化描述符，含18.1万条取代基级训练样本；并设计MolSC-Bench（1,541例），在骨架、取代基和分子层面与训练集完全不重叠。
AI.result: 现有分子LLM及GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Flash等强专有模型在取代基贡献预测上可靠性有限；在MolSC上训练可大幅提升该能力，并在多样下游分子任务中取得强性能。
AI.conclusion: 取代基贡献学习是细粒度分子理解的关键组成部分。

title: ChemCLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Multilingual Chemical Patents
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 22 pages including references and appendices; 7 pages of main text
summary:
Cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) is increasingly important in multi-national industries, where critical technical evidence may exist in a different language than the query. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately capture domain-specific cross-lingual retrieval or the retrieval-depth and recoverability failures that aggregate recall hides.
  In this work, we benchmark CLIR in the chemical domain, with a focus on patent data. We construct a multilingual dataset from Google Patents and the European Patent Office (EPO) data, spanning five languages (covering major Eastern and Western languages) and reflecting the diversity and complexity of real-world industrial documentation.
  Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate eight state-of-the-art embedding models for cross-lingual retrieval. Our results show a substantial performance gap between monolingual and cross-lingual settings: for the best-performing model, Recall@10 drops from 0.72 to 0.53 in cross-lingual setting. Retrieval depth also degrades significantly, with relevant documents ranked lower across languages in cross-lingual scenarios. Furthermore, some multilingual embedding models that perform strongly in monolingual settings exhibit sharp declines when queries and documents are in different languages, providing practical insights for model selection in cross-lingual use cases.
  These findings highlight critical limitations of current approaches and emphasize the need for more robust cross-lingual retrieval methods in domain-specific settings. Our benchmark provides actionable insights for model selection and establishes a controlled diagnostic evaluation framework for CLIR over industrial technical text. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/MohammadKhodadad/Multi-Lingual-QAC.

AI.tldr: 本文针对化学领域专利数据构建多语言CLIR基准，评估8个嵌入模型，发现跨语言检索性能显著低于单语言，并揭示检索深度与召回恢复性问题。
AI.motivation: 跨国产业中关键技术证据常以不同语言存在，跨语言信息检索（CLIR）愈发重要。然而现有基准未能充分覆盖领域特定的跨语言检索，也忽视了聚合召回率所掩盖的检索深度与可恢复性失败问题。
AI.method: 从Google Patents与欧洲专利局（EPO）构建涵盖五种语言（东西方主要语言）的多语言数据集，反映真实工业文档的多样性与复杂性；基于该数据集系统评估八个先进嵌入模型在跨语言检索上的表现。
AI.result: 单语言与跨语言存在明显性能差距：最佳模型Recall@10从0.72降至0.53；检索深度也显著退化，相关文档在跨语言场景中排名更低；部分在单语言表现优异的多语言嵌入模型在跨语言时性能急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示当前方法的严重局限，强调领域特定场景下需要更鲁棒的跨语言检索方法；所提供基准为模型选择提供实用见解，并建立面向工业技术文本CLIR的可控诊断评估框架，数据与代码已公开。

title: BackTrend: Evaluating Scientific Weak-Signal Prediction via Backward Reconstruction
summary: Scientific weak signals are early, low-visibility research directions that later become central to mature scientific topics, yet existing resources such as trend tracking, citation forecasting, and foresight reports rarely provide validated reference sets that link concrete early precursors to later paradigms. We introduce BackTrend, a retrospective benchmark in which, given a mature target topic and a temporal evidence constraint, systems must recover two types of precursors: problem-space signals, underrecognized research problems, and solution-space signals, emerging methods for known problems. BackTrend contains 25 mature target topics in artificial intelligence and machine learning and 66 human-validated weak signals, reconstructed from large-scale literature by grounding each candidate in its 2019-2024 publication-frequency trajectory. We evaluate frontier LLMs, RAG systems, and agentic research systems using semantic matching and coverage-based metrics. Current systems often generate plausible but misaligned precursors, exhibiting topic drift, granularity mismatch, near-miss matching, and incomplete coverage; the strongest system achieves only 10.1% F1, while Coverage10 reaches at most 18.5% of the reference signals. Our budget analyses show that additional retrieval and web-search evidence can improve performance up to a moderate budget, but does not by itself close the substantial performance gap.

AI.tldr: 提出BackTrend回溯基准，用2019-2024文献频率轨迹重建66个经人工验证的科学弱信号，评估LLM/RAG/智能体系统识别早期前兆的能力，结果表明现有系统表现很差（最高F1仅10.1%）。
AI.motivation: 科学弱信号是后来成为成熟主题核心的早期低可见度研究方向，但现有趋势追踪、引用预测和前瞻报告资源很少提供经过验证的参考集，将具体早期前兆与后期范式联系起来。
AI.method: 构建BackTrend回溯基准：给定成熟目标主题和时间证据约束，系统需恢复两类前兆——问题空间信号（被低估的研究问题）和解决空间信号（已知问题的新兴方法）；包含AI/ML领域25个成熟主题和66个经人工验证的弱信号，基于大规模文献以2019-2024发表频率轨迹为每个候选项提供依据；用语义匹配和覆盖率指标评估前沿LLM、RAG和智能体研究系统。
