These findings offer concrete design guidance for deploying multilingual Speech-LLMs in privacy-sensitive, distributed environments.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了多语言语音识别联邦学习基准，评测四种Speech-LLM架构，发现分组件调学习率和全三组件适配最优，且FedProx效果依赖架构。
AI.motivation: 在多语言自动语音识别中部署Speech-LLM面临隐私敏感的分布式环境需求，但缺乏针对联邦学习下多语言Speech-LLM的系统性评测与设计指导。
AI.method: 基于Multilingual LibriSpeech数据集，评测四种Speech-LLM架构，对比FedAvg与FedProx，在冻结/非冻结编码器配置下进行实验；分别独立调节语音编码器、连接器、解码器的学习率，并采用LoRA（编码器/解码器）+全训练（连接器）的三组件适配。
AI.result: 独立调节三个组件学习率可获得最低错误率；全三组件适配取得最佳联邦学习效果；FedProx的增益依赖架构，在多语言预训练架构（如EuroLLM对比TinyLlama，固定编码器时）优势明显。
AI.conclusion: LLM骨干容量是决定对异构数据分布鲁棒性的关键因素，研究为在隐私敏感的分布式环境中部署多语言Speech-LLM提供了具体设计指导。

title: CSC: Calibrated Simplicity for Conflict-Aware Social Bot Detection in the LLM Era
summary:
Social bot detection is essential for protecting online platforms from misinformation amplification, coordinated manipulation, and distorted public discourse. However, large language models have made social bots much harder to detect from text alone because semantic camouflage is now cheap, fluent, and scalable. The resulting challenge is modality conflict: an account may look human-like in semantics while remaining suspicious in graph structure, profile attributes, or cross-modal consistency. Recent graph-based detectors tackle this limitation by adding graph-side complexity, such as sparse prototype selection, adaptive gating, or architecture-specific control logic, yet our experiments suggest that complexity alone is not the most reliable way to resolve such conflict.
  We therefore propose CSC, a calibrated-simplicity framework for conflict-aware LLM-era social bot detection. The framework combines three design choices: a simplified prototype-guided graph expert that retains useful structural biases while removing unstable graph-side heuristics, calibrated simplex-constrained fusion that aligns heterogeneous confidence spaces before late fusion, and a lightweight inconsistency expert that models cross-modal disagreement. Experiments on TwiBot-22, TwiBot-20, and MGStBot-large show that \textsc{CSC} improves calibrated operating-point decision quality while remaining competitive across external benchmarks. Further analyses show that calibration improves confidence reliability, the inconsistency expert mainly provides localized corrections in high-conflict or near-threshold regions, and simplified graph-side control yields a better stability-cost trade-off. A targeted semantic-camouflage stress test further shows that replacing selected bot text with matched human text sharply degrades the standalone text expert while leaving graph and fused evidence stable on a balanced challenge set.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CSC（Calibrated-Simplicity framework），一个面向LLM时代社交媒体机器人检测的冲突感知框架，通过简化图专家、校准单纯形约束融合与轻量不一致专家，在保持竞争力的同时提升校准决策质量。
AI.motivation: LLM使语义伪装变得廉价、流畅且可扩展，仅凭文本难以检测社交机器人，导致"模态冲突"——账号在语义上像人类，但在图结构、画像属性或跨模态一致性上可疑。现有图检测器通过增加图侧复杂度（稀疏原型选择、自适应门控等）应对，但实验表明单纯增加复杂度并非可靠解法。
AI.method: 框架包含三项设计：（1）简化的原型引导图专家，保留有用结构偏置并去除不稳定的图侧启发式；（2）校准的单纯形约束融合，在后期融合前对齐异构置信空间；（3）轻量不一致专家，建模跨模态分歧。
AI.result: 在TwiBot-22、TwiBot-20和MGStBot-large上，CSC提升了校准工作点的决策质量并在外部基准上保持竞争力。分析显示：校准提升置信可靠性；不一致专家主要在高冲突或近阈值区域提供局部修正；简化图侧控制带来更好的稳定性-成本权衡。语义伪装压力测试中，将部分机器人文本替换为匹配的人类文本会使独立文本专家性能骤降，但图与融合证据在平衡挑战集上保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM时代，通过"校准+简化"而非一味增加复杂度，能更可靠地解决模态冲突，实现更稳健的社交机器人检测。

title: From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters
summary: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个LLM流水线，将灾害风险减灾档案的非结构化文本转换为结构化、带地理坐标的事件记录，用受控灾害词表和固定schema生成候选记录并保留证据。在PreventionWeb的1万篇文档上生成3,572条记录，覆盖24种灾害类型，81%位置提及解析到OSM几何；在171个人工正样本窗口上GPT-5达86.0% F1，远超基线44.2%。
AI.motivation: EM-DAT等灾害数据库无法直接摄取灾害风险减灾档案中以散文形式描述的灾害事件，导致大量信息难以被结构化利用。
AI.method: 构建LLM流水线，采用受控灾害词表和固定schema生成带地理坐标的候选事件记录，并保留证据供审核；对10,000篇PreventionWeb文档处理，进行人工参考集标注、多模型对比及自动化合规检查。
AI.result: 生成3,572条记录（来自1,913篇文档），覆盖24种灾害类型，81%位置提及解析到OSM；GPT-5在171个人工正样本窗口上达86.0% F1（基线44.2%），GPT-5.4在十个LLM中最高（86.6%）；逐字证据出现率GPT-5为72.0%、GPT-5.4为47.2%。
AI.conclusion: LLM流水线能有效从减灾档案中抽取结构化灾害事件记录，但评估仅在文档内池化灾害族、位置串和年份，未验证其对单个事件的归属；未来将公开提示、schema和输出以供适配国家报告档案。

title: Rethinking Class Imbalance for Single-Cell Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures and Long-Tail Loss Functions
summary: Single-cell foundation models (scGPT, scBERT, Geneformer) achieve cell-type classification accuracy up to 97.5% in our experiments, yet this aggregate accuracy can mask systematic failure on rare, often disease-relevant cell populations that long-tail loss functions are widely assumed to address. We present a systematic benchmark of six long-tail loss functions (cross-entropy, weighted CE, class-balanced loss, focal loss, LDAM, logit-adjusted softmax) across three architectures and three datasets (Multiple Sclerosis, Zheng68K, human Pancreas), totaling 162 controlled training runs (3 backbones x 3 datasets x 6 losses x 3 seeds). The gap between overall accuracy, Macro-F1, and rare-class recall under plain cross-entropy is consistent across all nine (architecture, dataset) settings, driven by dataset structure rather than pretraining. Rare-class failure itself splits into two regimes with distinct embedding-geometry signatures, visible before any loss is chosen: some classes are recoverable by the right loss, while others retain linear separability yet are absorbed into unrelated classes' neighborhoods under every evaluated loss and architecture. Among the recoverable classes, the efficacy of reweighting is predicted by a class's absolute training-set size, rather than its share of the dataset or the dataset's overall imbalance ratio. Class-balanced loss and LDAM are the most consistent choices across all nine settings, while logit adjustment trades rare-class precision for recall rather than improving both. Our results give both a reusable benchmark and mechanism-grounded practical guidelines for combining foundation models with imbalanced biological data.

AI.tldr: 本文对三种单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）配六种长尾损失函数进行162次受控训练，系统基准测试了稀有细胞类型分类问题。
AI.motivation: 单细胞基础模型在细胞类型分类上准确率高达97.5%，但整体准确率掩盖了对稀有、疾病相关细胞群的系统性失败；长尾损失函数被普遍认为可解决该问题，却缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 在三种架构、三个数据集（Multiple Sclerosis、Zheng68K、human Pancreas）上基准测试六种长尾损失（交叉熵、加权CE、类平衡损失、focal loss、LDAM、logit-adjusted softmax），共3×3×6×3=162次受控训练。
AI.result: 整体准确率、Macro-F1与稀有类召回之间的差距在所有九种(架构,数据集)设置下一致存在，由数据集结构而非预训练驱动。稀有类失败分为两种机制：部分类可被合适损失恢复，部分类虽保持线性可分却被吸收进无关类邻域；可恢复类的重加权效果由绝对训练集大小而非类别占比或整体不平衡率预测。类平衡损失与LDAM最稳定，logit调整以牺牲稀有类精确率换取召回。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可复用的基准和基于机制的实用指南，用于将基础模型与不平衡生物数据结合。

title: Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE
summary: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-TIE框架，通过学习式时间意图抽取（TIE）将查询时间约束映射为统一区间表示，兼具灵活性与显式约束建模，在TIR任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: RAG兴起使TIR愈发关键，时间不匹配的证据易误导生成。现有两类范式各有不足：时间检索器灵活但缺乏显式时间约束建模；时间重排序器能显式约束但依赖预定义规则，二者单独均难以实现鲁棒TIR。
AI.method: 提出Q-TIE重排序框架，核心是TIE模型：将每个查询的时间约束抽取为统一区间表示⟨t_start, t_end⟩，以模型学习方式（而非预定义规则）显式建模时间约束，作为独立信号与语义相关性结合进行重排序。
AI.result: 实验表明Q-TIE持续优于现有TIR方法，在多种时间查询类型上具有更强泛化性，并可作为轻量有效的插件用于时间感知的RAG流程。
AI.conclusion: 通过模型化时间意图抽取并显式建模时间约束，Q-TIE统一了两类TIR范式的优势，实现更鲁棒、可泛化的时间信息检索，适用于RAG场景。

title: A Patient World Model for Early Forecasting of Digital Health Campaign Outcomes: Capabilities and Limits
summary: Digital direct-to-consumer (DTC) health campaigns are usually measured after the fact. In-flight forecasting commonly relies on a separate classifier for every cutoff and horizon. We treat this task as a dynamic-system problem and build a compact patient world model. The architecture maintains a latent state per patient, learns exposure-conditioned state dynamics jointly with a weekly conversion hazard, and rolls forward into future conversion curves. We evaluate it on a US campaign dataset with 147{,}173 patients and 5.2 million at-risk person-weeks. In a retrospective evaluation conditioned on recorded future exposures, the model forecasts the remaining new-to-brand prescription volume through week 52 with a relative error of 2.9\% from a week-4 cutoff and 0.8--2.6\% from cutoffs at weeks 8--26. The strongest non-recurrent baseline, a pooled-hazard gradient boosting model given the same survival rollout and information, has relative errors of 13.6--33.1\%. Per-horizon classifiers perform substantially worse. A Fisher-information analysis motivates dense next-exposure supervision when conversions are rare. Removing this auxiliary objective increases prescription-volume error by approximately $2$--$14\times$, while providing no consistent disadvantage on the more common specialist-visit outcome. We also evaluate scenario simulation. Switching all future exposure off raises predicted conversion from 0.31 to 0.89, a pattern consistent with selection effects in observational exposure data. This result highlights the limits of interpreting exposure-conditioned rollouts causally.

AI.tldr: 将DTC健康活动的实时预测建模为动态系统问题，构建紧凑的患者世界模型以预测剩余转化曲线。
AI.motivation: DTC健康活动通常事后评估，实时预测依赖每个截断点和预测期单独的独立分类器，效率低且表现不佳。
AI.method: 为每位患者维护隐状态，联合学习暴露条件下的状态动态与每周转化风险(hazard)，并向前滚动生成未来转化曲线；引入密集下次暴露监督(Fisher信息分析支持)。
AI.result: 在美国147,173患者、520万风险人周数据集上，第4周截断相对误差2.9%，第8-26周为0.8-2.6%；最强非递归基线(池化风险梯度提升)误差13.6-33.1%，逐期分类器更差。去除辅助目标误差增大约2-14倍，而常见专科就诊结果无一致劣势。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型显著提升实时预测精度；但关闭所有未来暴露使预测转化从0.31升至0.89，反映观察性数据的选择效应，说明暴露条件下的滚动预测不宜做因果解读。

title: this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
summary: Software delegates more of its branches to models every year: which queue a ticket enters, whether a command is safe to run, whether a claim clears without a person. What the program needs back is not prose. It is one of n declared options and a number it can threshold. Today that costs a round trip to a frontier model -- hundreds of milliseconds, a per-token bill, and a parser -- for a question that is usually a conjunction of three clauses. this-that-model-1.0 is a 2B-parameter typed decision model. Its answer is read directly from the hidden state at a designated position and restricted to the option set the caller declared, so no text is generated, nothing can be malformed, and every question in a request is answered in the same forward pass. It decides in 30.9 ms on one laptop GPU and generates zero output tokens doing it, where a frontier API call costs 8758 ms and the hosted systems that answer these questions well spend between 21 and 212 generated tokens per question thinking first, billed for every one. It sustains 32 decisions per second on one consumer GPU and never lets the state leave the machine. On a third party's recorded cohort of 68 decision questions, on their inputs and their wording, it scores 0.941 with a Brier score of 0.042, against 0.765 and 0.133 for the hosted service Jev on the same items. One pass of our 42-family internal suite takes 32 seconds and 0.000217 USD of electricity; the most accurate hosted model we measured needs 155.2 minutes and 10.636 USD. We also report where it loses. On multi-step arithmetic, which a single forward pass cannot carry intermediate results through, it scores 0.560 against their 0.98 to 1.00, and a targeted second training round improved the five task families it was written for and transferred to none of the other 13. The model is open-sourced in https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0

AI.tldr: 提出2B参数的typed decision model，直接从隐藏状态读取n选一决策与阈值数值，无需生成文本，单次前向完成多问题，速度与成本远优于前沿模型API。
AI.motivation: 软件越来越多地把分支决策委托给模型（工单入队、命令是否安全、理赔是否免人工），但需要的是n个声明选项中的一个加一个可阈值化的数值，而非自然语言。当前用前沿模型需要一次往返：数百毫秒、按token计费、还要解析器，而问题通常只是三子句的合取。
AI.method: 训练2B参数的类型化决策模型。答案从指定位置的隐藏状态直接读取，并被限制在调用者声明的选项集合内，因此不生成文本、不会格式错误；一个请求中的每个问题在同一前向传播中作答。
AI.result: 笔记本GPU上30.9ms决策，生成0个输出token（前沿API为8758ms，托管系统每题生成21–212 token）；单卡消费级GPU每秒32次决策，数据不出本地。第三方68题队列上得分0.941、Brier 0.042，对比托管服务Jev的0.765/0.133。42家族内部套件一轮32秒、电费0.000217美元；最准的托管模型需155.2分钟、10.636美元。多步算术0.560，对手0.98–1.00；定向第二轮训练只提升目标5个任务族，未迁移到其余13族。
AI.conclusion: 单一前向的类型化决策可在大幅降低延迟、成本与隐私风险的同时，在合取式判定问题上超过托管服务；但无法承载中间结果的多步推理仍是其结构性短板，且针对性微调迁移性差。

title: What Can a Recurrent State Safely Forget?
summary:
Recurrent models must preserve information that changes future behavior while suppressing hidden-state error. These objectives conflict: contraction improves stability, but contraction along a future-distinguishing direction destroys memory. We formalize this boundary through the predictive quotient of a recurrent state space. Two hidden states are equivalent when they induce the same conditional future; their equivalence classes form predictive fibers. Every exact semantics-preserving corrector acts as the identity on this quotient. At a regular point with hidden dimension d and predictive dimension k, it can eliminate at most d - k independent directions. This establishes a discrete-continuous boundary: finite predictive states admit positive-radius exact correction basins, whereas an uncountable continuum of future-distinguishable states cannot be decoded after arbitrary positive-radius perturbations in finite-dimensional Euclidean space.
  To operationalize this principle, we develop an auditable finite-future framework. A compact deployment bank W is evaluated against an independent audit bank A (W subseteq A) on a declared correction domain. Under generative probe access and audit-metric coverage, finite stochastic rollouts furnish a high-probability certificate for the separation margin Omega_{W|A}(delta). Preserving learned W-predictions within this certified margin guarantees bounded audit-semantic distortion. For intrinsic audit dimension k, the required probe outcomes scale as O(M * Omega^{-(k+2)}), where M = |A|; a matching minimax lower bound proves this exponent is optimal. Extending guarantees to continuous futures is achieved via an explicit completeness modulus. Controlled experiments validate the certified margins, scaling laws, and automated probe refinement under a safety-first evaluation paradigm.

AI.tldr: 论文通过"预测商"形式化循环模型中稳定与记忆的冲突：预测纤维上的守恒约束给出可补偿方向数上限 d−k，并建立离散/连续边界；提出可审计有限未来框架，用探测滚动给出分离裕度 Ω 的高概率证书，并对内禀审计维度 k 给出 O(MΩ^{-(k+2)}) 的样本复杂度及匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 循环模型需同时保持影响未来行为的信息并抑制隐藏状态误差，二者存在根本冲突：收缩提升稳定性，但沿"区分未来"方向的收缩会破坏记忆。作者希望刻画这一稳定-记忆权衡的精确边界，并将其转化为可操作、可验证的保证机制。
AI.method: 1) 定义预测商：隐藏状态诱导相同条件未来时视为等价，形成预测纤维，任何语义保持的精确校正器在该商上为恒等，正则点处最多消除 d−k 个独立方向。2) 区分有限预测态（具有正半径精确校正域）与连续预测态（不存在正半径解码）。3) 构建可审计有限未来框架：紧凑部署库 W 对独立审计库 A（W⊆A）在声明校正域上评估，借助生成式探测访问与审计度量覆盖，用有限随机滚动生成分离裕度 Ω_{W|A}(δ) 的高概率证书。
AI.result: 在认证裕度内保持 W 预测可保证审计语义失真受限；对内在审计维度 k，所需探测结果为 O(M·Ω^{-(k+2)})，M=|A|，并给出匹配的 minimax 下界证明该指数最优；通过显式完备性模数将保证扩展到连续未来。受控实验验证了认证裕度、缩放律与自动探测优化。
AI.conclusion: 预测商刻画了循环模型中稳定性与记忆能力的根本边界，且该边界可通过有限未来、可审计的探测框架被有效操作化和认证；样本复杂度随审计维度呈最优多项式增长，为安全优先评估范式提供了理论基础与实践验证。

title: Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) drift out of date the moment their pretraining ends, yet retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive. Continued pretraining (CPT) is the natural remedy, but it is typically evaluated through a continual learning lens that assumes disjoint data streams. This is a poor fit for time-incremental updates on web-scale crawls, where successive snapshots share substantial URL overlap by design. We study time-incremental CPT in this realistic regime: continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn strictly from after each model's knowledge cutoff, evaluated across six open-weight models spanning three families (OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, Gemma-3-1B) and four parameter scales (1B-3B-7B-8B).
  We organize our findings around four practical questions. (i) Is knowledge acquired? Yes, but heterogeneously, and without catastrophic forgetting: five of six models also improve on pre-cutoff factual recall, and the gains track pretraining saturation (driven primarily by token budget per parameter). (ii) What does it cost? Almost nothing: the macro-average across a thirteen-task suite stays within 0.01 of the base for every model. (iii) What is the recipe? Data quality dominates quantity (a curated 6B-token slice matches a broader 40B one); the optima for knowledge acquisition and general capability are separated by roughly an order of magnitude in learning rate; and LoRA at sufficient rank matches full CPT. (iv) Does it survive deployment? CPT gains transfer through SFT, while DPO's effect is family-dependent. Together, these results paint a more optimistic picture of time-incremental CPT than the prior continual learning literature suggests.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究时间增量式持续预训练（CPT）在真实网络爬取场景下的效果，发现六个开源模型在学得新知识的同时几乎不损失通用能力，且效果受数据质量、学习率和微调方式影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型预训练结束后知识立即过时，从头重训成本过高，CPT是自然解决方案。但现有CPT评估沿用连续学习视角，假设数据流互不相交，这与网络爬取快照间存在大量URL重叠的现实不符。作者希望在更真实的设置下研究时间增量式CPT。
AI.method: 在严格取自各模型知识截止时间之后的FineWeb-Edu数据上进行持续预训练，覆盖三个家族（OLMo2、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-3-1B）和四个参数规模（1B-3B-7B-8B）的六个开源模型，围绕知识获取、成本、配方和部署四个问题展开评估。
AI.result: 知识获取异质但无灾难性遗忘（六个模型中五个提升截止前事实召回，收益与预训练饱和度相关）；成本极低，十三任务套件宏平均与基线差距在0.01以内；数据质量胜过数量（6B精选切片可匹配40B广泛数据），知识获取与通用能力的最优学习率相差约一个数量级，足够高秩的LoRA可匹配全量CPT；CPT收益可通过SFT传递，DPO效果因家族而异。
AI.conclusion: 相比以往连续学习文献的悲观结论，时间增量式CPT呈现出更乐观的前景，是一种实用且低成本的模型更新方式。

title: The Evidence Ladder for Reinforcement Learning in Healthcare: From Retrospective Policies to Trusted Interventions
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural language for healthcare decisions whose conse- quences unfold over time, yet most reported progress remains far from routine intervention. Ex- isting surveys organize the field by algorithm or clinical application. We instead review healthcare RL through an evidence ladder: problem formulation, retrospective identification, policy estima- tion, stress testing, prospective evaluation, and lifecycle monitoring. This view connects clinical treatment, patient engagement, and health-system operations while exposing a recurring gap: evi- dence that a policy scores well in a historical dataset is not evidence that it will improve care. We synthesize the assumptions and failure modes at each rung, identify what evidence can and can- not transfer across settings, and propose reporting practices for cumulative evaluation. Restless bandits are included as one special case, not as the organizing framework. The central lesson is that healthcare RL should be evaluated as an intervention embedded in a changing sociotechnical system, rather than only as an optimizer of a retrospective reward.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"证据阶梯"（问题定义、回顾性识别、策略估计、压力测试、前瞻性评估、生命周期监测）来综述医疗强化学习，强调历史数据表现好不等于能改善临床照护。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗RL综述多按算法或临床应用组织，忽略了一个核心问题：历史数据集中策略得分高，并不能证明它能真正改善照护。作者希望用证据评估视角重新组织这一领域。
AI.method: 采用"证据阶梯"框架（六层级）系统综述医疗RL，涵盖临床治疗、患者参与和卫生系统运营，逐层综合各层的假设与失效模式，分析证据跨场景可迁移性，并提出累计评估的报告规范；将restless bandits作为特例而非组织框架。
AI.result: 揭示了领域内反复出现的证据缺口——回顾性得分与真实改善之间存在断层；明确了各阶梯层面的假设、失效模式及证据可/不可迁移的边界。
AI.conclusion: 医疗RL应被视为嵌入于动态社会技术系统中的干预措施来评估，而不仅仅是回顾性奖励的优化器。

title: Measuring the Assistant's Harmlessness Preferences on the User Turn
summary: Post-training turns a general next-token predictor into a chat model with a persistent assistant persona. If that persona is a character the model plays only on its own turns, its preferences should govern what the assistant says, not what the model predicts other speakers will say. We test this boundary and find that it does not hold: a safety-relevant preference of the assistant---for harmless over harmful tasks---shapes the model's predictions even on the user's turn, where the assistant is not the one speaking. We find that this preference is small or near-zero in pretrained base models, that it emerges through post-training, replicated across open-weight model families, grows with scale, and can be moved by narrow finetuning that never touches user turns. We claim that this is evidence that post-training does not merely install a shallow assistant persona, but instead generalises beyond just the local assistant turn, into the model's representation of the user.

AI.tldr: 后训练不仅塑造助手角色本身，其安全偏好还会泛化到对用户话语的预测中。
AI.motivation: 检验一个假设：助手人格应只影响模型自己的发言，不应影响对他人（用户）话语的预测。作者想验证这一边界是否成立。
AI.method: 测试助手对“无害优于有害任务”的安全偏好是否影响模型对用户发言的预测；比较预训练基座与后训练模型，跨开源模型家族、随规模变化，并用仅针对助手回合的窄微调进行验证。
AI.result: 该偏好在基座模型中很小或接近零，通过后训练出现，在多个开源模型家族中可复现，随规模增长，且可被不触及用户回合的窄微调改变。
AI.conclusion: 后训练并非只安装浅层的助手人格，而是将其泛化到模型对用户的表征中。

title: Discovering Physical Representation Languages
summary: Before a machine can discover a physical law, it must discover what its measurements are: which observations live on cells, which are intensive or extensive, which sectors are dual, and which distinctions are merely gauge. We introduce physical representation-language discovery, the problem of recovering this hidden ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We give an identifiability theory and constructive polynomial-time procedure that recovers a carrier and differential sequence, measurement types and orientation twist, noninvertible refinement semantics, primal-dual Maxwell diagrams, and the residual equivalences that no permitted experiment can break. The theory turns material nuisance into a commutant, uses refinement to separate quantities from coordinates, and selects physics only after its representation has been recovered. For a certified finite experiment family, we prove an end-to-end two-stage measurement bound and a matching minimax rate in dimension, accuracy, and confidence. Blind Maxwell experiments recover complete primal/relative-dual ontologies on regular and unstructured carriers under jointly corrupted observations; an independent unstructured RLC system demonstrates that the result is not specific to Maxwell. The framework scales to tens of thousands of cells per carrier, while stress audits demonstrate robustness across severe physical regimes - including non-Markovian memory, nonlinearities, nonlocality, and complex constitutive hysteresis. A public FDTD audit demonstrates the emergence of anonymous curl structure from incomplete field data, while characterizing the informational prerequisites for complete recovery. The goal is to move scientific ML from learning laws in a human-supplied language to discovering the language in which laws become expressible, establishing exact theoretical limits on observational identifiability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"物理表示-语言发现"，旨在让机器从匿名受控实验中直接恢复隐藏的物理本体（载体、微分序列、测量类型、原始-对偶图等）。给出可辨识性理论与多项式时间构造算法，并证明端到端测量界与极小极大率；在Maxwell及RLC系统上验证，可扩展至上万单元。
AI.motivation: 机器发现物理定律前，必须先弄清其测量语义：哪些量定义在格点上、是强度量还是外延量、哪些扇区互为对偶、哪些区别仅为规范选择。现有科学机器学习通常使用人类给定的语言直接拟合定律，而这一表示-语言层面的前提被忽略，因此需要从匿名实验数据中恢复隐藏的物理本体。
AI.method: 提出"物理表示-语言发现"问题：从匿名受控实验中恢复载体与微分序列、测量类型与取向扭曲、不可逆精细化语义、原始-对偶Maxwell图及残余等价关系。给出可辨识性理论、构造性多项式时间算法；将材料干扰转化为交换子（commutant），用精细化分离量与坐标，并在表示恢复后再选择物理。
AI.result: 对认证的有限实验族证明端到端两阶段测量界及在维度、精度、置信度上的匹配极小极大率。盲Maxwell实验在联合损坏观测下于规则与非结构载体上恢复完整原始/相对对偶本体；独立非结构RLC系统验证其非Maxwell特异性。可扩展至每载体数万单元；压力审计显示在非马尔可夫记忆、非线性、非局域及复杂本构迟滞等极端物理条件下具鲁棒性；公开FDTD审计展示从不完整场数据中涌现匿名旋度结构，并刻画完整恢复的信息前提。
AI.conclusion: 目标是推动科学机器学习从"在人类给定语言中学习定律"转向"发现定律得以表达的语言"，并为观测可辨识性建立精确理论极限。

title: XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice
summary: Effective communication between users and AI agents is essential for human-AI collaboration. The XY problem is a well-known communication pitfall where a person asks about their attempted solution rather than their actual problem. We extend prior sycophancy evaluation to the XY problem in agentic settings, evaluating whether agents can resist plausible but misleading suggestions from users and communicate their reasoning. We introduce XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that can transform an existing benchmark into an XY problem evaluation. We evaluate five models across six diverse benchmark suites. Agents suffer large XY drops under XY mutation across benchmarks, with relative drops reaching up to 46.7%. With $τ^2$-bench, we further show that agent performance drops more when encountering a pedantic user who requires detailed explanations before approving a better solution. Our findings suggest that current agents lack the ability to effectively reason and communicate when facing misleading suggestions. A simple system instruction baseline that encourages awareness of XY problems only offers partial mitigation. Extensive trace analyses provide behavioral insights into how and why these XY drops occur across execution trajectories. Our results show that mitigating the XY problem remains challenging, requiring agents to both recognize user misdirection and clearly communicate the underlying problem.

AI.tldr: 提出XYEval元评估框架，将现有基准转化为XY问题评估，发现当前AI agent在面临用户误导性建议时性能大幅下降，且沟通推理能力不足。
AI.motivation: 用户与AI agent的有效沟通对人机协作至关重要。XY问题（用户询问其尝试的解决方案而非实际问题）是常见的沟通陷阱，但既有研究仅在谄媚性层面评估，未扩展到agent场景，故需要针对性评估agent能否抵御看似合理但误导性的建议。
AI.method: 提出XYEval元评估框架，可将现有基准转化为XY问题评估；在六个多样化基准套件上评估五个模型；并使用τ²-bench引入"学究型用户"（需详细解释才批准更优方案）场景；同时测试鼓励XY问题意识的简单系统指令作为缓解手段，并进行了大量轨迹分析。
AI.result: 各基准下agent均出现显著XY性能下降，相对降幅高达46.7%；遇到要求详细解释的学究型用户时性能下降更大；简单系统指令仅提供部分缓解；轨迹分析揭示了下降发生的行为机制。
AI.conclusion: 当前agent缺乏在面对误导性建议时有效推理和沟通的能力；缓解XY问题仍具挑战，需要agent既能识别用户误导，又能清晰传达真正的问题所在。

title: Blind Thermodynamic Ontology Discovery from Anonymous Experiments
summary: Before a machine learning model can learn a thermodynamic equation of state, it must discover what its measurements represent: which channels scale with system size, which are intensive conjugates, how sectors pair through contact, and which potential governs stability. When sensors expose only an unknown linear mixture of extensive states and intensive responses, passive observations cannot disentangle physical quantities from coordinate artifacts. We formulate the problem of discovering this hidden thermodynamic ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We present an operational identifiability theory and a constructive polynomial-time algorithm that extracts extensive and intensive scaling sectors from replication contrasts, recovers their dual cotangent pairing from thermal contact and reciprocity, verifies a globally admissible concave potential via discrete cyclic concavity, and determines an invariant matroid of reservoir ensembles. We prove that the residual observational equivalence is strictly (x, lambda) ~ (A x, a A^{-T} lambda + beta), establishing the sharp observational limit that no permitted experiment can break. Blind evaluations on van der Waals fluids and Curie-Weiss magnets confirm robust recovery under ill-conditioned mixing, correctly resolving anonymous Maxwell tie-lines while rejecting non-equilibrium continuations. External validation across six real fluids from the NIST WebBook demonstrates that operational ontology discovery transfers across real physical substances without coordinate leakage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从"匿名受控实验"中直接发现隐藏的热力学本体（哪些量随系统尺寸缩放、哪些是强度量、如何配对、何种势函数支配稳定性），给出可识别性理论与多项式时间构造算法，并在范德华流体、居里-外斯磁体及NIST六种真实流体上验证了恢复效果。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型要学习热力学状态方程，必须先弄清测量量的物理含义（广延/强度通道、共轭配对、稳定性势），但当传感器只给出广延态与强度响应的未知线性混合时，被动观测无法区分物理量与坐标伪影，因此需要主动的受控实验来辨识这一隐藏本体。
AI.method: 提出操作化可识别性理论，并构造多项式时间算法：通过复制对比（replication contrasts）提取广延与强度标度扇区；利用热接触与互易性恢复二者的对偶余切配对；通过离散循环凹性验证全局可行的凹势函数；确定储层系综的不变拟阵（matroid）。
AI.result: 证明残余观测等价性严格为 (x, λ) ~ (A x, a A^{-T} λ + β)，即任何允许实验都无法突破的观测极限。在病态混合下对范德华流体和居里-外斯磁体实现稳健恢复，正确解析匿名麦克斯韦切线并排除非平衡延拓；在NIST WebBook六种真实流体上完成外部验证，本体发现可迁移且无坐标泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了从匿名受控实验中辨识热力学本体的理论基础与算法框架，刻画了观测等价性的紧界，并证明该方法可迁移到真实物理物质。

title: HaikuS2S: A Cascaded System For Responding In Verse
comment: Accepted to SLT 2026, Demo Track. 5 pages, 5 figures
summary: Expressive speech synthesis has advanced through prosody modeling, yet generating structured poetic speech, such as haiku, remains challenging. Prior work on prosody transfer improves expressiveness, and fine-tuned poetry TTS (text-to-speech) systems capture verse intonation. However, these models do not model haiku's 5-7-5 syllable structure or line-ending pauses. We present a cascaded system, HaikuS2S, combining ASR (automatic speech recognition), LLM (large language model)-generated haiku, and TTS fine-tuning on both prose and custom haiku datasets. Our evaluation focuses on emotion similarity, speech quality, and prosody alignment. In our experiments, we see that our prosody and tonal alignment improve significantly with our fine-tuned systems, particularly the one trained on both general poetry and haiku. We also see that we maintain similar emotion similarity scores across all systems.

AI.tldr: 提出级联系统HaikuS2S，结合ASR、LLM生成俳句与TTS微调，实现符合5-7-5音节结构和行末停顿的诗意语音合成。
AI.motivation: 结构化诗意语音（如俳句）生成仍具挑战，现有韵律迁移和诗歌TTS系统未建模俳句的5-7-5音节结构及行末停顿。
AI.method: 构建级联系统HaikuS2S，整合ASR、LLM生成俳句，并在散文与自定义俳句数据集上进行TTS微调；评估情感相似度、语音质量和韵律对齐。
AI.result: 微调系统（尤其同时在通用诗歌和俳句数据上训练者）的韵律与音调对齐显著提升，各系统情感相似度得分相近。
AI.conclusion: 微调TTS可有效提升俳句韵律与音调对齐，兼顾情感表达，为结构化诗意语音合成提供可行方案。

title: Tool-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Domain Adaptation in Sequence-Based Omics Tasks
summary: Multi-omics sequences contain complex biological patterns, yet deciphering their mechanisms for automated scientific discovery remains challenging. As large language models (LLMs) interpret these sequences, evaluating both predictions and scientific reasoning is critical. However, existing benchmarks for multi-omics sequence tasks rely on classification and regression metrics, neglecting whether models grasp the underlying biological evidence. We introduce OmicsBench, the first reasoning benchmark for multi-omics sequences, comprising 1,160 expert-validated questions across six tasks spanning DNA regulation, RNA processing, and protein function. OmicsBench requires traceable evidence chains, evaluated using instance-specific rubrics developed with domain experts. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals an inverse relationship: while scientific LLMs outperform general-purpose LLMs in sequence classification accuracy, they fail to provide valid evidence to support their predictions. One plausible interpretation is shortcut learning: specialized models may rely on statistical patterns rather than the biological mechanisms needed for scientific discovery. Motivated by this finding, we introduce tool-augmented on-policy distillation (TA-OPD), a post-training method to align sequence prediction with evidence-grounded biological reasoning. Across five Qwen3.5 models spanning 0.8B to 27B parameters, TA-OPD consistently strengthens biological evidence grounding while improving predictive performance on most tasks. These gains persist across model scales, indicating that stronger sequence reasoning does not arise solely from increased model capacity, but can be improved through evidence-aware training. Together, OmicsBench and TA-OPD provide a framework for diagnosing reasoning failures in multi-omics LLMs and a path toward models whose predictions are better grounded in biologically meaningful evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OmicsBench（首个多组学序列推理基准，含1160道专家验证题目，覆盖6类任务），揭示科学LLM在序列分类上更强却缺乏有效证据支持，疑似捷径学习；并提出工具增强在线策略蒸馏（TA-OPD）方法，在多个Qwen3.5模型上同时提升证据落地与预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多组学序列基准仅用分类/回归指标评估，忽视模型是否真正理解背后的生物学证据，无法判断其推理是否可靠。
AI.method: 构建OmicsBench：1,160道经专家验证的题目，涵盖DNA调控、RNA加工、蛋白质功能三大方向共六类任务，要求可追溯的证据链，并用专家开发的实例专属评分标准进行评估；随后提出TA-OPD（工具增强在线策略蒸馏）后训练方法，将序列预测与证据落地推理对齐。
AI.result: 评估17个LLM发现反向关系：科学LLM分类准确率高于通用LLM，但无法提供有效证据支持其预测；TA-OPD在0.8B–27B五款Qwen3.5模型上一致增强生物证据落地，并在多数任务上提升预测性能，且增益跨模型规模持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 更强的序列推理不只源于模型规模，而可通过证据感知训练提升；OmicsBench与TA-OPD共同为诊断多组学LLM的推理失败提供了框架，并指明让预测更好扎根于生物学有意义证据的路径。

title: Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs
summary: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.

AI.tldr: 研究埃及阿拉伯语中主流Cairene方言(CEA)与次要Sa'idi方言(SEA)在LLM中的表现差异，发现LLM对SEA存在上游偏见并导致下游性能下降。
AI.motivation: NLP研究主要关注具声望的Cairene埃及阿拉伯语(CEA)，导致较少声望的Sa'idi埃及阿拉伯语(SEA)在LLM与资源开发中代表性不足。作者欲探究这种缺失是否造成LLM对SEA可接受性的上游偏见，以及该偏见是否导致下游任务性能下降。
AI.method: 采用定向句法评估(TSE)任务检验SEA方言特征对LLM偏好的上游影响；随后在MMLU基准上分析相同特征对下游模型性能的影响。
AI.result: TSE任务显示多个LLM对SEA存在显著偏见；在MMLU基准上，模型面对SEA时出现性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了次方言(sub-dialectal)变异对语言技术影响的重要性，呼吁进一步探索该问题。

title: RLVR$^{2}$: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rubric-based Ranking
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is expanding from tasks with well-defined correctness signals, such as mathematics and code, toward multifaceted quality requirements specified by multi-dimensional rubrics. Since policy optimization consumes one scalar per rollout, rubric-based pipelines must map multiple criterion scores into a scalar reward. This aggregation is often treated as score scaling, but it implicitly determines how quality dimensions trade off during training. The prevailing practice, normalizing each criterion and taking a linear combination, assumes that cardinal score differences are comparable across criteria and that gains on one criterion compensate for failures on another; both assumptions are unreliable when criteria are semantically heterogeneous. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rubric-based Ranking (RLVR$^2$), a verifiable ranking paradigm for rubric-based RLVR. For each criterion, RLVR$^2$ converts rubric scores into criterion-specific within-group ordinal outcomes, recovers a latent utility from the resulting comparison matrix, and merges these utilities into one training signal. By retaining only within-group ordering and discarding raw score magnitudes, RLVR$^2$ avoids calibrating heterogeneous rubric scales. It further supports objective-preserving attribute adjustment: auxiliary attributes that correlate with observed rankings but are not training objectives can enter the estimation without expanding the rubric or rewarding them directly. Across three model scales and 16 benchmarks, RLVR$^2$ consistently outperforms representative rubric-based baselines, achieving the best overall performance on most benchmarks at every scale. Analysis shows it controls systematic effects tied to reasoning efficiency and response formatting while preserving the quality objective.

AI.tldr: 提出 RLVR²，用可验证的排序范式替代传统的加权归一化打分方式，将多准则 rubric 分数转化为组内序数结果并恢复潜在效用，合并为单一训练信号。
AI.motivation: RLVR 正从有明确正确性信号的任务扩展到由多维度 rubric 指定的复合质量要求。策略优化每次 rollout 只消费一个标量，因此需将多准则分数聚合为标量。传统做法（各准则归一化后线性组合）隐含假设不同准则的分差可比、且某准则收益可补偿另一准则失败，这在准则语义异构时不可靠。
AI.method: RLVR²：对每个准则，将 rubric 分数转换为该准则的组内序数结果，从比较矩阵恢复潜在效用，再合并为单一训练信号。仅保留组内排序、丢弃原始分数幅度，避免异构 rubric 尺度校准。并支持保持目标的属性调整：与观测排名相关但非训练目标的辅助属性可参与估计，而无需扩展 rubric 或直接奖励。
AI.result: 在 3 个模型规模和 16 个基准上，RLVR² 持续优于代表性 rubric 基线，在每个规模的多数基准上取得最佳整体表现。分析表明其能控制与推理效率和响应格式相关的系统性效应，同时保持质量目标。
AI.conclusion: 将多准则奖励聚合视为决定质量维度权衡的机制而非简单分数缩放，序数化排序范式可有效规避异构 rubric 尺度问题，并提升 rubric-based RLVR 的性能与稳健性。

title: Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model
summary: Screening a phone call for fraud needs a trustworthy probability after every caller turn, in milliseconds. Jev-style typed decisions promise exactly that: declared options go in, one calibrated probability per option comes out of a single forward pass, with no generated text. We test an open implementation of this readout, JevLite, on scam-call screening: Qwen3-4B is LoRA-tuned so that the temperature-scaled softmax over two answer-label logits is P(scam). On 41 held-out CallScreenBench scenarios (577 per-turn decisions) a three-seed ensemble reaches AUROC .974 with calibration error .052, non-inferior to an LLM judge (MiniMax-M3) at a pre-registered .02 margin, with no false alarms on legitimate calls, decisions 1.14 turns earlier under the same hang-up rule, and 64.5 ms per decision on one consumer GPU, 4.9x lower than the same backbone fine-tuned to generate its answer. The gain is in the readout and calibration, not accuracy: a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder is not significantly worse, the recipe was selected with test-set exposure, and all callers are synthetic. We claim no architectural novelty; the contribution is the application and an evaluation reporting calibration, false alarms and decision timing alongside AUROC.

AI.tldr: 论文测试一种无需生成文本的"类型化决策"读出法（JevLite），用于诈骗电话逐轮筛查：通过LoRA微调Qwen3-4B，使其在答案标签logits上做温度缩放softmax得到P(scam)。在41个场景、577次逐轮决策上，三种子集成达到AUROC .974、校准误差 .052，与LLM裁判非劣，且无误报、决策更早（1.14轮）、单卡64.5ms。
AI.motivation: 诈骗电话筛查需要在每一轮对话后、以毫秒级给出可信（校准良好）的概率判断。Jev-style类型化决策承诺"选项输入、单次前向输出每个选项的校准概率、不生成文本"，本文即验证该读出方式在诈骗电话场景中的实用性。
AI.method: 使用开源实现JevLite：对Qwen3-4B做LoRA微调，在答案标签的两个logits上做温度缩放softmax作为P(scam)；在41个留出场景共577次逐轮决策上评估，采用三种子集成，并与LLM裁判（MiniMax-M3）对比。
AI.result: AUROC .974、校准误差 .052；在预注册的.02非劣边距内与LLM裁判非劣；对合法通话零误报；同等挂断规则下决策提前1.14轮；单消费级GPU每次决策64.5ms，比同骨干生成式微调快4.9倍。精度并非来源：微调的ModernBERT编码器表现不显著更差，且配方经过测试集暴露挑选，所有来电为合成数据。
AI.conclusion: 无架构创新主张；贡献在于应用本身，以及一套在报告AUROC之外同时给出校准、误报与决策时延的评估。收益来自读出与校准而非准确率。

title: TRACE: Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG
summary: Deep learning has advanced automated electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis, but the field's most accurate models, foundation models pretrained on millions of recordings, are not decision-pathway auditable: a clinician cannot trace a diagnosis to a physiological pathway or intervene on one. We propose TRACE, a Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG, whose 32-dimensional clinical latent space is specified in advance from domain knowledge rather than discovered by optimization. TRACE partitions this space into perfusion, structure, and conduction subspaces, routes each to its own diagnostic head by design, regularizes the partition with an orthogonality penalty, and reconstructs the ECG through a decoder that permits latent perturbation. On PTB-XL and Georgia, TRACE exceeds unconstrained classifiers and stays ahead of an ECG foundation model pretrained on ten million recordings, evaluated by linear probe on frozen features, at roughly an eighth of the parameter count. On the nine-label CPSC2018 cohort, which carries no structural class, the framework transfers with only the routing table re-specified to a perfusion/rhythm/conduction partition. Joint probe, erasure, and perturbation analyses verify the routing contract, and perturbing the depolarization and repolarization pathways modulates the reconstructed waveform. Removing the specified partition and its orthogonality penalty costs 1.70 AUC and 11.30 macro-F1 points on PTB-XL, and 2.76 AUC and 16.92 macro-F1 points on Georgia. A capacity-matched permutation control places arbitrary assignments within 0.34 AUC points of the ontology routing and leaves macro-F1 statistically level (p=0.619): the ontology supplies decision-pathway auditability at no macro-F1 cost.

AI.tldr: TRACE提出一种可解释、可控的ECG诊断自编码器，其32维潜空间按临床知识预先划分为灌注、结构、传导子空间并设计路由，在多个数据集上以更少参数超越无约束分类器与大型基础模型，实现诊断路径可审计且性能无损。
AI.motivation: 现有最精准的ECG深度学习模型（含千万级预训练基础模型）缺乏决策路径可审计性，临床医生无法追溯诊断到生理通路或进行干预。作者希望构建一个诊断过程可追溯、可干预的模型。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG）：32维临床潜空间由领域知识预先指定而非优化发现；划分为灌注、结构、传导三个子空间，各路由到独立诊断头；用正交性惩罚正则化分区；解码器支持潜变量扰动以重建ECG。在CPSC2018上仅需重新指定路由表即可迁移为灌注/节律/传导划分。
AI.result: 在PTB-XL和Georgia上，TRACE超越无约束分类器，并在仅约1/8参数量下通过线性探针领先千万级ECG基础模型。移除指定分区与正交惩罚后PTB-XL下降1.70 AUC、11.30 macro-F1，Georgia下降2.76 AUC、16.92 macro-F1。容量匹配的随机置换控制与本体路由相差仅0.34 AUC且macro-F1统计持平(p=0.619)。
AI.conclusion: 本体论指定的路由在无macro-F1损失的前提下提供了决策路径可审计性，探针、擦除与扰动分析验证了路由契约，扰动去极化与复极化通路可调控重建波形。

title: From Tables to Quantified Statements: Evaluating LLM Inference Generation through Executable Verification
summary: LLMs can generate fluent descriptions from tables, but their outputs may remain logically unsupported by the structured data. We introduce STAT-TO-TEXT, a controlled task in which LLMs generate quantified natural language inferences from statistical tables using quantified constructions such as all, some, no, and most. To evaluate these inferences, we use an LLM generated Python checker code which when executed verifies the corresponding truth conditions against the table. We compare four open-weight LLMs across model families and scales, evaluating faithfulness, logical accuracy, table coverage, and diversity. Our results show that model scale and family matter, with the largest model (GPT-OSS-120B) consistently producing the most faithful inferences without sacrificing greater table coverage and quantifier diversity, as opposed to smaller models. These findings are supported by human annotation, which shows that the automated checker closely aligns with human judgments.

AI.tldr: 提出 STAT-TO-TEXT 任务，让 LLM 从统计表生成带量词的自然语言推断，并用 LLM 生成的 Python 校验代码验证真实性。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的表格描述虽流畅，但逻辑上未必被结构化数据支持，需要可控任务来评估这种忠实性。
AI.method: 设计受控任务，要求 LLM 使用 all、some、no、most 等量词构造从统计表出发的量化推断；用 LLM 生成的 Python 校验代码执行真值条件验证。对四个开放权重 LLM 跨模型家族和规模进行比较，评估忠实性、逻辑准确性、表格覆盖度和多样性。
AI.result: 模型规模和家族均有影响；最大模型 GPT-OSS-120B 在不牺牲表格覆盖度和量词多样性的情况下，持续产生最忠实的推断，优于较小模型。人工标注支持该结论，自动化校验与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM 从表格生成量化推断的忠实性受模型规模和家族影响，大模型表现最佳，且自动化校验方法可靠。

title: ITSY: Causal Discovery From Irregular Time-Series Data
summary: Structural causal models for time series recover contemporaneous and lagged effects, but most methods require complete observation windows and become misspecified when samples are missing. We introduce ITSY, the first continuous-optimization method for causal discovery from irregular time series under a linear model. ITSY reformulates the structural equation so that prediction uses the nearest available history rather than the possibly missing current slice, and jointly imputes missing values while learning both graphs. A weighted reconstruction objective corrects the noise transformation induced by this reformulation. Across synthetic regimes varying missingness, scale, graph density, and noise, and on a real world benchmark, ITSY consistently improves graph recovery over representative SCM-based baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results establish a focused solution for irregular linear first-order dynamics and clarify the assumptions required for nonlinear or higher-order extensions.

AI.tldr: ITSY：首个面向不规则时间序列的连续优化因果发现方法，在缺失情况下联合填补与图学习。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列结构因果模型可恢复同期与滞后效应，但大多要求完整观测窗口，样本缺失时会模型误设。
AI.method: 重构结构方程，用最近可用历史进行预测而非可能缺失的当前切片；联合填补缺失值并学习两个图；采用加权重构目标校正该重构引入的噪声变换。
AI.result: 在缺失率、规模、图密度和噪声各异的合成场景及一个真实基准上，图恢复效果持续优于代表性SCM基线。
AI.conclusion: 为不规则线性一阶动态提供了针对性方案，并阐明了推广至非线性或高阶情形所需假设。

title: When Evidence Conflicts: Reliability-aware Meta-review Generation
summary: Generating coherent meta-reviews from multiple peer reviews is challenging when reviewer evidence conflicts and varies in reliability. Existing approaches typically formulate meta-review generation as a multi-document summarization task and aggregate reviewer feedback uniformly, making it difficult to determine which opinions should be prioritized under disagreement. In this paper, we study meta-review generation through reliability-aware evidence aggregation. Our framework first extracts aspect-level opinions from peer reviews and identifies conflicting evidence within each aspect. It then estimates opinion-level support and review-level quality to measure evidence reliability. Based on these signals, the framework assigns reliability-aware weights to reviewer feedback, enabling the generator to prioritize better-supported arguments while preserving diverse perspectives. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves meta-review generation over strong baselines on both automatic and human evaluations, with clear gains in conflict recognition and resolution under high-conflict review scenarios. The code and implementation details are publicly available at https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可靠性感知的证据聚合框架用于从多篇同行评审生成元评审，通过识别方面级冲突、估计证据可靠性并加权反馈，提升冲突场景下的元评审质量。
AI.motivation: 现有元评审生成方法将其视为多文档摘要任务，统一聚合评审意见，难以在评审证据冲突且可靠性不一时判断应优先采纳哪些观点。
AI.method: 框架先抽取评审中方面级意见并识别每个方面内的冲突证据；再估计意见级支持度与评审级质量以衡量证据可靠性；最后据此为评审反馈分配可靠性感知权重，使生成器优先采纳支持更强的论点，同时保留多样观点。
AI.result: 在自动与人工评估中，方法持续优于强基线，并在高冲突评审场景下冲突识别与解决方面取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性感知的证据聚合能有效改进元评审生成，尤其在评审意见冲突时；代码与实现已公开。

title: Feature Suppression and Differential Privacy for Residential Traffic Classification: A Two-Home Federated Study
summary: Residential traffic classification supports service management, but learning across homes must account for heterogeneous traffic and privacy constraints. Privacy-aware training may impose uneven costs across traffic categories. We study this tradeoff in simulated two-client federated learning using 1.62 million preprocessed gateway-collected flows across six categories. We compare a full-feature baseline, feature suppression (FS), and differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) under one fixed record-level privacy setting. FS-mild excludes four timing features from 16 model inputs; it provides no formal privacy guarantee. With size-proportional aggregation, FS-mild achieves higher combined macro-F1 and worst-group F1 (the minimum per-class F1 across homes) than DP-SGD in all five seeds at both model capacities under stratified and temporal splits. The tested DP-SGD configuration incurs pronounced minority-category losses, especially in the smaller home, but FS-mild does not uniformly improve on the full-feature baseline. On stratified-split models, loss-based and shadow-model membership probes show near-chance aggregate discrimination without a consistent ranking across probes; this does not establish equivalent privacy. These findings support FS as an input-minimization baseline, not a substitute for formal privacy.

AI.tldr: 在双客户端联邦学习中比较全特征、特征抑制(FS)与DP-SGD,发现FS-mild在宏观F1和最差组F1上优于DP-SGD,但FS无正式隐私保证,不能替代形式化隐私方法。
AI.motivation: 住宅流量分类需跨家庭学习,但面临流量异构与隐私约束;隐私感知训练可能对不同流量类别带来不均衡成本,需研究该权衡。
AI.method: 基于162万条网关流量(六类)模拟双客户端联邦学习;对比全特征基线、特征抑制(FS,轻度版从16个输入中排除4个时序特征)与固定记录级隐私设置下的DP-SGD;采用按大小比例聚合,在两种模型容量、分层与时间划分、五个随机种子上评估;并用基于损失和影子模型的成员推断探测隐私。
AI.result: 在所有五个种子、两种模型容量及分层/时间划分下,FS-mild的组合宏观F1和最差组F1均高于DP-SGD;DP-SGD在少数类(尤其较小家庭)损失显著;FS-mild相对全特征基线并非全面提升;成员推断探测接近随机水平,但无一致排序,不能证明隐私等价。
AI.conclusion: FS可作为输入最小化基线,但不能替代正式隐私保证。

title: Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)
summary: Crash datasets that carry an investigator narrative hold information the coded fields omit. Coding those narratives at scale has been blocked by three obstacles. Frontier large language models are costly at that scale, their generated text cannot be verified, and no rule says how much output a human must check. This paper formulates narrative coding as gated, typed decisions answered by Jev, a System One model that returns probabilities over analyst-defined options and generates no text. A screen covered 499,500 Texas narratives and 195,857 were coded with a 27-question schema. Cost is governed by schema size rather than narrative length. The probabilities are audited against coded fields and against 2,416 blinded human judgments drawn under a stated sampling design. Two frontier large language models are benchmarked on the same records. Against human labels the typed model attains an F1 of 0.908. One frontier model gains 0.059 and the other is indistinguishable from it. Calibration varies by model rather than by paradigm, so each model must be audited. Recalibration on the same labels reduces calibration error by a factor of 3.3. Agreement with coded fields understates fidelity to the narrative by a median of 0.26 in kappa. A resolution-floor bound covers any model that reports probabilities on a discrete grid. A review budget over flagged records gives the records a human must read per variable and per year. Adding the calibrated variables to the coded fields raises the injury and fatal crashes attributed to nine factors by 10,747 per year.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用不生成文本的System One模型Jev将事故叙述编码为有门控的类型化决策，返回分析师定义选项的概率，并用审计机制保证可信度，从而在超大规模上提取编码字段遗漏的信息。
AI.motivation: 事故数据集中的调查员叙述包含编码字段遗漏的信息，但大规模编码叙述受三方面阻碍：前沿大语言模型在此规模上成本高、生成文本无法验证、且无规则规定人工需核查多少输出。
AI.method: 将叙述编码形式化为有门控的类型化决策，由System One模型Jev回答，输出分析师定义选项上的概率且不生成文本。筛查499,500条德州叙述，用27题schema编码195,857条；成本由schema大小而非叙述长度决定。概率对照编码字段及按明确抽样设计获得的2,416个人工盲判进行审计，并与两个前沿大语言模型在同一批记录上基准比较。提出离散网格模型的resolution-floor下界，并给出对标记记录的人工复核预算。
AI.result: 对人工标签，类型化模型F1为0.908，一个前沿模型增益0.059，另一个与之无显著差异。校准随模型而非范式变化，故每个模型都需审计；同样标签上重校准使校准误差降低3.3倍。与编码字段的一致度中位数低估对叙述的保真度0.26（kappa）。加入校准变量后，归因于九个因素的受伤与致死事故每年增加10,747起。
AI.conclusion: 叙述编码可由不生成文本的概率化类型决策模型高效、可审计地完成，成本随schema规模而非叙述长度增长；模型校准需逐一审计并重校准，且编码字段的一致度会低估对叙述的真实保真度，校准后的变量能显著改变事故归因统计。

title: Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Neural Operators via Observable Spectral Error Decomposition
summary: Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their reliability under distribution shift remains a critical barrier to deployment. Existing approaches to out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in operator learning are largely empirical and black-box: they report aggregate error metrics without explaining why errors arise or when they will grow. We propose a structure-preserving framework that makes OOD generalization predictable and auditable. Our key idea is to parameterize the learned solution operator as a spectral filter $h_θ(λ)$ acting on the eigenvalues of the underlying elliptic operator, implemented via Chebyshev polynomial expansions and trained with a weak-form objective. This parameterization admits an exact decomposition of the energy-norm error into two observable components: a model-dependent spectral approximation term and a distribution-dependent spectral weighting term induced by the input. From this decomposition we derive three diagnostics: a conservative in-band supremum $\vareps_{\mathrm{sup}}$, a global RMS proxy $\vareps_{\mathrm{rms}}$, and a sample-dependent effective metric $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)$. These diagnostics can be computed without access to ground-truth solutions. Through four controlled experiments, we show that $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)\|f\|$ consistently predicts energy error under in-distribution, in-band spectral shift, out-of-band tail, and compound shifts, whereas global metrics can be systematically misleading. Our framework shifts OOD assessment of neural operators from black-box benchmarking to operator-structure diagnostics, providing a practical route to auditable scientific machine learning.

AI.tldr: 提出结构保持框架，把神经算子OOD泛化变得可预测、可审计，通过谱滤波参数化将能量误差分解为可观测的谱近似项与分布相关谱加权项，并导出三个可无需真值计算的诊断量。
AI.motivation: 神经算子作为PDE代理模型在分布偏移下可靠性不足；现有OOD泛化方法多为经验性黑箱，仅报告聚合误差，无法解释误差来源或预测其增长。
AI.method: 将学习到的解算子参数化为作用于底层椭圆算子特征值的谱滤波器h_θ(λ)，用Chebyshev多项式展开并以弱形式目标训练。该参数化给出能量范数误差的精确分解：模型相关的谱近似项与输入诱导的分布相关谱加权项。由此导出三个诊断量：保守带内上确界ε_sup、全局RMS代理ε_rms、样本相关有效度量ε_eff(f)，均无需真值解即可计算。
AI.result: 在四组受控实验中，ε_eff(f)‖f‖在分布内、带内谱偏移、带外尾部及复合偏移下均能一致预测能量误差，而全局指标系统性误导。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将神经算子的OOD评估从黑箱基准测试转向算子结构诊断，为可审计的科学机器学习提供了实用路径。

title: Efficient Reasoning Exploration via State-Conditioned Latent Steering with Progress Guidance
summary: Best-of-$N$ is a widely used inference strategy for complex reasoning, whose effectiveness depends on whether sampled candidates can cover diverse and high-quality reasoning paths. However, post-trained reasoning models often suffer from \emph{exploration collapse}, where independent rollouts repeatedly follow similar reasoning paths and limit the gains from increasing the rollout budget. Existing methods alleviate this issue by promoting broader exploration, but do not explicitly guide exploration toward continuations that make meaningful progress, resulting in limited exploration efficiency. To address this, we propose \emph{\underline{S}tate-conditioned \underline{P}rogress-guided \underline{S}teering} (SPS), a training-free latent steering framework. Specifically, SPS constructs a state-conditioned Direction Bank containing multiple progress-guided steering vectors for different prefix-state regions. During online inference, SPS retrieves a suitable steering vector based on the current prefix state and applies it at high-uncertainty transitions to guide the next reasoning step toward meaningful progress. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and benchmarks demonstrate that SPS consistently outperforms strong baselines. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of its key designs and offer valuable insights for future research. The code is available at https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练隐空间引导框架SPS，通过状态条件化、进展导向的引导向量解决推理模型探索崩溃问题，提升Best-of-N效率。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N效果依赖采样候选覆盖多样化高质量推理路径，但后训练推理模型存在"探索崩溃"，独立采样反复走相似路径，增加预算收益有限；现有方法仅促进更广探索，未显式指向有意义的进展，探索效率受限。
AI.method: SPS为免训练隐空间引导框架：构建状态条件化的Direction Bank，包含针对不同前缀状态区域的多个进展导向引导向量；在线推理时依据当前前缀状态检索合适向量，并在高不确定性转移处施加引导，指引下一步推理走向有意义的进展。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模和基准上，SPS持续优于强基线；进一步分析验证了关键设计的有效性，并为未来研究提供有价值见解。
AI.conclusion: SPS通过状态条件化和进展导向的隐空间引导，有效缓解探索崩溃、提升探索效率，是一种通用且免训练的解码期改进方案，代码已开源。

title: Preserving Geometric Integrity in Graph Prompting via Measure-Constrained Optimal Transport
summary: Graph prompt learning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of frozen Graph Neural Networks to downstream tasks through lightweight prompt parameters. As routing becomes increasingly node-adaptive, however, independently optimized local decisions can collectively concentrate assignment mass on a small subset of a finite shared prompt bank, even when individual node--prompt matches remain locally meaningful. We propose MINT (Measure-INtegrity Transport), an entropically regularized optimal transport framework that formulates node-to-prompt adaptation as a globally coupled allocation problem. The transport cost favors local geometric compatibility, while a prescribed prompt-side marginal explicitly controls graph-wide prompt utilization. We further derive an exact variance decomposition that separates prompt-side geometric variance into retained prompt-update variation and within-node barycentric dispersion, together with a conditional stability bound for the frozen-encoder forward map. Across standard citation networks and additional heterophilic graphs, MINT remains competitive in few-shot adaptation. Controlled and end-to-end experiments further distinguish the roles of routing and topology: fixed-marginal routing controls graph-wide prompt utilization and has measurable end-to-end effects on citation networks, while topology augmentation provides a complementary, graph-dependent mechanism for addressing structural mismatch. Code is available at https://github.com/Ga1axy0051/MINT.

AI.tldr: MINT 提出用熵正则化最优传输将图提示学习的节点到提示路由建模为全局耦合分配问题，通过规定提示侧边际控制全图提示利用率，并在少样本异质图上保持竞争性。
AI.motivation: 现有图提示学习中路由越来越节点自适应，独立优化的局部决策会导致分配质量集中在共享提示库的少数提示上，即使局部节点-提示匹配仍然合理。
AI.method: 提出 MINT（Measure-INtegrity Transport），一个熵正则化最优传输框架：传输代价偏好局部几何兼容性，规定的提示侧边际显式控制全图提示利用率；并推导精确方差分解，将提示侧几何方差分为保留的提示更新变异与节点内重心离散度，以及冻结编码器前向映射的条件稳定性界。
AI.result: 在标准引文网络和额外异质图上，MINT 在少样本适应中保持竞争性；受控与端到端实验区分了路由与拓扑的作用：固定边际路由控制全图提示利用率，并在引文网络上产生可测的端到端效果，而拓扑增强提供互补的、依赖图的机制来应对结构不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 固定边际路由能有效控制全图提示利用率并产生端到端影响，拓扑增强则作为互补机制应对结构不匹配；方法在少样本适应中具竞争力。

title: You Can Tell Who's Asking: What the Web's Questions Are Made Of, and Where They Come From
comment: Accepted to the 13th Web as Corpus Workshop (WaC-13) at EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/bodhiumlabs/tell-whos-asking
summary: Questions scraped from the web are used across academia and industry as a proxy for what people want to know. Across QA training data, retrieval benchmarks, and content strategy, questions on a page are assumed to reflect human intent. We test this assumption at scale by extracting 13.4B question occurrences across 110 FineWeb snapshots (2013-2025), and report three findings. First, you can tell who is asking: provenance (the host/page of questions) leaves a signal in question form, and a logistic model can separate genuine user questions from templated/manufactured ones at AUC 0.725 via length and surrounding context rather than question type, though only 0.554 against commerce FAQ writing. Second, question frequency does not measure demand: the most-frequent questions are boilerplate/templated (over 70% of the top thousand), so occurrence counts measure how often a string was published and not how often it was asked. Third, over twelve years the genuine share of occurrences fell by 79% (42-56% after controlling for crawl composition), with question length and context decreasing. We present the first diachronic, occurrence-level measurement of web question provenance, and find the crawlable web's questions have shifted from being asked by humans toward manufactured for machines to read.

AI.tldr: 本文大规模检验"网页问题反映人类意图"这一假设，发现网页问题的来源可从形式区分，频率不等于需求，且12年间真实人类提问比例骤降79%。
AI.motivation: 学术界与工业界普遍将网页抓取的问题作为"人们想知道什么"的代理，用于QA训练数据、检索基准与内容策略，但这一假设从未被大规模验证。
AI.method: 从110个FineWeb快照（2013-2025）中提取134亿次问题出现，用逻辑回归模型基于长度和上下文区分真实用户问题与模板/制造问题，并进行历时分析。
AI.result: 来源留下可识别信号，模型区分真实与制造问题AUC为0.725（对商业FAQ写作仅0.554）；最高频问题中逾70%为模板/样板；12年间真实问题占比下降79%（控制抓取构成后为42-56%），问题长度与上下文均缩短。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对网页问题来源的历时、出现级测量，表明可爬取网络的问题已从"人类提问"转向"为机器阅读而制造"。

title: Physics-residual machine learning predicts oxygen-evolution catalyst activity beyond the training range from sparse polarization measurements
summary: Screening oxygen-evolution catalysts on combinatorial libraries requires deciding which candidates receive the remaining measurements. The deciding activity lies beyond each candidate's measured potential window and often above every activity recorded during fitting. We predict it by physics-residual machine learning: the Tafel equation extrapolates the candidate's own measured current and slope, a learned residual attenuated with feature-space distance corrects the magnitude, and an applicability-domain score identifies predictions above the training range before measurement. In a separately fabricated 322-candidate library, 282 above the training maximum, two measurements per candidate gave a mean absolute error of 0.203 mA cm$^{-2}$ against 1.330 for the selected data-driven machine-learning model. Errors inside the training range remained comparable, and 35 labelled catalysts were enough to fit it. In two independent datasets the same construction lowered the overpotential error by 29 to 52%. Campaigns can therefore shorten each measurement and still rank the most active compositions.

AI.tldr: 提出物理残差机器学习方法，通过Tafel方程外推与残差校正预测组合库中氧析出催化剂的活性，大幅提升筛选效率。
AI.motivation: 组合库筛选氧析出催化剂需决定哪些候选进行后续测量，而决定活性的数据通常在测量电位窗口之外、且高于拟合时所有记录值，无法直接测得，需要可靠外推预测。
AI.method: 物理残差机器学习：用Tafel方程外推候选自身测得的电流与斜率；用随特征空间距离衰减的学习残差校正幅度；用适用域分数在测量前识别超出训练范围的预测。
AI.result: 在独立制备的322候选库（282个超训练最大值）中，每候选两次测量，平均绝对误差0.203 mA cm⁻²，而选定的数据驱动机器学习模型为1.330；训练范围内误差相当；仅35个标注催化剂即可拟合；两个独立数据集中过电位误差降低29%到52%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可缩短每次测量并仍能对最具活性的组分排序，从而加快催化剂筛选进程。

title: Re:CAP - Auditing Retrieval Coverage in Production RAG Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is hard to monitor in production: exhaustive relevance labels do not exist for non-stationary multi-million-passage corpora that re-index in real time. As a result, retrieval quality is generally understudied and often deprioritised in favour of generation-oriented metrics. In this work, we propose auditing retrieval coverage by probing for evidence of missing documents rather than enumerating every relevant one. Our method Re:CAP (REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing) is a reference-free audit loop applied to a deployed RAG pipeline's initial answer and retrieved context: it identifies the topics already covered, generates probing questions for plausibly missing topics, retrieves candidate documents, and applies an LLM-as-judge to retain only those that introduce previously-unretrieved information. On four public benchmarks, Re:CAP recovers 9-29% of gold labels that flat BM25 top-500 cannot reach, rising to 48% on TREC-COVID. On MuSiQue Re:CAP beats flat hybrid top-500 by +12.9 pp on recall at less than half the document budget. An ensemble BM25, dense, and hybrid baseline (top-500 each) still leaves out 21.2% of gold docs on TREC-COVID that Re:CAP recovers; human annotators judge that 78.9% of those structurally distinct documents add new information to the baseline answer (Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79, n = 123), and 73.9% on live production traffic (n = 180). End-to-end recall is reproducible to within $\pm$1% across three independent runs, making Re:CAP a stable instrument for periodic retrieval audits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Re:CAP，一种无需参考标注的检索覆盖审计方法：通过迭代探测缺失文档证据来审计 RAG 检索覆盖率，而非枚举所有相关文档。在多个基准与生产流量上，Re:CAP 显著找回基线检索遗漏的 gold 文档并证明其能带来新信息，且结果可稳定复现。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的 RAG 面临非稳态、数百万级且实时重建索引的语料，不存在穷尽的相关性标注，导致检索质量被低估、常让位于面向生成的指标。作者希望提供一种无需完整标注、可实际部署的检索覆盖审计手段。
AI.method: Re:CAP（REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing）是一个应用于已部署 RAG 流程初始答案与检索上下文的无参考审计循环：识别已覆盖主题 → 针对可能缺失主题生成探测问题 → 检索候选文档 → 用 LLM-as-judge 仅保留引入此前未检索到信息的文档，从而迭代审计检索覆盖。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上，Re:CAP 回收了 flat BM25 top-500 无法触及的 9–29% gold 标注，TREC-COVID 上达 48%；在 MuSiQue 上以不到一半文档预算实现比 flat hybrid top-500 高 +12.9 pp 的召回。即便 BM25、稠密与混合 top-500 集成基线在 TREC-COVID 仍遗漏 21.2% gold 文档，Re:CAP 可找回；人工标注认为其中 78.9% 的结构性不同文档为基线答案增加新信息（Fleiss κ=0.79，n=123），生产流量上为 73.9%（n=180）。端到端召回在三次独立运行中可复现性在 ±1% 以内。
AI.conclusion: Re:CAP 是一种无需参考标注、可作为稳定仪器的定期检索审计方法，能够揭示并找回既有强基线遗漏的检索覆盖盲区，同时经人工与生产验证确认其找回文档具有实际信息增益。

title: Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE IECON 2026. 6 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Sink-aware deployment may identify important first-token attention heads before a model is quantized, then reuse that map at the edge. We test when this shortcut is safe for 4-bit NF4 weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ). Our Sink Topology Consistency (STC) metrics separate global rank preservation, top-$k$ set overlap, and layerwise sink-mass shift, and distinguish per-input sensitivity from calibration-map transfer. Across Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama-3.2-1B, global bf16-to-4-bit ranks remain high at 4,096 tokens ($ρ_s \geq 0.980$), yet top-$k$ Jaccard overlap is only 0.619-0.793, corresponding to 76.5-88.5% membership retention. The global statistic also masks local failures: terminal Qwen layers shift by 6.2-7.9x their model means, whereas Llama-3.2-1B shows low, nearly uniform drift. Under a C4-to-LongBench shift, cross-domain overlap degrades more than the within-domain precision comparison for both Qwen models, but not for Llama-3.2-1B. Matched-domain 4-bit recalibration reaches 90% of a split-half stability plateau at the smallest tested $n=8$ for both Qwen models and $n=32$ for Llama-3.2-1B, though not as a sharp threshold; for the two Qwen models, updating only selected layers does not reach the full-map stability criterion. On Jetson Orin NX, the 16-sample workload takes seconds for the two models with valid on-device sink measurements. The practical message is precise: global rankings often transfer, but discrete head sets, layer-local policies, and cross-domain calibration should be revalidated after quantization.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试"沉洞感知部署"在4-bit NF4权重量化后复用注意头映射是否安全，提出STC指标并发现全局排名转移良好但top-k头集合、层级策略与跨域校准需重新验证。
AI.motivation: 沉洞感知部署可先在量化前识别重要的首token注意头并复用到边缘设备，但该捷径在4-bit NF4权重量化PTQ下是否安全尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出Sink Topology Consistency (STC)指标，分离全局排名保持、top-k集合重叠与层级沉洞质量漂移，并区分逐输入敏感性和校准映射转移；在Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、Llama-3.2-1B上测试，含C4到LongBench域偏移及Jetson Orin NX部署。
AI.result: 全局bf16到4-bit排名在4096 token下仍高（ρ_s≥0.980），但top-k Jaccard重叠仅0.619-0.793（成员保留76.5-88.5%）；全局统计掩盖局部失效，Qwen末端层漂移达均值的6.2-7.9倍，Llama接近均匀；跨域重叠在Qwen上退化更明显；匹配域4-bit重校准在n=8（Qwen）与n=32（Llama）达90%稳定性平台，Qwen仅更新部分层不达标；Jetson上16样本工作负载耗时数秒。
AI.conclusion: 全局排名往往可转移，但离散头集合、层级局部策略与跨域校准应在量化后重新验证。

title: TAC-Time: Texts as Channels For Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
summary: Most existing time series forecasting methods rely solely on numerical observations, overlooking rich contextual information from auxiliary texts. Recent multimodal approaches attempt to incorporate textual signals, but they often treat text as static features or use large language models as forecasting backbones, limiting their ability to capture temporal dynamics and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose TAC-Time, a unified framework that transforms textual information into additional temporal channels. By modeling text features jointly with numerical sequences in a shared temporal backbone, TAC-Time preserves temporal continuity and periodic structures while remaining efficient and scalable. This formulation also enables systematic interpretability analyses. We show strong cross-modal dependencies through attention and frequency-domain analyses, and identify predictive textual signals whose correlation-aware alignment yields partial forecasting improvements. Extensive experiments on real-world multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that TAC-Time outperforms prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 TAC-Time 框架，将辅助文本转化为额外的时间通道，与数值序列在共享时序骨干中联合建模，实现高效、可扩展且可解释的多模态时间序列预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时序预测多依赖数值观测，忽略辅助文本的语境信息；已有方法要么将文本视为静态特征，要么用大语言模型作为预测骨干，前者难以捕捉时间动态，后者计算开销大。
AI.method: 将文本特征转化为额外的时间通道，与数值序列在共享时序骨干中联合建模，保留时间连续性与周期结构，并支持系统性的可解释性分析（注意力与频域分析）。
AI.result: 通过注意力与频域分析揭示强跨模态依赖，识别出具预测性的文本信号，其相关性对齐能带来部分预测提升；在真实多模态基准上，TAC-Time 优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: TAC-Time 提供了一种统一、高效、可扩展且可解释的多模态时序预测范式，验证了文本作为时间通道的有效性。

title: Efficient LLM Distillation for Bangladesh Legal Context: A Smartphone-Compatible Retrieval-Augmented Generation Model
summary: Legal information in Bangladesh is inaccessible to most citizens. Statutory text is English-only, trained lawyers are concentrated in urban centres, and cloud-dependent AI fails where mobile connectivity is unreliable, a setting in which hallucinated legal text causes direct harm. The system addresses statutory interpretation only; queries that require judicial precedent or case-law reasoning fall outside its scope. We target the statutory access gap by compressing a 9-billion-parameter Gemma-2 teacher into a 2-billion-parameter student through two-phase progressive knowledge distillation. Phase 1 performs supervised fine-tuning on 9,429 quality-gated legal question-answer pairs (65% acceptance from 14,514 generated queries); Phase 2 minimises sparse Kullback-Leibler divergence against the teacher's top-50 per-token logits at temperature tau = 4.0, implemented via QLoRA (4-bit NF4, rank-32 LoRA adapters). Prior legal language models target general legal English; this system specialises in Bangladeshi statutory law. Every response is grounded through hybrid retrieval combining dense semantic search (60%) and BM25 (40%) across 36,029 statutory passages from the Bangladesh Constitution and national legislation. On a 50-query English benchmark, the distilled model reaches ROUGE-L 0.4715 and BERTScore F1 0.5679, a 103% ROUGE-L and 143% BERTScore gain over the retrieval-augmented undistilled baseline (ROUGE-L 0.2323, BERTScore 0.2340). The adapter quantises to 1.6 GB (GGUF Q4_K_M) and runs at 4-8 tokens per second on a Pixel 6 with no network access. Cross-lingual evaluation on 50 Bangla queries yields ROUGE-L 0.4083 and BERTScore 0.8133, showing effective retrieval from Bangla input against an English-only corpus. In a single-evaluator pilot, a practising lawyer rated 50 responses at a weighted mean of 4.16/5 (90% rated 4 or 5), supporting utility beyond text-overlap metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向孟加拉国法律信息不可及问题，通过两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏将9B Gemma-2压缩为2B学生模型，结合混合检索实现本地离线运行的成文法问答系统。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国成文法仅英文、律师集中城市、云AI依赖网络，且幻觉法律文本会造成直接伤害，亟需可在低连通环境下运行的本地化成文法解释工具。
AI.method: 两阶段渐进知识蒸馏：阶段1在9,429条质量过滤的法律问答对上监督微调（14,514条生成查询中65%通过）；阶段2用QLoRA（4-bit NF4，rank-32）最小化与教师top-50 logits的稀疏KL散度（tau=4.0）。检索采用稠密语义搜索(60%)+BM25(40%)混合，覆盖36,029段成文法条文。
AI.result: 50条英文基准上ROUGE-L 0.4715、BERTScore F1 0.5679，较未蒸馏检索基线分别提升103%和143%；适配器量化至1.6GB，Pixel 6离线运行4-8 tokens/s。50条孟加拉语查询ROUGE-L 0.4083、BERTScore 0.8133。律师单评试点加权均值4.16/5（90%为4或5分）。
AI.conclusion: 该系统有效弥合孟加拉国成文法访问鸿沟，实现移动端离线可用的检索增强蒸馏模型，跨语言检索有效且获法律从业者认可；但仅限成文法解释，不含判例推理。

title: Bilinear Optimization Divergence: Diagnosing Factor-Constrained LoRA Continual Learning
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Code is available at [https://github.com/legend91019/My_first](https://github.com/legend91019/My_first)
summary: Orthogonality in a LoRA factor does not by itself specify what the composed update protects: the answer depends on the task-start state, the parameterization, and the realized optimizer displacement. We formalize this question through Bilinear Optimization Divergence (BOD), an anchor-relative diagnostic of effective-update response on selected historical features. The finite-step analysis distinguishes two cases. In a shared adapter, protecting the routing displacement leaves a learned-anchor residual through the changing companion factor. In a fresh zero-output block, a feasible routing state can protect the composed update while both current factors remain trainable. These conditions yield Semi-Frozen Orthogonal Routing (SFOR) for shared adapters and current-block hard protection for cumulative O-LoRA; Weight Residual Projection (WRP) enforces the required displacement after the optimizer step. Controlled two-task traces verify the predicted residual paths, reducing normalized historical response from 19.12% to 0.005% in the shared family and from 7.72% to 0.002% in the cumulative family. Four-task experiments on Qwen3-8B characterize the resulting trade-offs: SFOR improves backward transfer (BWT) from -2.47 to -0.86 with nearly unchanged average accuracy (AA), while O-LoRA hard protection improves three-order mean AA from 80.27% to 81.30% and forgetting measure (FM) from 2.20 to 0.43. Component controls also show that stricter feasibility need not improve final task performance. Together, the analysis and evidence provide an architecture-conditioned account of which constraint to enforce, how to enforce it, and how to interpret its empirical value.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BOD诊断分析LoRA更新保护问题，提出SFOR与WRP，在共享适配器和累积O-LoRA中分别减少历史响应并改善BWT/AA/FM。
AI.motivation: LoRA因子的正交性本身不能确定组合更新保护了什么，其结果依赖任务起始状态、参数化和优化器实际位移，因此需要锚点相对的诊断指标来厘清该问题。
AI.method: 提出Bilinear Optimization Divergence (BOD)，对选定历史特征上的有效更新响应做锚点相对诊断；有限步分析区分共享适配器（存在学习锚残差）与全新零输出块（可行路由状态可保护组合更新且两因子可训练）两种情形；据此给出SFOR（共享适配器半冻结正交路由）与累积O-LoRA当前块硬保护，并用WRP在优化步骤后强制所需位移。
AI.result: 双任务轨迹验证预测的残差路径，共享族归一化历史响应从19.12%降至0.005%，累积族从7.72%降至0.002%。Qwen3-8B四任务实验中，SFOR将BWT从-2.47提升至-0.86且AA几乎不变；O-LoRA硬保护将三阶平均AA从80.27%提升至81.30%，FM从2.20降至0.43。组件控制显示更严格的可行性未必提升最终任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 分析提供了架构条件下的指导：应根据架构选择约束类型、执行方式并解释其经验价值。

title: When Residualization Helps an Audit: Format Effects, Slice Gains, and Their Limits
summary: Evaluation scores used around LLM systems -- including reward models, rerankers, and LLM judges -- can track surface form instead of the quality they claim to measure. When presented with a terse correct solution and a commented buggy solution for the same MBPP problem, a public preference reward model selects the correct one no better than a coin flip (0.507). Subtracting the predictable surface component from such scores is increasingly common, but removal alone does not yield a more valid measurement: the removed component may carry construct-relevant signal, and residualization cannot tell which is which. Under designed interventions -- unit-test labels with comment-only edits -- residualization attenuates the reward model's format effects by about 0.12 on both correct and buggy code, while the correct-versus-buggy margins move by less than 0.01. In observational NLI and QA settings, we freeze a held-out replication before scoring and re-evaluate it using labels from disjoint annotators; this supports only a narrower conclusion: better agreement with the construct labels on a pre-declared slice where a surface-only predictor errs, not a repaired score. Full-population agreement falls in every observational setting with a reported positive slice gain, and within-question ranking falls in every such QA setting. When construct and surface features are entangled, residualization can decorrelate a score while degrading construct alignment, and, in a controlled model, configurations just as damaging to construct alignment pass every pre-adjustment check, so no committed gate is a guarantee. We assemble these distinctions into a reporting protocol whose outcomes, refusal included, state what an adjusted score may be claimed to show: an audit-time diagnostic reported beside the construct-alignment cost it incurs, never a replacement for the raw score.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑对LLM评测分数做"表面形式残差化"的常见做法，提出应将其视为审计诊断而非修复后的分数，并给出报告协议。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型、重排序器与LLM评审的分数常追踪表面形式（如注释、格式）而非真实质量，例如公开偏好奖励模型在MBPP"简洁正确解 vs 带注释错误解"上仅0.507准确率。减去可预测表面成分虽流行，但去除成分可能含构念相关信号，残差化无法区分二者。
AI.method: 设计干预实验：仅改注释的单元测试标签；观测性NLI与QA设置中，冻结留出复制集并用不重叠标注者的标签重评；并在受控模型中检验各类预调整检查能否拦截有害配置。
AI.result: 残差化将格式效应约削减0.12（正确与错误代码均如此），而正确-错误边际变化小于0.01；观测设置下仅支持较窄结论：在预先声明的"表面预测器出错"切片上构念一致性更好，但全样本一致性在每个报告正向切片增益的设置中均下降，QA中问题内排序也下降。
AI.conclusion: 当构念与表面特征纠缠时，残差化可能让分数去相关却损害构念对齐，且损害构念对齐的配置也能通过所有预调整检查，无门控可保证。应将其作为审计诊断与构念对齐代价并列报告，绝不替代原始分数。

title: ETH-TraceBench: A Large-Scale Event-Stream Benchmark for Ethereum DeFi under Temporal, Protocol, and Contract Shift
comment: 30 pages. Under review at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Ethereum decentralized finance (DeFi) provides a public, time-stamped record of transaction-level event streams, but the same public symbols can create strong machine-learning shortcuts. We introduce ETH-TraceBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ethereum DeFi representations under temporal, protocol, pool/infrastructure, and symbolic shift. The raw event universe covers January 2021-December 2025 and contains 1.35 billion transactions with logs and 5.01 billion raw log rows. Model evaluation uses a fixed 911,267-instance supervised sample, training on 2021-2024, selecting models on 2025H1, and testing on 2025H2. Simple models perform strongly on the aggregate temporal test: TraceStats-GB reaches 0.953 macro-F1 and TopicEmitterHashMLP 0.959 on the canonical DEX test set. Performance drops sharply under protocol novelty, with macro-F1 of 0.794, 0.743, and 0.766 for TraceStats-GB, TopicEmitterTrace-SGD, and TopicEmitterHashMLP, while strict unseen-pool scores remain 0.927, 0.897, and 0.935. Uniswap v4 and Ekubo v1, both absent from supervised training, are materially harder than the full test. Jointly masking emitter and topic identity reduces DEX macro-F1 to 0.916 and liquidation macro-F1 to 0.774 for TopicEmitterTrace-SGD. A standard Transformer over log-index-ordered events provides no consistent advantage over a deterministic shuffle of the same events, indicating that high aggregate scores can arise without sophisticated chronological modeling. A natural-prevalence audit estimates 2025H2 DEX prevalence among logged Ethereum transactions at about 22.5%, and a deterministic 400-transaction audit finds complete agreement with task label sources and independently re-queried raw-log counts. ETH-TraceBench therefore treats difficult transfer and controlled-input conditions, rather than a single aggregate score, as the main evaluation target.

AI.tldr: 提出 ETH-TraceBench 基准，评估以太坊 DeFi 表示在时间、协议、池/基础设施与符号偏移下的迁移能力，强调困难迁移条件而非单一聚合分数。
AI.motivation: 以太坊 DeFi 提供公开、带时间戳的交易级事件流，但公共符号易造成机器学习捷径，导致模型看似高性能实则依赖表面特征，需专门基准检验真实迁移能力。
AI.method: 构建覆盖 2021.01–2025.12 的事件宇宙（13.5 亿交易、50.1 亿原始日志行）；使用固定 911,267 实例监督样本，2021–2024 训练、2025H1 选型、2025H2 测试；引入协议新颖性、未见过池、联合遮蔽 emitter/topic 身份等受控条件，并与确定性打乱的 Transformer 对比。
AI.result: 聚合时间测试上 TraceStats-GB 达 0.953 macro-F1，TopicEmitterHashMLP 0.959；协议新颖性下骤降至 0.794/0.743/0.766，严格未见池仍为 0.927/0.897/0.935；Uniswap v4 与 Ekubo v1 更难；联合遮蔽 emitter/topic 后 DEX 降至 0.916、清算 0.774；Transformer 相较确定性打乱无一致优势；2025H2 DEX 自然流行率约 22.5%，400 笔审计完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 高聚合分数可能无需复杂时间建模即可获得，ETH-TraceBench 应以困难迁移与受控输入条件作为主要评测目标。

title: LoopCD: Loop-wise Contrastive Decoding for Improving Reasoning in Looped Language Models
summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform "latent reasoning" by recursively refining internal latent representations with shared weights, offering a more effective alternative to explicit verbal reasoning. Despite their effectiveness, we find that LoopLMs remain prone to loop instability: unstable refinement across iterations can produce localized uncertain "hard" tokens associated with reasoning errors. To address this, we propose LoopCD, loop-wise contrastive decoding that enhances the reasoning performance of LoopLMs by intervening on these tokens at inference time. Specifically, we exploit the internal dynamics of LoopLMs and contrast the logits from earlier iterations with logits from the last refined iteration to form the final sampling distribution. We find that this strategy is highly efficient, introducing only negligible inference overhead and requiring no additional training, while effectively improving reasoning performance by naturally refining reasoning-critical hard tokens. Extensive experiments show that our method improves the performance of recent representative LoopLMs across various reasoning tasks.
