Model performance varied across survey rounds and subgroups, highlighting the importance of temporal validation, subgroup fairness assessment, and transparent interpretation in public health prediction modeling.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2007-2022年孟加拉国DHS数据，开发11种机器学习模型预测儿童发育迟缓，并用2018、2022年数据做时序验证，同时评估亚组公平性。
AI.motivation: 儿童发育迟缓是孟加拉国重大公共卫生问题，需要建立群体层面的预测模型，并检验其时间稳健性与亚组公平性。
AI.method: 纳入0-59月龄完整数据儿童（n=18,844）；用2007、2011、2014年数据建模，2018、2022年作时序测试。评估12种特征选择方法，采用KNN置换重要性特征集。比较11种模型（10种传统算法+TabPFN），指标含平衡准确率、AUROC、F1、Brier分数、ECE，按性别、居住地、社会经济地位评估公平性。
AI.result: 样本中35.05%儿童发育迟缓。开发集留出测试中TabPFN平衡准确率最高（67.58%），传统模型中AdaBoost最高（67.51%）。时序测试中，2018年Gradient Boosting、2022年XGBoost表现最佳。模型表现随调查轮次和亚组而变化。
AI.conclusion: 公共卫生预测建模中，时序验证、亚组公平性评估和透明解释至关重要。

title: NAVIR: Neuromorphic Audio-Visual Speech Recognition for Robust Human-Robot Interaction on Edge Hardware
summary: Voice-controlled interaction in industrial settings is hampered by acoustic noise, which severely degrades audio-only speech recognition. Audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) addresses this by fusing lip-motion cues with the audio stream, but state-of-the-art pipelines rely on three-dimensional convolutions, recurrent units, and attention modules that exceed the budget of typical edge devices. We present NAVIR, an end-to-end AVSR system targeting the BrainChip Akida neuromorphic processor, which natively supports only sequential two-dimensional convolutional inference. The pipeline factorises spatial and temporal encoding into separate AkidaNet-based modules: a per-frame visual encoder, a temporal video encoder, and a spectrogram audio encoder, fused by a lightweight predictor head and decoded by constrained beam search. Models are trained with connectionist temporal classification on noise-augmented audio and then fine-tuned with quantization-aware training. On the GRID benchmark, the quantized audio-visual model reaches 14.0% word error rate (WER) under noise on the unseen-speaker split and 3.3% WER on the overlapped-speaker split, against 22.5% and 11.8% for audio-only baselines, and it attains 98.6% command accuracy at 1.5% WER on a task-specific industrial-command corpus. Operation-count analysis indicates a 13-fold energy advantage of the spiking formulation over its artificial neural network counterpart at 27.6% mean firing rate. On-board measurements show roughly 5-fold lower energy per inference than a Raspberry Pi central processing unit on the lip-reading model, and over 100-fold lower than a laptop graphics processing unit, while sustaining 14.5 inferences per second. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first complete multimodal AVSR pipeline running on neuromorphic hardware of this class.

AI.tldr: 提出NAVIR，首个面向BrainChip Akida神经形态处理器的端到端音视频语音识别系统，在工业噪声场景下显著优于纯音频基线并实现极低能耗。
AI.motivation: 工业场景中噪声严重损害纯音频语音识别，而现有AVSR方案依赖三维卷积、循环单元和注意力模块，超出典型边缘设备算力预算。
AI.method: 将时空编码分解为基于AkidaNet的独立模块（逐帧视觉编码器、时序视频编码器、频谱图音频编码器），用轻量预测头融合，约束波束搜索解码；采用CTC在噪声增强音频上训练，再用量化感知训练微调。
AI.result: GRID基准上量化音视频模型在未见说话人划分14.0% WER、重叠说话人划分3.3% WER（纯音频基线为22.5%和11.8%）；工业命令语料达98.6%命令准确率、1.5% WER；脉冲形式较ANN有13倍能耗优势（27.6%平均发放率）；板载测量比树莓派CPU能耗低约5倍、比笔记本GPU低100倍以上，达14.5次推理/秒。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个在此类神经形态硬件上运行的完整多模态AVSR流水线。

title: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
summary: Sparse on-policy distillation (OPD) allocates teacher supervision to a small subset of tokens in student-generated trajectories. However, useful teacher guidance can yield a noisy update when its gradient is estimated from a sampled next token. We study this estimation problem at a fixed prefix in information geometry and propose an information-efficiency ratio (IER) based on a signal-to-noise decomposition. IER characterizes relative gradient estimation error under an optimal scalar baseline. A candidate-set approximation enables token selection based on IER and its combination with existing usefulness scores, while retaining the sampled reverse-KL training objective. On mathematical and medical reasoning tasks, adding IER improves existing selectors in multiple settings, with sparse configurations matching or exceeding full OPD without token selection at small token budgets of 0.1\%--1\%. These results support accounting for both usefulness and gradient-estimation reliability when allocating sparse supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/BruceSheng1202/IER-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏on-policy蒸馏(OPD)中的梯度估计问题，提出基于信噪比分解的信息效率比(IER)，用于更可靠地选择教师监督的token，在数学和医学推理任务上提升了现有选择器。
AI.motivation: 稀疏OPD只在学生生成轨迹的少量token上分配教师监督，但有用的教师指导若从采样的下一个token估计梯度，会引入噪声更新。现有方法多关注监督"有用性"，而忽略梯度估计的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 在固定前缀下用信息几何研究该估计问题，基于信噪比分解提出信息效率比(IER)，刻画在最优标量基线下的相对梯度估计误差；通过候选集近似实现基于IER的token选择，并可结合现有有用性分数，同时保留采样的reverse-KL训练目标。
AI.result: 在数学与医学推理任务上，加入IER可在多种设置下改进现有选择器；在0.1%--1%的极小token预算下，稀疏配置可媲美甚至超越无token选择的全量OPD。
AI.conclusion: 分配稀疏监督时应同时考虑"有用性"和"梯度估计可靠性"，IER为实现这一目标提供了有效工具。代码已开源。

title: Climate Variability Modulates the Impact of Price Spikes on Food Insecurity
summary: Climate variability influences whether a market disruption escalates into a food crisis, yet broad climate patterns like El Niño, tracked months before they alter hydro-climatic conditions, are still not incorporated as an early-warning component in food-security responses. We address this gap by introducing sensitivity regimes, a stratification of regions by the direction and strength of their vegetation response to the El Niño Southern Oscillation, and using them to estimate how food price spikes affect acute food insecurity across sub-Saharan Africa. Integrating remote sensing, socioeconomic data, and causal machine learning, we find that in regions where ENSO systematically suppresses vegetation, a price spike raises the share of the population at acute risk by 5.4 percentage points in the following month. In regions where vegetation is unaffected by or positively linked to ENSO, the estimated effect is smaller (around 2 percentage points) and statistically insignificant. These results demonstrate that climate context is critical for understanding food security vulnerabilities. Sensitivity regimes can be combined with operational price-spike triggers to stage anticipatory action: the ENSO state flags vulnerable regions months ahead, and a pre-positioned response in those regions to a price spike would avert the largest jump in acute food insecurity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"敏感性机制"(sensitivity regimes)分层方法,将ENSO对植被的影响方向与强度用于区分区域,结合遥感、社会经济数据与因果机器学习,估计粮价飙升对撒哈拉以南非洲急性粮食不安全的影响。
AI.motivation: 气候变率决定市场冲击是否演变为粮食危机,但像厄尔尼诺这样可提前数月追踪的大尺度气候模式,尚未被纳入粮食安全响应的预警体系。
AI.method: 按植被对ENSO响应的方向与强度对区域进行分层(敏感性机制),整合遥感、社会经济数据与因果机器学习,估计粮价飙升对急性粮食不安全的影响。
AI.result: 在ENSO系统性抑制植被的区域,粮价飙升使下月急性风险人口比例上升5.4个百分点;在植被不受影响或正相关的区域,效应较小(约2个百分点)且统计不显著。
AI.conclusion: 气候背景对理解粮食安全脆弱性至关重要;敏感性机制可结合业务化粮价飙升触发条件用于提前行动——ENSO状态提前数月标记脆弱区域,提前部署响应可避免急性粮食不安全的最大跃升。

title: Probabilistic Modelling of Operational Design Domains, A New Approach for Testing AI Systems
summary: The conventional testing process quickly fails when applied to ML-based systems such as obstacle detection in vehicles: if an obstacle is not detected in a test, classical bug fixing is impossible and an AI system will always retain shortcomings. Test results can therefore only be interpreted statistically, which in turn requires test sets that are not only complete with respect to the operational design domain (ODD) of the system, but also representative of it. To this end, we introduce probabilistically extended ontologies (PEONs): ontologies describing the ODD, augmented with a probability distribution over the partitioning they induce. Instead of unmaintainable conditional probability tables, only marginal distributions and functionally described dependencies need to be specified; algorithms based on couplings and optimal transport complete this specification to a Bayesian network. From a PEON we derive the sampling of representative test cases, rigorous end-of-test criteria for given quality targets and significance levels, and methods for re-evaluating existing test results and for assessing the balance of training data. We demonstrate the practical modelling of a complex ODD using the example of automatic train operation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出概率扩展本体(PEONs)，用于描述系统运行设计域(ODD)及其概率分布，从而支持代表性测试用例采样、基于统计的测试终止准则及数据平衡性评估。
AI.motivation: 传统测试流程不适用于基于ML的系统（如车辆障碍物检测）：若测试中漏检障碍物，无法进行经典意义上的缺陷修复，AI系统会一直保留该缺陷。因此测试结果只能从统计角度解释，这要求测试集不仅需对ODD完备，还需具有代表性。
AI.method: 引入PEONs：在描述ODD的本体之上，增加关于其诱导划分的概率分布。无需维护条件概率表，只需指定边缘分布和函数化描述的依赖关系；再通过基于耦合(coupling)和最优传输的算法，将该规格补全为贝叶斯网络。
AI.result: 基于PEON可实现：代表性测试用例的采样、针对给定质量目标与显著性水平的严格测试终止准则、对已有测试结果的重新评估方法，以及训练数据平衡性的评估。并以自动列车运行(ATO)为例，展示了复杂ODD的实际建模。
AI.conclusion: PEONs为ML系统提供了一种可维护、概率化的ODD建模方式，将本体与概率分布结合，支撑统计意义上严谨的测试设计与评估。

title: Artificial Structure Function Search: Preserving Artificial Functional Connectivity for Structured Pruning
summary: Structured pruning is a model compression technique that is used to reduce the computational cost of deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices. Popular methods of pruning rely on opaque heuristics or weight-based criteria that give no indication as to the structural dependencies in the network. To address these limitations we present Artificial Structure Function Search (ASF-S): a novel structured pruning framework. ASF-S utilizes Principle Gradient Importance (PGI): a novel prune-candidate selection criteria that is inspired by structure-function relationships in the brain. By ensuring the pruned structure of the model respects topographical organization of the output layer, we define Artificial Functional Connectivity (AFC) for artificial neural networks. AFC provides evidence to demonstrate that accurate smaller networks can be found using careful prune candidate selection criteria. We present results for PGI as a selection criterion and for ASF-S as a pruning framework against recent benchmarks, demonstrating that our method yields model variants with 70\% parameter reduction, that can recover baseline accuracy without re-training the pruned layers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化剪枝框架ASF-S及其候选选择准则PGI，受大脑结构-功能关系启发，通过尊重输出层拓扑组织定义AFC，实现70%参数缩减且无需重训练即可恢复基线精度。
AI.motivation: 现有主流剪枝方法依赖不透明的启发式规则或基于权重的准则，无法揭示网络中的结构依赖关系，限制了结构化剪枝的效果与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出ASF-S结构化剪枝框架，采用源自大脑结构-功能关系启发的新型剪枝候选选择准则PGI；通过保证剪枝后模型结构尊重输出层的拓扑组织，定义人工神经网络的人工功能连接性AFC，用于指导精细的候选选择。
AI.result: PGI作为选择准则、ASF-S作为剪枝框架均与近期基准方法对比验证，模型变体实现70%参数缩减，且无需重训练被剪层即可恢复基线精度。
AI.conclusion: AFC证实通过谨慎的剪枝候选选择可找到精确的小型网络，ASF-S在参数缩减与精度保持方面优于现有基准，为结构化剪枝提供了可解释的新思路。

title: Muon Can Outperform Dedicated Continual Learning Methods
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Presented at the 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), Work-in-Progress Track, 2026. Sebastian George Sincari and Bogdan Alexandru Gheorghe contributed equally
summary: Continual learning with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA) typically mitigates forgetting by penalizing the overlap between a new update and the accumulated past weights, which discourages certain update directions without controlling how an update distributes its energy over the ones that remain. We ask whether that restriction has to be task-aware, or whether a generic one supplied by the optimizer is enough. We train a plain incremental LoRA (IncLoRA) with Muon, which orthogonalizes each update, and compare it against O-LoRA and ELLA over five seeds and three task orders on the Standard CL Benchmark and three seeds on TRACE. IncLoRA+Muon reaches the accuracy band of the dedicated methods on Standard CL and improves on every AdamW configuration on TRACE. One update-constraining mechanism is enough, whether it comes from the loss or from the optimizer; on Standard CL a second one does not help, and for the most restrictive method it costs 8.4 points of accuracy and the plasticity to fit each task. What separates the two optimizers is not the size of the update, which under Muon is 0.91 to 2.06 times that under AdamW, but how it is distributed. AdamW confines it to between 1.4 and 1.8 effective singular directions, Muon spreads it over 7.0, and the two do not overlap in any tracked run. Part of the advantage usually attributed to dedicated CL methods may therefore be explained by the geometry of the optimizer's updates.

AI.tldr: 用Muon正交化更新的朴素增量LoRA（IncLoRA+Muon）即可达到专用持续学习方法（O-LoRA、ELLA）的精度，说明单一约束机制（来自损失或优化器）已足够，优化器更新的几何分布而非幅度是优势来源。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA持续学习通过惩罚新更新与累积过去权重的重叠来缓解遗忘，但这会在不控制更新能量分配的情况下抑制某些更新方向。作者质疑这种限制是否必须任务感知，还是优化器提供的通用限制就足够。
AI.method: 用Muon训练朴素增量LoRA（IncLoRA），Muon对每次更新进行正交化。在Standard CL Benchmark上对比O-LoRA和ELLA，使用五个随机种子、三种任务顺序；在TRACE上使用三个种子。
AI.result: IncLoRA+Muon在Standard CL上达到专用方法的精度范围，在TRACE上优于所有AdamW配置。Standard CL上第二个约束无益，对最严格方法反而损失8.4个精度点和可塑性。Muon更新大小为AdamW的0.91–2.06倍，但AdamW将更新限制在1.4–1.8个有效奇异方向，Muon则分布在7.0个方向，二者无重叠。
AI.conclusion: 一个更新约束机制就足够，无论来自损失还是优化器。专用CL方法的部分优势可能源于优化器更新的几何性质，而非方法本身。

title: ARM: Attention with Routed-Memory for Learnable Sparse Control
comment: Accepted to the Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026. First two authors contributed equally
summary: Despite advances in long-context inference, large language models (LLMs) remain fundamentally limited by the key-value (KV) caching mechanisms that are necessary for stable computation. Techniques such as selective token eviction and pruning have vastly mitigated these issues, but often discard core information to manage the growing cache. In this paper, we propose Attention with Routed Memory (ARM) a novel KV caching structure that introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size memory system organized as a hierarchical router. Via a Gumbel-Softmax, ARM learns to select memory slots and perform sigmoid-gated updates that softly combine new and stored information, avoiding hard eviction and reducing information loss. By further training a policy to dynamically select varying amounts of memory at inference, ARM adapts its accesses for both simple contexts and inputs that require deeper reasoning, enabling more scalable and effective retrieval on both short- and long-contexts. Experimental results on standard commonsense and long-context reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ARM achieves superior performance and efficiency compared to fixed KV-caching approaches, while remaining efficient and scalable in terms of both memory and generation latency.

AI.tldr: 提出ARM，一种可微、固定大小的KV缓存结构，通过分层路由器和Gumbel-Softmax选择内存槽并进行软更新，避免硬驱逐，提升长上下文推理性能与效率。
AI.motivation: LLM长上下文推理受限于KV缓存机制；现有选择性token驱逐/剪枝方法虽缓解问题，但会丢弃核心信息。
AI.method: 提出Attention with Routed Memory (ARM)：完全可微的固定大小内存系统，组织为分层路由器；用Gumbel-Softmax选择内存槽，sigmoid门控软更新新旧信息；并训练策略在推理时动态选择不同内存访问量。
AI.result: 在标准常识与长上下文推理基准上，ARM在性能和效率上均优于固定KV缓存方法，且在内存和生成延迟方面保持高效可扩展。
AI.conclusion: ARM通过可微路由内存替代硬驱逐，减少信息损失，并能自适应地分配内存访问，兼顾短上下文与需深度推理的长上下文任务。

title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
summary: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.

AI.tldr: 提出RRSI，通过对harness自进化的候选提案与选择施加正则化约束，缓解过拟合，在分布内提升14.1分、分布外提升4.7分，并降低30% token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM agent能力很大程度取决于其harness（提示、控制流、工具、记忆、上下文管理）。近年方法通过迭代式地提出并选择harness的组件级编辑，实现agent系统层面的递归自改进（RSI）。但这种递归进化会记忆训练任务而过拟合，导致分布内收益大、分布外收益缩小甚至消失。
AI.method: RRSI将正则化原则引入harness自改进，约束进化候选的提案与选择：提案器采用时间退火预算，限制候选可捆绑的编辑数量，并基于进化历史鼓励探索未走过的轨迹；选择器配备critic与pruner，critic筛选基准特定的提案，pruner移除过小、过贵或不再有用的改动。二者共同使机制倾向于可复用而非基准特定或噪声。
AI.result: 在代码、agent工作空间和工程设计等八个基准上，RRSI在进化所用划分上最高提升14.1分，在五个分布外基准上最高提升4.7分，同时harness相比无正则化进化少用30%的policy token。
AI.conclusion: 对harness递归自改进施加正则化可有效抑制基准过拟合，兼顾分布内性能与分布外泛化，并提升token效率，代码与项目已开源。

title: Comparing Latent Concept Formation in State Space Models and Transformers via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: The quadratic scaling of Transformer self-attention has driven the adoption of sub-quadratic Selective State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba, which compress past context into a fixed-size recurrent hidden state. This strict informational bottleneck raises a foundational question for mechanistic interpretability: do SSMs and Transformers learn fundamentally distinct latent representations? In this work, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to conduct a large-scale, feature-level correspondence analysis between Mamba-130m and Pythia-70m over a 10-million token corpus. Contrary to hypotheses predicting widespread architectural divergence, we find no evidence of systematic representational divergence between architectures: across the observed Jaccard distribution, 99.98% of Mamba features cluster toward the upper alignment boundary, providing preliminary feature-level support for the Universality Hypothesis. We further identify and qualitatively characterize this microscopic fraction (0.02%) of diverging features, finding patterns consistent with the hypothesis that the recurrent bottleneck selectively limits the parsing of rigid syntax rather than broad semantic ontology. We demonstrate that while Pythia's unconstrained attention permits the monosemantic decomposition of distinct formatting edge-cases, Mamba is forced to compress unrelated syntactical anomalies into polysemantic "junk drawer" neurons to preserve state capacity. Collectively, these results suggest that architectural routing mechanisms may have negligible impact on core semantic understanding, with representational divergence confined to extreme structural margins.

AI.tldr: 该论文用稀疏自编码器(SAE)对Mamba与Pythia做特征级对齐分析，发现99.98%特征高度对齐，支持"表征通用性假说"，分歧仅限极少数刚性语法特征。
AI.motivation: Transformer自注意力的二次复杂度推动Mamba等亚二次SSM的采用，但SSM将上下文压缩为固定大小的循环隐状态，形成严格信息瓶颈。这引发机制可解释性的根本问题：SSM与Transformer是否学习根本不同的潜在表征？
AI.method: 在1000万token语料上，用稀疏自编码器(SAE)对Mamba-130m与Pythia-70m进行大规模特征级对应分析，统计Jaccard分布并定性刻画分歧特征。
AI.result: 与预测架构广泛分歧的假说相反，Jaccard分布中99.98%的Mamba特征聚集于对齐上界，无系统性表征分歧证据。仅0.02%分歧特征，表现为Mamba将无关句法异常压缩为多义"垃圾抽屉"神经元，而Pythia能单义分解格式化边缘案例。
AI.conclusion: 架构路由机制对核心语义理解的影响可能可忽略不计；表征分歧仅限于极端结构性边缘，与循环瓶颈选择性限制刚性语法解析而非广泛语义本体的假说一致。

title: MUSE: Dependency-Aware Adaptation of a Frozen Vision Backbone for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time-series forecasting is essential to many real-world applications. Recent large vision models (LVMs) offer a promising paradigm by transferring cross-domain visual priors to time-series forecasting. However, existing LVM-based methods face two key challenges: balancing independent visual representation spaces with cross-variable dependency modeling, and adapting vision backbones pretrained on natural images to the distinct temporal semantics of time-series images. To address these challenges, we propose MUSE, a dependency-aware adaptation framework built on a fully frozen pretrained MAE. First, the Variable Context Refinement Module (VCR) aggregates shared temporal information within each variable and models cross-variable contextual dependencies while preserving independent visual spaces. Second, the Temporal-Periodic Refinement Module (TPR) performs lightweight refinement at different encoder depths and explicitly models across-period temporal dependencies and within-period periodic dependencies. The two modules independently produce forecasts, which are fused through a learnable prediction-level gate. Experiments on 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that MUSE achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: MUSE是一个基于完全冻结预训练MAE的依赖感知适配框架，用于多元时间序列预测，通过VCR和TPR两个模块分别建模跨变量依赖和时序周期性依赖，并通过可学习门控融合，在10个真实数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大视觉模型（LVM）方法在时间序列预测中面临两个挑战：一是难以平衡独立视觉表示空间与跨变量依赖建模；二是预训练于自然图像的视觉骨干难以适配时间序列图像特有的时序语义。
AI.method: 提出MUSE框架，基于完全冻结的预训练MAE。包含两个模块：变量上下文精炼模块（VCR）聚合每个变量内的共享时序信息并建模跨变量上下文依赖，同时保留独立视觉空间；时序周期精炼模块（TPR）在不同编码器深度进行轻量精炼，显式建模跨周期和周期内依赖。两模块独立预测，通过可学习的预测级门控融合。
AI.result: 在10个真实世界数据集上实验，MUSE取得state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: MUSE通过依赖感知的适配策略有效解决了LVM迁移到时间序列预测中的两大挑战，验证了冻结预训练视觉模型在多元时序预测中的有效性。

title: Critical-State RL: Diagnosing Trainable States for Multi-Turn Tool Use
summary: Multi-turn tool-use failures can hinge on a single model call, yet reward variation alone does not reveal which call would benefit from training. When rewards depend on later interactions, their variation can reflect downstream randomness rather than differences between the current actions. We introduce Critical-State RL to identify trainable states in multi-turn interactions. Given task-defined candidate calls and local rewards, the method assesses whether each reward captures the action's effect on task success and whether improvement over a reference policy is possible. It then uses nested sampling to separate action-dependent reward variation from continuation noise and optimizes the policy at the selected states using contextual-bandit training. Experiments on the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) v4 compare training at diagnostic-selected states with training at alternative states. For missing-function tasks, the diagnostic selects the response after the tool becomes available; for missing-argument tasks, it selects the response before the missing argument is supplied. Training the selected responses improves performance, including about 14 percentage points on the missing-function task, while training the alternatives leaves performance flat or worse. We further apply the recipe across models and tasks, including logged repeat-call avoidance and memory management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Critical-State RL，通过识别多轮工具调用中真正可训练的关键状态，区分由动作引起的奖励变化与后续交互噪声，并在这些状态上用上下文赌博机训练策略，在BFCL v4上显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 多轮工具使用任务的失败常取决于单次模型调用，但仅靠奖励变化无法揭示哪次调用值得训练。当奖励依赖后续交互时，奖励波动可能来自下游随机性而非当前动作差异，导致训练信号不可靠。
AI.method: 给定任务定义的候选调用和局部奖励，方法评估每个奖励是否反映动作对任务成功的影响、以及相对参考策略是否存在改进空间；随后用嵌套采样将动作相关的奖励变化与续接噪声分离，并在所选状态上使用上下文赌博机训练优化策略。
AI.result: 在BFCL v4上，将诊断所选状态与替代状态进行对比训练：缺失函数任务中诊断选中工具可用后的响应，缺失参数任务中选中提供缺失参数前的响应。训练所选响应可提升性能（缺失函数任务提升约14个百分点），而训练替代响应则表现持平或更差。该方案还应用于重复调用规避与记忆管理等任务。
AI.conclusion: 精确识别可训练的关键状态对多轮工具使用强化学习至关重要，Critical-State RL能有效定位这些状态并在多模型多任务上带来稳定收益。

title: WPBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Wind Power Forecasting
summary: Accurate, reliable, and deployable wind power forecasting is critical for power system dispatch, renewable energy integration, and electricity market operations. Progress in this field hinges on the ability to empirically and comprehensively benchmark forecasting methods. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of supporting systematic evaluation in four key aspects: 1) limited coverage of wind power scenarios across turbine scale, variable composition, and spatial structure; 2) incomplete coverage of forecasting model families; 3) evaluation metrics misaligned with wind power requirements; and 4) limited structure-aware diagnostics beyond individual temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose WPBench, a comprehensive, fair, and extensible benchmark for wind power forecasting. WPBench integrates 26 public datasets organized by turbine scale and variable composition, spanning single-turbine, multi-turbine, univariate, and multivariate settings. Under unified processing, training, and evaluation protocols, it benchmarks 19 representative models covering traditional methods, deep temporal models, spatio-temporal models, and foundation models. Beyond point-wise errors, WPBench assesses forecast-curve fidelity and computational efficiency, and delivers structure-aware diagnostics across temporal, variable-dependency, and spatial-dependency perspectives. Together, these capabilities enable systematic model comparison across diverse wind scenarios and provide a reusable platform for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WPBench，一个面向风电预测的全面、公平、可扩展基准，整合26个公开数据集和19个代表性模型，提供统一评估协议与结构感知诊断。
AI.motivation: 风电预测对电网调度、可再生能源并网和电力市场至关重要，但现有基准在四方面不足：风况覆盖有限、模型族覆盖不全、评估指标与风电需求不匹配、缺乏超越单一时间模式的结构感知诊断。
AI.method: WPBench整合26个公开数据集，按风机规模和变量组成组织，覆盖单机/多机、单变量/多变量场景；在统一处理、训练和评估协议下，基准测试19个代表性模型，涵盖传统方法、深度时序模型、时空模型和基础模型。
AI.result: 除逐点误差外，WPBench还评估预测曲线保真度和计算效率，并从时间、变量依赖和空间依赖三个视角提供结构感知诊断。
AI.conclusion: WPBench支持跨多样风况的系统化模型比较，并为未来研究提供可复用平台。

title: RAILS: Retrieval-Augmented Incremental LLM Clustering at Scale
summary: Using a Large Language Model (LLM) as the clusterer at production scale is hard: prompts cannot hold the entire label space, and per-document serial processing does not deliver the throughput real workloads require. We present RAILS, a retrieval-augmented incremental LLM clusterer that turns clustering into a simple loop over a growing label pool and scales through document batching with bounded concurrency. On six public benchmarks RAILS exceeds the strongest prior LLM-clustering method on average, lifting accuracy from 51.2% to 59.3%, NMI from 67.2% to 74.8%, and ARI from 45.4% to 54.7%. We further report production-deployment evidence from a SaaS ticket-topic-discovery pipeline, where RAILS has replaced a traditional HDBSCAN stage with higher clustering quality, transparent prompt-driven control, and stateful incremental operation.

AI.tldr: RAILS 是一种检索增强的增量式 LLM 聚类器，通过增长标签池与文档批处理并发，解决生产环境中 LLM 聚类的可扩展性问题，在六个基准和 SaaS 场景中均超越先前方法。
AI.motivation: 生产规模下使用 LLM 做聚类面临两大难题：提示词无法容纳整个标签空间，且逐文档串行处理无法满足真实工作负载的吞吐需求。
AI.method: 将聚类转化为对不断增长的标签池的简单循环，采用检索增强的增量式设计，并通过文档批处理与有界并发实现扩展。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准上平均超越最强先前 LLM 聚类方法：准确率从 51.2% 提升至 59.3%，NMI 从 67.2% 升至 74.8%，ARI 从 45.4% 升至 54.7%。
AI.conclusion: 在 SaaS 工单主题发现流水线中，RAILS 替换了传统 HDBSCAN 阶段，实现了更高的聚类质量、透明的提示驱动控制和有状态的增量运行。

title: A Temporal Knowledge Graph for Music Festival Lineup Forecasting
comment: Accepted to 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) 2026
summary: Music festival lineups emerge from complex relationships among artists, genres, releases, labels, and past performances, making the prediction of future lineups a natural fit for temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting. In this work, we present a TKG covering 380 festivals over 55 years, comprising more than 90K festival performance quadruples along with information on festivals, artist tours, and artist metadata, and release it as a resource for TKG forecasting evaluation. We formalize festival lineup forecasting as temporal link prediction between artists and festivals at future timestamps. We evaluate six TKG forecasting models on this task, analyze their capabilities and limitations, and compare them against Large Language Models applied zero-shot. Our resource complements existing TKG benchmarks by grounding evaluation in a concrete, real-world application domain.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个覆盖55年、380个音乐节、超9万条演出四元组的时间知识图谱（TKG），将音乐节阵容预测形式化为未来时间戳上艺术家与音乐节之间的时序链接预测，评估了六种TKG预测模型并与零样本LLM进行比较。
AI.motivation: 音乐节阵容由艺术家、流派、发行、厂牌和过往演出等复杂关系共同决定，天然适合用时间知识图谱预测来建模。现有TKG基准缺乏具体真实应用领域的落地评估。
AI.method: 构建包含380个音乐节、跨越55年、超9万条演出四元组的TKG，并附加音乐节、艺术家巡演及艺术家元数据；将音乐节阵容预测形式化为未来时间戳下艺术家与音乐节之间的时序链接预测；在六个TKG预测模型上评测，并与零样本大语言模型对比。
AI.result: 该资源被发布用于TKG预测评估，提供了对六种TKG预测模型能力与局限的分析，并给出了与零样本LLM的对比结果。
AI.conclusion: 该资源通过将评估扎根于具体真实应用领域，补充了现有TKG基准，推动时序知识图谱预测研究在实际场景中的应用。

title: Lifted Bellman Linear Programming for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically trains a critic by minimizing a regression loss against bootstrapped value targets stabilized by target networks with exponential moving average (EMA) updates. Multi-step targets incorporate behavior-policy actions and therefore require off-policy correction. We instead impose in-sample Bellman optimality on the critic through inequality constraints. We formulate the Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP), which lifts the linear programming characterization of Bellman optimality to the joint $(Q,V)$ space so that every constraint involves only state-action pairs in the dataset. Its unique minimizer is the in-sample optimal pair, and constraints along $K$-step segments of dataset trajectories leave this minimizer unchanged for any rollout policy and horizon. Under deterministic dynamics, this minimizer lies between the best dataset return and the optimal value. Relaxing the constraints into hinge penalties recovers the same solution above a finite penalty coefficient in the tabular case. Approximate Lifted Bellman Unconstrained Minimization (ALBUM) implements this relaxation with neural networks and detaches the $K$-step rollout targets by stop gradient. Its objective contains no squared regression onto bootstrapped targets, so it can be trained without target networks or EMA updates. Under deterministic dynamics, the LBLP solution is a stationary point of the detached update under a coefficient condition independent of $γ$ and $K$, and the inequality constraints allow discounted returns along dataset trajectories to serve as lower bounds without off-policy correction or action chunking. On OGBench, ALBUM uses a single critic with a Gaussian policy, matches the average performance of FQL, and is comparable to recent action-chunking methods, while using the fewest parameters and the least peak GPU memory among all compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出LBLP（将Bellman最优性LP提升到联合(Q,V)空间）及其松弛实现ALBUM，用不等式约束替代回归，无需目标网络/EMA，在OGBench上以单critic匹配FQL性能且参数和显存最省。
AI.motivation: 离线RL通常用回归损失拟合自举目标（依赖目标网络和EMA），多步目标含行为策略动作需离策略修正。作者希望回避这种回归式自举与off-policy correction。
AI.method: 将Bellman最优性的线性规划表征提升到联合(Q,V)空间，使每条约束只涉及数据集内状态-动作对，形成LBLP；其唯一最小值点即样本内最优对，K步轨迹段约束不改变该解。将约束松弛为hinge惩罚，用神经网络实现为ALBUM，通过stop gradient分离K步rollout目标，无需目标网络或EMA。
AI.result: 表格情形下有限罚系数即可恢复同一解。确定性动态下，LBLP解在系数条件（与γ、K无关）下是分离更新式的驻点，且数据集轨迹的折扣回报可作下界，无需离策略修正或动作分块。OGBench上ALBUM用单critic+Gaussian策略，平均性能与FQL相当，与近期action-chunking方法可比，但参数最少、峰值GPU显存最低。
AI.conclusion: 以不等式约束取代自举回归，可免去目标网络与EMA，同时保持竞争力性能并显著降低参数量与显存开销，为离线RL提供了一种更简洁高效的critic训练范式。

title: On Emergent Capabilities and Model Merging
comment: main paper has 8 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables
summary: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target. Studying two independent testbeds (activation oracles and emergent-misaligned models) across three model families, we find that the answer is threefold. First, merging preserves an emergent capability that both parents carry: merging two misaligned checkpoints retains most of their broad misalignment across the whole mixing range. Second, merging cannot create an emergent capability that is superadditive in its parents: no weighted merge of two single-task oracles reaches the jointly-trained oracle's auditing ability. Third, when only one parent carries the capability, merging dilutes it faster than the trained capability that accompanies it: the gap is significant in most settings. In short, emergent behaviors of an artifact do not compose the way its trained capability does.

AI.tldr: 模型合并（权重算术）对涌现能力的影响与对训练能力的影响并不一致：涌现行为不会像训练能力那样“可组合”。
AI.motivation: 微调检查点与适配器广泛公开，模型合并成为对它们最常见的廉价能力组装操作；但尚不清楚这一权重算术操作会对从未作为显式训练目标、由模型“携带”的涌现能力造成什么影响。
AI.method: 在两个独立测试平台（激活预言机、涌现失配模型）、三个模型家族上研究模型合并，并将结论归纳为三种情形进行系统性验证。
AI.result: 1）当双亲能力兼具时，合并能保留涌现能力：两个失配检查点合并后在几乎整个混合区间仍保留大部分广泛失配。2）合并不能创造在双亲中呈超加性的涌现能力：两个单任务预言机的任何加权合并都达不到联合训练预言机的审计能力。3）当仅一个亲本携带该能力时，合并对它的稀释速度快于对伴随的训练能力的稀释，且该差距在多数设置中显著。
AI.conclusion: 简言之，模型的涌现行为并不像其训练能力那样具有可组合性；模型合并对涌现能力的作用是“保留、不可创造、易稀释”三分格局。

title: $t_0$: A Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting with Context
summary: We present $t_0$, a family of open-weights foundation models for forecasting with multivariate context. We release its first two members: $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ and $\texttt{t0-beta}$, respectively 102M and 256M parameters. Both condition their forecasts on target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates, without task-specific retraining. Their transformer layers alternate attention along time and across variates. They produce probabilistic forecasts through quantile predictions. Pretraining combines curated public data with synthetic generator families constructed to contain covariate-to-target dependencies. On GIFT-Eval, $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ reaches an aggregate CRPS of 0.4941, and $\texttt{t0-beta}$ a CRPS of 0.4738 and a MASE of 0.6865, third on both and within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM. On fev-bench they score 42.2 and 46.7 in skill, the latter third again and 2.0 points behind the leader. We analyze $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ in depth. Known-future covariates raise its skill by 6.3 percentage points across 30 tasks. The report also examines its calibration, its rollout strategy on long horizons, and its robustness to missing data. On the Victoria electricity-demand benchmark, $\texttt{t0-beta}$ is among the most accurate models with a context of nearly a year. In an independent Macrocosm evaluation of hourly ERCOT prices over 29 months, both cut the MAE of the lagged-price baseline by 38%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 t0 系列开源基础预测模型，含 102M 的 t0-alpha 与 256M 的 t0-beta，支持多变量上下文与概率预测，在多个基准上接近领先零样本 TSFM。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型的预测能力仍有提升空间，尤其是多变量预测、结合协变量的预测，以及跨任务零样本迁移的需求。作者希望构建无需任务特定重训练、可直接进行概率预测的开源基础模型。
AI.method: 模型以目标历史、过去协变量和已知未来协变量为条件进行预测。Transformer 层在时间维度和变量维度交替进行注意力计算，通过分位数预测实现概率输出。预训练数据结合精选公开数据与人工构造的合成生成器族，这些合成数据包含协变量到目标的依赖关系。
AI.result: 在 GIFT-Eval 上，t0-alpha 的 CRPS 为 0.4941；t0-beta 的 CRPS 为 0.4738、MASE 为 0.6865，均排名第三，距最佳零样本 TSFM 仅差 4.0%。在 fev-bench 上技能分分别为 42.2 和 46.7，后者排名第三，落后领先者 2.0 分。已知未来协变量使 t0-alpha 在 30 个任务上技能提升 6.3 个百分点。在 Victoria 电力需求基准上表现出色；在 ERCOT 小时电价 29 个月的独立评估中，两者将滞后价格基线的 MAE 降低 38%。
AI.conclusion: t0 系列证明了开源、无任务特定重训练的多变量概率预测基础模型的可行性，在多个基准上接近领先零样本模型，且已知未来协变量带来显著增益。报告还分析了校准性、长周期 rollout 策略和对缺失数据的鲁棒性。

title: Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer: Integrating Heterogeneous Context for Process Event Prediction
summary: Event logs arise in a wide range of real-world processes, capturing not only event activities and timestamps but also multi-modal contextual information. Existing event-sequence models, including many temporal point process approaches, primarily model event activities and timestamps while overlooking heterogeneous context, such as numerical measurements, categorical attributes, textual descriptions, and metadata associated with individual events and entire traces. In this paper, we propose Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer (UMT), a unified framework for incorporating heterogeneous process context into next-event prediction. Built on a Transformer backbone, UMT introduces a universal feature encoder that maps diverse feature types into a shared representation space and handles contextual information at both the event and trace levels. UMT further develops a per-event Perceiver module that dynamically weights contextual features and adaptively integrates them into event-token representations. To accommodate the heavy-tailed and potentially multi-modal distribution of inter-arrival times, UMT represents each interval at multiple temporal scales and jointly predicts the corresponding scale-specific quantities. Experiments on 13 real-world event logs show that UMT improves both next-event activity and time prediction over existing approaches.

AI.tldr: UMT是一个基于Transformer的统一框架，将异构多模态过程上下文引入下一事件预测。
AI.motivation: 现有事件序列模型（如时间点过程）主要关注事件活动和时间戳，忽略了数值、类别、文本等多模态上下文信息，而这些信息在真实事件日志中普遍存在。
AI.method: UMT以Transformer为骨干，引入通用特征编码器将多种特征类型映射到共享表示空间，并在事件级和轨迹级处理上下文；同时设计per-event Perceiver模块动态加权上下文特征并自适应融合到事件token中。针对重尾且可能多峰的到达间隔时间，采用多时间尺度表示并联合预测各尺度量。
AI.result: 在13个真实事件日志上的实验表明，UMT在下一事件活动预测和时间预测上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将异构多模态上下文统一建模可有效提升事件序列预测性能，UMT为过程上下文建模提供了通用方案。

title: Overlay\_dx - Automating forecasting evaluation
summary: Traditional evaluation metrics provides numerical values but often lack comprehensibility, hindering effective differentiation of model performances. Our work addresses this challenge by introducing overlay\_dx, a novel evaluation metric measuring the performance of time series prediction models. Overlay\_dx is a visual metric that represents the percentage of predictions falling within a confidence interval around actual values. Additionally, once evaluation results are plotted, overlay\_dx computes the area under the overlay curve, providing a quantitative measure of alignment between predicted and actual values across different thresholds and predictions. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach offers a unified evaluation framework that combines both visual and numerical assessments, enabling improved model comparison and providing valuable insights for further research and optimization efforts in time series prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出overlay_dx：一种可视化+数值化的时间序列预测评估指标，衡量落在真实值置信区间内的预测比例，并通过曲线下面积量化对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 传统评估指标虽给出数值但缺乏可理解性，难以有效区分模型表现差异。
AI.method: 定义overlay_dx为落在真实值置信区间内的预测百分比；绘制评估结果后计算overlay曲线下面积，量化不同阈值下预测与真实值的对齐程度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该框架统一了可视化与数值评估，提升模型比较能力。
AI.conclusion: overlay_dx为时间序列预测提供统一评估框架，支持更好的模型比较并为后续研究与优化提供洞见。

title: Taking a Second Look: Correcting Sea Ice Forecasts with Sparse Observations
summary: Sea ice forecasts are issued several days ahead, allowing errors to accumulate while new, often sparse sea ice concentration (SIC) observations become available. We find that fixed-propagation errors concentrate near structured, high-gradient ice edges, whereas homogeneous interiors require limited propagation, suggesting that propagation distance should be state dependent. We therefore introduce ECHO (Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation), where ECHO-Scale adapts propagation distance while preserving correction geometry, and ECHO-Delta learns a bounded residual around fixed propagation. Across all 96 standard evaluation settings spanning diverse priors, observation times, sparsity levels, geometries, and noise conditions, both outperform fixed propagation. ECHO-Delta achieves the best average accuracy, while ECHO-Scale is more robust to geometry shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/yingtian22/TAKING-A-SECOND-LOOK.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有海冰浓度订正传播距离固定，提出状态依赖的ECHO框架，在96种评测设置下优于固定传播。
AI.motivation: 海冰预报提前数天发布，误差累积且新观测稀疏。固定传播误差集中在高梯度冰缘，均质内部传播需求低，故传播距离应随状态变化。
AI.method: 提出ECHO（证据引导的异质传播订正），含两个变体：ECHO-Scale自适应调整传播距离但保持订正几何；ECHO-Delta在固定传播基础上学习有界残差。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种先验、观测时间、稀疏度、几何与噪声条件的96个标准评测设置中，两变体均优于固定传播；ECHO-Delta平均精度最佳，ECHO-Scale对几何变化更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 传播距离应为状态依赖，ECHO框架有效提升海冰浓度订正精度与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: GraphToolbox: A Configurable Python Framework for Graph Neural Network Forecasting
summary: Electricity forecasting often involves spatially related signals observed over regions, substations, and feeders, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a natural way to represent these relations. Building a complete GNN forecasting experiment is nonetheless laborious, because graph construction, model selection, training, aggregation, and interpretation sit in incompatible tools. We present GraphToolbox, an open-source Python framework that unifies these stages in one configurationdriven pipeline built on PyTorch Geometric. It offers data-driven graph construction, an adapter that instantiates and trains 51 of the 65 PyTorch Geometric convolutions together with the recurrent cells of PyTorch Geometric Temporal, online expert aggregation, forecasting interpretability, and significance testing on cached forecasts. We evaluate the pipeline in two case studies. On French regional load, the 48 convolutions included in the complete forecasting sweep fall in a band from 1.14% to 1.60% error, online aggregation lowers this to 0.98%, and the graph models improve on classical additive and boosting baselines. On net-load, direct graph models are less accurate than a classical additive model, while forecasting each physical component separately improves them without closing that gap. Both comparisons use the same experimental interface, illustrating the role of GraphToolbox in systematic architectural evaluation.

AI.tldr: GraphToolbox是一个开源Python框架，将图构建、模型选择、训练、聚合与解释统一到基于PyTorch Geometric的配置驱动流水线中，并在法国区域负荷与净负荷两个案例上验证其系统化架构评估能力。
AI.motivation: 电力预测涉及跨区域、变电站和馈线的空间相关信号，GNN适合建模这类关系；但完整GNN预测实验流程繁琐，因为图构建、模型选择、训练、聚合和解释分散在不兼容的工具中，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 提出GraphToolbox，基于PyTorch Geometric的配置驱动开源流水线，统一各阶段。功能包括：数据驱动图构建；适配器实例化并训练65个PyTorch Geometric卷积中的51个及PyTorch Geometric Temporal的循环单元；在线专家聚合；预测可解释性；基于缓存预测的显著性检验。
AI.result: 在法国区域负荷上，48个卷积的完整预测扫描误差处于1.14%–1.60%区间，在线聚合降至0.98%，图模型优于经典加性和提升基线。在净负荷上，直接图模型不如经典加性模型，按物理分量分别预测可改善但仍未弥合差距。
AI.conclusion: 两个案例使用同一实验接口，说明GraphToolbox在系统化架构评估中的作用，即通过统一流程支持对不同图模型架构进行可比、可复现的评估。

title: Augmented Hypothesis Testing with Persona-Based LLM Simulations
comment: Work accepted at COLM Workshop on Agent Behavior
summary: A/B testing requires large sample sizes, long timelines, and significant costs. When auxiliary predictions of experimental outcomes are available from machine learning models, uncertain prediction quality precludes replacing human experiments entirely, yet these predictions may still contain useful signal. We propose a principled framework for learning-augmented hypothesis testing that leverages predictions of unknown quality to reduce sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity. Predictions naturally vary in granularity, from coarse aggregate signals to fine-grained individual-level estimates, and our framework addresses both ends of this spectrum: (1) for population-level directional predictions, where only a binary signal on the treatment effect sign is available, we use an asymmetric test and prove consistency and robustness bounds within the learning-augmented algorithms paradigm; (2) for individual-level predictions, we introduce Generalized PPI++ (GPPI), extending Prediction-Powered Inference to handle nonlinear prediction errors through higher-dimensional transformations. Both methods benefit from accurate predictions while remaining robust to inaccurate or adversarial ones. We validate our framework using persona-based LLM simulations, where AI agents equipped with user personas predict individual behavior, as a natural prediction source spanning both granularity levels. Experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods, combined with persona-based predictions, substantially reduce experimental costs while preserving rigorous statistical validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出学习增强假设检验框架，利用未知质量的机器学习预测降低A/B实验样本量并保持统计有效性，覆盖群体级和个体级两种预测粒度。
AI.motivation: A/B测试需要大样本、长周期和高成本。机器学习模型可提供实验结果的辅助预测，但预测质量不确定，无法完全替代真实实验，却可能蕴含有用信号。
AI.method: 框架覆盖预测粒度两端：(1) 群体级方向性预测（仅效应符号的二元信号），使用非对称检验，在学习增强算法范式下证明一致性与鲁棒性界；(2) 个体级预测，提出Generalized PPI++ (GPPI)，扩展PPI以通过高维变换处理非线性预测误差。两种方法均受益于准确预测且对不准确或对抗性预测鲁棒。用基于persona的LLM模拟作为预测来源进行验证。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集上，结合persona预测的方法显著降低实验成本，同时保持严格的统计有效性，并优于对不准确或对抗预测的表现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在预测质量未知的情况下，安全有效地利用机器学习预测减少A/B测试成本，兼顾有效性与鲁棒性。

title: iSDFT: Information-Proximal Self-Distillation for Continual Learning in LLMs
summary: On-policy self-distillation fine-tuning (SDFT) learns new skills from demonstrations while reducing forgetting, but it always distils toward the full demonstration-conditioned teacher. This fixes teacher influence at the full-teacher endpoint, providing no control over how much demonstration information should be transferred at each prediction state. We introduce Information-Proximal SDFT (iSDFT), which instead treats the teacher as a budgeted source of information. At each token, iSDFT selects the distribution closest to the current student that satisfies a prescribed teacher-information constraint, yielding a closed-form exponential target with a locally determined tilt. To control cumulative drift, we further anchor the student to its frozen base policy. Across four heterogeneous LLM backbones and two specialisation tasks, iSDFT improves vanilla SDFT in 7 of 8 model-task settings and matches it in the remaining one. It also provides tighter retention on the original SDFT benchmark suite, with 73% of evaluations remaining within 0.5 points of the base model versus 52% for the strongest baseline, while achieving the largest mean improvement on all ten additional mathematics, coding, and competition-mathematics benchmarks. These results show that controlling how much and when teacher information is introduced improves specialisation while preserving broader capability.

AI.tldr: 提出 iSDFT，把教师视为有信息预算的信息源，逐 token 选择满足教师信息约束且最接近当前学生的分布，改善专业化与遗忘抑制。
AI.motivation: 原 SDFT 始终向完整的演示条件教师蒸馏，教师影响固定在端点，无法控制每个预测状态应传递多少演示信息。
AI.method: iSDFT 在每个 token 选择最接近当前学生且满足指定教师信息约束的分布，得到闭式指数目标与局部确定的 tilt；并用冻结基座策略锚定学生以控制累积漂移。
AI.result: 在 4 个异构 LLM 骨干和 2 个专业化任务上，8 个模型-任务设置中 7 个优于 vanilla SDFT、1 个持平；在原 SDFT 基准上保留更好（73% 评测在基座 0.5 分内，最强基线 52%），并在 10 个数学、代码、竞赛数学基准上取得最大平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 控制教师信息引入的“多少”和“何时”能同时提升专业化并保留广泛能力。

title: Corrective Forcing: Unified Post-Training for Diffusions and Flows in Generative Speech Enhancement
summary: Diffusion and flow models, as promising generative paradigms for speech enhancement, face a training--inference mismatch: training uses analytical path states, whereas inference recursively evaluates models on self-generated rollout states along discretized sampling trajectories. This mismatch causes prediction and discretization errors to accumulate. To address it, we introduce Corrective Forcing (CoF), a post-training paradigm that forces diffusion and flow models to learn from self-generated rollouts and correct their predictions. CoF corrects clean-speech predictions on rollout states toward the ground truth under dynamic sampling schedules, exposing the model to varying inference conditions. It further regularizes local evolution using locally corrected counterfactual transitions as references for factual transitions. By expressing model outputs through a shared clean-speech prediction parameterization, CoF applies the same post-training objective across diffusion and flow formulations. Experiments with SB-VE and OT-CFM demonstrate improvements in perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity, together with robust performance across different numbers of sampling steps.

AI.tldr: 提出Corrective Forcing(CoF)后训练范式，解决扩散与流模型在语音增强中训练-推理不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型用于语音增强时存在训练-推理不匹配：训练用解析路径状态，推理则沿离散采样轨迹递归评估自生成的状态，导致预测和离散化误差累积。
AI.method: CoF强制模型从自生成rollout中学习并修正预测：在动态采样调度下将rollout状态上的干净语音预测修正向真值；用局部修正的反事实转移作为事实转移的参考来正则化局部演化；通过共享的干净语音预测参数化统一应用于扩散和流公式。
AI.result: 在SB-VE和OT-CFM上实验，感知质量和重建保真度均有提升，且在不同采样步数下表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: CoF作为后训练范式能有效缓解训练-推理不匹配，提升扩散与流模型语音增强的性能与稳定性。

title: Guaranteed Low-Rank Tensor Recovery from Modewise Measurements via Normalized Block-Weighted Riemannian Gradient Descent
summary: We consider the recovery of low-multilinear-rank tensors from linear measurements and propose an adaptive block-weighted modewise Riemannian gradient descent method. The method combines memory-efficient modewise measurements with a normalized adaptive weighting strategy for the core and factor components of the Riemannian gradient. The weighting improves convergence without increasing the multilinear-rank bound of the search direction or the size of the reduced core used for retraction. Under the tensor restricted isometry property and a suitable initialization, we establish local linear convergence and derive sampling guarantees for sub-Gaussian and subsampled orthogonal with random sign (SORS) measurements. Numerical experiments on synthetic low-Tucker-rank tensors show that the proposed method reduces iteration counts and computational time while maintaining reliable recovery performance, especially near the recovery threshold and for structured SORS measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应块加权模黎曼梯度下降法，用于低多重线性秩张量的线性测量恢复，兼顾问测量内存效率与收敛加速。
AI.motivation: 低多重线性秩张量恢复中，现有模测量方法在保持内存效率的同时收敛较慢，尤其接近恢复阈值时迭代次数多、耗时长，需要一种不增加搜索方向秩约束与缩减核心规模的加速策略。
AI.method: 将内存高效的模测量与归一化自适应加权策略结合，对黎曼梯度的核心分量和因子分量分别加权；该加权不增大搜索方向的多重线性秩上界，也不增大用于回缩的缩减核心尺寸。
AI.result: 在张量限制等距性质与合适初始化下，证明了局部线性收敛，并给出亚高斯测量与子采样正交随机符号（SORS）测量的采样保证；合成低Tucker秩张量实验显示迭代次数与计算时间减少，恢复性能稳定，在恢复阈值附近和结构化SORS测量下尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 所提自适应块加权模黎曼梯度下降法在不增加计算与秩约束代价的前提下加速低多重线性秩张量恢复，理论与实验均验证其有效性，适合阈值附近及结构化测量场景。

title: A Federated Artificial Intelligence Framework for Optimizing Pancreatic Cancer Treatment - Strategy Update
summary: While a centralized approach involving patient consent to collect and analyze data centrally would theoretically offer the best data quality and predictive performance, it is not always feasible in practice. Federated Learning (FL) architectures have shown to be a very promising approach to use and access distributed disease related resources within the GDPR boundaries. In a previous case report, we described the preconditions at the participating sites and necessary administrative and process related steps to prepare data, people and infrastructure for improving subtype identification and assessing treatment options in pancreatic cancer. We update this report sharing our experience in tackling the challenges and show preliminary results of the actual federated learning AI pipelines. At the participating sites, we have to identify and annotate the data being accessible after extraction and transformation in a local FL hub - in our case a centrally developed and distributively deployed Docker container. This container comprises the FL scripts generating local models. We apply a newly developed FL algorithm considering all local features, including partial overlapping features specific to the local sites. Theoretically, an annotation in a cancer setting should succeed using the German oncology core data set (oBDS), which is already utilized for mandatory reporting to cancer registries, and can be sustained in the FL setting. The FL algorithms deal robustly with partially overlapping features as we showed with public data sets. Major roadblocks including straightening operational concepts for the infrastructures, ethics approval for such novel architectures and support for every site have been addressed. However, scaling up this approach in the future faces hurdles; while including broader multi-modal data sets should be feasible, large-scale deployment to more sites remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 该论文更新了一个关于联邦学习(FL)在胰腺癌研究中的应用案例报告，展示在GDPR约束下利用分布式数据构建AI管线的实践经验与初步结果。
AI.motivation: 集中式数据采集理论上数据质量和预测性能最佳，但在实践中往往不可行。需在GDPR边界内利用分布式疾病相关资源，因此探索联邦学习作为替代方案。
AI.method: 在各参与站点部署集中开发、分布式部署的Docker容器作为本地FL枢纽，包含生成局部模型的FL脚本。采用新开发的FL算法处理所有本地特征，包括站点特有的部分重叠特征。利用德国肿瘤学核心数据集(oBDS)进行标注，并处理基础设施、伦理审批及站点支持等关键障碍。
AI.result: 成功克服主要障碍（运营概念、伦理审批、站点支持），FL算法在公共数据集上验证了对部分重叠特征的稳健性，并展示了实际FL AI管线的初步结果。
AI.conclusion: 该联邦学习方法可在GDPR框架内有效整合分布式数据。未来扩展面临挑战：纳入更广泛的多模态数据集可行，但大规模部署到更多站点仍然困难。

title: An Exact Junction-Tree Extended Formulation for Optimal Classification Trees
summary: We develop an exact linear programming (LP) formulation for bounded-depth classification trees with binary features, using a junction-tree representation. The formulation is integral and supports recursive subtree optimization. Exact reductions make the model smaller while preserving the optimal value and recovery of an optimal tree. The reduced model supports two solution methods: column generation and message passing. Column generation solves integral restricted LPs and uses bounds over the full feasible domain to certify optimality. Message passing recursively combines optimal subtree costs. Both methods solve common subtree problems that, once the preceding tree decisions are fixed, can be evaluated independently and in parallel. Computational experiments show that the exact reductions substantially reduce the size of the junction-tree formulation. The resulting linear programming formulation certifies instances for which the tested mixed-integer formulation does not establish optimality within the same computational budget, while the column-generation and message-passing methods certify more instances and achieve an order-of-magnitude reduction in geometric-mean runtime relative to an existing state-of-the-art exact method for optimal classification trees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于junction-tree表示的精确LP公式用于有界深度分类树，支持递归子树优化，并可用列生成与消息传递两种方法求解。
AI.motivation: 现有混合整数规划求解最优分类树在大规模实例上难以在预算内证明最优性，需要更紧凑且可精确求解的模型。
AI.method: 使用junction-tree表示建立整数精确LP公式；通过保持最优值与最优树可恢复性的精确约减缩小模型；提出列生成（求解整数受限LP并用全可行域界证明最优性）与消息传递（递归组合最优子树代价）两种方法，子树问题可独立并行求解。
AI.result: 计算实验表明精确约减显著缩小模型规模；该LP公式能证明测试MIP在相同预算下无法证明最优性的实例，列生成与消息传递能证明更多实例，并在几何平均运行时间上比现有最先进精确方法降低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: junction-tree LP公式结合精确约减与两种求解方法，为最优分类树提供了更高效且可证明最优性的求解途径。

title: Enhancing Transformer Representations of Symbolic ODE Expressions
summary: Existing approaches to solving differential equations, such as symbolic regression, physics informed neural networks, and neural operators, typically focus on numerical approximations or blind symbolic search via fitting to numerical data. Less attention has been paid to learning structured representations of mathematical expressions that preserve commutative properties and could support mathematical reasoning in symbolic forms. Transformer models have shown strong capabilities in solving symbolic differential equations. However, standard positional embeddings in transformers are designed for sequence data. Symbolic differential equations are naturally represented by expression trees, so these positional embeddings may not efficiently capture their hierarchical structures. We investigate existing tree positional embeddings in symbolic ordinary differential equation (ODE) tasks. We systematically study their effectiveness under different settings. Our results show that tree positional embeddings aid learning in early epochs and continue to improve performance throughout, ultimately yielding consistent advantages across various data sizes and tasks. Based on learned structural representations, we apply contrastive learning to support the commutative property in mathematics. Ablation studies provide insight into how these methods interact in modelling symbolic mathematical structures.

AI.tldr: 研究树位置编码在符号ODE任务中的作用，并结合对比学习支持数学交换律，验证其一致优势。
AI.motivation: 现有求解微分方程的方法多关注数值近似或盲目符号搜索，较少学习能保留交换律并可支持符号推理的结构化数学表达式表示。标准Transformer位置编码面向序列，难以高效捕捉符号微分方程表达式树的层级结构。
AI.method: 系统研究现有树位置编码在符号常微分方程任务中的效果；基于学到的结构表示，应用对比学习以支持数学中的交换性质；并通过消融实验分析各方法的相互作用。
AI.result: 树位置编码在训练早期有助于学习，并持续提升性能，在多种数据规模和任务上均表现出一致优势。
AI.conclusion: 树位置编码能有效建模符号数学结构，结合对比学习可支持交换性质，为符号形式数学推理提供了结构化表示思路。

title: Inference of Unknown Dynamical Components Using Next Generation Reservoir Computing: From Chaotic Systems to Climate Data
summary: We investigate next generation reservoir computing (NGRC) as a data-driven approach for inferring unseen components of dynamical systems. We compare NGRC with traditional reservoir computing (RC) using the Lorenz and Rössler system, where two unknown components are inferred from one given component. For both systems, NGRC achieves accurate results while requiring fewer training data and less computational time than RC. We identified an inverse proportional behavior between the number of time-delayed steps needed for NGRC and the temporal resolution, indicating that the physical time span covered by the delay interval is an important factor in determining the required number of delayed steps. Finally, we apply NGRC to the observational climate data of ENSO (El Niño--Southern Oscillation) and infer one observable from the remaining variables. Despite the noise and complexity of the real-world data, the NGRC shows promising results. Our findings demonstrate the potential of NGRC for efficient inference of unseen components in both controlled dynamical systems and real-world data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究下一代储备池计算(NGRC)作为数据驱动方法推断动力系统中未见成分的能力，并在Lorenz、Rössler系统及ENSO气候数据上验证其优于传统RC。
AI.motivation: 推断动力系统中未观测到的成分是重要问题。传统储备池计算(RC)虽可用于此任务，但需要较多训练数据和计算时间，因此作者探索NGRC作为更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 对比NGRC与传统RC，在Lorenz和Rössler系统中由单个已知成分推断两个未知成分；分析NGRC所需时间延迟步数与时间分辨率的反比关系；并将NGRC应用于ENSO观测气候数据，从其余变量推断一个可观测变量。
AI.result: 在两个系统上NGRC均取得准确结果，且比RC所需训练数据更少、计算时间更短。发现NGRC所需延迟步数与时间分辨率成反比，表明延迟间隔覆盖的物理时间跨度是关键因素。在含噪声的ENSO真实数据上NGRC也显示出良好结果。
AI.conclusion: NGRC能在受控动力系统和真实世界数据中高效推断未见成分，展现了其应用潜力。

title: Complex KDA: Understanding and Enhancing the Expressivity of Kimi Delta Attention
summary: Linear RNNs based on the delta-rule enable efficient sequence modeling, but their linear updates with a low-rank correction constrain their expressivity. Prior work has shown that composing two delta-rule transitions in a single recurrent update can model a 2D rotation, but this increases the rank and the cost of the updates compared to a single transition. We show that Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) can realize 2D rotations by combining a single delta-rule transformation with a second reflection supplied by its channel-wise gate. This requires extending the parameter ranges of KDA by combining two existing range extensions: allowing gates in $[-1,1]$ and the delta-rule coefficient $β$ in $[0,2]$. We call the resulting model Complex KDA (CKDA). It preserves KDA's stability and efficiency, with transitions that remain diagonal-plus-rank-one and non-expansive, while reaching the state-tracking expressivity of DeltaProduct$_2$. We characterize the expressivity of CKDA and prove that every orthogonal diagonal-plus-rank-one matrix is exactly a CKDA transition matrix. A single CKDA layer can track every finite group isomorphic to a subgroup of $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and many state-tracking results use one fewer layer for CKDA compared to other diagonal-plus-rank-one Linear RNNs. Empirically, combining both extensions yields the strongest length extrapolation among tested KDA range settings on $S_3$, $S_4$, and periodic audio continuation. In language modeling, CKDA outperforms Transformers and other linear RNNs, obtains similar results to a KDA baseline, and shows promising scaling behavior. Our code is open source at https://github.com/OpenEuroLLM/ComplexKDA and our models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/openeurollm/complexkda.

AI.tldr: CKDA通过将单一delta-rule变换与通道门控提供的反射结合，用对角加秩一、非扩张的转移矩阵实现2D旋转，达到DeltaProduct₂的状态跟踪表达能力，同时保持KDA的稳定性与效率。
AI.motivation: 基于delta-rule的线性RNN序列建模高效，但低秩修正的线性更新限制表达力。此前需组合两次delta-rule转换才能建模2D旋转，却增加秩与更新成本。
AI.method: 将Kimi Delta Attention的单一delta-rule变换与通道门控提供的第二次反射结合，扩展参数范围：门控允许取[-1,1]，delta-rule系数β允许取[0,2]，得到Complex KDA，转移仍为对角加秩一且非扩张。
AI.result: 达到DeltaProduct₂的状态跟踪表达能力；证明每个正交对角加秩一矩阵恰为CKDA转移矩阵；单层可跟踪SO(3)子群同构的有限群，多场景少用一层。实证上在S₃、S₄和周期音频续写上长度外推最强；语言建模优于Transformer及其他线性RNN，与KDA基线相当，扩展性良好。
AI.conclusion: CKDA以低成本实现更强表达力，兼顾稳定性与效率，代码与模型已开源。

title: G-NAC: Graph Neural Automata Clustering via Emergent Domain Formation
summary: We introduce Graph Neural Automata Clustering (G-NAC), an unsupervised clustering method in which observations interact as cells on a fixed neighborhood graph. A shared recurrent graph-neural cellular rule evolves latent domain states through local interactions, which are converted into a rank-based spectral affinity for partitioning. Across 73 clustering tasks from 57 benchmark datasets, G-NAC achieved a mean adjusted Rand index (ARI) of 0.7951, comparable to Genie at 0.7941 and higher than the other evaluated baselines. Empirical training time and GPU memory scaled approximately linearly from 5,000 to 100,000 nodes. Learned transition rules also transferred from smaller source graphs to independent 100,000-node samples generated under matched conditions. These results demonstrate a recurrent graph-clustering formulation while identifying dependencies on graph quality, readout design, and source-target similarity.

AI.tldr: 提出G-NAC，一种基于固定邻域图上细胞式局部交互的无监督图聚类方法，在73个聚类任务上平均ARI达0.7951，与Genie相当，且训练时间和显存随节点数近似线性增长。
AI.motivation: 探索一种将聚类任务形式化为固定邻域图上的循环图神经细胞自动机的方法，通过局部交互演化潜在域状态，从而绕开传统聚类对全局结构或显式目标的依赖，并验证其可扩展性与规则可迁移性。
AI.method: G-NAC将观测视为固定邻域图上的细胞，使用共享的循环图神经细胞规则，通过局部交互演化潜在域状态，再将演化结果转换为基于排序的谱亲和度用于聚类划分。
AI.result: 在来自57个基准数据集的73个聚类任务上，G-NAC平均ARI为0.7951，与Genie的0.7941相当，并优于其他基线；训练时间和GPU显存从5,000到100,000节点近似线性增长；学习到的转移规则可从较小源图迁移到匹配条件下独立生成的100,000节点样本。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了循环图聚类这一新范式，同时指出其性能依赖于图质量、读出设计和源-目标图之间的相似性。

title: When Tomorrow Becomes Today: Self-Evolving Policies for Agentic Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Agentic time series forecasting concerns systems whose underlying mechanisms evolve, making the relative effectiveness of numerical models, reasoning strategies, and intervention rules inherently time-varying. Consequently, a time series agent must adapt the forecasts it produces and the orchestration policy that determines which components to trust and how to coordinate them. The deployment process naturally provides supervision for this adaptation as forecast horizons elapse and realized targets reveal the effectiveness of earlier decisions. Committing all numerical expert forecasts and candidate agent paths before target observation allows each realized outcome to evaluate the entire alternative set, providing delayed feedback without additional annotation. However, existing time series agents primarily incorporate prior experience through forecast refinement, reflection, or retrieval, without systematically converting realized outcomes into persistent updates to the joint orchestration policy governing later origins. To exploit this delayed feedback systematically, we introduce TimEvolve, a frozen-backbone time series agent that converts each realized outcome into persistent joint updates of expert trust, agent path selection, and intervention strength. A temporally ordered predict, reveal, and update protocol applies this feedback to subsequent forecasts. Experiments across eight Time-MMD domains show that TimEvolve achieves the best average MSE and MAE ranks among fifteen methods and the lowest errors on both metrics in seven domains. These results demonstrate the value of learning forecasting policies from the futures encountered during deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出TimEvolve，一种冻结骨干的智能体时间序列预测框架，可将部署中延迟揭晓的真实结果转化为对专家信任、智能体路径选择与干预强度的持久联合策略更新。
AI.motivation: 时间序列底层机制随时间演化，使数值模型、推理策略与干预规则的相对有效性随时间变化，因此智能体需自适应调整预测与编排策略。部署过程天然提供监督：预测揭晓后可评估先前决策，且无需额外标注。但现有智能体仅通过预测精炼、反思或检索利用历史经验，未系统地将真实结果转化为持续更新后续起点的联合编排策略。
AI.method: TimEvolve采用冻结骨干的时间序列智能体。在观测目标前，先提交所有数值专家预测与候选智能体路径，使每个真实结果能评估整个备选集，形成延迟反馈。通过“预测—揭晓—更新”的时间有序协议，将每个真实结果转化为对专家信任、智能体路径选择和干预强度的持久联合更新，并应用于后续预测。
AI.result: 在八个Time-MMD领域实验中，TimEvolve在十五种方法里取得最佳平均MSE和MAE排名，并在七个领域中两项指标误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从部署过程中遇到的实际未来结果中学习预测策略具有显著价值。

title: Learning Prognostic Variables for AI Convective Parameterizations via Symbolic Distillation
summary: Hybrid AI-physics climate modeling aims to improve coarse (~100km-resolution) Earth system models by learning to parameterize subgrid processes from high-fidelity data. However, this so far mostly involves local-in-time, diagnostic parameterizations, in which the subgrid state depends only on the current coarse state with no memory of previous states, which is unrealistic for processes such as convection that have intrinsic persistence. To address this, we enhance local-in-time parameterizations by learning prognostic variables that compactly carry important, additional past information where no explicit sub-grid information is available. First we compress past information into a low-dimensional latent space using an autoencoder, which then informs a neural network trained to parameterize targeted subgrid-scale processes. We then replace the autoencoder with symbolic equations that govern the time evolution of the latent variables, yielding additional prognostic memory variables that can be integrated alongside the resolved atmospheric state. We evaluate this approach on two systems: the Lorenz-96 model (online) and surface precipitation from high-resolution atmospheric simulations (offline). A forced multivariate linear ordinary differential equation recovers most of the added value achieved by the autoencoder-based approach in both experiments. Benchmarked against diagnostic parameterizations without memory, our memory-informed approach improves climate statistics and temporal structure, including a realistic diurnal cycle of tropical land precipitation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出为混合AI-物理气候模型引入"预报记忆变量"，通过自编码器或符号方程压缩并演化历史信息，弥补传统诊断式参数化无记忆的缺陷，在Lorenz-96与降水模拟中提升了气候统计与时间结构。
AI.motivation: 现有混合AI-物理气候建模多采用局部、即时的诊断式参数化，子网格状态仅依赖当前粗网格状态而无历史记忆，这对具有内在持续性的过程（如对流）不现实，需引入记忆机制。
AI.method: 先用自编码器将历史信息压缩到低维潜空间，以辅助训练参数化子网格过程的神经网络；再用符号方程替代自编码器，刻画潜变量随时间演化，得到可与大气解析状态共同积分的预报记忆变量。
AI.result: 在Lorenz-96（在线）与高分辨率大气模拟地表降水（离线）两系统上评估：一个带强迫的多变量线性常微分方程即可复现基于自编码器方法的大部分增益；相比无记忆的诊断式参数化，该方法改善了气候统计与时间结构，包括热带陆地降水的真实日循环。
AI.conclusion: 引入可积分的预报记忆变量是增强混合参数化的有效途径，且简单符号方程即可捕获大部分收益，为气候建模提供更现实、可解释的参数化方案。

title: Exactness at Inference: A Representational Criterion for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
summary: A model generalizes outside its training distribution only when it computes a representation structurally equivalent to the generating mechanism, not an approximation fitted to it. Such equivalence is necessary for exactness in and out of distribution, and extrapolation is governed by this exactness at inference, whatever its realization. Tensor Logic shows this: a zero-temperature contraction is equivalent to discrete logic, deducing in place with no artefact extracted, its tensors Boolean, its embeddings orthonormal, only its arithmetic continuous. Lacking infinite recursion it reaches Datalog, not Prolog, and though exact over closed domains it needs external memory to bind a novel entity. The criterion needs neither a discrete representation nor an extracted expression, and constrains inference, not training: an exact marginal in $[0,1]$ passes, a Neural Network thresholded to a hard label does not. Logic Tensor Networks fail it, while differentiable ILP and Tensor Logic at $T=0$ pass. Piecewise-affine extrapolation divergence and an inability to bind novel entities are two faces of a shortfall in exact representability. For hybrid architectures, a propagation rule follows: the output inherits the bounds of every fitted estimator on its path, explaining which axes fail in equivariant models and the ARC-AGI induction/transduction split. Only an exact hypothesis class certifies what the training data leave underdetermined: on a law-derived partition it finds the $56.3\%$ of distant queries that are answerable, which ensembles meet with false confidence and distance metrics rank backwards. Common inductive biases, from symmetries to memory, reach exactness only because humans inject them, an argument for inducing exact representations rather than fitting surrogates whose residuals, even at the arithmetic floor in training, diverge outside the data and compound under composition.

AI.tldr: 模型只有计算与生成机制结构等价的表示才能泛化；精确性约束推理而非训练，据此可判定架构能否外推。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在训练分布内拟合良好，却在分布外失效。作者认为根源在于拟合的是近似替代品而非结构等价表示，需要重新界定泛化的判据。
AI.method: 以 Tensor Logic 为范例：零温收缩等价于离散逻辑，张量为布尔、嵌入为正交、仅算术连续。据此提出精确可表示性判据，并分析 ILP、Logic Tensor Networks、等变模型、ARC-AGI 等架构。
AI.result: Tensor Logic(T=0)、可微 ILP 通过判据，Logic Tensor Networks 不通过；精确假设类在法则分区上识别出 56.3% 可回答的远距查询，而集成方法以虚假自信作答、距离度量排序反向。
AI.conclusion: 精确性来自人为注入的归纳偏置而非拟合；应诱导精确表示而非拟合替代模型，因为后者的残差即使处于算术下限，也会在数据外发散并随组合累积。

title: Learning Physics from an Imperfect Ancestor
summary: Neural operators evaluate parametric partial differential equations cheaply but degrade sharply outside their training distribution. Physics-informed neural networks avoid dependence on labeled data, yet their optimization can be basin-fragile: when the governing residual admits multiple solutions, a PINN trained from scratch may converge to a physically incorrect state despite achieving a small residual. We show that these failure modes can be addressed jointly: an imperfect NO provides the structural prior needed to place a PINN in the correct solution basin, while the PDE residual refines the solution beyond the operator's accuracy. We introduce a three-stage framework that freezes the spatial basis of a physics-informed NO, extrapolates its solution branch to an out-of-distribution parameter using a polynomial continuation prior, and distills the resulting field into a fresh PINN. The NO need not be accurate at the target; it transfers solution-branch information, while PDE residual minimization in the PINN governs convergence. We evaluate the framework on three nonlinear PDEs: 1D viscous Burgers, 2D steady Allen-Cahn near a pitchfork bifurcation, and 2D steady lid-driven cavity flow. For Allen-Cahn, where the trivial solution satisfies the PDE residual exactly, a standard PINN collapses to the trivial zero branch, whereas distillation from the crude extrapolated operator recovers the non-trivial branch that matches the finite-difference reference. For the lid-driven cavity, extrapolating to a Reynolds number of Re = 3200 accelerates convergence to the correct physical state, achieving competitive accuracy using fewer parameters and optimization steps than recent literature baselines. These results establish a simple principle: an NO need not accurately predict the solution to be useful; it only needs to identify the correct basin from which PINN optimization can recover it.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段框架：冻结物理信息NO的空间基，用多项式延拓先验外推到分布外参数，再蒸馏为新PINN，利用NO的结构先验确定正确解分支，PDE残差精化结果。
AI.motivation: 神经算子（NO）在训练分布外精度急剧下降；PINN虽无需标注数据，但优化对初值/盆地敏感，当残差存在多解时可能收敛到物理错误的解。两类方法各有缺陷，本文试图联合解决。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：（1）冻结物理信息NO的空间基；（2）用多项式延拓先验将解分支外推到分布外参数；（3）将得到的场蒸馏进新的PINN，由PINN的PDE残差最小化主导收敛，NO仅传递解分支信息而无需在目标处准确。
AI.result: 在三个非线性PDE上验证：1D粘性Burgers、2D稳态Allen-Cahn（叉式分岔附近）、2D稳态顶盖驱动方腔流。Allen-Cahn中标准PINN坍缩到平凡零分支，而蒸馏粗外推算子可恢复与有限差分解匹配的非平凡分支；方腔流外推到Re=3200加速收敛，用更少参数和优化步数达到与近期基线相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: NO无需准确预测解即可有用，只需识别正确的吸引域，使PINN优化能从中恢复出正确解。这为NO与PINN联合使用提供了简单而有效的原则。

title: Rare Event Estimation via Iterative Unalignment
summary: As agents are deployed with increased autonomy, even extremely rare events along their stochastic output trajectories can occur and prove catastrophic. Safe deployment therefore does not depend on whether these events can occur, but on how often they might. We study the problem of estimating the probability of rare events that arise from stochastic variation in the agent's own actions. Estimating this type of risk requires searching over the combinatorially vast space of trajectories. Naive Monte Carlo is computationally prohibitive in this regime, and constructing effective importance sampling (IS) proposals requires coordinated changes to a context-dependent chain of conditional distributions. We develop a new IS method that perturbs the original model's weights to construct the proposal. The proposal is itself a differentiably parameterized language model, enabling gradient-based search over weight space. We formulate an objective that combines a differentiable surrogate for event amplification and an adaptive regularization scheme that dynamically balances amplification against estimator stability. We evaluate our approach on $\sim$120M and $\sim$2.6B models across three event families spanning 300+ rare events as rare as $10^{-9}$, with reference probabilities computed with $<10\%$ relative standard error. In our most verifiable settings, we observe that our IS estimator achieves over $800\times$ compute-weighted efficiency gains over naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities lower than $10^{-7}$. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/namkoong-lab/iterative-unalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的重要性采样方法，通过扰动模型权重构建可微参数化的提议分布，用于估计智能体随机输出轨迹中极稀有事件的概率。
AI.motivation: 智能体自主性增强后，即使极罕见的事件也可能发生并造成灾难性后果，安全部署的关键在于估计这些事件发生的频率。但这类风险评估需要搜索组合爆炸的轨迹空间，朴素蒙特卡洛计算代价过高，而有效的IS提议分布需要对上下文依赖的条件分布链进行协调改变。
AI.method: 提出一种新的重要性采样方法：通过扰动原始模型的权重来构建提议分布，该提议本身是一个可微参数化的语言模型，从而支持基于梯度的权重空间搜索。设计了一个结合事件放大的可微代理目标与自适应正则化方案的优化目标，动态平衡放大效果与估计器稳定性。
AI.result: 在约1.2亿和26亿参数模型上评估，覆盖3类事件家族、300多个低至10^{-9}的稀有事件，参考概率计算相对标准误差小于10%。在可验证设置中，对于概率低于10^{-7}的事件，IS估计器相比朴素蒙特卡洛实现了超过800倍的计算加权效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能高效估计智能体随机轨迹中的极稀有事件概率，显著优于朴素蒙特卡洛，为智能体安全部署的风险评估提供了可行工具。

title: LoRA-generating hypernetworks for efficient on-device LLM generative personalization
summary: On-device large language models (`LLMs'), e.g. running on mobile phones, are ripe for improvement via personalization. The limited compute resources of mobile devices impose limits on model scale and thus model quality, making any realizable quality gains highly impactful. At the same time, their personal nature (i.e., the close coupling to a particular user) means that a given on-device LLM tends to be used in similar, predictable patterns over the course of time. This paper presents a novel method for personalizing on-device LLMs. It trains a hypernetwork to map a user's context tokens to a low-rank adaptation (`LoRA') well-suited to that user. Once the trained common artifacts are deployed to users' devices, each user uses the hypernetwork to synthesize (entirely on device) a personalized LoRA. This approach blends the benefits while avoiding the drawbacks of two existing approaches to LLM customization: in-context learning (`ICL') and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (`PEFT'). Like ICL (and unlike PEFT), the on-device phase of our approach is computationally feasible, requiring only forward passes through neural networks. Like PEFT (and unlike ICL), our approach modifies the `target' base LLM via weights (the LoRA), avoiding negative consequences (e.g. increased latency) associated with extending the input sequence. Our approach is particularly well-suited to the mobile device regime. Apart from the on-device compute and latency benefits mentioned, it also requires minimal additional storage, as internally its architecture partly leverages the same LLM weights as belong to the target LLM to be personalized. We demonstrate the benefits of LoRA-generating hypernetworks on several representative personalization datasets, comparing against baselines like ICL and PEFT. Of note, our personalization experiments focus on more challenging and less studied long-form text generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出用超网络根据用户上下文生成个性化LoRA，在设备端实现LLM个性化，兼具ICL与PEFT优点。
AI.motivation: 移动端LLM算力受限导致模型规模与质量受限，但用户使用模式相似且可预测，个性化收益显著。现有ICL增加序列长度带来延迟，PEFT设备端计算不可行。
AI.method: 训练超网络将用户上下文token映射为适配该用户的低秩适配(LoRA)。部署后，用户在设备端仅通过前向传播合成个性化LoRA，用于修改基础LLM权重。架构部分复用目标LLM权重以减少存储。
AI.result: 在多个代表性个性化数据集上与ICL和PEFT基线对比，验证LoRA生成超网络的有效性，尤其聚焦于更具挑战且研究较少的长文本生成任务。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适合移动设备场景：设备端计算与延迟低、存储需求小，融合ICL与PEFT优势，为移动端LLM个性化提供可行方案。
